metadata.title: 插件中英文查询
metadata.notice: 索引包含7,664个插件、17类、7,748条分类关系，短中文介绍齐全。初始1,015项扩展介绍保留原状态，其中85项旧来源核验，894项历史恢复未重新核验，另36项旧有扩展未核验；历史介绍中5项不完整。其余6,649项均已尝试核对：5,363项取得完整同ID公开说明，1,286项未取得完整核验详情（743项正文未取得、436项仅条目线索、60项正文不完整、45项候选缺ID关联、2项说明未提供充分功能详情）。当前扩展介绍6378项，不代表全部已核验或插件当前可用。厂商候选补充另列，不计本插件详情。原图审计7628成功、31失败、5跳过，现221项附带离线原图。 原先跳过的5个原SVG已另行实际渲染通过，合计7633项曾成功显示，31项未取得；联网可用性可能变化。

plugins.overview_zh: 这是一款购物优惠发现工具，覆盖食品、家居日用品、服装、宠物用品、电子产品和饮料等。官方示例包括根据购物小票查促销，以及购买前寻找可领取的奖励。它的定位是汇集优惠信息，不能据此认定每张小票都符合活动资格、一定能收到返奖，或可在聊天中付款。适用国家、兑换规则、奖励到账时间和具体资格尚未公布在该介绍中。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A shopping-offer discovery app covering groceries, household goods, clothing, pet supplies, electronics and drinks. Its examples include using a purchase receipt to look for promotions and checking rewards before buying. The description promises a consolidated offer catalogue, not proof that a particular receipt qualifies, a reward will be paid, or checkout is handled in chat. Eligibility, countries, redemption rules and payout timing are not specified.

plugins.description_zh: 在阿联酋订购 % Arabica 咖啡
plugins.overview_zh: 面向 % Arabica 阿联酋加盟体系的点单助手，由 Emirates Digitals 代表 Emirates Hospitality Restaurant Management LLC 发布。可询问菜单、定制饮品、提前安排取餐、重复购买常点饮品并累计积分，官方说明包括到店取餐和路边车内取餐。这里没有确认阿联酋以外地区、送货服务、支付方式或取消规则，仍需按具体门店与订单核对。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: An ordering assistant for the UAE franchise of % Arabica, published by Emirates Digitals for Emirates Hospitality Restaurant Management LLC. It supports menu questions, drink customization, advance pickup scheduling, repeat orders and loyalty points, with walk-in collection and curbside car pickup described. The page does not establish availability outside the UAE, delivery service, payment methods or cancellation terms; these must be checked for the chosen store and order.

It does not specify export formats, commercial licensing, quotas or whether a design becomes a deployed website; those should not be inferred from the visual-generation description.

plugins.description_zh: 与 ChatGPT 一起锻炼大脑
plugins.overview_zh: 这是在聊天中进行记忆、词汇和专注力练习的小游戏工具，官方还展示了“找出不同项”的玩法。比较适合轻量练习或休闲，而不是标准化能力测评。页面没有说明评分体系、长期进步记录、自适应难度或临床效果，不能把产品名称和宣传理解成已经验证的智力或认知提升。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A conversational collection of brain-training activities. The examples focus on recall, vocabulary, concentration and an Odd One Out game, so it is most clearly positioned as casual practice rather than assessment. No standardized scoring, progress history, adaptive difficulty or clinical benefit is documented. The name and promotional language are not evidence of a measured improvement in intelligence or cognition.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找食谱、烘焙、餐食和备餐方案
plugins.overview_zh: 把用户想做的菜或烘焙配方展示成聊天内的食谱组件，示例包括苹果派、橙汁鸭和肉酱意面，也可先让助手推荐菜谱。已经说明的是食谱展示能力，不是操控厨房电器、采购食材或进行饮食安全审核。份量换算、过敏原检查、营养数据和食谱来源范围均未在详情中明确。

Users can ask for a dish or a cooking/baking suggestion, with examples ranging from apple pie to duck à l'orange and spaghetti bolognese. The described function is presenting recipes, not controlling appliances, purchasing ingredients or validating dietary safety. Serving-size adjustment, allergen checks, nutrition data and recipe-source coverage are not specified.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 ChatGPT 创建和使用清单
plugins.overview_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中创建、整理和查看清单。官方示例涵盖蛋糕原料、电影推荐、旅行打包检查，以及按完成速度重排当天待办，重点是把对话内容变成便于使用的列表。详情没有证明它会同步外部任务管理器、发送提醒、支持多人共同编辑或永久保存清单，因此不能把这些额外功能一并算入。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates and works with lists inside ChatGPT. The page illustrates ingredient lists, movie recommendations, travel packing checks and ordering a daily to-do list by how quickly tasks can be finished. These examples show how a list can be organized and reviewed, but do not establish external task-manager synchronization, reminders, shared editing or durable storage. Use it as an in-chat list workflow unless those additional features are separately confirmed.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接已有的 100Hires 招聘账户，读取职位、候选人、申请、面试和评估资料，也能移动候选人阶段、安排面试、记录评价、从简历建立候选人，以及发送模板化邀约或拒绝消息。权限沿用用户现有账户，所以它不是只读报表工具。需要注意这些操作会改变招聘记录或对外发消息；产品描述并不等于允许自动作出录用决定或任意披露候选人资料。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects to an existing 100Hires recruiting account to read jobs, candidates, applications, interviews and evaluations. The connector also describes operational changes: moving application stages, arranging interviews, recording evaluations, creating candidates from resumes and sending template-based outreach or rejection messages. Access follows the account's existing permissions. Because it can change hiring records and send messages, it is not a read-only reporting app; the description does not authorize autonomous hiring decisions or unrestricted disclosure of candidate data.

plugins.overview_zh: 将财务分析和项目运营放在同一个工作区内处理，而不只是展示仪表盘。可分析余额、收支、交易、账单、承包商结算与成本分类，并搜索项目、任务、评论、成员、报价、价目表和知识库。官方还明确列出创建或修改财务事件、转账记录、报价、任务、评论和 Wiki 内容。它具有写入影响，尤其不能仅凭“transfer”字样就认定已实际从银行账户付款。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A finance-and-project workspace connector rather than a simple dashboard. It can analyze balances, revenue, expenses, transactions, bills, contractor settlements and cost categories, while searching projects, tasks, comments, people, estimates, price lists and Wiki pages. The page also lists creation or editing of financial events, transfers, estimates, tasks, comments and Wiki content. These are consequential workspace changes; the description does not establish that a recorded transfer means a bank payment was actually executed.

plugins.overview_zh: 在聊天中显示可弹奏的钢琴或键盘，并让用户与 AI 讨论演奏表现。示例包括打开键盘、弹熟悉的曲子和尝试自己创作的旋律。官方没有说明是否支持 MIDI 硬件、录音、乐谱导出、系统课程或自动评分，所以更适合按“互动弹奏加交流”理解，不能等同于完整音乐制作软件。

It is therefore best understood as an interactive playing-and-conversation tool, not a fully documented music-production suite.

plugins.description_zh: 星盘、未来和关系匹配解读
plugins.overview_zh: 根据出生日期、时间和地点进行本命盘、1 至 365 天行运、比较盘与组合盘解读，也可研究行运如何作用于关系组合盘。账户最多保存 50 张出生图；不知道出生时间时，会避开依赖宫位的数据，而不是声称精度不变。这些属于占星解释，并非经过科学确认的预测，不应当作健康、财务或重要关系决定的可靠依据。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: An astrology tool using birth date, time and place for natal charts, 1–365-day transits, synastry and composite relationship charts. It can retain up to 50 birth charts under an account and examine transits to a composite chart. If birth time is unknown, it omits house-dependent information rather than claiming the same precision. These are astrological interpretations, not scientifically established forecasts or a reliable basis for consequential health, financial or relationship decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: 用于查询和比较巴士、渡轮、航班、火车及多种交通方式组合的行程。用户可以给出起终点、日期和人数，再按价格、出发时间、币种或推荐顺序比较。已确认的是交通发现与比较流程，详情并未明确保证可在聊天内支付、出票、改签或退款；最终余票和限制仍需按具体行程核对。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches and compares multimodal travel options including buses, ferries, flights and trains. A request can include origin, destination, travel date and passenger count, and the app presents choices that can be sorted by price, departure time, currency or recommendations, including mixed-mode routes. The description supports discovery and comparison; it does not clearly establish in-chat payment, ticket issuance, changes or refunds. Final availability and conditions need checking with the selected itinerary.

plugins.description_zh: 记录智能体收到的指令
plugins.overview_zh: 在代理执行前记录收到的指令与计划动作，执行后再把结果补到同一条可验证防篡改记录中，也能封存记忆并提供公钥、登记戳、见证者及包含性与一致性证明。登记系统定期把日志指纹锚定到 Bitcoin/OpenTimestamps 和 Base，默认公开的是 SHA-256 指纹，正文由用户保留或以用户密钥加密。读取无需登录，写入需要已认证的代理身份；它不转钱，也不调用登记系统外的服务。防篡改证明只能说明记录未被改动，不能证明记录内容本身真实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Records an agent's instruction and intended action before execution, then adds the result to the same tamper-evident record. It also seals memories and exposes public keys, registry stamps, witness information, and inclusion/consistency proofs. The registry periodically anchors log fingerprints to Bitcoin/OpenTimestamps and Base; by default only SHA-256 fingerprints are public, while text stays with the user or is encrypted to their key. Reading needs no login, but writing requires an authenticated registered agent. It moves no money and calls no service outside its registry; integrity proofs do not prove that the recorded claims are true.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: An interactive version of the 2048 tile puzzle. Arrow keys or swipes slide a grid, and matching numbered tiles combine into double their value; the objective is to reach 2048. The page lists animations, score tracking and a best score. It does not specify cross-device saves, online multiplayer, account synchronization or a competitive leaderboard, so those features should not be assumed.

plugins.overview_zh: 把餐饮或接待业务的 20Tabs POS 账户连接到对话式报表与管理流程。可以查询销售、收入、税额、日结月结、客户购买记录、小票、付款信息和商品表现，也能管理商品目录、平面布局和 POS 配置。通过 OAuth 选择授权范围，实际可见与可改内容取决于权限。配置写入可能影响营业，但“读取付款信息”不能理解成已经支持退款或实际转移资金。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects a hospitality business's 20Tabs POS account to conversational reporting and administration. It does not describe managing appointments, invitations or external calendar synchronization. The source uses a product-name URL and provides no recovered bridge to the selected catalogue ID, so it is supplemental information only and this exact plugin remains unverified.

plugins.overview_zh: 从已接入零售商中搜索和比较实物商品，可设置关键词、价格上限、配送国家、库存与商品属性，并显示价格观察时间、寻找更便宜的替代品。AliExpress 的地区目录以用户明确提供的配送国家决定，不根据 IP、VPN 或界面语言推断。插件不会下单或付款，最终条款和购买在商家网站完成；部分链接含联盟归因，官方声明佣金不影响排序，商家和地区范围会动态变化。

It never orders or pays: users review terms and finish purchases on retailer sites. Some links may be affiliate links; the page states commissions do not influence ranking and that retailer/region coverage is dynamic.

plugins.description_zh: 准备……就位……开始！（原文宣传语）
plugins.overview_zh: 在聊天中显示数字式或指针式秒表，并把测得的经过时间交回助手，适合记录简单活动用了多久，再继续讨论。详情没有说明后台持续计时的可靠性、分段记录、设备接入或科研级精度。它是秒表与结果回传工具，不能默认视为预约排程或可靠后台闹钟服务。

This is useful when a discussion depends on how long a simple activity took. The page does not establish background timing reliability, lap history, device integration or precision suitable for scientific measurement. It is a stopwatch display and time-return workflow, not a documented scheduling or alarm service.

plugins.overview_zh: 可在 ChatGPT 内启动可视化倒计时，也能创建全屏网页计时链接；虽然叫“30 Minute Timer”，时长可以用分钟或秒指定。支持背景、进度图标、结束文字、音效类型、中途提醒、重复音效，以及暂停、继续、停止和重启。持久链接不等于后台永远运行，详情没有保证关闭应用或设备后仍会响铃，也没有说明通知权限。

Users can choose backgrounds, progress icons, ending text, sound family, halfway alerts and repeat sound, plus pause, resume, stop and restart controls. The description does not guarantee alarms after an app/device is closed or permission to send notifications; a persistent link is not proof of an always-running background timer.

plugins.overview_zh: 面向企业管理员的严格只读 CRM 连接，可查看线索、客户、交易、销售管道、预约、会话运营元数据、已存 Meta 广告数据、WhatsApp 活动汇总和限定范围的业务报表。数据仅限 OAuth 授权绑定的公司，不能修改、分配、预订、取消、发消息、启动活动、刷新或切换租户。正文消息、附件、临床和预约备注、凭据、收件名单、广告受众及创意详情不会返回，但所请求的 CRM 记录可能包含联系人姓名、电话或邮箱。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A strictly read-only CRM connection for company administrators. It reviews leads, customers, deals, pipelines, bookings, conversation operational metadata, stored Meta ad data, WhatsApp campaign aggregates and bounded business reports within the company tied to the OAuth grant. It cannot edit, assign, book, cancel, send, launch, refresh or switch tenants. Message bodies, attachments, clinical/appointment notes, credentials, recipient lists and advertising creative/audience details are excluded, although requested CRM records may include contact name, phone or email.

plugins.description_zh: 创建阿拉伯语设计和音频
plugins.overview_zh: 根据模板、文字和颜色制作可编辑的阿拉伯语动态图形设计，再到 3aqel 预览、修改并申请导出。创建设计无需账户且免费，但分享链接七天后失效，聊天工具本身不渲染视频也不发送邮件。配音是另一条需要连接既有账户的流程：选择声音与方言、确认最多 500 字符的脚本，再领取生成音频；会消耗账户额度，方言表现可能有差异。

Design creation is free without an account, but share links expire after seven days; the chat tool itself neither renders video nor emails it. Voiceovers are a separate authenticated workflow using a catalogue voice/dialect and an approved script up to 500 characters. Audio generation consumes the account's allowance and dialect delivery can vary.

plugins.overview_zh: 面向丹麦建筑和翻修项目的工匠对接服务。用户描述需求并附照片，可从 ChatGPT 把任务直接提交给 3byggetilbud.dk，范围包括厨房浴室、屋顶、涂装、门窗、电工、水暖、木工、热泵、太阳能和扩建。提交意味着把项目资料交给服务方，不代表承包商已经接单或已形成有约束力的报价。响应时间、费用和合同规则未在插件介绍中详述。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A Danish construction/refurbishment matching service. Users describe a job, attach photographs and submit it directly to 3byggetilbud.dk from ChatGPT, covering bathrooms, kitchens, roofs, painting, windows, electrical/plumbing work, carpentry, heat pumps, solar panels and extensions. Submission sends project information to the provider; it is not proof that a contractor has accepted the work or that a binding quote exists. Response times, charges and contract terms are not detailed on the plugin page.

plugins.description_zh: 转换 CAD 和三维文件
plugins.overview_zh: 这是配合 Windows 桌面程序 3D CAD Converter 及 cadconvert 命令行使用的技能，可在用户电脑上转换 STEP、IGES、STL、OBJ、FBX、glTF、3MF 等文件，按官方说明不上传源文件。必须区分运行环境：Codex 可以执行命令，而 ChatGPT 只是告诉用户应运行哪条命令。需要先安装桌面程序，不能将它写成无需本地软件的云端转换服务。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A skill for the installed Windows application 3D CAD Converter and its cadconvert command-line tool. It converts formats including STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, FBX, glTF and 3MF on the user's own computer, with files not uploaded by this workflow. Crucially, the page distinguishes surfaces: Codex can run the commands, while ChatGPT tells the user which command to run. The desktop program must already be installed; it is not an in-cloud conversion service.

plugins.overview_zh: 使用三维装箱求解器规划集装箱、卡车或托盘装载。输入数量、尺寸、重量以及易碎、必须直立、不可堆叠等限制后，返回所需箱型、利用率和未能装入的货物，并可旋转查看三维布局，再到 3dpack.ing 调整或导出。需要账户，免费账户含每月一定次数；具体额度、运输预订及装载合规认证并未得到确认。

Input can include quantities, dimensions, weights and constraints such as fragile, upright-only or no stacking; results describe container needs, utilization and items left out. An interactive 3D plan can be opened in 3dpack.ing for adjustment/export. An account is required, with a free monthly packing allowance. The description does not establish transport booking, load certification or the exact quota.

plugins.overview_zh: 独立建立索引的 3GPP 资料研究工具，可查公开规范、会议提案、已记录决定和公司立场，并返回带文件编号、版本及来源链接的短摘录。确认关注对象后，可在 Scout 账户跟踪主题并选择邮件摘要。覆盖范围随版本和工作组变化，提案不等于会议已达成的结论；需要账户并受请求额度限制，插件内不能购买，也不代表获 3GPP 或 ETSI 认可。最终以官方文件为准。

Coverage depends on release and working group, and a proposal must not be confused with an agreed result. An account and request limits apply; purchases are unavailable in the plugin, and the service is not affiliated with or endorsed by 3GPP/ETSI. Official documents remain authoritative.

plugins.overview_zh: 通过 JSON 数据结构建立 REST API，无需手写后端代码。官方列出增删改查、Webhook、沙箱与生产隔离、日志和用量统计，还能测试调用、邀请协作者、部署，以及生成在 WordPress 页面展示端点内容的代码片段。这是会产生写入和部署影响的开发连接，不只是解释代码；账户权限、费用、Webhook 去向和生产环境改动仍需逐项核对。

It can also produce WordPress snippets to display endpoint data. This is an operational development connector with write/deployment effects, not just a code explainer; access, billing, webhook destinations and production changes require separate verification.

plugins.description_zh: 品牌在 AI 回答中的可见度
plugins.overview_zh: 读取 3RD 账户中已配置的品牌 AI 可见度监测，包括品牌、提示词、市场、竞品、被引用网站、内容缺口和建议任务。比较数据有明确时间范围，通常为最近 30 天。它是严格只读的，不会修改账户或替用户建立监测；新增品牌和提示词必须先在 3RD 设置并收集首批回答，之后才有结果可分析。

Comparisons apply to a stated reporting period, usually the preceding 30 days. It is explicitly read-only and does not configure monitoring or change the account. New brands or prompts must be set up in 3RD and collect initial answers before there are results to analyze.

plugins.description_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中使用人脉网络
plugins.overview_zh: 面向私募投资、并购团队和收购型创业基金，把联系人关系洞察与交易管道带入 ChatGPT。可查询联系人、公司、关系路径和交易阶段，也能添加标签、记录备注和移动交易阶段。官方说明每次修改都有预览确认及撤销入口，OAuth 沿用该成员席位已有权限。能找到关系路径不等于已得到引荐许可，也不代表已经发送联络消息。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Brings relationship intelligence and deal pipelines into ChatGPT for private-market investors, M&A teams and search funds. Users can query contacts, companies, relationship paths and deal stages, or add tags, record notes and move deals. Each described change has a preview/confirmation step and an undo option. OAuth respects the individual teammate's existing seat permissions. Access to the CRM is not a guarantee that a suggested introduction is available or that outreach has been sent.

plugins.description_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中使用人脉网络
plugins.overview_zh: 4Degrees 的沙特阿拉伯区域版本，可查询联系人、公司、关系路径与交易管道，也能修改标签、备注和交易阶段。每次写入有预览确认和一键撤销，权限沿用该成员的 OAuth 授权。厂商明确表示数据由 KSA 区域提供并留在该区域。这个地域承诺属于此版本，不能套用到另一个普通版插件，也不能理解成已经做过独立合规审计。

It describes preview-and-confirm for every write and one-tap undo, using the teammate's existing OAuth permissions. The vendor says data is served from and remains in the KSA region. Recorded ROI is not a guaranteed realized saving, and captured suggestions are distinct from approved processes.

Computation is transient, with no lookup, persistent records, sending, transactions or paid model calls. Standalone CSV/JSON review/export stays on the website; MCP requests and responses are capped at 128 KiB and 256 KiB, with additional field/record limits.

plugins.overview_zh: 用于室内混响和吸声计算，不处理房间之间的隔声。可计算 125–4000 Hz 各倍频程混响时间，对照用途标准目标，筛选有实测吸声数据的产品，建议数量并重新计算。基础计算和检索无需账户，保存项目房间、分享、导出品牌 PDF 及查看详细测量变体需要账户。它基于 Sabine 公式与目录测量值，不能替代现场测量或声学顾问设计；不售货，删除房间需在账户内完成。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Models room reverberation and absorption, not sound insulation between rooms. It calculates octave-band reverberation from 125–4000 Hz, compares published room-use targets and searches products with measured absorption, proposing quantities and recalculating the room. Basic calculation/search needs no account; saving project rooms, sharing/exporting a branded PDF and detailed measured variants use an account. It uses Sabine's formula and catalogue measurements, not an on-site measurement or substitute for an acoustic consultant. It sells nothing, and deleting a room is handled in the account rather than the plugin.

plugins.overview_zh: 用确定性规则审核 Meta Ads Manager 导出的 CSV，查创意疲劳、被拒广告、预算节奏及用户给定的盈亏 ROAS、CPA、CPL，返回 0–100 分、修复建议和跳过检查的原因。要求广告级逐日数据且至少七天，不支持其他平台；Meta 归因可能高估购买，缺少商店数据时跳过新客成本。不会连接或修改广告账户；源文件不保存，派生报告保留 14 天，另存 Adcero 账户除外。

It never connects to or edits the account. The file is not stored, but the derived report lasts 14 days unless saved to an Adcero account.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ADoor connects conversational work to shared workspace tables: look up contacts, inspect table structure and record-change history, update permitted records, or create spaces and tables. Existing table and field restrictions still apply. An ADoor account is required, access can be narrowed later, and broader access is requested through a link the user approves in ADoor. This distinction matters before asking it to maintain a shared tracker: a read-only connection cannot silently become a writing one.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: adplane combines live Google Ads and Meta account analysis with advertising changes. It supports period comparisons, search-term inspection and raw GAQL; reported money is already in the account's currency. Google workflows include Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, responsive ads and negatives; Meta workflows include campaigns, ad sets, ads and image/video creatives with previews. New campaigns are created paused, and activation is a separate explicit step that can start spending. Existing budgets, bids, names and statuses can change; deletion is limited to never-spent campaigns, not bulk deletion. Changes are read back from the platform. Adplane plus the advertising accounts are required; Google connection can include every account accessible to that login.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adrio is a Meta-advertising workspace assistant combining creative generation, campaign setup, performance review and competitor-ad research. Its Spark workflow can draft static or video creatives from a product, brand voice and angles; campaign and ad-set preparation can use account history. It can propose scaling, pausing or new tests and organise competitor examples by angle, hook, format or company into swipe boards. The important boundary is approval: the publisher says workspace or Meta changes and credit spending wait for confirmation through cards. An Adrio account is required. Proposals are not guaranteed performance improvements, and this public description was not tested against a connected ad account.

plugins.overview_zh: Adspirer 面向已连接的 Google、Meta、LinkedIn 和 TikTok 广告账户，支持账户与效果分析、关键词及定向研究、转化追踪检查、系列或素材草稿，以及定时报表和阈值提醒。因此既可用于跨平台规划监测，也可能写入投放配置，不能一概视为只读报表工具。公开说明称新系列先处于暂停状态，预算、出价或状态修改需要明确提出，未经确认不会正式上线。实际能力仍受账户权限和平台支持限制；报表准确性、提醒送达及投放成效均未独立实测。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adspirer works across connected Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok advertising accounts. Its published scope includes account and performance analysis, keyword and targeting research, conversion-tracking audits, campaign or creative drafts, scheduled reports and threshold alerts. This makes it a cross-platform planning and monitoring tool as well as a potential campaign-writing interface. New campaigns are paused, and budget, bidding or status changes require an explicit request; the publisher states that campaigns do not go live without confirmation. Connected-account permissions, platform support and the user's approval therefore remain central. Reporting accuracy, alert delivery and advertising results were not independently tested.

plugins.overview_zh: AdStellar 基于团队已连接的 Meta 账户，处理图片或视频素材、结合品牌资料的文案、已同步的系列和广告组及广告数据，并可暂停、恢复、改预算或通过 AI 系列构建器准备上线。持续优化规则会进入审批队列，并不意味着可以绕过人工。发布者说明每项线上变更都先预览和确认，新上线默认暂停，供用户到 Ads Manager 复核。需有 AdStellar 账户和 Meta 连接；同步数据可能与即时平台状态有差异，而获准的预算或启用操作可能产生广告费用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AdStellar uses a connected team's Meta account for creative production, reporting and campaign operations. It can make image/video creatives and brand-kit-aware copy, inspect synced campaign, ad-set and ad performance, pause or resume ads, change budgets and prepare launches through its AI campaign builder. Standing optimisation rules feed an approval queue rather than removing oversight. The publisher describes a preview and confirmation for every live change, with new launches paused by default for review in Ads Manager. An AdStellar account and connected Meta account are required. Synced statistics can differ from immediate platform state, and approved budget or activation changes can incur advertising spend.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Advanza connects to a selected marketing workspace to find and manage contacts, companies and deals, review campaign results and prepare content. An account and workspace membership are required, and connected services and permissions limit available operations. Its published default policy allows reversible workspace changes directly, while deleting or merging records and spending credits require confirmation. Sending, publishing, activating workflows and destructive batches above 100 records require a person to approve in Advanza or on an approval card; organisations can require approval for every change. These are the vendor's product rules, not blanket permission for an assistant to act. Check the selected workspace and approval consequences before modifying shared CRM data.

plugins.overview_zh: AdvenBook 把户外旅行的日期、路线、距离、照片和故事整理成纸质纪念书，并可加入 GPS 地图、海拔曲线及行程统计。公开流程会提供价格和私密预览编辑链接，之后到 AdvenBook 网站下单，提到精装、平装和螺旋装订。它更适合把已完成的徒步或旅行做成纪念册，而不是单纯规划路线。厂商关于就近印制、免运费的说法不代表所有目的地都有保障；最终价格、配送资格、印刷校样和订单确认需要另行核实，本轮没有购买。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AdvenBook turns outdoor-trip material into a printed travel book: dates, routes, distances, photographs and stories can be assembled with GPS maps, elevation profiles and trip statistics. The described workflow offers a price and a private preview/edit link, followed by ordering on AdvenBook's site; hardcover, softcover and spiral formats are mentioned. It is useful for converting a hike or journey into a keepsake rather than simply planning a route. The public description's local-printing and free-shipping claims are not a verified delivery guarantee for every destination. Final price, shipping eligibility, print proof and order confirmation must be checked separately; no book was purchased.

plugins.overview_zh: Advertising Mentor 是付费广告教学与诊断技能，并没有证据表明它直接接管真实广告账户。它可帮助梳理策略、预算、出价、定向、优惠、创意文案、转化测量、实验、漏斗和落地页，也覆盖电商、本地业务及 B2B 的竞品、政策和报告讨论。适合先形成排查逻辑和测试方案，再到实际平台核实规则、追踪与财务假设。不能据此推断它有权上线广告或调整花费，也不能保证盈利；涉及联盟推广的推荐应识别其商业关系，而非默认完全独立。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Advertising Mentor is an instructional skill for planning and reviewing paid advertising, not a demonstrated live ad-account connector. It can help examine strategy, budgets, bidding, targeting, offers, creative and copy, conversion measurement, testing, funnels and landing pages. The scope includes ecommerce, local businesses and B2B, with competitor research, policy considerations and reporting discussion. Use it to structure diagnosis and experiments, then verify platform rules, tracking and financial assumptions in the relevant account. It does not establish permission to launch ads or change spending, and its suggestions cannot guarantee profit. Affiliate-related recommendations should be recognised as such rather than assumed independent.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索 SEC 投资顾问申报文件
plugins.overview_zh: AdvPulse 查询 SEC Form ADV 中的投资顾问机构资料，而不是个人从业者档案。可按机构名称、CRD 编号、州、管理资产规模或类型筛选，也能对 Part 2A 说明书做语义检索；结果可包含所在地、申报 AUM、注册及网站信息、披露标记和 SEC IAPD 来源链接。公开说明称无需账户，但每次最多返回十家机构。应留意申报时间和更新滞后，披露标记只是调查线索，不等于违法判定，AUM 也不是实时余额。它用于公共资料研究，不是个性化投资建议。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AdvPulse searches public SEC Form ADV information about investment-adviser firms, not individual professionals. Queries can use firm name, CRD number, state, assets-under-management range or firm type, and semantic searches can examine Part 2A brochure content. Results can include location, reported AUM, registration and website information, disclosure flags and the SEC IAPD source link. The service returns at most ten firms per search and does not require an account according to the description. Filing dates and reporting lag matter: a disclosure flag is a research lead, not a verdict, and reported AUM is not a live balance. This is public-information research, not personalised investment advice.

The description covers advertising, analytics, ecommerce and CRM sources, including Google and Meta services, Shopify, Amazon, HubSpot, Salesforce and several social-ad platforms. Its value is combining data already accessible through connected accounts rather than manually copying reports. The recovered body supports reporting and analysis, not an assumption that it can publish campaigns or change budgets. Source availability, account permissions, metric definitions and any subscription limits must be checked. This umbrella entry does not verify the separately listed Adzviser connectors or prove that every named source is included in every plan.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser Amazon Seller Central retrieves seller performance for conversational analysis, including sales, orders and product metrics across marketplaces and date ranges. It can compare ordered-product sales, units, sessions and Buy Box percentage, with breakdowns such as ASIN, SKU, marketplace and fulfilment channel. This is useful for finding which products or markets explain a change in sales without manually assembling several reports. The description does not establish listing edits, refunds or order execution. Interpret results using the connected seller account's permissions, source reporting delays and metric definitions; a sales movement alone does not identify its cause. No Amazon account or live data was connected in this check.

plugins.overview_zh: Adzviser CallRail 分析电话追踪数据，包括总来电、首次来电、已接与未接、通话时长及时间比较，并可按追踪号码、来源、活动或坐席拆分，适合检查线索承接和营销贡献。它的证据范围是报表查询，不能据此认定能拨打电话或读取所有录音。可见数据取决于 CallRail 权限和归因规则，来电数量也不直接等于线索质量或收入。排查漏接时应回看原始记录、统一时间区间；本轮没有拨号或执行账户操作。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser CallRail analyses call-tracking performance: total and first-time calls, answered and missed calls, duration and comparisons over time. It can break results down by tracking number, source, campaign or agent, helping a team examine lead handling and marketing contribution. This is a reporting interface, not evidence of telephone-calling capability or access to every call recording. Connected CallRail permissions and attribution rules determine available data, and call volume does not by itself establish lead quality or revenue. Use source records to investigate missed calls and reconcile time periods before drawing operational conclusions; no actual call or account action was performed.

plugins.description_zh: 通过对话探索 CallTrackingMetrics 数据
plugins.overview_zh: Adzviser CallTrackingMetrics 通过对话分析电话与短信营销追踪数据，涵盖数量、已接和未接、时长及转化，并可比较时间段，按追踪号码、来源、活动或坐席拆分，帮助区分获客量问题与响应或转化问题。公开内容不证明能外呼、发送短信或无限制读取录音。结果受连接账户权限、追踪和归因口径影响，转化数据应与业务主系统核对。本轮未发送通信，也未测试路由或追踪配置修改。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser CallTrackingMetrics provides conversational analysis of tracked call and text marketing activity. Its description covers volume, answered and missed calls, duration and conversions, compared across time and broken down by tracking number, source, campaign or agent. This can help distinguish an acquisition-volume issue from a response or conversion problem. It does not establish outbound calling, SMS sending or unrestricted recording access. Results depend on connected-account permissions and the service's tracking and attribution definitions; reported conversions should be reconciled with the business system of record. No live communications or changes to routing and tracking settings were tested.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser Klaviyo reports on email and SMS campaigns and automated flows, including opens, clicks, unsubscribes, conversions and attributed revenue. Comparisons can be organised by campaign, flow, message or list across selected dates, making it useful for reviewing which messaging programmes deserve investigation. The documented scope is performance retrieval and analysis, not permission to send messages, edit flows or alter subscription status. Attribution is not proof that a message caused the entire reported revenue; privacy features and metric definitions can also affect interpretation. Only connected, permitted Klaviyo data should be assumed available, and no sending workflow was exercised.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser MNTN retrieves connected-TV advertising metrics such as spend, reach, impressions, completed views, visits, conversions and cost per visit. It supports comparisons across dates and breakdowns by campaign or creative, so teams can examine delivery and response without reconstructing reports manually. The public description supports reporting, not creating campaigns or changing their budgets. Conversion and visit attribution should be read under MNTN's definitions rather than treated as a causal experiment or a guaranteed return. Access, source delays and available dimensions depend on the connected account; no advertising spend or platform change was made.

plugins.description_zh: 通过对话探索 PageSpeed 数据
plugins.overview_zh: Adzviser PageSpeed Insights 把网页性能报告转成可对话分析的结果，涵盖性能、无障碍、最佳实践、SEO 评分，以及 LCP、CLS、INP 等核心网页指标，并可比较单页在移动端与桌面端的表现。适合确定技术排查优先级、解释加载慢或布局跳动，但不是自动修复网站的证据；无障碍评分也不等于完整审计或合规认证。实验室测试与真实用户数据可能来自不同条件和人群，采取开发措施前应核对报告类型与目标页面。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser PageSpeed Insights turns page-performance reports into conversational analysis. It covers performance, accessibility, best-practice and SEO scores, plus Core Web Vitals such as LCP, CLS and INP, with mobile and desktop comparisons for individual pages. This can help prioritise technical investigation and explain why a page feels slow or unstable. The connector is a reporting aid, not evidence of automatically repairing a site, and an accessibility score is not a complete accessibility audit or legal certification. Lab tests and field data may describe different populations or conditions; confirm the report type and page before making development decisions.

plugins.description_zh: 通过对话探索 Search Ads 360 数据
plugins.overview_zh: Adzviser Search Ads 360 分析已连接的跨搜索引擎广告数据，包括花费、展示、点击、点击率、单次点击成本、转化和 ROAS，可按广告主、引擎账户、系列、广告组或关键词拆分并比较时间段，适合统一审阅多引擎表现。描述证实的是分析查询，而非修改出价、预算或启用广告。比较时需统一币种、归因、时区及数据延迟，归因 ROAS 也不等于可保证的增量利润。实际访问仍以 Search Ads 360 的账户权限为限。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser Search Ads 360 reports across connected search-advertising engines, with spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions and ROAS. It can compare dates and segment by advertiser, engine account, campaign, ad group or keyword, which is useful when reconciling multi-engine search performance. The description establishes analytics retrieval, not changes to bids, budgets or campaign activation. Keep currency, attribution settings, time zones and reporting lag aligned when comparing accounts, and do not interpret attributed ROAS as guaranteed incremental profit. Actual access remains limited by the connected Search Ads 360 account and its permissions.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adzviser Snapchat Ads retrieves Snapchat advertising results for period comparisons and campaign, ad-squad or ad-level breakdowns. Supported metrics include spend, impressions, swipe-ups and their rate, video views, cost per result, conversions and ROAS. It can support creative and funnel diagnosis by showing where reported results differ, but it does not establish creative uploads, campaign edits or budget control. Metric definitions, attribution windows and connected-account permissions matter, especially when comparing Snapchat with another platform. The public page describes reporting functionality only; no connected account, spend change or performance guarantee was tested.

plugins.description_zh: 通过对话探索 Sprout Social 数据
plugins.overview_zh: Adzviser Sprout Social 分析已连接社交资料和已发布内容，涵盖账号增长、展示、互动率、粉丝、点击及发帖数量，并支持日期比较和按平台、账号或帖子拆分，便于跨渠道复盘内容。不能由此推断可发帖、回复用户或修改社交账户。不同平台的互动定义与数据可用性可能不同，不宜不加区分地合并比较。范围限于 Sprout Social 连接账户获准的数据，本轮没有发布或修改社交内容。

Date comparisons and breakdowns by network, profile or post help teams review content performance across channels. This is not evidence that the connector can publish posts, reply to people or modify social accounts. Differences in network metrics and data availability should be preserved rather than combined as though all engagement measures were equivalent. Only the connected Sprout Social account's permitted data is in scope, and no social content was posted or changed.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AegeanBot Direct Stays helps find Greek holiday rentals using verified property information, current availability, policies, exact prices and direct-booking links. A useful request should specify real travel dates and guest details so the quoted option can be checked against those requirements rather than inferred from a generic listing. It is a discovery and booking-link workflow, not proof that a reservation or payment has been completed inside the chat. Availability and prices can change before checkout, while cancellation, occupancy and property-specific rules still need review on the final booking page. No accommodation was reserved during this check.

plugins.description_zh: 追踪 AI 搜索可见度
plugins.overview_zh: AEO/GEO by VibeSEO 跟踪品牌在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Google AI Mode 和 AI Overviews 中的出现情况，比较提及量、声量占比和位置，查看引用网页、情绪与依据，并寻找竞品提及及爬虫访问问题。它不仅能读报告，也能重新检查已跟踪问题、管理主题和竞品、控制项目内的每日监测，因此不完全是只读工具。必须有 VibeSEO 账户及相应功能权限。结果属于所抽样问题的观测，不保证所有用户看到相同回答，也不保证排名改善；修改主题与监测会改变工作区配置。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AEO/GEO by VibeSEO tracks a brand's presence in ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews. It compares mentions, share of voice and mention position, identifies cited sites and pages, examines sentiment and evidence, and highlights competitor mentions or crawler-access issues. Beyond reading reports, it can run fresh checks for tracked questions, manage topics and competitors and control daily monitoring within VibeSEO projects. An account with access to the requested features is required. These sampled observations are not a guarantee that every user sees the same answer or that rankings will improve; changing tracked topics and monitoring also changes the workspace rather than merely reading it.

plugins.description_zh: 运行自己的定时智能体
plugins.overview_zh: Aeon 是公开开源 aeonfun/aeon 框架的配置和操作技能，通过用户 GitHub 仓库中的 GitHub Actions 定时运行技能。它可指导初始化、启停技能、调整日程与行为、排查未触发任务、维护 STRATEGY.md，并把历史编程代理对话整理为候选技能。页面明确称最适合在 Codex 中配合本地仓库使用，依赖仓库的 ./aeon 命令以及 git、gh；对话挖掘被描述为只在用户机器本地读取、不上传。这是特定第三方框架，不证明纯浏览器就能运行，也不自动授予 GitHub 或本地会话文件的访问权。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Aeon is a setup and operator skill for the public open-source aeonfun/aeon framework, which runs scheduled skills in a user's GitHub repository through GitHub Actions. It can guide initial setup, enable or disable skills, edit schedules and behaviour, diagnose missed runs, maintain STRATEGY.md and turn past coding-agent chats into potential skills. The description says it works best in Codex with a local repository checkout, using the repo's ./aeon CLI, git and gh. Chat mining is described as local to the user's machine, not uploaded. This is a named third-party framework; the listing does not prove a browser-only workflow, automatic GitHub access or permission to read local transcripts.

plugins.overview_zh: Aerion 连接已认证的项目与人员运营数据，将工时、人员安排、审批和分析放在对话中，可查找和检查获准记录、创建或修改记录、提交自己的工时，并在角色有权时批准条目。这属于实际业务操作，不只是只读仪表盘，项目、日期或审批身份选错会影响共享记录。可用动作由组织及角色决定，不能默认能看所有员工工时或批准他人记录。页面没有证明薪资结算、付款或无限制人事访问；本轮未修改记录。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Aerion connects authenticated project and workforce operations, combining time tracking, staffing, approvals and analytics. It can inspect and locate permitted records, create or update them, submit the user's time and approve entries where the current role allows it. This is operational access, not just a read-only dashboard, so a wrong project, date or approver context can affect shared records. The authenticated organisation and role determine available actions; access to every employee's time or authority to approve others should not be assumed. Payroll calculation, payment execution and unrestricted personnel access are not established by the description, and no records were changed in this research.

plugins.description_zh: 为 PR 提供 AI 安全审查
plugins.overview_zh: Aevral 是安装 GitHub App 的配置技能，实际在厂商服务器审查拉取请求，并非本地代码扫描器。PR 审查涵盖访问控制、业务逻辑、注入、XSS、SSRF、路径穿越、不安全反序列化、令牌会话及大模型集成风险，并给出由人应用的修复建议。安装后下一个 PR 即可被审查，不必先登录控制台；结果只是建议，不会阻止合并。可选全仓库扫描范围更窄，仅涉及授权、IDOR 和业务逻辑访问控制；仅支持 GitHub，不等同通用 SAST、密钥或依赖扫描，也不检测内存破坏。发现仍需验证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Aevral is a setup skill for installing a GitHub App that reviews pull requests on the vendor's servers, not a local code scanner. PR reviews look for access-control and business-logic flaws plus issues such as injection, XSS, SSRF, traversal, unsafe deserialisation, token/session problems and LLM-integration risks, with suggested fixes for a person to apply. After installation, the next PR can be reviewed even before console sign-in; reviews are advisory and never block merging. The optional whole-repository scan is narrower: authorisation, IDOR and business-logic access control only. It is GitHub-only, not a general SAST, secret/dependency scanner or memory-corruption scanner. Findings still need validation.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AfAMax Property Calculations performs indicative calculations for German residential-property depreciation, remaining useful life and associated annual or monthly tax effects. It can also estimate land/building allocation using the stated BMF method, validate inputs and return assumptions, limitations and attribution. The publisher presents the service as free, read-only and idempotent, rather than a tool that files a return or changes property records. Outputs are non-binding estimates, not a valuation report or personalised tax/legal advice; purchase details, eligible costs, dates and applicable treatment need professional verification. A calculated result does not establish entitlement to a deduction or acceptance by a tax authority.

plugins.overview_zh: AFerry 提供渡轮航线搜索、比较与预订入口，页面宣传覆盖全球超过 100 家运营商和 4,000 条航线，并举出步行乘客、汽车及携犬出行的查询场景。适合先筛选路线和乘客条件，但网络规模不保证每班船或每种车辆、宠物组合都可售。正文没有详述付款在哪一步完成，也没有给出所有船公司的票价、行李、宠物和退改规定。付款前应核实具体班次、总价和条款；本轮没有购票。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AFerry offers a conversational route to searching, comparing and booking ferry crossings. The description advertises coverage of more than 100 operators and 4,000 crossings worldwide, with examples involving foot passengers, cars and dogs. It is useful for narrowing route and passenger requirements before reviewing a fare, but the advertised network size does not guarantee that every sailing or vehicle/pet combination is available. The body does not explain exactly where checkout finishes or every carrier's fare, luggage, pet and cancellation rules. Confirm the particular sailing, total price and terms before payment; no ticket purchase was made.

plugins.overview_zh: Affinity 将关系型 CRM 工作带入对话，可查询联系人、公司和商机，根据笔记及互动历史准备会议，并更新获准记录。上下文可包括已在 Affinity 记录的邮件、会议和关系信息，便于整理会前简报，但不能把联系人数据库当成所有通信的完整档案。访问受已连接工作区和权限限制，描述不证明可以无限制读取私密资料，也不意味着有权对外发消息。修改共享关系记录前应确认联系人与公司身份；本轮未连接账户或编辑记录。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Affinity connects relationship-focused CRM work to conversation: search people, companies and deals, prepare for meetings from notes and interaction history, and update permitted records. The context can include logged email or meeting interactions and relationship information already captured in Affinity. This helps assemble a briefing without treating a contact database as a complete record of every communication. Access remains subject to the connected workspace and permissions; the description does not establish unrestricted visibility into private CRM data or authority to send outreach. Changes to shared relationship records should be checked for the correct person and company. No account connection or record edit was tested.

plugins.overview_zh: AfterShip Post-Purchase 查询订单与运输信息、配送时间线和异常，以及退货/RMA 的商品、处理结果和退款进度；经用户确认，还可对正确识别的记录执行重新追踪停滞包裹、设置最终配送状态、批准、接收或解决退货等操作。因此它不只是被动查快递，动作还受组织和角色权限约束。更改记录或看到退款进度，不等于承运人确已送达或资金实际划转。涉及后果的操作前需核实订单、运单和退货对象；本轮未修改任何状态。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AfterShip Post-Purchase retrieves shipment and order information, delivery timelines and exceptions, and return/RMA details including items, outcomes and refund progress. With the user's confirmation it can act on correctly identified records, including retracking stalled shipments, setting final delivery status and approving, receiving or resolving returns. Organisation and role permissions constrain these actions, so this is not merely a passive parcel lookup. Updating a record or seeing refund progress does not prove that a carrier delivered an item or that money was actually transferred. Check the intended order, shipment and return before consequential changes; no return or delivery status was modified here.

plugins.overview_zh: AGAPES Studio 用经文、历史译本和原文参考资料辅助圣经研究，所述资源包括 KJV、Reina-Valera 1909、希伯来语、亚兰语和希腊语词汇及 Strong 编号，以及 Matthew Henry、John Gill、Geneva、Scofield 等经典注释。适合比较措辞和研究解释背景，但不代表涵盖所有译本或学术观点。厂商称其为精选资料、自托管于欧盟且零保留的服务，这些是发布者说法，不是独立隐私审计。引用、语言学和神学判断仍应回查所标版本与原文。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AGAPES Studio supports biblical study through canonical passages, historical translations and original-language references. The described resources include the King James Version and Reina-Valera 1909, Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek terms with Strong's identifiers, and classic commentaries such as Matthew Henry, John Gill, Geneva and Scofield. It is suited to comparing wording and examining interpretive context, not declaring that all translations or scholarly viewpoints are represented. The publisher describes a curated, EU-hosted service with zero retention; those are provider claims, not an independent privacy audit. Check quotations and linguistic or theological conclusions against the cited text and edition.

plugins.overview_zh: AgencyAnalytics 将代理公司已连接客户的 SEO、付费广告、社交、邮件、电话追踪和电商报告带入对话，页面称有超过 85 种集成，并可跨客户比较，同时沿用既有权限，只显示获准客户。适合准备客户会议或汇总渠道表现，减少导出多份报表。其“无需登录”“始终准确及时”等宣传不证明完全不需认证或数据绝无延迟，因为仍依赖已连接集成和权限，刷新频率及源指标定义也重要。正文证实的是报告与洞察，不是任意编辑客户营销账户。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AgencyAnalytics brings an agency's connected client-reporting data into conversation across SEO, paid advertising, social, email, call tracking and ecommerce. The page advertises more than 85 integrations and cross-client comparisons while preserving existing permissions, so users should see only authorised clients. This can help prepare a client call or summarise channel performance without exporting multiple dashboards. Its promotional wording about no login and always-current accuracy does not prove zero authentication or perfect data: connected integrations and existing permissions still matter, as do refresh delays and source definitions. The body establishes reporting and insights, not unrestricted edits to clients' marketing accounts.

plugins.description_zh: 将图片转化为日历事件
plugins.overview_zh: Agenda Hero 可浏览日历和事件细节，把赛程、简报或议程批量转成事件，并调整时间、地点和描述，或移除取消的活动。变更可同步到使用 Google、Apple 或 Outlook 的订阅者，适合维护共享日程，避免反复发送更新清单。同步也是关键影响：修改或删除可能改变别人的日历，不只是私人草稿。写入前应确认目标日历、订阅人、日期和账户权限；公开描述未保证同步时效或具体通知行为。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agenda Hero lets users browse calendars and event details, create multiple events from material such as sports schedules, newsletters or agendas, and update event times, locations and descriptions or remove cancelled entries. Changes can propagate to subscribers using Google, Apple or Outlook calendars, making it useful for maintaining a shared schedule rather than repeatedly circulating revised lists. That propagation is also the key risk: changing or deleting an event may affect other people's calendars, not just a private draft. Verify the intended calendar, subscribers, dates and account permissions before writes. The public description does not guarantee delivery timing or subscriber notification behaviour.

plugins.overview_zh: Agenda+ | Business 为沙龙、诊所等服务型商家提供只读查询，可查看当天预约、搜索客户并获取当日摘要，适合快速了解营业安排。关键限制是只读：公开描述没有证明能创建、改期或取消预约；提到诊所也不代表可读病历或提供医疗决策。结果范围取决于连接的商家与权限，客户资料应只用于获准任务。本轮没有修改预约或客户记录。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agenda+ | Business provides a read-only conversational view for service businesses such as salons and clinics. Its documented functions are looking up today's appointments, searching clients and obtaining a daily summary, useful for a quick operational briefing. The important limitation is read-only access: the description does not establish creating, moving or cancelling bookings. It also does not prove access to clinical records or medical decision support merely because clinics are mentioned. Available results depend on the connected business and its permissions, and customer details should be used only for the authorised task. No appointment or customer record was changed.

plugins.overview_zh: Agent Calendars 是规划技能，把目标、项目或活动拆成建议时间线，标明里程碑、依赖、研究轮次、不确定性与审批窗口，适合把搬家、旅行或发布准备分散到可管理的阶段。0.1 版本明确只做规划，输出供审阅的日历建议，不会自行排入日历、发送消息、购买或授权动作。因此示例中的预订、找优惠只是规划情境，不代表有自主订票能力；真正写日历或购买仍需用户或另行获准的执行工具处理。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Calendars is a planning skill that translates a goal, project or event into a proposed timeline with milestones, dependencies, research rounds, uncertainties and approval windows. It can be useful for spreading a move, trip or launch across manageable preparation stages. Version 0.1 is explicitly planning-only: it prepares reviewable calendar proposals and does not schedule events, send messages, purchase anything or authorise actions on its own. Example requests about bookings or bargain hunting therefore describe planning context, not autonomous booking powers. A user or separately authorised execution tool must review and perform any real calendar or purchasing action.

plugins.description_zh: 成员查询与 DMV 工具
plugins.overview_zh: Agent Community 支持按已知成员的精确名称或路径查询、查看社区规模，并核验实时 DMV 证书签发情况；另提供明确免费且不具约束力的 .agent 名称预登记。它不是全量模糊搜索引擎，预登记也不等于拥有域名或保证获配，该顶级域仍受 ICANN 流程影响。证书和成员信息应按该服务语境理解，不应混同政府许可。登记与只读查询属于不同操作，本轮没有替用户登记名称。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Community supports precise lookups of known members by exact name or slug, a current community-size check, and verification of live DMV certificate issuance. It also offers an explicitly free, non-binding preregistration workflow for .agent names. It is not a broad directory search engine, and preregistration is not ownership or a guarantee that a domain will be granted: the proposed top-level domain remains subject to ICANN processes. Certificate or member information should be read in the service's defined context rather than confused with government licensing. Any registration step should be distinguished from a read-only lookup, and no name was registered during this check.

plugins.description_zh: 构建更安全、更出色的 AI 智能体
plugins.overview_zh: Agent Consent Patterns 是设计或检查代理权限、审批体验的建议技能，重点包括最小权限、无障碍控件和有意义的人工监督，例如审阅客服邮箱连接流程，或检查审批对话框的范围与易用性。它可以帮助把模糊同意改成更清楚的用户选择，但公开正文较简短，没有说明完整审计方法。它提供指导，不会直接授予权限、安装策略或认证安全与法律合规；真实访问控制和确认要求仍须另行实现与测试。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Consent Patterns is an advisory skill for reviewing or designing agent permission and approval experiences. Its stated focus is least privilege, accessible controls and meaningful human oversight; examples include evaluating a customer-support inbox connection flow or checking an approval dialogue for scope and usability problems. It can help turn vague consent into clearer user choices, but the public description is brief and does not specify a complete audit methodology. This is guidance, not a tool that grants permissions, installs policies or certifies security or legal compliance. Real access controls and the applicable confirmation requirements still have to be implemented and tested separately.

plugins.description_en: 整理你的筆記與學習知識
plugins.overview_zh: Agent KB 把个人知识笔记接入对话，可创建、读取、更新和删除自己的私密笔记，并在账户具备成员权限时访问教学材料；页面提到 Google 连接及与网页服务同步，适合在两端维护学习或工作笔记。个人笔记所有权与课程资料访问资格是不同边界，连接并不意味着所有课程或其他用户笔记都可读。删除和编辑会改变已保存内容，而不是仅生成聊天草稿；本轮没有修改笔记。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent KB connects an individual's knowledge notes with conversational search and maintenance. It can create, read, update and delete the user's own private notes and access teaching material where the account's membership grants permission. The description mentions Google connection and synchronisation with the web service, making it useful for keeping personal study or working notes available in both places. Ownership of personal notes and entitlement to teaching material are separate boundaries; connecting does not make all courses or other users' notes accessible. Deletion and edits change stored content rather than merely drafting a response, and no notes were modified in this check.

plugins.description_zh: 制作游戏化培训幻灯片
plugins.overview_zh: Agent Kunjani 把培训需求制作成经 Kunjani 在 WhatsApp 使用的游戏化学习卡组：先确定并批准学习目标，再围绕 Jolt、Advance、Mystery、Oops、Explain、Demonstrate 六类活动编写内容、答案和评分说明。用户可列出和编辑权限内的活动及目标、更新卡组，并通过 Kunjani 账户发布，学员随后在 WhatsApp 学习。适合结构化微学习，但题目和评分仍需专业复核。发布卡组不等于获准向任何第三方发消息，账户连接也不代表能管理所有培训资源。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Kunjani turns a training brief into a gamified learning deck for WhatsApp delivery through Kunjani. The described workflow starts by defining and approving learning outcomes, then develops six activity types: Jolt, Advance, Mystery, Oops, Explain and Demonstrate, with answers and grading guidance. Users can list and edit their permitted activities and outcomes, update decks and publish through a Kunjani account; learners then play in WhatsApp. It is useful for structured microlearning, but generated questions and grading still require subject review. Publishing a deck is distinct from permission to message third parties, and account access does not imply authority over every training resource.

plugins.description_zh: 协调智能体在同一代码仓库工作
plugins.overview_zh: Agent Parley 通过独立 Git worktree、编号任务认领及同伴可见进度，协调多个编程代理在同一仓库工作。其 MCP 文件预留只是协作约定，不是操作系统文件锁，参与者忽略约定时仍可能冲突。流程包括交接与接收、提交检查及剩余事项总结，但这些状态是代理报告，不是代码正确性的独立证明；还需要单独安装 CLI 和合适仓库环境。它是协作辅助，不能替代测试、审查，或提交、合并与修改共享代码之前的权限核对。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Parley coordinates multiple coding agents working on one repository using separate Git worktrees, numbered issue claims and peer-visible progress. Its MCP file reservations are advisory coordination signals, not operating-system file locks, so conflicts remain possible if participants ignore them. The workflow includes handoffs and acceptance, commit checks and a summary of remaining work; those reported outcomes are agent claims rather than independent proof that code is correct. A separate CLI installation and suitable repository environment are needed. This is a collaboration aid, not a substitute for tests, review or permission checks before committing, merging or changing shared code.

plugins.overview_zh: Agent Reach 是研究路由技能，依据配套指导和参考资料组织网页研究，帮助梳理相关来源与研究计划，并列出只读检索能力。关键环境限制是：外部运行功能只有在宿主提供时才可用，安装技能不会凭空产生通用浏览器、新账户连接或无限制联网能力。公开描述较简短，没有逐项列出所有检索来源和宿主。应把它视为流程辅助，真正读取外部资料前，仍要核实当前环境实际具备的工具。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Reach is a research-routing skill that uses its guidance and reference material to structure web-research requests. It can help map relevant sources and form a research plan, with read-only retrieval named as a capability. The crucial surface limit is that external runtime features exist only when the host environment supplies them. Installing the skill therefore does not create a universal browser, new connected accounts or unrestricted web access. The public description is concise and does not enumerate every retrieval source or supported host. Treat the output as workflow assistance and verify which tools are actually available before expecting it to fetch external material.

plugins.description_zh: 扫描对 AI 智能体的适配情况
plugins.overview_zh: Agent Ready 检查网站面向 AI 代理的信息呈现，包括 llms.txt、结构化数据、Markdown 镜像及 MCP 卡片、A2A 代理描述等新兴协议，给出 0–100 分、页面或协议问题、实用改进建议及可分享报告，并支持修改后重扫。发布者称 agent-ready.dev 免费且无需账户。这是诊断建议，不保证进入 AI 搜索、被推荐或获得流量，满足新兴约定也不等于符合所有平台的统一标准。修复仍需实际实施与验证；描述没有证明会自动编辑网站。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Ready scans how a website presents information to AI agents, using checks involving llms.txt, structured data, Markdown mirrors and emerging protocols such as MCP cards and A2A agent descriptions. It produces a 0–100 score, page or protocol findings, practical fixes and a shareable report, with rescanning after changes. The publisher describes agent-ready.dev as free and requiring no account. This is diagnostic guidance, not a promise of AI-search placement, endorsement or traffic, and support for an emerging convention is not proof of a universal standard. Suggested fixes still need implementation and validation; the description does not establish automatic editing of the site.

plugins.description_zh: 检查 AI 能否找到你的网站
plugins.description_en: Check if AI can find your site
plugins.overview_zh: Agent Ready Checker 检查一个公开页面及 robots.txt、站点地图等基础文件，不执行 JavaScript；通过元信息、标题、HTTPS、速度、JSON-LD、llms.txt、Markdown 和爬虫访问判断可发现性与结构，再给出三个优先修复项、工作量估计及不同建站平台的操作提示。若被反爬拦截，只能报告可取得的站点基础信息；发布者表示会标识抓取并遵守 robots 规则。高分不保证被 AI 推荐，单页且不运行 JavaScript 的检查也不等于全站或安全审计。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Ready Checker examines one public page plus basic site files such as robots.txt and sitemap data. It does not run JavaScript; it checks discoverability and structure through metadata, headings, HTTPS, speed, JSON-LD, llms.txt, Markdown and crawler access, then suggests three prioritised fixes with effort estimates and platform-specific instructions. If bot access is blocked, it can report only the site basics it can retrieve. The publisher says it identifies its fetches and respects robots rules. A good score does not guarantee recommendation by an AI service, and a single-page, non-JavaScript check is not a comprehensive site or security audit.

plugins.description_zh: 规划可靠的 AI 工作流
plugins.overview_zh: Agent Router 帮助把不完整的 AI 或自动化想法整理成实施与评估方案，通过聚焦提问判断是否真的需要自主代理，再建议较简单可靠的架构，定义来源权威、审批、安全措施、故障处理和测试用例。适合在开发助手、工作流或检索系统前厘清问题，尤其是需求尚不明确时。它明确只提供建议，不发邮件、不改外部系统、不执行业务流程，也不作法律、金融等高影响决策。输出方案仍需工程验证和另行获准的实际实施。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Agent Router helps turn an incomplete AI or automation idea into an implementation and evaluation plan. It asks focused questions, tests whether an autonomous agent is needed at all, recommends a simple architecture and defines source authority, approvals, safeguards, failure handling and test cases. It can be useful before building an assistant, workflow or retrieval system, particularly when the problem is not yet well specified. It is explicitly advisory: it does not send email, modify external systems, execute business processes or make legal, financial or other high-impact decisions. Its plan still requires engineering validation and separately authorised implementation.

It returns four readiness dimensions and prioritized improvements backed by observed evidence. A public-site scan needs no account. This is an assessment of website signals, not a promise of inclusion in AI answers, higher sales or successful checkout. The scoring methodology, scan coverage, frequency limits and paid features are not detailed here.

plugins.overview_zh: 读取已连接 Agentio 品牌的创作者广告表现。YouTube 数据包括花费、观看、点击、转化、收入和广告回报，可按活动、创作者或归因维度汇总；Meta 数据涵盖广告汇总、人口特征和每周触达。还可查询产品文档理解指标定义。需要 Agentio 账户，登录时选定单一品牌并由服务端限定范围。连接只读，不能改广告数据或访问其他品牌，可在集成设置中撤销。

plugins.overview_zh: 为智能体提供独立邮箱，支持双向邮件交流，而不仅是通知发送。工具可管理邮箱、消息、线程、标签和草稿，执行回复、转发、全文搜索、草稿定时发送，以及取回附件并提取 PDF、DOCX 文本。使用 AgentMail 控制台身份经 OAuth 连接，无需在 ChatGPT 输入 API 密钥。部分操作会发送邮件或删除记录，应明确权限与对象；套餐额度及保留期限未说明。

Plan limits and retention are not stated.

plugins.overview_zh: 在网站构建阶段补充机器可读层，包括 llms.txt、JSON-LD、Markdown 镜像、爬虫规则和内容标头。它按实际生成 HTML 的框架选择适配器，也支持已构建目录和自定义流程。仓库检查只读；安装、改文件、构建及对外检查前会提出明确计划。验证给出确定性的错误或警告，不生成营销评分；已有精编文件默认保留，除非批准替换。采用 MIT 许可。

Repository inspection is read-only; installation, file edits, builds and outbound checks require a disclosed plan. Validation reports deterministic errors or warnings rather than marketing scores, and curated existing files are preserved unless replacement is approved. The package is MIT-licensed.

plugins.description_zh: 企业 AI 智能体构建工具
plugins.overview_zh: 从企业网站或业务说明建立面向客户的对话智能体，可调整外观与行为、私下预览，再经 Agentplace 发布独立链接或嵌入网站。示例包括前台接待、服务推荐、预约和报价需求收集。需要 Agentplace 账户；预约及其他联动操作取决于已配置的服务和权限。发布和网站安装在 Agentplace 中完成，不能仅凭此介绍认定已能自动上线或连接所有业务系统。

Examples include reception, service recommendations, appointment handling and estimate intake. An Agentplace account is required; booking and other connected actions depend on configured services and permissions. Publication and website installation occur in Agentplace, not automatically through this description alone.

This is a local Codex workflow, not a general ChatGPT receipt service.

It returns page-specific findings with prioritisation rather than a general checklist detached from the page. Its explicit boundary is a single-page technical inspection, not a complete website crawl or ranking forecast. A clean result therefore does not establish full-site health, search-engine inclusion or future traffic, and inaccessible content may remain outside the check.

plugins.description_zh: 将 SVG 图形导出为 PNG
plugins.overview_zh: Alpenmarketing SVG zu PNG 将上传的 SVG 转成聊天内返回的 PNG，输入上限 500 KB，可选输出宽度最高 2,048 像素。含脚本、外部图片或嵌入内容的 SVG 会被拒绝，因此浏览器能显示的复杂文件也未必能转换。发布者称文件不会永久保存。这是有明确范围的栅格导出工具，不等于矢量编辑器，也不支持据此推断无限分辨率或全部 SVG 特性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alpenmarketing SVG zu PNG converts an uploaded SVG into a PNG returned in the chat. The SVG must be at most 500 KB, and an optional output width can be set up to 2,048 pixels. It rejects SVGs containing scripts, external images or embedded content, so a complex SVG may fail even when it displays in a browser. The publisher says the file is not retained permanently. This is a bounded raster-export utility, not evidence of vector editing, unlimited resolution or conversion of every SVG feature.

plugins.description_zh: 将 TIFF 图片导出为 JPG
plugins.overview_zh: Alpenmarketing TIFF zu JPG 把上传 TIFF 的第一页转为 JPG 并直接返回聊天，文件上限为 8 MB。透明区域会变白，多页 TIFF 只处理第一页，不会自动合并或逐页输出。厂商称文件不会永久保存。替换原文件前应检查页面和效果，因为该转换不保证无损存档质量，也不会保留透明度，全部 TIFF 元数据是否保留同样未说明。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alpenmarketing TIFF zu JPG converts the first page of an uploaded TIFF into a JPG and returns the result directly in chat. Input is limited to 8 MB. Transparent areas become white, and a multipage TIFF contributes only its first page, not a merged document or separate output for every page. The provider says files are not permanently stored. Check the selected page and appearance before replacing an original: this conversion does not promise lossless archival quality, preservation of transparency or retention of all TIFF metadata.

plugins.overview_zh: Alpha Spread 提供内在价值估算、财务数据及估值模型，辅助研究公司，并举出历史估值比较和分析师预期等场景；需要 Alpha Spread 账户。它适合分析公司可能值多少、估算依赖哪些假设，而不是把模型输出当成确定目标价。公开页没有说明更新频率、市场覆盖、套餐权限或交易功能；仍需核对假设和资料日期，不能保证投资结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alpha Spread supplies intrinsic valuations, financial data and valuation models to support company research, with examples involving historical valuation comparisons and analyst expectations. An Alpha Spread account is required. Its useful role is exploring what a company might be worth and the assumptions behind that estimate, rather than treating a model output as an objective price target. The public page does not specify data refresh intervals, market coverage, subscription entitlements or a trading function. Valuation assumptions and source dates still need checking; no investment outcome is guaranteed.

plugins.overview_zh: ALPHAPORT.AI 将上市公司研究与账户内研究流程结合，覆盖财务、估值、经营 KPI、分部、ETF 持仓、业绩、主题和筛选，并可选择流程运行，完成后再查看结果。因此它不只是静态行情查询，请求可能启动工作流。使用所选流程需连接账户；页面没有证明能交易，也没有承诺预测准确、执行时长或费用。应区分研究结果与投资决策，并在启动前确认流程范围。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ALPHAPORT.AI combines public-company research with account-linked research pipelines. It covers financials, valuation measures, operating KPIs, reported segments, ETF holdings, earnings, themes and screening; users can choose a pipeline to run and return to its result when ready. This is broader than a static quote lookup, because a request can initiate a workflow. An account connection is needed for the chosen pipelines. The page does not establish trading, guaranteed forecasts, execution time or workflow charges; distinguish research output from an investment decision and check the pipeline's actual scope before starting it.

plugins.overview_zh: AlphaStocks 分析投资论点、财报、分析师笔记和公司更新，帮助拆解假设、找出风险或警示，并把业绩材料中的正面、负面和中性信号整理成可复核结构。描述没有证明它具备实时行情、券商连接或自动交易能力。结果取决于材料完整性与时效，给信号分类也不证明未来财务影响。适合据此回查原始文档，而不是把输出当作个性化投资建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AlphaStocks analyses investment material such as stock theses, earnings reports, analyst notes and company updates. It helps separate assumptions, identify risks or warning signs and organise positive, negative and neutral earnings signals into a reviewable research structure. The description does not establish live market feeds, brokerage access or automatic trading. Its output depends on the completeness and currency of the supplied material, and classifying a signal does not prove its future financial impact. Use the structured review as a starting point for checking underlying documents, not a personalised investment recommendation.

plugins.overview_zh: alphaXiv 支持发现论文、阅读并询问正文、检查关联 GitHub 仓库，以及用文件夹管理已保存论文，适合从文献搜索进入个人阅读收藏，并查看相关实现。管理文件夹会改变收藏组织方式，而读取代码不等于运行代码。简短公开描述未说明全文限制、仓库权限、引用覆盖或导出额度；论文结论和程序行为仍需独立核查。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: alphaXiv supports academic-paper discovery, reading and questions about paper content, inspection of linked GitHub repositories and organisation of saved papers into folders. It is useful for moving from a literature search to a personal reading collection while examining associated implementation material. Folder management can change saved-library organisation, whereas reading a repository is not the same as executing its code. The short public description does not define full-text access restrictions, repository permissions, citation coverage or export limits. Research claims and code behaviour still require independent checking.

plugins.description_zh: 监测 MCP 应用和服务器
plugins.overview_zh: Alpic 面向托管在 Alpic 的 MCP 服务器，可查看项目、排查部署和查看应用或服务器分析，示例涉及托管应用、项目列表和使用数据。因此它是既有 Alpic 部署的运维辅助，不是通用 MCP 监控器。页面提到项目管理，但未列明可修改事项、部署动作或回滚保障；账户权限、日志敏感性、历史保留和费用均未实测，操作前应确认目标项目。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alpic connects to MCP servers hosted on Alpic so users can inspect projects, investigate deployments and view app or server analytics. Its examples focus on hosted apps, project lists and usage analysis, making it an operations aid for an existing Alpic deployment rather than a universal MCP monitor. The description says projects can be managed but does not enumerate allowed mutations, deployment actions or rollback guarantees. Account permissions, log sensitivity, available history and billing implications were not specified or tested; confirm the target project before any operational change.

plugins.description_zh: 在共享画布上绘制像素画（原文截断）
plugins.description_en: Draw pixel art on a shared can
plugins.overview_zh: Alpix 提供人与 AI 协作的实时共享像素画布，用户描述形状或场景后由 AI 绘制，每个像素会标注贡献用户与模型。关键边界是贡献对所有人可见，不是私人草稿。页面没有解释审核、撤销范围、导出格式、作品授权或他人能否覆盖内容，因此不宜放入机密信息，后续使用前也应检查实际结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alpix provides a live shared pixel-art canvas on which a person and AI can draw together. A user describes a shape or scene and the AI paints it; each pixel is attributed to the user and model responsible. The important privacy and collaboration boundary is that contributions are visible to everyone, rather than being a private draft. The page does not explain moderation, undo scope, export formats, ownership licensing or whether other participants can overwrite a contribution. Avoid placing confidential material on the canvas and review the result before reuse.

plugins.description_zh: AI 构建，Alpy 提升设计品味
plugins.overview_zh: Alpy 是网站与应用设计工作流，使用已连接 Alpy Library 的设计令牌、React/Vue 组件和视觉风格。它先澄清目标、受众、内容及约束，批准需求与视觉方向后制作响应式预览，再改进界面、体验、字体、易用性和无障碍，也可协助建立设计系统。页面并不保证生产托管、部署、后端功能或无障碍认证，实际构建取决于宿主执行能力与资料库权限。它与滑雪租赁插件 Alpy.com 是不同产品。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alpy is a website and app design workflow using a connected Alpy Library of design tokens, React/Vue components and visual styles. It begins with goals, audience, content and constraints, asks for approval of the brief and visual direction, then builds a responsive preview and supports UI, UX, typography, usability and accessibility refinement. It can help establish a coherent design system and audit responsive behaviour, but the page does not promise production hosting, deployment, backend functionality or accessibility certification. Host execution and library access determine what can actually be built. This is distinct from the ski-rental app named Alpy.com.

plugins.description_zh: 滑雪装备租赁（原文自称全球最佳）
plugins.overview_zh: Alpy.com 查询和比较欧洲、尤其阿尔卑斯地区商店的滑雪板及单板租赁，可按目的地、日期、水平、装备组合和取货需求筛选，结果显示装备、时间、取货地点与价格。最终需到 Alpy.com 复核并完成预订，聊天推荐不等于租赁已确认。所选方案的尺码、库存、押金、退改和营业时间还需核对；它不同于同名近似的 Alpy 设计系统插件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alpy.com searches and compares ski and snowboard rentals from European shops, especially in the Alps. A request can specify destination, dates, skill level, equipment package and pickup needs; results show equipment, dates, collection location and price. The user then opens Alpy.com to review details and complete the booking, so chat recommendations are not a confirmed rental. Check sizing, availability, deposit, cancellation and shop opening times for the selected offer. This travel app should not be confused with the separate Alpy design-system plugin.

plugins.description_zh: 查找正在开放的公告或征集
plugins.overview_zh: AltEditais 通过 Lupi 助手按领域、地区和申请人类型寻找公开征集及资助机会，显示期限、金额并链接到 AltEditais。需要账户；公开说明称 ChatGPT 免费额度每月可看十个不同公告，Pro 可搜索完整数据库，且聊天额度与平台自身额度分开。找到公告不代表符合资格或已经申请，仍应核对原始规则、截止时间和材料要求，套餐条件也应以当前页面为准。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AltEditais uses its Lupi assistant to find open calls and funding opportunities by field, territory and applicant profile, showing deadlines, amounts and links into AltEditais. An AltEditais account is required. The described free allowance is ten distinct notices per month in ChatGPT, while Pro searches the full database; the ChatGPT allowance is separate from the platform's own quota. Finding a notice does not establish eligibility or submit an application. Confirm the original rules, deadline and required documents before relying on an opportunity, and recheck current subscription terms.

plugins.overview_zh: AlterVision 分析零售客流、销售、转化和门店或销售人员目标进度。连接既有账户后可找门店、比较每日表现，并通过原因汇总和销售人员填写的说明研究未成交情况；未转化报告和销售竞赛另需 AlterVez 权限。这些资料可辅助运营排查，但员工记录的原因不等于独立因果证明，也不适合直接自动决定人事结果。页面未证明能修改销售或人员安排，时效与可见范围仍由连接账户决定。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AlterVision analyses retail traffic, sales, conversion and progress against store or seller targets. An existing account lets a team find stores, compare daily results and investigate missed conversions through reason summaries and seller-entered explanations. Non-conversion reports and sales competitions require additional AlterVez access. These records can support operational questions, but an explanation entered by a seller is not independently established causation or a fair basis for an automatic personnel decision. The description does not establish changing sales records or staffing. Data freshness and access depend on the connected account.

plugins.overview_zh: Alteryx Insights 对组织已在 Alteryx One 配置的数据进行自然语言查询，用于了解表现、调查可能驱动因素和准备业务更新，减少切换仪表盘。它不保证访问公司所有数据库，公开正文也未说明可写回源记录或任意执行工作流。结果依赖配置数据集、权限、刷新安排与业务口径；分析出的驱动因素应作为待调查线索，而不是自动成立的因果证明。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alteryx Insights lets users ask business questions against data their organisation has configured in Alteryx One. The intended workflow is to explore performance, investigate possible drivers and prepare updates using governed organisational data without switching dashboards. It is not a promise of access to every company database, and the public body does not describe writing source records or independently running arbitrary workflows. Answers remain dependent on the configured datasets, permissions, refresh schedule and business definitions. Treat an inferred driver as something to investigate, not automatic proof of causation.

plugins.description_zh: 读取云工作区背景信息
plugins.overview_zh: Altifigence 只读访问获准的 Altifigence Cloud 项目与工作区，可浏览项目、查看工作区详情和已保存源码，以便理解设计或结合上下文讨论代码。它没有证明能编辑、部署、运行代码，或读取本地未保存文件。可见范围由所选工作区和既有权限限定，页面也没说明版本更新时效及完整依赖访问，因此实施前应核对真正保存的版本。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Altifigence gives read-only access to authorised Altifigence Cloud projects and workspaces. Users can browse projects, inspect workspace details and read saved source files to understand a design or discuss code in context. It does not establish editing, deployment, execution or access to unsaved files on a local machine. The chosen workspace and existing project permissions bound what is visible. The description also does not specify version freshness or complete dependency access, so code explanations should be checked against the actual saved revision before implementation decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: AltoDocs 在用户选择共享的项目内读写原生文档，支持文字、列表、表格、MathCanvas 工作表和可编辑标记草图，可将提供的 CSV、表格或 Python 输出整理成报告，回读保存结果并链接具体章节。公式采用 MathLive/LaTeX 与 mathjs，也包括梁挠度和支持的钢结构检查。需账户、项目访问及编辑资格；不抓外部文件、不运行 Python，不提供独立电子表格或 CAD，也不支持任意图片上传、导出和共享控制，更不认证工程设计。涉及安全的计算仍须专业验证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AltoDocs reads, creates and updates native documents in projects the user chooses to share, including text, lists, tables, MathCanvas worksheets and editable markup sketches. It can turn supplied CSV, spreadsheet or Python results into reports and verify saved changes with section links. Calculation uses MathLive/LaTeX input and mathjs; beam deflection and supported steel checks are included. An account, project access and editing entitlement are required. It does not fetch external files, execute Python, provide standalone spreadsheets or CAD, support arbitrary image uploads, exports or sharing controls, or certify engineering designs. Calculations require professional validation where safety matters.

plugins.description_zh: 闭路电视产品搜索平台
plugins.overview_zh: Alvamitra 搜索监控摄像头及安防设备，查看库存、规格，并按需求推荐产品，可打开商品页或联系商家订购实体设备。它属于选品与购买准备，不证明可控制已安装摄像头、读取监控画面或自动付款。兼容性、安装要求、实际库存及配送条件仍需向商家核实；零售推荐也不等于对场所安全的独立审计。

It can open a product page or provide a route to contact Alvamitra to order physical equipment. This is product discovery and purchase preparation, not evidence of controlling installed cameras, viewing surveillance footage or automatically completing payment. Compatibility, installation needs, actual inventory and final delivery terms should be checked with the seller. A recommendation from a retailer is not an independent security audit of a premises.

plugins.overview_zh: Alvore Finance 读取顾问与客户私密工作区中的企业及个人财务资料，包括损益、指标、预算、分类交易、家庭财务和顾问交付物。写入仅限项目、需求说明、HTML 交付物及版本，不会发起或结算付款、转账或购买，也不会把内容发布到公开地址。因此这里的“发布”指私密项目内容，不等于公开传播或资金执行；权限及底层账务准确性仍需核对。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Alvore Finance connects consultants with business and personal financial information held in a client's private workspace. Reads include company P&L, indicators, budgets, categorised transactions, household finances and consulting deliverables. Writes are limited to project content such as a project, briefing, HTML deliverable and versions. No tool initiates or settles payments, transfers or purchases, and created content is not published to a public address. This distinction matters when a request says publish: it means private engagement content, not public dissemination or financial execution. Access and the accuracy of underlying accounting data still need checking.

plugins.overview_zh: Aman 帮助探索其目的地与住宿，以及餐饮、康养和文化体验，可按日期查看房型和价格，审阅选择后继续到 Aman 预订网站。发布者明确说明不会在 ChatGPT 内完成预订，因此它适合行程选择与准备，不代表房间已保留或已付款。最终房态、总价、退改条款和体验项目条件仍应在实际预订流程确认。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Aman helps explore Aman destinations and stays, including dining, wellness and cultural experiences. Users can check rooms and rates for preferred dates and review a selected stay before continuing to Aman's booking site. The publisher explicitly says reservations are not completed inside ChatGPT. It is therefore useful for choosing and preparing a trip, not evidence that a room has been held or paid for. Availability, total price, cancellation terms and any experience-specific conditions must be confirmed in the final booking flow.

plugins.overview_zh: Amapas Vacation Rental 面向巴亚尔塔港 Zona Romántica 的特定两居室海景公寓 Amapas 353，而非通用租房市场。它展示房源、日期、房态和包含税费及清洁费的明细，并可在组件中提交预订请求。收到邮件仅表示请求已收悉，不代表入住最终确认；付款在 ChatGPT 外进行，由业主另行确认房态并邮件发送付款链接。付款前应核实业主回复、完整条件和收款目标，本轮未提交预订。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amapas Vacation Rental concerns one specific two-bedroom ocean-view property, Amapas 353 in Puerto Vallarta's Zona Romántica, rather than a general rental marketplace. It shows property details, dates, availability and itemised pricing including taxes and cleaning fees, and can submit a reservation request through its widget. Receipt email means the request was received, not that the stay is final. Payment is outside ChatGPT: the owner separately confirms availability and emails a payment link. Verify the property's response, full terms and payment destination before paying; no reservation was submitted during this research.

plugins.overview_zh: Amass 连接论文与摘要、临床试验、药物、监管批准、人类基因及生命科学专利六类关联资料，支持筛选检索、完整记录和回溯来源，适合跨科学、临床、监管与专利证据研究靶点。其中 PatentCore 明确仍是预览。宣传的记录数量及靶点注释只代表厂商覆盖，不等于完整性或临床有效性；应核对日期和原始文档，研究汇总不能替代诊断、治疗建议、监管判定或专利实施自由意见。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amass connects six linked biomedical collections covering publications and abstracts, clinical trials, drugs, regulatory authorisations, human genes and life-science patents. It supports filtered searches and full records with links back to underlying sources, useful for tracing a therapeutic target across scientific, clinical, regulatory and patent evidence. PatentCore is explicitly a preview. Advertised corpus counts and target-intelligence annotations describe the provider's coverage, not completeness or clinical validity. Check source dates and original documents; a research synthesis is not a diagnosis, treatment recommendation, regulatory approval determination or freedom-to-operate opinion.

plugins.description_zh: 绘制艺术和设计的草图与初稿
plugins.overview_zh: Amazing Drawing 提供绘画界面，让用户画示意图、标志或布局后与 ChatGPT 讨论，可用于视觉解释、征求反馈、分析草图或猜画游戏，适合文字不易说清的想法。示例中要求 ChatGPT 生成成品图，并不能单独证明这个应用自带专门渲染引擎。公开正文没有说明导出格式、保存方式、协作权限或专业设计保障，应把它理解为草图沟通工具。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amazing Drawing opens a drawing surface so users can sketch a diagram, logo or layout and discuss it with ChatGPT. A prompt that asks ChatGPT to produce a finished image does not by itself establish a dedicated rendering engine in this app. Export formats, storage, collaboration permissions and professional design guarantees are not specified in the public body.

plugins.description_zh: 聆听自然之声，放松身心
plugins.overview_zh: Amazing Nature Sounds 在聊天时播放自然环境声音，例如林中雨声和海浪，用于放松聆听，不是医疗或睡眠治疗工具。简短页面没有列明声音库规模、循环控制、离线、下载或商业音频授权，播放还取决于宿主的音频支持。适合作为环境声辅助，不能根据介绍推断会录制用户或自动控制其他设备。
