plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amazing Nature Sounds offers nature-sound playback while chatting, with examples such as rain in woods and waves. Its documented purpose is a relaxing listening experience rather than producing a medical or sleep-treatment outcome. The short page does not specify the catalogue size, looping controls, offline use, downloads or commercial audio licences. Playback also depends on the host's audio support. Use it as an ambient-sound aid, and do not infer that it records the user or automatically controls other devices from the description.

plugins.overview_zh: AmazingPensions 提供退休收入交互估算，可调整缴费额、退休年龄等输入，查看变化并在聊天中讨论情景。它是规划计算器，不证明能连接养老金机构、修改缴费或购买投资。页面没有公开收益率、通胀、税费、提取方式及地区养老金规则的假设，而这些会显著影响结果；应比较情景并核实模型，不能把显示收入当成必然或保本承诺。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AmazingPensions provides an interactive estimate of retirement income. Users can change inputs such as contribution amounts and retirement age, see the estimate update and discuss scenarios in chat. It is a planning calculator, not evidence of accessing a pension provider, adjusting contributions or buying investments. The description does not reveal assumptions for returns, inflation, tax, fees, drawdown or jurisdiction-specific pension rules. Those assumptions strongly affect the result, so compare scenarios and verify the model before treating a displayed income as achievable or guaranteed.

plugins.description_zh: Amazon 关键词与卖家数据
plugins.overview_zh: Amazon Product Research 查询市场与搜索数据，涵盖需求、关键词量与难度、季节趋势、反查 ASIN 排名、竞品、卖家档案，以及刊登和 Buy Box 报价，可一次比较最多 1,000 个关键词，并查看价格、库存、评价、分类及履约信息。需 1Product 账户，严格只做研究，不在 Amazon 购买、刊登、编辑或发布，也未获 Amazon 背书。缺失数据应明说，不能猜测；搜索估计、即时报价和竞争信号都不保证需求或备货盈利。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amazon Product Research queries marketplace and search data for product demand, keyword volume and difficulty, seasonal trends, reverse-ASIN rankings, competitors, seller profiles and listing/Buy Box offers. It can compare up to 1,000 keywords at once and inspect price, availability, reviews, category and fulfilment details. A 1Product account is required. It is strictly research-only: it does not buy, list, edit or publish on Amazon and is not endorsed by Amazon. Unavailable data should be reported rather than guessed. Search estimates, current offers and competition signals are not guarantees of demand or profitable inventory decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: Ambak Loan Offers 比较合作贷款方可能适用的住房贷款方案，估算月供和转贷节省，并提供 Ambak 页面继续办理。适合初步比较，但合作方并不覆盖全部市场，估计方案也不等于正式批贷。简短描述没有证明会提交申请、查询征信、签合同或转移资金。依赖节省金额前应核对利率类型、费用、资格、转贷成本及贷款方条款。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ambak Loan Offers compares potentially eligible home-loan offers from partner lenders, estimates monthly instalments and balance-transfer savings, then provides the relevant Ambak page to continue. It is useful for initial comparison, but partner coverage is not the whole lending market and an estimated offer is not a binding approval. The short description does not establish submitting an application, checking credit, signing a loan or moving money. Confirm interest type, fees, eligibility, transfer costs and lender terms before relying on the displayed savings.

plugins.description_zh: 人类与 AI 共享工作区
plugins.overview_zh: Ambiguous Workspace 描述了包含文档、邮件、聊天、表格、CRM 和日历等 17 个应用的协作平台，AI 同事拥有独立身份，可通过消息、任务或评论参与团队上下文。厂商宣传五人以内团队免费，并支持 CLI 或 MCP 接入。但这不证明自动获得外部 Google 或 Microsoft 账户权限；简短正文未逐项列出工具、权限和发送保护机制，处理影响团队的工作前应核实实际工作区和当前套餐。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ambiguous Workspace describes an integrated set of 17 productivity apps, including documents, mail, chat, sheets, CRM and calendars, where AI coworkers have their own identities and share a team's work context. They can be addressed through messages, tasks or comments. The publisher advertises free use for teams up to five and access through CLI or MCP. This is a collaboration platform, not evidence of automatic access to external Google or Microsoft accounts. The short body does not enumerate each tool, permission or sending safeguard; verify the actual workspace and current plan before consequential shared work.

plugins.overview_zh: AmbitionBox 提供公司评价与薪资资料，覆盖员工对文化、管理、工作生活平衡、福利及晋升的看法，也包括公司薪酬区间和按经验划分的工资分组，可辅助比较雇主或准备面试问题。厂商称评价匿名且经过验证，但这不等于独立保证样本代表性、真实性或现状。工资分布不是聘用报价，描述也不证明能申请职位、联系员工或作招聘决策。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AmbitionBox provides company reviews and salary information intended to support career research. The published scope includes employee perspectives on culture, management, balance, benefits and progression, plus company-specific compensation ranges and experience-based salary buckets. It can help compare employers or identify questions for an interview. The provider calls reviews anonymous and verified, but that is not an independent guarantee of representativeness, truth or current conditions. A salary distribution is not a promised offer, and the description does not establish applying for jobs, contacting employees or making hiring decisions.

plugins.description_zh: 启用 AMD 技能生态
plugins.overview_zh: AMD 汇集其代理技能，涉及 Ryzen AI 本地图像和音频、通过 vLLM 在 Instinct GPU 提供大模型推理、Hyperloom 吞吐优化，以及 GPU 内核或 PyTorch 跟踪分析。它面向开发和性能工作，安装不代表附送云 GPU。适用硬件、运行软件和执行权限需另行确认；公开描述不保证每种 AMD 设备都支持，也不自动授予模型许可。本地运行、下载和部署应以真实环境为界。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AMD packages AMD's agent skills for local AI and GPU workflows: image/audio on Ryzen AI, LLM serving on Instinct GPUs through vLLM, inference-throughput optimisation with Hyperloom and investigation of GPU kernels or PyTorch traces. It is aimed at development and performance work, not a hosted GPU entitlement bundled with installation. Suitable hardware, runtime software and authorised execution access are separate requirements to verify. The public description does not promise support for every AMD device or automatic model licences. Local execution, downloads and deployment should be scoped to the actual environment.

plugins.description_zh: 柬埔寨银行与科技法律
plugins.overview_zh: Amok 检索柬埔寨央行及证券监管方的英语官方银行、金融科技和技术监管材料，称会返回条文原文、条款编号、效力状态及链接。可用其他语言提问，再以英语资料为依据解释，主题包括许可、审慎规则、技术风险、支付、反洗钱和 Bakong。服务免费且无需账户，资料缺失时应说明而非猜测；用途是研究，不替代法律顾问。合规决策前仍应核对原条文和日期。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amok searches English-language official Cambodian banking, fintech and technology-regulation material, including National Bank of Cambodia and securities-regulator sources. Results are described as verbatim provisions with article references, validity and official links; users may ask in another language and receive an explanation grounded in the English corpus. It covers subjects such as licensing, prudential rules, technology risk, payments, AML/CFT and Bakong. The service is free with no account, reports corpus gaps rather than guessing, and is for research rather than legal counsel. Always check the original provision and date before a compliance decision.

plugins.overview_zh: Amortiza Loan Planner 根据输入计算固定利率贷款月供、总利息、还清日期及可下载摊还表，支持额外或一次性还款、每周和双周安排、两至四笔方案比较、点数及费用回本分析，也可加入税、保险、HOA 和 PMI。无需个人资料；PMI 模型在贷款高于房价 80% 时收费、降至 78% 时停止，这不是普适法律。支持零利率，但不处理浮息重置、只付利息或气球贷，也不查询当前利率、税额或保险报价。结果是信息性计算，不是放贷报价或财务建议。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amortiza Loan Planner calculates fixed-rate loan payments, total interest, payoff dates and downloadable amortisation schedules from supplied values. It supports extra or lump-sum payments, weekly/biweekly schedules, comparisons of two to four loans, points/fee break-even analysis and housing-cost inputs such as tax, insurance, HOA and PMI. No personal data is needed. Its PMI model starts above 80% of home value and stops at 78%; these are not universal legal rules. It handles zero-interest loans but not variable-rate resets, interest-only or balloon loans, and does not retrieve current rates, taxes or insurance quotes. Results are informational calculations, not lender offers or financial advice.

capabilities_zh: 按训练时长、目标、水平、可用器械及重点部位定制训练安排。
生成高强度间歇训练（HIIT）、力量训练或全身训练方案。
安排动作和节奏，说明需要做什么以及做多久。
配合 amp 生态使用，并可根据当下精力和状态调整训练。

The short page does not specify confirmation screens, destination channels, identity-match accuracy or model validation. Check the intended audience, data rights and operational effect before activating anything; matching profiles does not prove that every linked identity is correct.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找潜在客户、开展研究并沟通
plugins.overview_zh: Amplemarket 按职务、资历、行业、公司规模和地区寻找潜客，并补充个人或企业资料、技术栈、融资和联系方式，也可查看互动历史、管理线索名单及加入触达序列。后者可能影响外联流程，因此不能当成纯查询工具。公开说明不保证所有资料准确，也不意味着可以联系所有找到的人；加入序列前应核实身份、时效、权限和触发后果，本轮未进行外联。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amplemarket searches for prospects by role, seniority, sector, company size and location, and enriches people or companies with profiles, technology stacks, funding and contact information. It also retrieves engagement history, manages lead lists and adds leads to sequences. That last capability can affect outreach workflows, so this is not merely a contact lookup. The description does not establish universal data accuracy or permission to contact everyone found. Verify the correct person, source freshness, account access and the effect of a sequence before adding leads; no outreach was performed in this research.

plugins.description_zh: 品牌 AI 可见度智能体
plugins.overview_zh: Amplifyr 报告品牌在 AI 模型中的声量占比、排名、KPI、引用、情绪和相关问题，数据明确限于用户组织，可不写 SQL 就审阅已监测回答中的品牌表现。它不证明覆盖所有提示或用户，也不保证改进措施一定提高排名；采样问题、测量时间和原回答都应检查。正文没有证明能修改公开内容或营销活动。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Amplifyr reports on a brand's visibility across AI models, including share of voice, rankings, KPIs, citations, sentiment and related questions. The data is explicitly scoped to the user's organisation. It can help review how monitored answers portray a brand without writing SQL or opening dashboards. The description does not prove visibility across every possible prompt or user, nor promise that suggested changes will improve ranking. Sampling choices, measurement period and source answers matter, and the body does not establish editing public content or modifying campaigns.

plugins.overview_zh: Amplitude EU 连接工作区，支持搜索图表和仪表盘、查询指标与实验结果、检查事件和属性，并创建或更新图表、仪表盘和提醒，因此不是只读工具。可见和可改范围取决于权限及指标定义，实验结论仍须谨慎统计解释。名称中的 EU 不能单独当成完整数据驻留或合规保证；本轮未测试埋点、提醒送达或生产修改。

The workspace's permissions and metric definitions determine what the user can see or alter; experiment results still require careful statistical interpretation. The name includes EU, but this description alone is not a complete data-residency or compliance guarantee. No event instrumentation, alert delivery or production changes were tested.

plugins.overview_zh: Amtstools 搜索德语产品文档、列出帮助页并读取完整功能与流程说明，适合了解导入、计算等操作。示例提到发票检查和准备商品 CSV，但功能正文证明的是文档检索，不是直接访问用户发票或审计文件。不能推断它会修改账务或执行税务检查；仍需将文档版本、软件版本及生成步骤与实际安装核对。

plugins.overview_zh: Amy Food Journal 读取自己的私密饮食日志与目标，记录食物和饮料，并精确更正已有条目；示例包括比较热量和营养素目标、查看近期记录或体重趋势。新增和更正会改变健康相关记录，需核对日期、份量与目标条目。简短页面未说明营养数据来源、自动份量测量或临床验证，应把结果当作跟踪辅助，而非诊断或处方饮食，也不应假设可读取他人日志。

Logging and corrections change stored health-related records, so dates, portions and the intended entry should be checked carefully. The short page does not explain nutritional-data provenance, automatic portion measurement or clinical validation. Treat totals and trends as tracking aids rather than diagnosis or a prescribed diet, and do not assume access to another person's journal.

plugins.overview_zh: Anagram 分析 Site Agent 用户对话及互动和业务结果，可查找、阅读对话、汇总活动，并执行限定项目的分析查询，明确只读。适合发现重复问题或服务洞察，不会因此自动回复客户或修改网站。项目权限与对话隐私仍重要，互动和业绩相关也不等于因果；页面未说明保留周期、匿名化方式或全部渠道覆盖。

plugins.description_zh: 了解学习者的特点与需求
plugins.overview_zh: Analyse des apprenants 是教学设计技能，在类似 ADDIE 的流程中分析学习者背景、需求、先修条件、约束和情境，帮助区分经验、态度与入门要求，并找出缺失信息。示例体现法语结构化收集，但正文没有定义所有字段或经验证量表。它是规划指导，不是自动录取、评分或障碍诊断系统；只应使用必要的学习者信息，并结合教学场景复核假设。

This is a specialised editorial knowledge base, not a live connection to the user's analytics accounts or the entire web. It returns passages with episode number, title, timestamp and link, and can answer archive questions such as the latest episode or releases in a particular year. This makes it useful for locating a discussion without listening to every episode. It covers that archive rather than all analytics literature; a speaker's opinion is not an independently established fact. Verify the surrounding context and respect quotation limits when reusing material.

Remote use requires a separately connected Anarlog Cloud service, personal or paid-Team Pro access, explicit Cloud API/Connectors opt-in and uploaded snapshots. Installing this skill does not connect an account or make local records available remotely. Cloud snapshots may differ from current local notes; confirm the source and meeting scope before exporting sensitive discussions. The description does not establish editing or sending meeting follow-ups.

plugins.overview_zh: Anatomy 打开交互式三维人体，可查看肌肉、骨、神经、关节和器官，隔离结构、淡化遮挡层、标注和着色、剖切并演示动作，也能用受力方向解释关节角度变化时的肌肉作用。用户可指出疼痛位置或做识别测验，但发布者明确仅供参考解剖与教育，不诊断、不提供医疗建议。通用模型不能确定个人症状原因，也不能替代检查。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Anatomy opens an interactive 3D body to explore muscles, bones, nerves, joints and organs. It can isolate structures, fade covering layers, label or colour groups, show cross-sections and animate movements; line-of-pull views explain how a muscle's role changes with a joint angle. Users may point to pain or take identification quizzes, but the publisher explicitly limits the model to reference anatomy and education. It does not diagnose or provide medical advice. A generic 3D model cannot establish the cause of an individual's symptoms or replace clinical examination.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Anchor gives ChatGPT an account-scoped shared drive for reading and writing text files such as HTML, Markdown, JSON and CSV, organising folders, copying or moving files and designing/querying typed tables with SQL. The provider handles storage, permissions and versioning, and access is limited to what the signed-in user can access. Created material can be shared with a team, but shareable does not mean automatically public or authorised for every recipient. This is persistent file work rather than a temporary chat draft. Confirm the file, folder and sharing context before edits or distribution.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找毛里求斯体验活动
plugins.overview_zh: Andeor 展示毛里求斯体验活动的市场资料，包括起价、时长、地点和难度，并按人数查询已发布出发安排，适合筛选徒步或家庭活动。公开应用明确只提供信息，不给外部链接，也不执行交易。已发布班次或起价并不等于确认预订或最终全包报价，承诺行程前仍应核对余位、参加限制、安全要求和最终条件。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Andeor presents current Mauritius experiences with marketplace information on starting price, duration, location and difficulty, and checks published departures for the user's party. It is useful for narrowing hikes or family activities by practical requirements. The public app is explicitly informational: it provides neither external links nor transactional actions. A published departure or starting price is therefore not a confirmed booking or final all-inclusive quote. Check actual availability, participant restrictions, safety requirements and final terms separately before making travel commitments.

plugins.overview_zh: Andexnite Shopping 是布拉格 Andex Nite 商店的购物助手，查找皮革、仿皮和仿毛、辅料、环氧树脂及制模硅胶，按项目尺寸、颜色和预算比较价格、库存与规格，并可应要求准备免注册购物车。用户需在 andexnite.cz 检查运费和总价后确认订单，备好购物车不等于购买完成。尤其树脂和制模材料仍须核实适用性、用量、操作防护与兼容性，本轮没有下单。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Andexnite Shopping is Andex Nite's Prague-store shopping assistant for leather, faux leather/fur, haberdashery components, epoxy resins and mould-making silicones. It compares current prices, stock and specifications against a project's dimensions, colour and budget and can prepare a guest cart on request. The user reviews shipping and final price and confirms the order on andexnite.cz. Cart preparation is not a completed purchase. Material suitability, quantities, handling precautions and compatibility still need checking, particularly for resins and moulding products; no order was placed here.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: anew packages a self-contained HTML document, fragment or plain text into a publicly resolvable URL carrying the page itself. The crucial boundary is public accessibility: putting content in the generated URL is not private storage. Do not include secrets or personal information that should not be public. The page does not establish revocation, access controls, long-term availability, custom-domain support or a conventional editable hosting account.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Angell Naruto RPG Akatsuki helps players draft and review fictional techniques, items and other proposals for that specific role-playing community. It consults official game rules, identifies prerequisites and limits and organises the proposal into text suitable for staff assessment, including the illustrated BBCode workflow. It does not replace staff approval or establish that a new technique is accepted into the game. Rules, character eligibility and final wording should be checked in the current community context. This is game-content assistance, not a general Naruto canon authority or automatic account-management tool.

plugins.description_zh: 根据湖泊情况选择拟饵
plugins.overview_zh: Angler Adventures: Lure Guide 根据用户描述的结构、水色、天气、风和温度推荐并排序鲈鱼钓饵，解释各自用法，其逻辑和美术来自配套手游并用于现实建议。这不证明具备实时天气、湖泊调查或保证上鱼能力。建议依赖观察准确性，也不能替代当地垂钓规定、天气安全和水域准入要求；应把它用于给定条件下比较策略，而非默认知道现场状态。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Angler Adventures: Lure Guide recommends and ranks bass-fishing lures from conditions the user supplies, including structure, water clarity, weather, wind and temperature, with guidance on using each lure. It adapts the decision logic and artwork of the associated mobile game to real-world fishing advice. That does not establish live weather, lake surveys or guaranteed catches. Recommendations depend on accurate observations and cannot replace local fishing rules, weather safety or water-access restrictions. Use it to compare tactics for stated conditions rather than assume it knows the current lake automatically.

plugins.overview_zh: Animal Sounds 宣传提供超过 240 种动物声音、知识、短循环、栖息地环境声、纪录片、导览和歌曲，也包括恐龙与史前声音，后者不能理解为灭绝动物的真实录音。页面提到可连续播放 20 种声音，并明确不使用麦克风。它是教育娱乐媒体工具，不是录音识别野生动物的设备。数量及知识内容属于发布者描述，下载、再使用授权和地区播放限制未说明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Animal Sounds plays an advertised collection of more than 240 animal sounds, animal facts, short loops, habitat ambience, documentaries, narrated tours and songs. It also includes prehistoric/dinosaur sounds and tours; those must not be understood as authentic recordings of extinct animals. The page describes a sequence of 20 sounds for autoplay and explicitly says the plugin never uses the microphone. It is an educational and entertainment media tool, not a wildlife-identification recorder. Catalogue counts and factual details are publisher claims; downloads, reuse licences and regional playback availability are not specified.

plugins.overview_zh: Annotations Extensibility 是 OpenAI 发布的集成技能，帮助开发者让自己的网站配合 ChatGPT 浏览器的标注模式，包括可选区域、评论上下文，以及预览颜色、大小或可见性变化的自定义控件，也涉及通过既有代码集成画布对象。它是依据公开文档的网站开发工作，不自动授予操作用户浏览器或修改其他网站的权限。宿主与应用必须支持集成，控件的可用性、安全和无障碍仍需实现与测试。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Annotations Extensibility is an OpenAI-authored integration skill for developers who want their website to cooperate with annotation mode in the ChatGPT browser. It covers selectable page areas, context attached to comments and custom controls previewing changes such as colour, size or visibility, including canvas-object integration through existing application code. This is website development work based on public documentation, not permission to operate a user's browser or alter unrelated sites. The host and application must support the integration; availability, security and accessibility of custom controls still require implementation and testing.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Annstracts exposes general business information, including its website and contact email, and provides a way to get in touch with the team. Although the directory title refers to abstract photography, the recovered functional body does not establish browsing a complete artwork catalogue, generating images, purchasing prints or managing photography files. Its demonstrated role is business information and contact support. The exact contact mechanism, data transmitted and any order or licensing process are unspecified; looking up a contact is distinct from authorising a message to be sent.

plugins.overview_zh: Ansight 从集成 SDK 的开发版移动应用收集日志、网络、遥测、截图、界面树和触摸记录，技能通过另装 CLI 调查会话、操作模拟器或应用、调用应用暴露工具、标注证据及构建可重复 UI 测试，覆盖原生 iOS/Android、MAUI、React Native、Flutter 和 Capacitor。实时操作需要带 SDK 的开发或 QA 构建，以及主机执行权限；仅在云端安装不等于能访问本地设备。屏幕和请求可能含敏感资料，采集或导出前需检查范围。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ansight supplies runtime evidence from development mobile apps instrumented with its SDK: logs, network activity, telemetry, screenshots, UI trees and touches. Its skills use a separately installed CLI to investigate sessions, control simulators or apps, call app-exposed tools, annotate evidence and build repeatable UI tests. Supported frameworks include native iOS/Android, MAUI, React Native, Flutter and Capacitor. Live operation needs an instrumented development/QA build and authorised access to the host machine. A cloud-only installation does not grant local-device access. Recorded screens and requests may contain sensitive data; inspect scope before capture or export.

plugins.overview_zh: 把法律、监管和安全标准资料接入 AI 助手，支持合规差距分析、威胁建模、数据保护影响评估及审计准备。开发者称其内容基于 300 多个精选语料库，并提供段落级官方来源引用；这些覆盖范围、准确性和授权声明未作独立验证。
capabilities_zh: 在 ChatGPT、Claude、Microsoft Copilot 或其他兼容 MCP 的客户端中开展合规工作。
辅助监管差距分析、STRIDE/LINDDUN 威胁建模、威胁分析与风险评估（TARA）、数据保护影响评估（DPIA）和审计准备。
开发者介绍称，资料涉及欧盟与国际立法、判例、立法准备材料、监管指南和安全标准，覆盖 300 多个精选语料库。
开发者称每个回答提供段落级官方来源引用，来源不可用时返回错误而不是猜测。
涉及 NIS2、GDPR、DORA、CRA、欧盟 AI 法案及国家和行业监管规则。
use_cases_zh: 详情页示例：查找 GDPR 中规定删除权的条款，并引用官方来源。
详情页示例：研究 NIS2 是否适用于一家位于荷兰、拥有 60 名员工的 SaaS 公司。
详情页示例：查询 CVE-2024-3400 是否已有在野利用，以及严重程度。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需将所用 AI 助手连接至 Ansvar Gateway；详情页列出 ChatGPT、Claude、Microsoft Copilot 和兼容 MCP 的客户端。页面未明确费用、账号开通条件或具体权限。来源覆盖、段落引用、准确性及再分发许可均为开发者声明，不等于已核验法律意见或取得任意用途的再分发权。

plugins.overview_zh: AnswerTracker 读取连接账户中品牌、企业、产品、服务或专家在 AI 回答中的表现证据，包括跟踪问题、回答、引用、测量、查询扩展依据、建议动作及测量费用，便于检查评分依据而非只看总分。正文证明的是审阅账户数据，不等于可无限启动新测量或自动发布建议。结果依赖抽样问题和模型，可见度也不保证被背书、产生销量或未来继续出现。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnswerTracker reads a connected account's evidence about how brands, companies, products, services or experts appear in AI-generated answers. It includes tracked questions, generated answers, citations, measurements, query fan-out evidence, proposed actions and measurement costs. This helps inspect the basis of a visibility assessment rather than relying on a single score. The body establishes review of existing account data, not unrestricted new measurements or automatic publication of recommendations. Results depend on the sampled prompts and models, and visibility does not guarantee endorsement, sales or future answer placement.

plugins.description_zh: 每日市场和全球风险简报
plugins.overview_zh: Antevo Executive Brief 提供公开只读的市场与全球风险分析，包括每日简报、附支持或反驳条件的风险分级、行业笔记、分层地理背景，以及约 180 个国家的宏观历史。回答带日期和来源，无需账户或登录，也无修改工具。适合建立研究方向，但风险等级仍是厂商解释，不是未来事件的确定预言；重大业务或投资决策前应核实日期和原证据。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Antevo Executive Brief is a public, read-only source of Antevo's published market and world-risk analysis. It includes a daily brief, graded risks with evidence that would confirm or challenge them, sector notes, layered geographic context and macroeconomic history for roughly 180 countries. Answers are dated and identify sources; no account or sign-in is required and no tool changes records. It is useful for orienting research, but risk ratings remain the provider's interpretation rather than certainty about future events. Check dates and original evidence before consequential business or investment decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: Antevo Trademark 在实时商标登记中筛查名称，按相似程度分组，并介绍尼斯分类、持有人申请模式和各局异议期限，引用期限依据并区分注册前后窗口。服务免费、无需账户、只读，明确属于登记情报而非法律意见。相似结果不等于可注册结论或侵权认定，期限应按具体机构及案件核实；它不会代为申请、异议或修改登记。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Antevo Trademark screens a proposed name against live trademark registers, groups similar marks by similarity tier and offers context on Nice classes, holders' filing patterns and opposition windows by office. It cites the provisions behind timing and distinguishes windows before or after registration. The service is free, account-free and read-only, with an explicit register-intelligence rather than legal-advice boundary. A similarity result is not a clearance opinion or infringement finding, and a deadline must be checked against the actual office and case. It does not file, oppose or alter registrations.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Antevo Wealth connects to the user's own account for household briefings, positions and allocation, AUM, model drift, correlations, concentration, real assets, compliance alerts and calendar context. Answers are dated and name their sources. Access is confined to the connected user's data; the page also says any record-changing action must describe its effect and wait for approval, so it should not be labelled unconditionally read-only. The description does not establish trading, money movement or independently validated financial advice. Verify data currency, account scope and any proposed change before acting on a portfolio interpretation.

plugins.overview_zh: Anti-Churn 是本地工作流检查技能，用于再次测试、审查、重试或晋级检查之前，将拟做动作与已接受证据比较，复用匹配结果，并指出变更后哪些证据失效、需要重跑。它限制重复动作，不是停止整个任务；发布者明确不负责发布或改权限，限流指标也不构成停止授权。它并不保证旧证据一直有效，代码、环境或需求变化仍需据实判断。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Anti-Churn is a local workflow-review skill used before repeating a test, review, retry or promotion check. It compares a proposed action with accepted evidence, reuses matching results and identifies what became invalid after a change and therefore must run again. It limits duplication rather than stopping the overall task. The publisher explicitly says it does not publish or change permissions and that rate-limit telemetry is not authority to stop. It is not a guarantee that previous evidence remains valid: changed code, environment or requirements still need an evidence-based assessment.

plugins.overview_zh: ANTOC CRM 为房地产团队提供线索、仪表盘、销售管道、员工表现报告和房源搜索，明确限制在登录用户所属业务及 CRM 权限内。适合复盘管道或按要求匹配房源，但正文未证明可修改线索、联系客户或变更员工记录。表现摘要可能受业务记录不完整影响，不应直接决定人事结果；依赖回答或共享客户资料前，应核对业务、日期和房源细节。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ANTOC CRM gives real-estate teams natural-language access to leads, dashboards, sales pipelines, staff-performance reports and property searches. The connected user's business and CRM permissions explicitly limit access. It is useful for pipeline review and matching properties to stated requirements, but the body does not establish editing leads, contacting prospects or changing staff records. Performance summaries may reflect incomplete operational data and should not automatically decide employment outcomes. Confirm the business, date range and property details before relying on an answer or sharing customer information.

plugins.overview_zh: Antom Integration 帮助开发者选择支付产品和接入方式，依据官方文档生成或审阅代码、排查 API 响应及通知、规划沙箱测试和检查上线准备，覆盖一次性、令牌化、订阅支付，以及 Checkout Page、Payment Element 和纯 API 接入。明确仅提供代码与指导，不执行支付、不访问商户账户。签名和通知建议仍需在获准环境测试，上线准备检查也不等于生产安全认证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Antom Integration is a developer guidance skill for choosing an Antom payment product and integration mode, generating or reviewing implementation code from official documentation, diagnosing API responses and notifications, planning sandbox tests and assessing readiness for launch. It covers one-time, tokenised and subscription payments, Checkout Page, Payment Element and API-only approaches. Its explicit boundary is code and guidance only: it does not execute payments or access merchant accounts. Advice about signatures and notifications still requires testing in the developer's authorised environment; readiness assessment is not a production-security certification.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Antwork drafts, schedules and publishes to connected social accounts and reports engagement. It supports LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest, uses recent account posts to inform voice and can attach chat or workspace-library media. It also reviews the content calendar and published results. This is an external publishing tool, not just a writing assistant: immediate publication or a scheduled post can reach an audience. Verify the target account, time zone, media rights and approved content before sending; the page does not spell out every platform restriction or safeguard.

plugins.description_zh: 规划包含多场活动的婚礼
plugins.overview_zh: Anvaya 管理共享婚礼筹备，包括宾客、各场 RSVP、预算与实际花费、供应商报价比较和待办，既适合多日庆典，也支持单日婚礼，并展示真实筹备数据的交互视图。发送 RSVP 提醒或改预算等动作需要确认。伴侣、父母和婚礼团队共享工作区，修改可能影响其他筹备者；比较报价不等于订供应商或付定金，动作前应核对收件人、场次和费用假设。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Anvaya manages shared wedding planning, including guest lists, per-event RSVPs, budgets versus spending, vendor-quote comparisons and next tasks. It is designed for multi-day celebrations as well as single-day weddings, with interactive views tied to the user's actual planning data. Changes such as RSVP reminders or budget updates require a confirmation step. Shared access by couples, parents or the wedding party means edits can affect other planners. Comparing a quote is not booking a supplier or paying a deposit; confirm recipients, event and financial assumptions before consequential actions.

plugins.overview_zh: anVendor 研究企业使用的 SaaS 和商业服务，支持按供应商找公司、检查名单、读取保存发现及可选异步实时扫描，但不提供员工联系方式、邮箱规律或外联。需账户及流程授权；查询可能复用近期结果，不一定新扫，扫描可能五至十分钟甚至更久。必须区分未确认候选、历史与近期发现。检测到使用不证明付费合同、不满或购买意图，没检测到也不证明未使用；采用程度和花费只是估计，不是发票或可靠上下界。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: anVendor researches companies using SaaS or business services, with vendor discovery, company-list checks, saved findings and optional asynchronous live scans. It returns company intelligence, not employee contacts, email patterns or outreach. An account and workflow authorisation are required; a lookup may reuse recent results rather than run a fresh scan, and scans can take five to ten minutes or longer. Distinguish unconfirmed candidates and historical detections from recent findings. Detected use does not prove a paid contract, dissatisfaction or buying intent; no detection does not prove non-use. Adoption and spending are estimates, not invoices or guaranteed ranges.

plugins.description_zh: 焦虑时帮助自己平稳下来
plugins.overview_zh: 这是一项为 AI 助手提供回应方式的技能，面向反复担忧、惊慌、思绪停不下来或夜间难以平静的时刻。开发者强调一次只给一个简短练习和有限的下一步，不反复提供短暂安慰；它不是心理治疗、诊断、评估或危机照护工具。
capabilities_zh: 以简短、边界明确的方式回应焦虑、反复思考和担忧循环。
一次提供一个练习，而非同时堆叠多种技巧；提供简短的当下安定练习和一个有限的下一步。
以试探性的表达帮助描述所陷入的思维循环，避免不断重复提供很快失效的安慰。
出现危机或可能医疗急症的迹象时停止相关支持，并建议联系当地急救服务及身边的人。
不实施或评分心理量表，不进行诊断，不提供用药指导。
use_cases_zh: 详情页示例：“我陷入了反复思考，没法让思绪慢下来。”
详情页示例：“凌晨三点了，我的大脑还是停不下来。”
详情页示例：“我一直为同一个担忧寻求安慰。”
plugins.requirements_zh: 组件类型为技能（skill），不是临床评估服务。仅提供一般健康支持，不是治疗、诊断、医疗处置或危机照护；不提供 GAD-7、PHQ-9、PSS-10 等量表测试或评分。技能本身不指定急救电话号码，由助手结合用户所在地提供合适资源。由 Anima Felix 以 CC BY 4.0 发布。详情页未说明费用、账号或地区要求。

plugins.overview_zh: Any Exchange Rate 提供可调整金额和币种的交互汇率换算，并把最终数字带回对话，适合快速比较。但公开描述没有说明汇率来源、时间、更新频率或是否为参考中间价，也不证明可实际兑换或汇款。银行价差、卡费和成交时间可能使实付不同，作财务承诺前应核实具体交易报价。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Any Exchange Rate provides an interactive currency conversion view where users change amounts or currencies and continue the conversation with the final figures. It is convenient for a quick comparison, but the public description does not identify the exchange-rate source, timestamp, update frequency or whether rates are indicative mid-market values. It does not establish actual currency exchange or a money-transfer service. Bank spreads, card fees and transaction timing can make the paid amount differ from the displayed conversion; verify a transaction-specific quote before using it for a financial commitment.

plugins.overview_zh: Any Fact Widget 展示指定主题或随机主题的简短知识，示例涉及动物和天文，适合轻量学习与满足好奇。简短页面没有说明引用数据库、核查方法、更新策略或专业科学审阅。小组件答案不适合作为高影响决定或正式引用的唯一依据；准确性重要时应要求并核实一手来源。描述未证明连接个人研究账户或自动执行外部动作。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Any Fact Widget displays short facts on a requested subject or a random topic, with examples involving animals and astronomy. It is intended as a lightweight learning or curiosity aid. The brief page does not describe a cited reference database, fact-checking methodology, update policy or specialised scientific review. A concise widget answer should therefore not be treated as sufficient evidence for a high-stakes decision or formal citation. Ask for and verify primary sources when accuracy matters; no account-connected research or automatic external actions are established.

plugins.description_zh: 可保存学习进度的课程
plugins.overview_zh: Any Topic Academy 创建个性化课程、调整课时、提供测验或评估，并跟踪已掌握概念、薄弱点和进度，可用个人代码跨聊天或设备续学。它是持续学习流程，但不证明具备认可学历、独立验证测评或所有主题的专家审查。续学代码应妥善保管，共享前核实保存机制；内容准确性、年龄适宜性、订阅和保留条件仍需检查。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Any Topic Academy builds a personalised course, adapts lessons, provides quizzes or assessments and tracks mastered concepts, gaps and progress. A personal code lets the learner continue from another conversation or device. This is a continuing study workflow rather than a one-off answer, but the description does not establish accredited qualifications, independently validated assessment or expert-reviewed coverage of every subject. Keep the continuation code private and check how progress is stored before sharing it. Lesson accuracy, suitability for a learner's age and any subscription or retention conditions remain to be verified.

plugins.overview_zh: Anya As-Is Home Estimate 服务于房产买方，不是独立估价机构。一般讨论无需地址或联系方式；请求特定房产估计时需在面板确认待售房产，利用可用证据计算，但不检查房况或验证维修成本。估计无需账户和联系资料，可能无法得出结果；数值只是初步投资者估计，不是市值、正式报价或保证净收入。是否向聊天分享有限结果可选，进一步评估另需明确邮件或电话同意，不会自动安排电话或加入营销；请求记录也不证明送达或预约成立。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Anya As-Is Home Estimate is operated for a property buyer, not an independent appraisal service. General discussion needs no address or contact details; a requested estimate requires confirming the sale property in its panel and uses available evidence without assessing condition or verifying repair costs. No account or contact is required for estimation. Results are preliminary investor estimates, not market value, firm offers or guaranteed proceeds, and may be unavailable. Sharing limited result fields with chat is optional; property review requires separate explicit email/phone consent and does not enrol marketing or schedule an automated call. A recorded request proves neither delivery nor an appointment.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyBarcodeScanner 打开商品条码扫描界面，让用户扫描后与 ChatGPT 讨论，例如询问商店商品或食品包装。描述没有列明条码格式、商品库、相机权限、营养验证或地区覆盖。扫到编码不等于证明真伪、安全或包装成分匹配；重要事项仍应查看实物标签和权威资料。页面不证明会购物、修改库存或持续监控相机。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyBarcodeScanner opens a product-barcode scanning interface so a user can scan an item and discuss it with ChatGPT. Examples include asking about a shop product or food package. The description does not specify supported barcode formats, the product database, camera permissions, nutritional verification or coverage of every market. Scanning a code does not prove authenticity, safety or that ingredients match the item in hand. Check the physical label and authoritative product information where it matters; do not infer a purchase, inventory change or continuous camera monitoring from this page.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyConversion- Imperial/Metric 换算公制与英制数量，涉及长度、质量、温度、面积、体积、速度、压力、能量和存储单位，并宣传即时更新、科学工程换算及收藏。页面也包含通用移动应用的离线宣传，但不能据此认定 ChatGPT 集成断网仍可用。工程使用前应确认单位约定、有效数字及舍入，尤其容易混淆的单位和存储前缀。它是计算器，不是设计认证或测量仪器。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyConversion- Imperial/Metric converts quantities across metric and imperial units, with categories such as length, mass, temperature, area, volume, speed, pressure, energy and data storage. The page advertises instant input updates, scientific/engineering conversions and saved favourites. It also makes generic offline/mobile-app claims, which do not by themselves prove that the ChatGPT integration works without a network. Confirm the exact unit convention, significant figures and rounding before engineering use, particularly for ambiguous units or storage prefixes. It is a calculator, not a certification of a design or measurement instrument.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyDB 连接记录、文档、文件和流程工作区，可查找、创建、更新、复制、移动记录，语义搜索、上传下载文件，定义类型及公式、建立视图报告、共享表单、评论、恢复版本并设置事件驱动流程。需登录且沿用权限，属于广泛的持久业务数据操作，不是纯搜索。共享和自动化可能影响其他对象，需确认接收者和触发条件；描述不保证所有修改都可恢复或支持每种文件。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyDB connects a user's workspace of records, documents, files and processes. It can find, create, update, copy and move records, search meaningfully, upload/download files, define types and formulas, build views or reports, share forms, comment, restore versions and automate event-driven workflows. An AnyDB sign-in is required and existing permissions bound access. This is broad persistent business-data control, not just search. Sharing and event-driven automation can have effects beyond the edited record, so confirm recipients and workflow triggers. The description does not guarantee recovery of every change or safe handling of every file type.

plugins.description_zh: 学习 DIY 操作步骤
plugins.overview_zh: AnyHowTo 按用户经验、工具和时间把任务拆成步骤，可继续追问、改为简短清单、比较方法，并提醒常见错误及何时找专业人员，示例覆盖维修、烹饪、技术、手工和学习。它输出指导，不会实际代做或认证步骤。覆盖广不代表掌握所有危险作业；涉及电气、结构、医疗等严重风险时，应核实具体产品说明并寻求合格专业帮助。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyHowTo turns a task into step-by-step guidance adapted to the user's experience, tools and available time. It supports follow-up explanations, shorter checklists, comparisons of methods and warnings about common mistakes or when professional help is needed. Examples span everyday repairs, cooking, technology, crafts and learning. This is instructional output, not a tool that physically performs the work or certifies a procedure. The broad coverage does not prove expertise in every hazardous activity; verify product-specific directions and obtain qualified help where electrical, structural, medical or other serious risks are involved.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyLawyer 检索波兰、中欧及欧盟权威法律资料，包括法规、判例、监管材料、采购记录和 KRS 公司登记摘录，并在可用时返回标识、引用、官方链接和有限原文。需要账户；所有工具只读，不创建、修改、提交或删除登记。它用于研究，不提供法律代理或替代法律意见。不同来源覆盖与时效可能不同，适用前应核对原文、法域和生效日期；取得公司摘录不意味着有权修改登记。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyLawyer searches authoritative Polish, Central European and EU legal sources, including legislation, judgments, regulator material, procurement records and KRS company-register extracts. It returns source identifiers, citations, official links and bounded excerpts where available. An account is required. All tools are read-only: they do not create, change, file or delete register records. This is a research connection, not legal advice or representation. Coverage and currency differ by source; check the original text, jurisdiction and effective date before applying a result, and do not confuse a retrieved company extract with authorisation to change it.

plugins.description_zh: 为学校与课堂生成教学内容
plugins.overview_zh: AnyLessonPlan for Teachers 协助生成课堂教案或修改已有计划，可按年级、年龄、科目或缩短课时处理，适合备课组织材料。公开正文较短，不证明匹配所有课程标准、通过差异化教学或安全审核，也不自动访问学校记录。活动和时间安排仍需教师按实际班级评估；只上传适宜分享的材料，不能据示例推断能评分、排课或联系家庭。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyLessonPlan for Teachers helps generate classroom lesson plans and revise an existing plan, with examples tailored to a grade, age group, subject or shorter duration. It can assist a teacher in organising material before teaching. The public body is brief and does not establish alignment with every curriculum, validated differentiation, safeguarding review or automatic access to school records. Generated activities and timing need the teacher's assessment for the actual class. Upload only material appropriate to share, and do not infer student grading, scheduling or communication with families from these examples.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyMortgageCalculator 根据本金、利率和期限回答房贷计算问题，示例涉及月供、首付及总利息，适合粗略情景比较，不是贷款方报价或申请。页面没有解释复利口径、税、保险、手续费、浮息处理或地区假设，显示月供可能遗漏重要居住成本。借贷决策前应核对输入和贷款方完整报价；描述没有证明会查征信、审批或划款。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyMortgageCalculator answers mortgage-calculation questions using supplied amounts, interest and term, with examples about monthly payment, down payment and total interest. It is useful for rough scenario comparison, not a lender's offer or loan application. The page does not explain compounding conventions, taxes, insurance, fees, variable-rate treatment or jurisdiction-specific assumptions. A displayed payment may therefore omit important housing costs. Check the calculation inputs and a lender's full quote before making a borrowing decision; the description does not establish credit checks, approvals or money movement.

plugins.description_zh: 通过一句提示转换 PDF
plugins.overview_zh: AnyPDF 提供三档压缩，将 JPEG/PNG 及 Office 文档转为 PDF、把 PDF 转 JPG，也可合并、抽页和旋转。流程明确在处理前请求上传文档许可，之后返回下载。它是文件处理服务，不证明能任意原位修改 PDF 文字或保证版式不变。敏感文件应谨慎上传，正文未说明保留、大小限制、密码文件处理或完整保密条款；替换原件前需检查页面与压缩质量。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyPDF compresses PDFs at three levels, converts JPEG/PNG and Office documents to PDF or PDF pages to JPG, merges PDFs, extracts pages and rotates them. The described workflow explicitly asks permission to upload a document before processing and returns a download. It is a file-processing service, not proof of unrestricted in-place PDF text editing or guaranteed layout fidelity. Sensitive files should be shared only when appropriate; retention, size limits, password handling and confidentiality terms are not specified in this body. Review output pages and compression quality before replacing an original.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyReg 通过英国车牌查询车辆资料，示例包括年份和税务状态，所述车辆类别涵盖汽车、货车、摩托车和卡车，适合已知车牌的快速参考。简短描述不证明可查车主身份、完整事故或贷款历史、法律所有权或全面道路安全检查。购买和合规决定前应向官方核对记录及日期；它也没有证明能修改车辆登记或缴税。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyReg looks up UK vehicle information from a registration number, with examples involving vehicle year and tax status. It covers the stated categories of cars, vans, motorcycles and lorries, making it a quick reference aid for a known plate. The short description does not establish access to owner identity, a full accident or finance history, legal proof of ownership or a complete roadworthiness assessment. Registration records and their dates should be checked against official sources before a purchase or compliance decision. The tool does not establish changing vehicle records or paying tax.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyVan 根据待搬物品的文字或图片生成即时搬运报价，描述涵盖住宅、家具、办公室、汽车及进出仓储，并提供后续预订流程。报价依赖清单、路线和服务条件，不代表已订妥或任何运输都可用。承诺前应核对出入条件、人力、保险、附加费、取消和最终价格。照片可能暴露居家隐私，公开正文未说明全部处理及保留条件。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyVan uses a description or images of items to be moved to generate an instant moving quote. The described scope includes house removals, furniture, offices, cars and storage-related moves, followed by a booking path. A quote depends on the supplied inventory, route and service requirements; it is not proof of a completed booking or universally available transport. Check access conditions, labour, insurance, extras, cancellation and final price before committing. Photos may reveal private household details, and the public body does not explain every handling or retention condition.

plugins.overview_zh: AnyWhereMap - Navigate+Locate 打开指定地点的交互地图，可移动、缩放、放置标记，并与 ChatGPT 讨论可见区域，适合了解街区或开展地点相关交流。精确 ID 正文没有证明具备逐路导航、实时交通、预订、持续定位，或对地区安全及宜居性的核验判断。地图信息与旅行建议仍应对照当前当地资料；本次完整来源为索引缓存，可能落后于实时应用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: AnyWhereMap - Navigate+Locate opens an interactive map for a requested place, supports panning and zooming, dropping pins and discussing the visible area with ChatGPT. It is useful for exploring a neighbourhood or orienting a place-based conversation. The recovered exact-ID description does not establish turn-by-turn navigation, live traffic, bookings, continuous device-location tracking or verified assessments of whether an area is safe or pleasant. Map details and any travel advice should be checked against current local information. The indexed source is complete but may lag the live app.

plugins.overview_zh: Análise de Ações Listadas 用基本面、法证及估值流程研究上市公司，依据巴西 ITR/DFP 等监管披露、报表、电话会、市场和同业资料，分析业务质量、风险、DCF 假设、催化剂及情景，并区分事实、说法、共识、计算和假设，附来源日期。若重要授权库可用，会询问是否已有获准会话，绝不索取凭证。它不交易，也不提供个性化买卖持有建议；仍需验证来源权限与模型假设，估值情景不保证回报。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Análise de Ações Listadas is a structured public-equity research skill combining fundamental, forensic and valuation analysis. It draws on regulatory filings such as Brazil's ITR/DFP, statements, earnings calls, market data and peers to examine business quality, risk, DCF assumptions, catalysts and scenarios. It separates facts, claims, consensus, calculations and assumptions, with dates and sources. If material licensed data is available it asks about an already authorised session, never credentials. It does not trade or give personalised buy/sell/hold advice. Source access and model assumptions still require verification; a valuation scenario is not a promised return.

plugins.description_zh: 巴西房地产投资信托基金研究
plugins.overview_zh: Análise de FIIs 研究巴西房地产投资基金的价格、收益率、基本面、风险、流动性、分配和报告，可比较及筛选。免费预览提供公开数据与指标，Pro 解锁其余工具和完整分析，包括登录用户自己的持仓、股息、估值和处理状态。它明确只读、仅供信息，不买卖投资或划款，所以读取组合不等于交易授权。需核对日期和分配口径，历史收益率或折价指标不能保证未来收入。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Análise de FIIs researches Brazilian real-estate investment funds through prices, yields, fundamentals, risk, liquidity, distributions and reports, with fund comparisons and screening. The free preview provides public data and indicators; Pro enables remaining tools and full analyses, including an authenticated user's own holdings, dividends, valuations and processing status. It is explicitly informational and read-only, with no investment purchases, sales or money movement. Portfolio access therefore does not authorise trading. Check data dates and distribution definitions, and do not treat a historical yield or discounted valuation ratio as a guarantee of future income.

plugins.overview_zh: ApartmentIQ 描述了按日更新的多户住宅数据平台，用于市场调查、投资研究、基准比较及收入管理，并宣传覆盖四千万套单位和大型运营商客户。这些是厂商覆盖与营销说法，不证明连接器能取得每个物业或当前报价。页面未列具体查询工具、权限、改价或交易功能；使用时需核对物业、观测日期和可比样本，不意味着可以自动定租金或作住房决策。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ApartmentIQ describes a daily multifamily-property data platform for market surveys, investment research, benchmarking and revenue-management decisions. Its public body advertises coverage of 40 million units and adoption by major operators. Those are provider coverage and marketing claims, not proof that every property or current quote is available through this connector. The page does not enumerate particular query tools, permissions, pricing changes or transaction functions. Use it as a source of market signals, then verify the property, observation date and comparable set; it does not establish authority to set rents or make housing decisions automatically.

plugins.overview_zh: Apartments.com 按地点、预算、卧室、宠物政策和设施搜索房源，返回照片、价格及可租情况，也描述了户型、费用和租约政策查看、街区信息、负担能力估算、预约看房和联系物业。后两项会触达他人，不是被动查询。房态和广告租金可能变化或未含附加费，估算也不等于获批租住。联系前应确认房号、总成本、接收人和预约细节，最终应查看真实租约。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Apartments.com searches rental listings by place, budget, bedrooms, pet policy and amenities, returning photos, prices and availability. It also describes floor-plan exploration, fees and lease-policy review, neighbourhood context, affordability estimates, tour scheduling and contacting properties. The latter actions involve other people and should not be confused with passive searching. Availability and advertised rent can change or exclude additional charges; an affordability estimate is not approval for a tenancy. Confirm the unit, total costs, recipient and appointment details before any contact, and inspect the actual lease rather than relying solely on the summary.

plugins.overview_zh: ApexLog 只读连接自己的赛道日志，可按分段比较圈速，查看设置、轮胎年限、零件磨损、天气、GPS 和确实记录过的 OBD 数据，帮助结合机械及环境背景解释表现，而不是补造缺失遥测。它不修改或删除记录。厂商宣传不限提问仍受用户 ChatGPT 套餐和服务可用性影响；历史驾驶数据不等于车辆安全认证，也不是尝试危险动作的许可。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ApexLog is a read-only connection to the user's own track-day logbook. It compares laps by sector and retrieves setup, tyre age, component wear, weather, GPS traces and OBD values when those were actually logged. This can help interpret a lap in its mechanical and environmental context, rather than inventing missing telemetry. It never changes or deletes records. The publisher's no-question-limit claim still depends on the user's ChatGPT plan and service availability. Historical driving data is not a vehicle safety certification or permission to attempt an unsafe manoeuvre.

plugins.overview_zh: Aphex 连接施工交付记录，让用户提问并起草有现场资料依据的报告，示例包括审阅周日志中的潜在预警及汇总分包工时。它辅助报告与调查，不代表正式通知已送达或合同问题已成立。简短正文未说明能修改进度计划、授权作业、发通知或认证工地安全；用于商务和运营决定前应核对日志、日期及项目权限。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Aphex connects to construction-delivery records so users can ask questions and draft reports grounded in site information. Examples include reviewing weekly diaries for possible early warnings and summarising subcontractor labour hours. It is a reporting and investigation aid, not proof that a notice has been formally served or that a contractual issue is established. The short body does not describe editing the programme, authorising work, sending notices or certifying site safety. Verify the underlying diary, dates and project permissions before using a draft for commercial or operational decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: API Documentation Checker 从提供的 API 契约提取端点、参数、响应和错误，检查文档覆盖并比较版本，输出结构化结果且明确限于所给证据。适合发现遗漏和契约变化，但不会因此独立调用 API 或证明服务端遵守契约。缺失或含糊材料应保留为缺口，不能编造接口；行为验证仍需获准集成测试及真实实现。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: API Documentation Checker extracts endpoints, parameters, responses and errors from supplied API-contract material, checks whether documentation covers that contract and compares versions. Its outputs are structured and explicitly limited to the provided evidence. It is useful for spotting omitted documentation or stated contract changes, but it does not independently call an API or prove that a server implements the contract. Missing or ambiguous source material should remain a gap rather than an invented endpoint. Pair its review with authorised integration tests and the actual implementation where behaviour matters.

plugins.description_zh: 梳理 API 变更及其影响
plugins.overview_zh: API Impact Mapper 提取明确 API 变更、分类可能的破坏性变化，并把有依据的影响关联到调用方、测试和文档。它仅使用用户提供事实，不访问外部系统，因此是限定范围的变更分析技能，不是实时依赖扫描器。未提供的调用方可能遗漏，影响清单为空也不能证明迁移安全；发布批准前仍需检查真实调用、版本和部署计划。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: API Impact Mapper extracts explicit API changes, classifies potentially breaking changes and links supported impacts to consumers, tests and documentation. It uses only facts supplied by the user and does not access external systems. This makes it a scoped change-analysis skill rather than a live dependency scanner. A consumer not present in the supplied evidence may remain unknown, so an empty impact list is not proof that migration is safe. Check the actual callers, versioning and deployment plan before relying on the map for release approval.

plugins.description_zh: 查找 API 与 MCP 培训
plugins.overview_zh: API Lessons 汇集 Emmanuel Paraskakis 在 Maven 的短时 Lightning Lessons，主题包括 API、MCP、产品管理、技术 PM 职业和 ChatGPT 应用，可找录像、未来直播及相关进阶班。短课被描述为免费、实操、经 Zoom 进行且仅用英语，面向有技术基础的职场人士。找到课程不代表已报名，关联进阶班也不能默认免费；报名应核对日期、名额、基础要求和课程条款。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: API Lessons is a catalogue of Emmanuel Paraskakis's short Maven Lightning Lessons on APIs, MCP, product management, technical PM careers and ChatGPT apps. Users can find recordings, upcoming live lessons or related cohort courses for deeper study. The short lessons are described as free, practical, delivered over Zoom and exclusively in English, aimed at technically comfortable mid-career professionals. A listed opportunity is not a completed registration, and related cohort courses should not automatically be assumed free. Check dates, availability, prerequisites and any course-specific terms before signing up.

plugins.description_zh: 检查服务当前是否故障
plugins.description_en: Is a service down right now?

plugins.overview_zh: Apilio 连接智能家居自动化平台，查看和管理设备、变量及逻辑块，创建规则、检查条件并触发动作，提及 Tuya、Philips Hue、Tado、eWeLink、IFTTT、Alexa、Webhook 和 REST API。它可能产生现实设备效果，不只是出方案。支持设备、权限和保护机制取决于实际连接，描述不保证每项动作都能撤回。启用前应确认设备、条件及后果，尤其安防或安全相关设备。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Apilio connects to a smart-home automation platform for devices, variables and logicblocks. It can inspect state, manage configuration, create rules, evaluate conditions and trigger actions, with named integrations including Tuya, Philips Hue, Tado, eWeLink, IFTTT, Alexa, webhooks and REST APIs. This can have physical-world effects, not merely produce a plan. Supported devices, permissions and safeguards depend on the actual account and integration; the description does not guarantee every action is reversible. Confirm the target device, condition and consequences before activation, especially for security or safety-related equipment.

plugins.overview_zh: APiM Galaxy 研究 B2B 市场进入与企业关系，提出引荐路径并排序潜客，给关系附来源并标记未核实联系。厂商称完整研究免费且无使用上限，已有 Pro 账户登录后可加品牌报告页、PDF 和保存的公司档案。它辅助准备接触策略，不会因此自动引荐，也不保证关系仍活跃或可接触。外联前需核对来源时效、身份和商业相关性；免费及 Pro 条件不意味着永不调整。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: APiM Galaxy researches B2B market entry and company relationships, proposes introduction paths and prioritises prospects, with links supporting relationships and unverified ties flagged. The provider advertises full research free without a usage cap; an existing signed-in Pro account adds a branded report page, PDF and saved company profile. It helps prepare an approach, not send introductions or guarantee that a relationship is active or accessible. Check source recency, identity and commercial relevance before outreach. Free access and Pro features are published terms, not a promise that service limits will never change.

plugins.overview_zh: Apixel 根据文本生成图片，主打带清晰文字的海报、标志和社交内容，示例也涉及信息图及多轴图表。但视觉生成不等于科学图示准确、数字作图精确或每次拼写无误，使用前应核对文字、数据标注和事实，并另查授权与品牌要求。正文未说明编辑工具、分辨率、额度、价格或商用许可，速度和准确性属于厂商宣传而非保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Apixel generates images from text prompts, positioning itself for posters, logos and social content with readable lettering. Examples also include an infographic and a multi-axis chart. It is a visual-generation tool, not evidence of reliable scientific diagrams, exact numerical plotting or perfect spelling in every output. Review embedded text, data labels and factual content before use, and verify usage rights and brand requirements separately. The public body does not specify editing tools, resolution, quotas, pricing or commercial licences; fast or accurate output is a provider claim rather than a guarantee.

plugins.overview_zh: aplicANT 是求职文档的最后编辑与导出环节，把聊天中准备的内容放入嵌入编辑器，可检查个人资料、经历、教育、技能、语言、项目、推荐人和求职信，提供 50 种模板、颜色字体布局、章节排序、可选照片和拼写辅助，并预览导出 PDF。发布者明确不会自动投递或联系雇主。导出前需核实事实及隐私，模板精美不保证 ATS 兼容、招聘偏好或录用结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: aplicANT is an editing and export stage for job-application documents already prepared in conversation. Its embedded editor lets users review personal details, experience, education, skills, languages, projects, references and cover letters, with 50 templates, layout/font/colour options, reorderable sections, optional photos and spelling assistance. It previews and renders downloadable PDFs. The publisher explicitly says it does not send applications or contact employers. Review factual accuracy, references and private information before export; a polished template does not guarantee ATS compatibility, recruiter preference or a job outcome.

plugins.overview_zh: Aplicativos Fonocenter 汇集四个 Fonocenter 标准应用，可在对话中打开、审阅、编辑或继续处理，示例提到 PHD 排程和护理换药安排。公开描述很短，未列全四个应用、字段、账户权限、临床验证或运行宿主。所列交互与写入能力不能解释为无限制访问患者记录或作医疗决策授权。编辑前应核实应用与数据范围，本轮未打开或修改实际排程。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Aplicativos Fonocenter groups four canonical Fonocenter applications so they can be opened, reviewed, edited or continued from a conversation. Examples name PHD scheduling and a treatment/dressing schedule. The public description is brief and does not identify all four applications, supported fields, account permissions, clinical validation or the host needed to run them. Its listed interactive/write capability should not be interpreted as unrestricted access to patient records or authority to make healthcare decisions. Verify the application and data scope before editing; this research did not open or alter any operational schedule.

plugins.overview_zh: APODICTIC Development Editor 评估稿件结构，输出编辑意见及有优先级的修订计划；小说关注情节、节奏、人物弧线和连贯，论述非虚构关注主张、证据、逻辑缺口及反驳。它明确只诊断，不改写或编造正文。机械检查和标注导出需宿主运行脚本，续接项目需持久文件，独立审阅代理需委派支持，可选 SETEC 测量需兼容安装，且没有作者运营后端。它是编辑辅助，不自动核验全部事实，也不保证所有宿主支持全部流程。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: APODICTIC Development Editor assesses manuscript structure and produces an editorial letter with prioritised revision work. Fiction review covers plot, pacing, character arcs and continuity; argumentative nonfiction review covers claims, evidence, logical gaps and objections. It explicitly diagnoses rather than rewriting or inventing prose. Mechanical checks and annotated exports need host script execution, saved-project continuation needs persistent files, separate review agents need delegation support and optional SETEC measurements require a compatible installation. There is no author-operated backend. Treat it as editorial support, not automatic fact verification or a guarantee that every host can perform every optional workflow.

plugins.overview_zh: 只读连接 Apollo Invoicing，可找客户、查看发票、付款状态和未结余额。OAuth 将访问限定到一个企业和一个环境，适合查欠款或确认付款状态，不用于开票、收款或更改客户记录。需要 Apollo 账户；历史覆盖、导出选项和套餐资格未说明。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要 Apollo 账户及 OAuth，只读范围限一个企业和环境。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A read-only connection for finding customers and reviewing invoices, payment status and outstanding balances in Apollo Invoicing. OAuth links one business and one environment, keeping the query scope explicit. Useful for checking who owes money or whether an invoice is paid, not for creating invoices, collecting payment or changing customer records. An Apollo account is required; historical coverage, export options and plan eligibility are not specified.

plugins.overview_zh: 据目录介绍，把 Apollo 工作区中的客户开发资料和外联流程带入 ChatGPT，并按团队规则与权限处理。
capabilities_zh: 搜索、筛选账户与联系人，补充记录信息并总结背景
创建列表、记录笔记及生成任务
通过 sequences 准备或组织外联内容
use_cases_zh: 使用示例：筛选一组目标公司，整理联系人清单和可供审核的外联草稿。
plugins.requirements_zh: 在团队规则和工作区权限范围内运行。外联准备不等于可以未经审核直接发送。

plugins.overview_zh: 本 ID 当前显示名称为 Apostra，而非原目录的 Apostra Distribution。它通过区分角色的市场工作流连接广告买卖双方，包含购买准备、活动设置和管理技能；示例包括根据简报选择媒体库存与创意，以及检查正在运行的活动。简短功能正文未证明全部平台覆盖、自动花费权限或详细定向能力；实际操作前应确认角色、库存、预算及发布权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入、账户和环境条件见介绍；未公开的价格、额度及权限仍待核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: The selected ID now displays Apostra rather than Apostra Distribution. It describes a role-aware marketplace workflow connecting advertising buyers and sellers, with skills for account readiness, campaign setup and campaign management. Examples include choosing supply and creatives from a brief and reviewing active campaigns. The short functional description does not establish every supported platform, automatic spending authority or detailed targeting controls. Confirm account role, inventory, budget and publication permissions before real campaign actions.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找 ChatGPT 和 Claude 应用
plugins.overview_zh: 按类别、关键词或场景搜索 ChatGPT 和 Claude 应用目录，并用表格比较结果，适合研究生态或寻找任务工具。明确不覆盖生态外通用软件、不安装或购买应用，也不负责开发和配置。目录结果只是发现线索，不证明当前账户资格或完整能力；连接前仍应核对目标应用详情。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches a directory of ChatGPT and Claude apps by category, keyword or use case, returning a comparison table. It can support ecosystem research or help find a tool for a particular task. Its scope explicitly excludes general software outside these ecosystems, installation, purchases, and app building or configuration. Directory results are discovery leads rather than proof of current account eligibility or full capabilities; verify the chosen app's own detail before connecting.

plugins.description_zh: 制作 App Store 和 Google Play 截图
plugins.overview_zh: 把应用截图做成单张或系列商店展示图，可加标题、背景和设备边框，支持商店规定或自定义尺寸、预览和完整分辨率 PNG ZIP 下载，无需本地渲染设置。它生成文件，不直接发布到商店账户。源图片与项目保留到用户请求删除，导出包 24 小时后删除；应核对素材权利并及时下载。
plugins.requirements_zh: 提供截图或使用样例；源图与项目保留至请求删除，导出包 24 小时后删除。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Turns supplied app captures into individual or coordinated App Store/Google Play graphics, adding headlines, backgrounds and device frames. It supports store dimensions or custom sizes, preview and full-resolution PNG downloads bundled in a ZIP, without local rendering setup. It creates files rather than publishing to store accounts. Source images and projects remain stored until deletion is requested; exports expire after 24 hours. Review content rights and download outputs promptly.

plugins.overview_zh: 用于验证插件提交流程的调试应用。精确 ID 页面给出完整但非常简短的功能说明，不是生产级提交管理规范。没有说明看板、真实审核状态追踪、自动提交或商店审批权限。宜视为测试工具；支持用例、可用用户、数据保留和稳定性未在介绍中记录。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A debugging app whose stated purpose is validating plugin-submission flows. The exact-ID page contains a complete but very brief functional statement, not a production submission-management specification. It does not describe dashboards, real review-state tracking, automated submission or marketplace approval authority. Best treated as a test utility; supported test cases, eligible users, data retention and stability are not documented in the listing.

plugins.overview_zh: 读取 Appbot 账户追踪的应用，获取筛选后的评论，并汇总评论量、评分、版本和情绪。示例包括负面评论原因、增长的功能请求及发布后情绪变化。适合研究反馈和排优先级，不代表能发布回复或改商店资料。结果取决于追踪范围、筛选和可用历史；应确认账户权限及套餐限制。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Reads apps tracked in an Appbot account, fetches filtered review pages and summarizes review counts, star ratings, app versions and sentiment. Examples investigate drivers of negative reviews, growing feature requests and release-related sentiment changes. Useful for review research and prioritization, not evidence that it can publish replies or change store listings. Results depend on the tracked apps, filters and available review history; account access and plan limits need checking.

plugins.overview_zh: 从聊天构建并发布网页应用，可查看部署与 QA 结果、管理版本和源码快照，也涉及后端密钥与自定义域名配置。这不只是起草代码，可能影响真实服务。应审核部署目标和权限，不能把部署成功等同完整测试、安全密钥处理或生产就绪。账户、资源额度、回滚保证和托管价格未说明。

Review deployment targets and permissions; do not assume testing coverage, secure secret handling or production readiness merely from successful deployment. Account requirements, resource quotas, rollback guarantees and hosting prices are not stated.

plugins.description_zh: 创建 App Store 截图套组
plugins.overview_zh: 由一至六张截图生成可编辑的 App Store 或 Google Play 展示项目，编写画面名称及标题，套设备边框和商店尺寸，再在编辑器修改并导出 PNG。开始无需账户，保存到资料库时需登录。源截图在保存后删除，若从未打开则 72 小时后删除。自动用模拟器或浏览器截图属于编程智能体能力，不应套用到普通聊天。
plugins.requirements_zh: 提供一至六张截图，保存时需账户，后续在 appdesigns 编辑导出。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates an editable App Store or Google Play screenshot project from one to six uploaded captures. It writes screen names/headlines, applies device frames and store-specific dimensions, then opens the set in its editor for changes and PNG export. No account is needed until saving; sign-in saves to a library. Source screenshots are deleted after saving the set or after 72 hours if never opened. Automatic simulator/browser capture is a coding-agent capability, not established for ordinary chat.

plugins.overview_zh: 从应用截图制作商店图、社交素材、宣传视频和动态设备样机，可浏览项目与素材、上传参考、比较风格并预览三种视频构想。先选择风格再生成变体；支持的客户端显示选择器，否则给网页链接，后续在已连接 AppLaunchFlow 账户编辑。导出格式、渲染额度和费用未完整说明，也未确认直接发布到商店。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates app-launch visuals from screenshots: store graphics, social assets, promotional videos and animated device mockups. It can browse projects/assets, upload references, compare styles and preview three video concepts. A style is selected before a variant is generated. Supported clients show interactive pickers, otherwise browser links are supplied; further editing happens in a connected AppLaunchFlow account. Export formats, render quotas and costs are not fully listed, and it does not establish direct store publication.

plugins.overview_zh: 根据用户提供的截止日期和每日投入估计倒排申请准备，排序并标记已过截止或开工日期。每项独立计算，多个申请争抢时间需另行检查。仅使用成人用户可控制的结构化事实，不外查、持久保存或发送。服务器计算是临时的，独立网站在本地计算并支持 CSV／JSON 审核导出。MCP 请求上限 128 KiB、结果 256 KiB，另有字段及记录限制。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Back-plans application preparation from user-supplied deadlines and daily work estimates, sorts items and flags deadlines or planned starts already passed. Each application is calculated independently, so overlapping workload conflicts require separate review. It uses structured, adult-controlled facts without external lookup, persistence or sending. Server calculations are transient; the standalone site computes locally and supports CSV/JSON review/export. MCP requests are limited to 128 KiB and computed responses to 256 KiB, with additional record/field limits.

plugins.overview_zh: 从用户明确确认已审核的申请事实生成可复核的跟进邮件主题和正文。姓名只是可选标签，不是投递地址，工具不会发送。仅使用成人可控制的结构化输入，不外查或持久保存。服务器临时计算，独立网站本地计算并可导出 CSV／JSON；请求及结果分别限 128／256 KiB。用于真实邮件前应审核措辞与事实。
plugins.requirements_zh: 明确确认已审核事实；只起草不发送，请求结果上限 128／256 KiB。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Builds a reviewable follow-up email subject and body from application facts the user explicitly confirms have been reviewed. Names are optional labels, not delivery addresses, and nothing is sent. It uses adult-controlled structured input without external lookup or persistent storage. Calculations are transient on the server and local on the standalone site, which offers CSV/JSON export. Requests and results are capped at 128/256 KiB respectively. Review wording and facts before copying into a real message.

plugins.overview_zh: 按申请阶段、联系日期和用户选择的跟进间隔生成下一步清单，标出逾期事件与已关闭申请；间隔只是自己的规划规则，不代表雇主期待。无外查、持久记录或发送能力。使用成人可控制的结构化数据，服务器临时计算，独立网站可本地处理及导出 CSV／JSON。输入输出限 128／256 KiB，并有字段记录上限；行动前应审核清单。
plugins.requirements_zh: 提供阶段、日期和跟进间隔，无外查保存发送；请求结果限 128／256 KiB。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates a next-action queue from application stages, contact dates and a user-chosen follow-up interval. It flags overdue scheduled events and closed applications, but the interval is the user's planning rule rather than an employer's expectation. No external lookup, persistent records or sending is provided. It accepts adult-controlled structured data, with transient server computation and optional local-site CSV/JSON export. Input/output limits are 128/256 KiB plus field and record caps; review the queue before acting.

plugins.description_zh: 研究优秀 iOS 应用的界面
plugins.description_en: Study screens of top iOS apps
plugins.overview_zh: 提供高收入移动应用的页面、流程、引导和付费墙参考，并附收入背景，帮助创始人与设计师比较体验模式。示例从研究引导流程延伸到为新应用设计提供参考。页面不证明收入估计准确，不授权复制受保护素材，也不保证完成整款应用。目录覆盖、时效、套餐和素材许可需另行核对。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A reference library of high-grossing mobile-app screens, flows, onboarding and paywalls, presented with revenue context. It helps founders and designers compare patterns and research why leading apps structure experiences a certain way. Example prompts extend from browsing onboarding to informing a new app design. The listing does not verify revenue estimates, authorize copying protected assets, or promise a complete app implementation. Catalog coverage, freshness, access plan and licensing need separate checking.

plugins.description_zh: 简历评分、求职信和准备工作
plugins.overview_zh: 把职位广告与粘贴的简历或一份 PDF／DOCX 简历对照，展示哪些要求有明确经历证据、哪些仍有缺口，并据简历事实起草求职信及准备面试题。无需账户，明确不编造经历、不预测录用结果。匹配报告是申请辅助，不是招聘决策或录用保证；使用前应复核提取内容与证据对应。

It can draft a cover letter grounded in CV facts and prepare interview questions from the same role. No account is required. It explicitly avoids inventing experience or predicting hiring outcomes; a fit report is application preparation, not a hiring decision or guarantee. Review extraction and evidence matches before using the draft.

plugins.overview_zh: 根据学科、目的地、预算和计划入学时间筛选留学项目，帮助比较教育层级、时间和课程资料是否符合学术及财务偏好。定位是项目发现，不是提交申请，也不保证录取、就业或签证。应向学校确认学费、截止日期、认证及入学标准；账户要求和目录覆盖及更新频率未详细列明。

The listing describes discovery, not submitting an application or guaranteeing admission, work prospects or visa eligibility. Confirm tuition, deadlines, accreditation and entry criteria with the institution; account requirements and the breadth or update frequency of the catalog are not detailed.

plugins.description_zh: App Store 和 Google Play 应用商店优化
plugins.description_en: App Store and Google Play ASO
plugins.overview_zh: 把 Applyra 账户的每日双商店排名、关键词历史、竞争位置及资料审查带入聊天，可查流量和难度指标、按商店规则检查草稿、比较可见性，并按要求追踪或取消关键词及竞品。需要包含 API 权限的账户。它研究和评分，不发布商店资料，用户需自行在商店后台发布。评分只是改进参考，不保证排名或下载增长。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Brings an Applyra account's daily App Store/Google Play rankings, keyword history, competitor positions and listing audits into chat. It can inspect traffic/difficulty indicators, check draft metadata against store rules, compare visibility and track or untrack keywords/competitors when requested. An account with API access is required. It scores and researches rather than publishing listing changes; users publish in the stores themselves. Scores forecast possible improvements, not guaranteed ranking or download gains.

plugins.overview_zh: 建立并管理同时指向 Apple App Store、Google Play 及可选备用网站的下载链接，可列出链接、查看或修改名称和目标，并查看保留日期范围内点击及浏览统计。需连接 AppQR 账户并批准权限。它不发布应用、不收款、不删链接，也不报告确认安装量，因此点击不能等同安装；改目标会影响真实分享链接。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates and manages download links with Apple App Store and Google Play destinations and an optional website fallback. It can list links, inspect or update names/destinations, and report retained click/page-view statistics. Requires a connected AppQR account and approved account-scoped permissions. It does not publish apps, process payments, delete links or report confirmed installations. Click counts should therefore not be interpreted as installs, and changing a destination affects a real shared link.

plugins.description_zh: 识别可重复的大语言模型调用
plugins.overview_zh: 找出循环、定时任务或接口中反复使用同类结构的大模型调用，指导从现有调用收集经核验示例，再测试优化提示词或较小微调模型能否保质降本。这是代码与评测工作流，不保证所有任务都能安全换便宜模型。需要仓库、代表性样本、训练部署工具及成本质量基准，并审核结果。

It guides capture of verified examples from existing calls and tests whether prompt optimization or a smaller fine-tuned model can retain quality at lower cost. This is a code-oriented evaluation workflow, not a promise that every workload can safely use a cheaper model. Repository access, representative examples, training/deployment tooling and cost-quality benchmarks must be available and reviewed.

It exports PNGs at required store sizes for the user to upload. Useful for producing a coordinated marketing set, not evidence of direct publishing or store approval. plugins.overview_zh: 查询 Appskyline 中追踪的移动应用，查看商店身份、关键词及 iOS App Store、Google Play 和 Microsoft Store 当前排名；示例可跨商店比较并查近期历史。确认的是排名查看，不是改商店资料或保证提升。覆盖取决于已配置追踪及商店支持；保留期限、刷新频率、订阅条件和历史完整性未详细说明。

Examples compare positions across stores and inspect recent history. The listing establishes ranking review, not editing app listings or guaranteed rank improvement. Coverage depends on configured tracking and supported stores; retention, update cadence, subscription requirements and whether history is complete are not detailed.

plugins.description_zh: iOS 市场研究和应用商店优化
plugins.overview_zh: 研究 iOS App Store 细分市场、地区商店、竞品、评分、关键词热度和搜索结果，再从资料与评论提炼 ASO 建议。需 OAuth 连接 AppTail，数据及追踪额度随套餐变化。公开竞品数据不同于自己 App Store Connect 实测数据；可用的竞品下载收入是滚动 30 天估计。不覆盖 Google Play、独立数值难度分或发布，也不保证排名下载。

Requires OAuth to AppTail, with data and tracking limits determined by the plan. Public competitor data is distinct from measured App Store Connect data; competitor downloads/revenue are rolling 30-day estimates when available. plugins.overview_zh: 查询来自社交帖子与视频的消费者情报，研究品类趋势、品牌情绪、受众语言及活动产品构想，宣称结果关联底层对话，示例可限定地区和时间。需要连接 ARIA 账户。社交证据不自动代表整体市场，应检查抽样、覆盖、时效和原帖，不把发布者的信心宣传当作独立验证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Queries consumer-intelligence data drawn from social posts and videos to investigate category trends, brand sentiment, audience language and potential campaign or product ideas. Results are described as linked to the underlying conversations, with geographic and time-window examples. Requires a connected ARIA account. Social evidence is useful but not automatically representative of a whole market; inspect sampling, coverage, recency and cited posts rather than treating publisher confidence claims as independent validation.

plugins.overview_zh: 早期预览版数字咨询助手，根据业务问题及 KONGMY Digital Consultancy 经验，讨论公司网站、内部系统或 AI 智能体的高层方案。发布者明确称输出为经验意见，并提醒可能变化或出问题。虽然副标题提到建设，正文未证明会实际搭建部署网站。应当作方向建议，不是交付承诺或技术效果保证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 早期预览，仅建议而非建设部署承诺，可能变化或出问题。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: An early-preview digital-consulting assistant that discusses how a business might approach a company website, internal system or AI agent. Its guidance is based on stated business problems and KONGMY Digital Consultancy's experience. The publisher explicitly describes outputs as opinions and warns of changes and issues. Despite the directory subtitle, the body does not establish that it builds or deploys a website. Treat it as high-level advice, not a delivery commitment or guaranteed technical solution.

plugins.overview_zh: 搜索教学资料库的论文、转写和来源，返回引用片段，并把课程目标与已有资料比较。需要 Thinker 账户及自己拥有的资料库，每个连接限定该库且默认只读；允许后可保存对话摘要并准备待审核资料建议。视频链接不等同已导入转写；搜索采用字面匹配，没有结果不能证明主题不存在。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Thinker 账户及自有资料库，默认只读，保存需许可；字面搜索可能漏概念。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches a teaching library's papers, transcripts and sources, returns cited excerpts and compares course goals against existing material. A Thinker account and a library owned by the user are required; each connection is confined to that library and defaults to read-only. With permission it can save conversation summaries and prepare profile suggestions for review. Saved video links are separate from imported transcripts. Search is literal, so no matches do not prove a topic is absent.

plugins.description_zh: 将聊天转化为视觉看板
plugins.overview_zh: 把对话变成计划、研究比较或技术取舍的视觉板，先审核简报，再组合笔记、表格、图表和视觉面板，明确假设、风险与未解问题。可在 Canvas 或 Reader 浏览，从聊天重开并在 Arkah 修改。需要账户；视觉结构不独立证明事实正确，分享权限、导出和套餐限制未说明。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Arkah 账户，并在创建前审核板式简报。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不是安装实测、服务质量或宣传保证。产品特定限制见介绍。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Turns conversation context into visual boards for plans, research comparisons or technical trade-offs. You first review a brief, then create a board combining notes, tables, charts and visual panels, making assumptions, risks and unanswered questions visible. Boards can be explored in Canvas or Reader, reopened from chat and refined in Arkah. An Arkah account is required. Generated visual structure does not independently validate the underlying facts; sharing permissions, exports and plan limits are not specified.

plugins.description_zh: 保持 AI 工作连续性
plugins.overview_zh: 跨多个 AI 工具的私人项目续接层，可搜上下文、执行开工前检查、记录决定、保存进度和结构化交接。工作区隔离并用限定范围 OAuth；可选 Arkon Sync 能捕获支持的本地会话，但连接应用并不自动启用本地捕获。应确认共享、同步范围和保留内容；连续记录不保证之前工作正确。
plugins.requirements_zh: 限定 OAuth 及隔离工作区；本地捕获另需 Arkon Sync。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A private continuity layer for projects across multiple AI tools. It searches project context, runs preflight checks, records decisions, checkpoints progress and prepares structured handoffs so later sessions can resume consistently. Workspaces are isolated and use scoped OAuth; an optional Arkon Sync component can capture supported local sessions. That local capture is not automatic merely by connecting the app. Confirm sharing, synchronization scope and retained content; continuity records do not guarantee that prior work was correct.

plugins.description_zh: 检查 MCP 智能体活动
plugins.overview_zh: 帮助开发者查看已配置 MCP 服务器、记录的智能体会话和用例，调查重复问题并报告应用能力缺口。示例可按影响排序问题并查看相关会话。它是观测调查界面，不代表能访问未配置服务器、拦截所有智能体或自动修复。覆盖、工作区权限、敏感日志处理和保留规则决定分析边界。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入、账户和环境条件见介绍；未公开的价格、额度及权限仍待核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Helps developers inspect configured MCP servers, recorded agent sessions and use cases, investigate recurring issues and report missing app capabilities. An example prioritizes workspace issues by potential impact and opens a relevant session. It is an observability and investigation interface, not evidence that it can access unconfigured servers, intercept all agents or fix issues automatically. Recorded coverage, workspace permissions, sensitive-log handling and retention determine the usefulness and safety of the analysis.

plugins.description_zh: 读取和更新 AI 政策
plugins.overview_zh: 读取、更新和审核限制编程智能体使用工具、文件及基础设施的策略，支持自然语言规则、状态检查和调用前意图计划登记。它是治理界面，不保证策略覆盖所有环境，也不能覆盖宿主自身安全控制。策略变更可能显著影响权限，编辑前应核对工作区、执行范围并批准；语法和审计保留未详细说明。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入、账户和环境条件见介绍；未公开的价格、额度及权限仍待核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Reads, updates and reviews policies governing AI coding agents' access to tools, files and infrastructure. It supports natural-language rules, policy-state checks and intent-plan registration before tool calls. This is a governance interface, not a guarantee that a policy reaches every execution environment or can override a host's own safety controls. Policy changes can materially affect access, so verify target workspace, enforcement scope and approval before editing. Supported policy syntax and audit retention are not detailed.

plugins.overview_zh: 免费只读查询 Arne Kellmann 已发布 AI 架构咨询服务，可搜索英德语文档及来源片段，比较合作范围和价格联系指导。页面四项服务均为每小时 120 欧元、不含增值税，具体范围与档期待单独约定。不预约、不发送询价、不收款。价格是当时公开资料，签约前需重确认，不是已接受报价。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公开资料免费，咨询标价每小时 120 欧元不含税，需单独约定。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A free read-only reference for Arne Kellmann's published AI-architecture consulting services. It searches English/German documents with excerpts and source URLs, compares engagement scope and explains pricing/contact guidance. The listed four services are EUR 120 per hour excluding VAT, with actual scope and availability negotiated individually. It does not book meetings, send inquiries or collect payment. Treat the published rate as dated information to reconfirm before a contract, not an accepted quotation.

plugins.description_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中打开 Crew Hub
plugins.overview_zh: 在聊天中打开全屏 Arrayco Crew Hub，访问班组运营、安全资源、日程和现场报告，并只读参考 BC Building Code 2024 及 WorkSafeBC 职业安全规定。不能替代当前官方要求或专业合规意见。正文没有逐项说明运营记录可否编辑及访问对象；应核实账户权限和规范版本。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Opens Arrayco Crew Hub as an in-chat full-screen app for crew operations, safety resources, schedules and field reports. It also provides read-only reference access to the BC Building Code 2024 and WorkSafeBC occupational-safety regulation. This is not a substitute for checking current official requirements or obtaining professional compliance advice. The body does not enumerate which operational records are editable or who can access them; account permissions and the reference edition should be verified.

plugins.overview_zh: 通过 @hotdocx/arrowgram-agent 包，让 Codex 初始化、编辑、验证、预览、快照和构建基于文件的 Arrowgram 工作区，示例包括论文工作区和图形 JSON 修改。依赖合适编程环境及真实项目文件，不是通用托管画图器。构建成功不证明科学内容正确或视觉质量，应另外检查图、论文和验证结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要 Codex 及文件工作区工具，不是独立托管编辑器。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A Codex-oriented workflow for initializing, editing, validating, previewing, snapshotting and building file-backed Arrowgram workspaces through the @hotdocx/arrowgram-agent package. Examples include creating a paper workspace and refining a diagram JSON file. It depends on an appropriate coding environment and actual project files rather than a general hosted diagram editor. Build success is not proof of scientific correctness or visual quality; inspect generated diagrams, papers and validation outputs separately.

plugins.description_zh: 创建 AI 艺术和设计
plugins.overview_zh: 覆盖提示词、插画、绘画风格、概念艺术、封面、周边、图案及照片草图转化的艺术指导技能包，也辅助构图、配色、点评和印刷准备。索引正文提到回复附推广联盟尾注，这是产品行为描述，不是本目录的写作指令。渲染工具、生成额度和商用权未明确，广泛能力仍属发布者声明，制作前需审核输出及许可。
