plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A wide-ranging art-direction skills package for prompts, illustration, painting styles, concept art, covers, merchandise, patterns and photo/sketch transformations. It supports composition, palettes, critiques and print-preparation guidance. The indexed description includes an affiliate-footer requirement, which is product behavior information rather than a requirement for this catalog. Rendering tools, image-generation credits and commercial rights are not established. Treat advertised expertise and broad coverage as publisher claims, and review outputs and licenses before production.

plugins.overview_zh: 从想法或照片准备适合纸张、画布、墙、蛋糕等表面的清晰描摹图，并可分新手步骤，再指导使用手机实时摄像叠图手工描画。插件本身不打开摄像头、不向服务上传图片；用户需保存参考，在手机浏览器上传并亲手描。设备设置、图片权利及表面适用性仍须自行确认。
plugins.requirements_zh: 用户自行将参考图上传手机网页工具并手工描，插件不打开摄像头。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prepares clean, appropriately sized tracing references from an idea or photo for paper, canvas, walls, cakes or other surfaces, with optional beginner stages. It then explains using Art Overlay's phone-camera overlay to trace by hand. The plugin itself neither opens the camera nor uploads images to the service: users save the reference, upload it in their phone browser and do the drawing themselves. Device setup, image rights and physical-surface suitability remain the user's responsibility.

plugins.overview_zh: 查找独立艺术家的原创及版画，并帮助创作者比较定价、销售渠道和费用。发布者称可实时检查约 190 家商店的 2.1 万件作品及 eBay，并提供其他市场搜索链接；还指导尺寸、防骗、委托、补助和版税计算。数据和估值不是独立鉴定或法律意见，需核对作品现状、费用及补助资格；介绍称不保存用户信息。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Finds original artwork and prints from independent artists and helps artists compare pricing, selling channels and fees. The publisher describes live availability checks for about 21,000 works across 190 shops plus eBay, with search links to other marketplaces. Additional guidance covers sizing, scams, commissions, grants and royalty calculations. These figures and valuations are not independent appraisals or legal advice; check listings, fees and grant criteria. The description says user information is not stored.

plugins.overview_zh: 经 Article Galaxy 账户检查科学文章可用性、访问方式和再使用权，并支持订购及交付状态查询，PDF 按账户已有资格交付。这是文献采购流程，不是任意论文无限访问或任意复用许可。应审核文章、价格、许可和订购确认，区分查询资料与可能收费的实际下单。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Article Galaxy 账户资格，订购与复用权需分别审核。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Checks scientific-article availability, access options and reuse rights through an Article Galaxy account, then supports ordering and delivery-status lookup. Ordered PDFs are delivered under the account's existing entitlements. This is a document-procurement workflow, not unrestricted access to every paper or permission for any reuse. Review the selected article, price, license and order confirmation; availability checks and metadata retrieval should be distinguished from placing a potentially chargeable order.

plugins.description_zh: 使用 AI 开展交互式培训
plugins.overview_zh: 根据主题、学习目标、受众和深度连接 Articulate 起草课程或培训包大纲，先在 Articulate 打开审核，再生成完整互动培训内容，也可搜索已有课程。这是分阶段创作，不等于自动取得合规认证。应确认订阅、来源准确性、可访问性和学习者适用性；未证明所有导出格式或发布权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 完整内容生成前需在 Articulate 审核大纲。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects chat to Articulate for drafting a course or training-package outline from a topic, learning goals, audience and desired depth. You open and review the outline in Articulate before generating full interactive-training content, and can search existing courses. It is a staged authoring workflow rather than an automatic compliance-certified course. Confirm the connected subscription, source accuracy, accessibility and learner suitability; the listing does not establish every export format or publishing permission.

plugins.description_zh: 使用 AI 开展交互式培训
plugins.overview_zh: 欧盟版 Articulate 采用相同的大纲优先流程：说明目标受众，在平台审核大纲，再开发互动内容或浏览已有课程。明确面向订阅托管在 Articulate 欧盟数据中心的欧洲用户。账户托管地区重要时，不应随意以普通版替代。课程质量、数据处理许可、权限和发布仍需审核。
plugins.requirements_zh: 限托管于 Articulate 欧盟数据中心的欧洲订阅，先审大纲再生成。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: The EU-specific Articulate connection offers the same outline-first training workflow: describe goals and audience, review the generated outline in Articulate, then develop full interactive content or browse existing courses. It is explicitly intended for European users whose subscriptions are hosted in Articulate's EU data center. Do not substitute the ordinary entry when the account's hosting region matters. Course quality, permitted data processing, access rights and publication remain subject to review.

plugins.description_zh: 管理变更数据捕获管道
plugins.overview_zh: 在已认证 Artie 环境中设置、检查和运行数据库或 API 到仓库的 CDC 管道，可列出连接器、看表元数据、配置复制、监测延迟，并管理 SSH 隧道及 PrivateLink。操作可能改变数据流和基础设施，不只是报告。应核对源目标权限、复制范围和网络变更；连接器覆盖、费用及恢复保证未完整列明。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需认证 Artie 环境，复制和网络更改需适当授权。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Sets up, inspects and operates change-data-capture pipelines from databases or APIs into warehouses. It lists pipelines/connectors, reads table metadata, configures replication, monitors lag and manages supporting SSH tunnels or PrivateLink connections within an authenticated Artie environment. These actions can alter data flows and infrastructure, not just produce reports. Review source/destination permissions, replication scope and network changes; supported connectors, cost and recovery guarantees are not enumerated here.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索文档并提出修改建议
plugins.overview_zh: 连接团队文档工作区，支持搜索读取、创建受管理文档和提出变更；受治理修改需获授权人工审核，允许情况下所有者可直接改工作稿。还可整理文档、使用 Agent Rooms 和发布版本分享链接，需 ArtifactBridge 账户。已配置集成可能同步评论到 Docs／Notion、通知 Slack 或触发 webhook，文档操作可能产生聊天外影响。

This is a market-information connector, not access to private balances or authority to trade. Quotes and depth can change rapidly, and contract limits describe the instrument rather than recommend using leverage. The provider explicitly limits use to information rather than advice, offers or solicitation. Check timestamps and the instrument before relying on a chart or comparison.

Reading is not permission to edit records, send follow-ups or share a transcript with other people. The public body does not establish direct blockchain tracing tools, law-enforcement database access, recovery of funds or authority to accuse anyone. The skill's guidance does not authorise contacting suspects or changing accounts.

It is preparation guidance, not proof of legal representation, automatic filing or a successful appeal. County procedures and deadlines must be checked against current official records, and comparable-property assumptions need validation. The description does not authorise sharing a homeowner's private documents with any office.

plugins.overview_zh: Cache Stats 报告上一条已核实响应的缓存输入、未缓存输入含写入，以及新生成输出，并指导开发者请求和解释发布者所列支持模型的 Responses API 缓存诊断。Windows 辅助程序仅在本地运行，核实当前任务，不声称重建未取得的 API 诊断。因此宿主数据与权限很关键，安装技能不会到处显示隐藏令牌统计。它不保证命中或省钱，也不授权读取无关本地会话。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cache Stats reports cached input, uncached input including writes, and newly generated output for a previous verified response. It also guides developers in requesting and interpreting Responses API prompt-cache diagnostics for the supported model generations named by the publisher. Its Windows helper is local-only, verifies the active task and does not claim to reconstruct unavailable API diagnostic results. Host data and permissions therefore matter; installing the skill does not expose hidden token telemetry everywhere. It is a diagnostic aid, not a guarantee of cache hits, cost savings or permission to read unrelated local sessions.

plugins.description_zh: 评估和核验商业房地产交易
plugins.overview_zh: Cactus: Real Estate Analysis 查询商业地产交易和组合资料，审阅 NOI、租金表、资本化率及债务条件等承销输入，核心是追溯数字来源并区分有证据与未核实事实。它可整理尽调，但有文档链接不代表数字完整、最新或经过独立审计。页面未证明能交易、批融资或出具正式评估；收购决定前需核对假设、日期和资料权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cactus: Real Estate Analysis retrieves commercial-property deals and portfolio information and examines underwriting inputs such as NOI, rent rolls, capitalisation rates and debt terms. Its central workflow is tracing numbers to documents and separating supported facts from unverified ones. It can improve due-diligence organisation, but a linked source is not proof that its figures are complete, current or independently audited. The page does not establish transactions, financing approval or a binding appraisal. Verify assumptions, source dates and deal permissions before using an overview for an acquisition decision.

plugins.overview_zh: Cadabra AI 制作图片、视频和短片，涉及旁白、对话、音乐、字幕、口型、翻译、放大及去背景，也可编辑照片和跨镜头保持角色，支持英语与希伯来语。需连接账户，生成前会展示将运行的内容并等用户批准，结果返回聊天且保存到账户图库。角色一致、语音质量及文字并非保证，制作前应核对媒体权利、声音肖像同意、费用和输出规格。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cadabra AI produces images, video and short films, including narration, dialogue, music, captions, lip-sync, translation, upscaling and background removal. It can edit reference photos and maintain a character across shots, with English and Hebrew workflows. A connected account is required, and the user previews exactly what will run and approves before generation; results are returned in chat and saved in that account's gallery. Consistency, speech quality and generated text are not guaranteed. Check media rights and consent for voices or likenesses, plus actual costs and output specifications, before authorising production.

plugins.description_zh: 规划并安排社交帖子发布
plugins.overview_zh: Cadencz 结合连接账户与网站提取的业务信息，按品牌语气规划、起草和排程社交内容，支持周计划、LinkedIn、X、Threads、Bluesky 等草稿及额度查看。草稿先保存工作区，未经确认不发布也不排程。网站背景可能过时或不完整，需要检查事实和语气；批准前应核对账户、渠道、时区和用量成本，保存草稿并不代表已上线。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cadencz uses a connected account and website-derived business context to plan, draft and schedule social posts in the business's voice. It supports content planning, draft examples for LinkedIn, X, Threads and Bluesky, viewing the week's plan and checking allowance use. Drafts are saved to the workspace for review, and nothing is published or scheduled without confirmation. Website-derived context can be outdated or incomplete, so review factual claims and brand voice. Confirm account, channel, time zone and usage costs before approval; a saved draft is not a live post.

plugins.overview_zh: Cafe24 按风格、价格或商店等需求进行对话式商品搜索，官方例子包括服装，可减少手动翻目录。功能正文很短，没有说明商家覆盖、排序方法、实时库存保证、付款或订单管理，不能推断能购买、退货或退款。作承诺前应在商家结账页核实具体商品、卖家、币种、到手总价和政策。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cafe24 provides conversational product search using requirements such as style, price or store, with clothing examples in the official page. It can help narrow relevant shopping options without manually navigating a catalogue. The functional body is short and does not identify merchant coverage, ranking methodology, live-stock guarantees, payment handling or order-management tools. Do not infer that the assistant can purchase, return or refund products. Verify the exact item, seller, currency, delivered total and policies on the merchant's checkout page before making a commitment.

plugins.overview_zh: Caipi 描述了私密工作区，助手可创建和更新笔记、数据、仪表盘、页面及小型网页应用，用户可跨设备管理，因此是持久内容制作，不只是聊天排版。简短正文未列运行时、角色、共享、部署限制或备份保证。“私密”不自动授权公开发布或连接敏感系统，应先检查保存内容、访问人和实际宿主能力，再判断应用是否可用于生产。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Caipi describes a private workspace where an assistant creates and updates notes, data, dashboards, pages and small web applications, which the user can then manage across devices. It is persistent workspace authoring rather than only a formatted answer in chat. The brief body does not enumerate supported app runtimes, access roles, sharing controls, deployment limits or backup guarantees. A private-workspace claim is not permission to publish content or integrate sensitive external systems. Check what is saved, who can access it and the actual host capabilities before treating a generated app as production-ready.

plugins.overview_zh: CAIRO Medicines 读取欧盟与美国获批药品的监管说明书原文，附产品、文件、章节、网址和日期，可按商品名或成分查找、定位警告、查看版本及官方不良事件报告入口。名称有歧义时列候选，不随意替用户选；其他市场会明确说明不支持，而非借用别国标签。它是来源研究，不提供诊断、剂量或个人治疗建议；临床使用前需匹配产品、剂型、法域和最新版本，找到报告入口也不等于已提交。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CAIRO Medicines retrieves regulator-published drug-label passages for authorised medicines in the EU and US, with product, document, section, source URL and date attached. It supports brand/ingredient lookup, targeted warnings, label history and official adverse-event reporting routes. Ambiguous names produce candidate products rather than an arbitrary choice. Other markets are explicitly outside the supported scope instead of silently substituting a foreign label. This is source-text research, not diagnosis, dosing or personalised treatment advice; match the exact product, formulation, jurisdiction and current label before clinical use. Finding a reporting route does not submit a report.

plugins.overview_zh: CaixaBank 提供账户、卡片等银行产品公开信息，无需登录银行或提供个人资料即可比较功能。它是产品发现入口，不读取余额交易或判定个人资格。免手续费账户、旅行卡等示例只是待了解问题，不保证所有人合格或全部费用为零。应向银行核实当前条款、收费、居住要求和信贷条件；描述不证明能在聊天开户、签约或转账。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CaixaBank offers public information about accounts, cards and other banking products, allowing comparison of features without signing into a bank account or providing personal data. It is a product-discovery interface rather than access to balances, transactions or personalised eligibility. Examples about fee-free accounts or travel cards are questions to explore, not a guarantee that every customer qualifies or that all fees disappear. Check current product terms, charges, residence criteria and any credit conditions directly with the bank. The description does not establish opening accounts, signing agreements or moving money in chat.

plugins.overview_zh: Cal Plus 通过有有效订阅的账户读取本人饮食、热量和营养素目标、食物、活动与体重趋势，也可查看连接健康应用的步数和能量、训练一致性、习惯及保存的饮食限制和过敏。它分析的是记录，不保证日志完整或消耗估计准确，正文未明确描述写入。建议应尊重过敏和个人需要，但不替代临床意见，平台期解释也只是可能原因而非诊断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cal Plus reads the user's own logged nutrition, calorie/macronutrient targets, foods, activity and weight trends through an account with an active subscription. It can review connected-health-app steps and energy, workout consistency, habit streaks and remembered dietary restrictions or allergies. This is analysis of recorded data, not a guarantee that logs are complete or calorie expenditure is measured accurately. The body does not explicitly describe changing records. Suggestions should respect allergies and individual needs but do not replace clinical advice; a plateau explanation is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis.

plugins.overview_zh: Cal.com 浏览个人和团队事件类型、查带时区的空闲，并列出、创建、改期或取消普通预订，能够真正改变排程，不是仅出计划的日历技能。改期和取消可能影响他人，需确认事件类型、参与人、当地时间和修改内容。简短正文没列全部通知、取消、收费事件或团队授权规则；查到空闲不等于已保留时段或发出邀请。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cal.com browses personal and team event types, finds timezone-aware availability and lists, creates, reschedules or cancels ordinary bookings. It can help move from a proposed meeting to an actual scheduling change, unlike a planning-only calendar skill. Confirm the event type, participants, local time and intended modification because rescheduling or cancellation may affect other people. The short public body does not specify every notification, cancellation rule, paid-event restriction or delegated-team permission. An availability response is not itself a held slot or a completed invitation.

plugins.overview_zh: CalcForms 把工作簿说明或自然语言需求转成计算表单，支持测试与发布，以及提交、邀请、导出和账户设置的私密面板，适合报价估算等输入型计算器。但发布会形成对外表单，不只是私人工作表。上线前应检查公式、单位、验证、权限及收集的个人数据；正文不证明兼容所有电子表格特性、财务正确或自动合规，结果仍依赖规格与假设。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CalcForms turns a workbook specification or plain-language brief into a calculated form, with testing and publication plus private dashboards for submissions, invitations, exports and account settings. It is useful for quote estimators and other input-driven calculators, but publishing creates a user-facing form rather than merely a private worksheet. Check formulas, units, validation, access and any personal data collected before publication. The body does not establish support for every spreadsheet feature, financial correctness or automatic legal compliance; calculated outputs remain dependent on the supplied specification and assumptions.

plugins.description_zh: 工资、第十三薪、休假工资和解约结算
plugins.overview_zh: Calculadora CLT 按所示 2026 税表和法律依据估算巴西正式雇员到手工资、休假、十三薪、特定离职和利润分享税，并比较 2026–2028 节假日连休。结果逐项列示，仅用输入值，厂商称不索取或保存 CPF、姓名、健康及支付资料。不处理加班、夜班、危险工作补贴、工会协议及家政等特殊合同。估算不能替代工资单、会计或法律意见，仍须确认劳动事实与当前规则。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Calculadora CLT estimates Brazilian formal-employment net pay, holiday pay, thirteenth salary, selected termination scenarios and profit-sharing tax using the displayed 2026 tables and legal bases. It also compares leave dates around listed 2026–2028 holidays. Results are itemised and use only supplied values; the provider says it neither requests nor stores CPF, names, health or payment data. Overtime, night premiums, hazardous-work additions, union agreements and special contracts such as domestic employment are excluded. Estimates do not replace a payslip, accountant or legal advice; confirm the applicable employment facts and current rules.

plugins.overview_zh: Contabilizei 的 Calculadora de Autônomos 模拟税改对雇用自由职业者的企业及个体从业者的影响，比较资金、运营时间和不同经营或正规化方式。它是情景分析，不等于报税、注册企业或认定劳动关系。尽管示例提到未来预测，正文未列全税务假设、日期、地区及豁免；更改合同或经营结构前需核实输入并咨询合格专业人士，预计更便宜不等于合规适用。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Calculadora de Autônomos, from Contabilizei, models how tax reform may affect businesses hiring independent workers and self-employed professionals. It compares money and operational-time costs and alternative working or formalisation arrangements. This is scenario analysis, not a completed tax filing, incorporation or employment-status determination. The short body does not set out all tax assumptions, dates, jurisdictions or exemptions, even though examples mention future projections. Verify those inputs and consult qualified advice before changing contracts or business structure; a projected cheaper option is not automatically compliant or suitable.

plugins.overview_zh: Calculadora de Combustível 根据输入油价比较乙醇与汽油，基本规则是乙醇价格除以汽油低于 0.70 时偏向乙醇；填写各自真实每升里程后可更准确比较每公里成本。无需注册，称不收集个人资料。但 70% 经验规则并非适合所有发动机、路况和驾驶方式，也不会自动查加油站价格。需使用车辆兼容燃料，并区分费用计算与机械建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Calculadora de Combustível compares ethanol and petrol costs from the prices the user supplies. Its basic rule favours ethanol when the ethanol/petrol price ratio is below 0.70; entering each fuel's actual km-per-litre efficiency enables a more specific cost-per-kilometre comparison. It requires no signup and says it collects no personal data. The 70% shortcut is not universal for every engine, route or driving style, and the tool does not fetch the pump price automatically. Use fuel compatible with the vehicle and distinguish a cost calculation from a mechanical recommendation.

plugins.overview_zh: Calendar Habit Streak 依据成人自行提供的结构化事实，在明确日期范围和预定星期内计算已确认连续记录，完成、缺失和未知分开；未知会打断确认的连续性，但不算失败。它不推测活动或心理、不查外部、不存历史、不发送或交易。服务端计算短暂，独立网站本地计算并提供 CSV/JSON 审阅导出；MCP 请求上限 128 KiB、响应 256 KiB，另有字段限制。导出前应核对日期及未知项。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Calendar Habit Streak calculates confirmed streaks within an explicit date window and chosen scheduled weekdays using structured, adult-controlled facts. Completed, missed and unknown days remain separate: an unknown breaks a confirmed streak without being labelled a failure. It does not infer activity or psychological meaning, look up external sources, store history, send messages or make transactions. Server processing is transient; website computation is local, with CSV/JSON review and export there. MCP requests are capped at 128 KiB and responses at 256 KiB, with further field limits. Review dates and unknowns before export.

Nutrition is estimated, and ingredient exclusion does not guarantee freedom from allergens or cross-contamination. The app offers general information, not diagnosis, disease treatment, medication guidance or a replacement for medical advice.

Performance and engagement summaries should be checked against their source records rather than used as automatic judgments about participants.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: 仅补充候选：官方 CamScanner 产品路径页描述上传或扫描图片，用 OCR 提取印刷及手写文字，并整理为可分析、总结或翻译的结构化材料。但页面未包含本条目录 ID，也未找到明确 ID 对照，所以功能与所示元数据不能作为本条已核验事实。OCR 受图像和版式影响，敏感文件上传需适当许可及隐私检查；精度宣传不保证每个数字、姓名或手写词都正确。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: Supplemental candidate only: an official CamScanner slug page describes uploading or scanning images, extracting printed or handwritten text with OCR and turning photos into structured material for analysis, summary or translation. The observed page did not contain the selected catalogue ID and no explicit ID bridge was recovered. These functions and its displayed metadata are therefore not verified for this selected entry. OCR accuracy depends on image quality and layout, and sensitive documents need appropriate upload consent and privacy review. The source's precision claims are not a guarantee that every number, name or handwritten word is correct.

plugins.overview_zh: Canary Data 使用厂商专有数据、情报和综合分析研究上市企业，并称可结合其他金融 MCP，用于提出和审视投资想法，而不是执行交易。正文没有列全数据集、许可、覆盖、时效和工具，“任何上市企业”不保证所有资料都有。应核来源日期、区分证据与综合判断；生成论点不是个性化建议、已验证预测或收益保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Canary Data supports public-company investment research using the provider's proprietary datasets, intelligence and synthesis, with the stated possibility of combining other financial MCP sources. It is intended for developing and examining ideas rather than executing trades. The public body does not identify all datasets, licences, coverage, refresh intervals or specific tools, and the phrase any publicly traded business is not a guarantee that every requested fact is available. Check provenance and dates and distinguish evidence from synthesis. A generated investment thesis is not personalised advice, a verified forecast or assurance of returns.

plugins.overview_zh: Cancel My Sub 提供约八十种美国和英国常见订阅的官方取消步骤，也帮助理解账单与续费问题。但所有工具只读、无需登录，不会真的替用户退订。厂商称不保存用户资料，无广告或付费推荐。它是指导来源，不检查账户，也不能确认已取消。必须向实际服务核对套餐、购买渠道、通知期、费用和最终确认，不能据指南就认定停止扣款。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cancel My Sub provides official cancellation instructions for roughly eighty popular US and UK subscriptions and helps interpret related billing or renewal questions. Despite the name, every tool is read-only: there is no sign-in and it does not cancel a subscription for the user. The provider says it stores no user information and has no advertising or paid placement. This is a guidance source, not account inspection or confirmation of a cancellation. Verify the current plan, purchase channel, notice period, fees and final cancellation acknowledgement with the actual service before assuming billing has stopped.

plugins.overview_zh: Candidate Time Extractor 把候选人提供的可用时间消息转成时间、时区、联系方式和备注，保留来源并标记缺项或错误。它只读无状态，不排期、不发邀请、不联系候选人、不改 ATS，也不排名或作录用决定。适合准备排程交接，但提取时段不是已保留，时区缺失也应保留不确定。需核模糊日期，并仅在另行获准流程分享必要联系资料。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Candidate Time Extractor converts a candidate's supplied availability message into structured times, timezone, contact information and notes, preserving source text and flagging missing fields or errors. It is read-only and stateless. It does not schedule, send invitations, contact candidates, update an ATS, rank applicants or make hiring decisions. It is useful for preparing a scheduling handoff, but an extracted time is not a reserved slot and an absent timezone should remain uncertain. Check ambiguous dates and only share the necessary contact information in any separately authorised workflow.

plugins.overview_zh: Canny 结合客户反馈分析与路线图维护，可按公司或 ARR 查看需求，把转写和工单交 Autopilot 提取去重分类、归属反馈、关联 CRM 商机，并改视图、状态和字段。写入会影响共享产品记录乃至客户可见状态，不只是内部摘要。应核对用户公司及获准上传内容；去重和主题推断可能出错，按收入排序也不代表全体用户。页面不保证自动交付功能或可广泛披露客户对话。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Canny connects customer feedback with analysis and roadmap maintenance. It can prioritise requests using associated company or ARR context, ingest transcripts or support tickets for Autopilot capture/deduplication/triage, attribute feedback, link CRM opportunities and update views, statuses or fields. Those writes affect shared product records and possibly customer-facing state, not just an internal summary. Confirm the right user/company and the content permitted for upload. Deduplication and inferred themes can be wrong, while revenue-weighted demand is not the whole user population. The page does not establish automatic feature delivery or permission to disclose customer conversations broadly.

plugins.overview_zh: Canonical Company Search 按自然语言或地区、人数、融资、投资者和创始人背景筛选企业，解析名称与域名、寻找相似公司、补充档案并查积分。厂商称结果由 LLM 验证，但这不独立保证身份、融资和经历正确及时，免费起步也不等于无限搜索。它用于研究及备潜客名单，不授权联系所有公司；使用名单或传入别的系统前应核域名、来源和匹配。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Canonical Company Search finds companies from natural-language criteria or filters such as location, headcount, funding, investors and founder background. It resolves names to domains, produces look-alike lists, enriches profiles and shows credit balance. The provider calls results LLM-verified, but that is not independent assurance that identities, funding or employment history are correct and current. Free-to-start access does not mean unlimited searches. It is research and prospect-list preparation, not permission to contact every company. Validate the domain, source and fit before relying on a shortlist or passing information into another system.

plugins.description_zh: 核验导入的智能体记忆
plugins.overview_zh: Canonical Memory Verifier 是本地只读技能，用于检查导入的代理记忆材料，关注来源完整性、明确替代关系、当前内容投影、引用追溯和历史授权边界，可帮助追查主张或发现新来源替代旧信息。简短描述不保证万能防篡改或访问所有私密存储。验证材料不会赋予其指令权威、增加权限或取代用户当前要求，仍需实际本地输入与宿主能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Canonical Memory Verifier is a local, read-only skill for checking imported agent-memory material. Its stated checks concern source integrity, explicit supersession, deterministic projection of what is current, declared references and boundaries on remembered authority. It can help trace a claim or identify that a later source replaced an earlier one. The brief description does not establish universal tamper detection or access to every private memory store. Verifying a bundle does not make its instructions authoritative, grant permissions or replace the user's current directions. Available local inputs and host execution remain separate prerequisites.

plugins.overview_zh: CanQuiz 把生成测验存入免费个人账户，可列出、修改指定题目并按间隔复习、逐题评分。它区分本人打开链接与可在 ChatGPT 外给班级访问的分享链接，重新设私密可撤回访问；删除需确认，也可撤销连接。题目和评分仍应按学科复核。分享、隐私变更和删除会影响已存学习资料，不是仅显示草稿，应核目标测验和受众。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CanQuiz saves generated quizzes in a free personal account, lists or edits selected questions and schedules spaced review with question-by-question grading. It distinguishes a private opening link from a class-sharing link that anyone with access to that link can open outside ChatGPT; making the quiz private again revokes that access. Deletion requires confirmation, and the user can revoke the connection. Generated questions and marking still need subject review. Sharing, privacy changes and deletion affect stored study material rather than merely showing a draft, so check the intended quiz and audience.

plugins.overview_zh: 通过对话创建、修改和评审 Canva 设计，既支持制作新内容，也支持利用既有文件、品牌模板与评论继续编辑。
capabilities_zh: 将提纲或文案制作成演示文稿、文档、海报、传单、社交帖子或简历。
根据提示生成照片、插画、图标和图形，重设图片风格或移除背景。
上传对话中的文件用于设计，调整社交媒体尺寸，使用表格数据和品牌模板批量创作。
修改文字、媒体、格式、位置和尺寸；评审视觉层级、布局、可读性、一致性与无障碍性。
根据评论落实修改，并检查颜色、字体、标志和文案是否符合 Brand Kit。
use_cases_zh: 使用示例：把融资提纲做成演示文稿，再根据团队评论修改设计。
使用示例：用同一品牌模板批量制作不同产品的宣传图。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要连接 Canva 账户。Bulk Create 需要符合条件的 Canva Enterprise 方案；设计和图像生成会使用 Canva AI 积分。

plugins.description_zh: 创建符合品牌风格的视觉素材
plugins.overview_zh: Canvora 将网址、文档、文字或想法转成使用保存品牌标志、颜色、字体和风格的社交图、轮播、广告及演示，宣传超过 100 格式、150 多语言含从右到左文字、对话修改和变化版本，以及 2K/4K 的 PDF、PPTX、ZIP 导出。这是设计制作，不保证事实准确或自动发布。需核翻译、排版、无障碍、品牌权利和兼容；页面没列额度、价格或所有格式是否都支持各导出规格。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Canvora turns a URL, document, text or idea into branded social designs, carousels, stories, ads and presentations using saved logo, colours, fonts and style. The provider describes more than 100 formats, localisation across over 150 languages including RTL scripts, conversational edits, variations and PDF/PPTX/ZIP export at 2K or 4K. These are design-production functions, not proof that content is factually correct or automatically published. Check translations, typography, accessibility, brand rights and output compatibility. The page does not state quotas, pricing or whether every format supports every export or resolution.

plugins.overview_zh: Canvs.io whiteboard 在自己的私密工作区创建和编辑协作白板，可从形状布局或 Mermaid 图生成、检查已有元素，并更新或删除保存内容，适合界面草图、时序图和组织图。内容会持久保存，删除不只是改聊天展示。编辑共享前应确认白板与协作者；简短页面未说明恢复保障、导出格式、实时并发行为或自动图正确性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Canvs.io whiteboard creates and edits collaborative boards in the user's private workspace. It can generate boards from shape layouts or Mermaid diagrams, inspect existing elements and update or delete saved canvas content. It is useful for UI sketches, sequence diagrams and organisational charts, but the underlying content is persistent and deletion is not merely changing the current chat. Verify the board and intended collaborators before edits or sharing. The short page does not establish recovery guarantees, export formats, real-time concurrency behaviour or automatic correctness of generated diagrams.

plugins.overview_zh: Capability Orchestrator 将复杂请求拆解，选择较少且有效的专门能力并委派聚焦子任务，减少多余上下文，价值在于规划和路由，而非新增权限、账户或外部工具。简短正文未列能力清单，也不保证宿主支持委派。实际执行受现有工具和授权范围约束，选定能力或列出子任务不代表已完成或结果被独立验证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Capability Orchestrator is a coordination skill that interprets a non-trivial request, selects a small effective set of specialist capabilities and delegates focused subtasks while limiting unnecessary context. Its value is task decomposition and routing, not a new source of permissions, accounts or external tools. The brief body does not enumerate the specialist catalogue or guarantee that the host supports delegation. Actual execution remains limited to available capabilities and authorised scope. A planned subtask or selected capability is not proof that work has run or that its output was independently verified.

plugins.description_zh: 原生 AI 股权结构管理平台
plugins.overview_zh: Capable Cap Table 按权限回答所有权、股份类别、期权等权益工具、归属、409A、融资稀释及退出分配问题；管理员范围较广，员工、顾问和投资者只看获准自身权益。可起草授予或终止等变更提案，但必须由管理员在 Capable 批准才生效，也提供导出链接和活动审查。融资退出模型仅供规划，不是税法投资意见，不划款或交易；草拟授予不是已发行证券或完成法律动作。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Capable Cap Table answers permission-scoped questions about ownership, share classes, options and other equity instruments, vesting, 409A records, fundraising dilution and exit proceeds. Administrators have broader views; employees, advisers and investors see their own permitted equity. It can prepare proposed changes, including grants or terminations, but nothing changes until an administrator approves inside Capable. It also provides export links and activity/proposal review. Round and exit models are planning estimates, not tax, legal or investment advice. The plugin does not move money or trade, and a draft grant is not an issued security or completed legal action.

plugins.overview_zh: Capacities 描述以对象为中心的个人知识系统，人物、书籍、项目和想法带属性与链接，形成关联网络，可比纯文本列表更有结构地组织上下文。但取得的完整正文没有逐项说明连接器的搜索、新建、编辑、删除或共享动作，不能从通用产品介绍推断特定写入能力。开展实际流程前仍需核对账户权限、同步、导出及对象类型。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Capacities describes an object-based personal knowledge system in which notes about people, books, projects and ideas have properties and links forming a connected network. This can provide a structured way to organise context rather than a flat list of text notes. However, the recovered public body does not enumerate this connector's search, creation, editing, deletion or sharing operations. Do not infer a specific mutation capability from the general product description. Account permissions, synchronisation, export and supported object types need checking before relying on it for an operational workflow.

plugins.overview_zh: Cape Partners 按委托要求研究并购标的、买家及合作服务，返回排序匹配、合资格范围汇总和参考估值区间，交易方身份及敏感财务受控制披露与 NDA 流程保护。它只做数据发现，不谈判、不联系对方、不约束任何人交易；估值无约束力，不是评估或投资意见。需核需求、日期和假设，取得名单不授权披露秘密交易信息或接受 NDA。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cape Partners researches M&A targets, buyers and partner services from a mandate, returns ranked matches and an aggregate qualified universe, and estimates an indicative valuation range. Counterparty identities and sensitive financials are protected by controlled disclosure and an NDA workflow. This is a data/discovery service: it does not negotiate, contact counterparties or bind anyone to a transaction. A valuation is non-binding, not an appraisal or investment advice. Verify the mandate, source dates and assumptions; accessing a shortlist does not authorise disclosure of confidential deal information or acceptance of an NDA.

plugins.overview_zh: CapelanIA – Orientador 帮助牧灵人员、志愿者和领导规划学校关怀、城市宣教或混合项目，框架结合基督信仰、圣经依据、社会情绪技能、未成年人保护及宗教自由，示例强调适龄且不劝教的学校活动。它是项目指导，不是心理治疗、保护认证或接触儿童许可。实际活动需机构规则、适当同意、合格监督并尊重信仰；正文不证明会自动联系学校或执行项目。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CapelanIA – Orientador supports chaplains, volunteers and leaders in planning school chaplaincy, urban mission or hybrid projects. Its stated framework combines Christian spirituality and biblical grounding with social-emotional skills, protection of minors and religious freedom; examples include age-appropriate school work without proselytism. It is project-design guidance, not professional mental-health treatment, safeguarding certification or permission to approach children. Actual activities need the institution's rules, appropriate consent, qualified supervision and respect for participants' beliefs. The brief body does not establish contacting schools or operating programmes automatically.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 ChatGPT 经营商店
plugins.overview_zh: Capi Agent for Merchants 读取商店销售、服务问题和运营数据，并可更新 AI 销售代理知识、规则、时间和行为，厂商称所有变更有日志且可撤回。客户姓名、电话、邮箱、地址留在 Capi 内，文本电话邮箱会遮盖；营销活动仅供批准，不从 ChatGPT 发给客户。这是产品承诺，不是独立保证。需核商店与规则修改影响，因为即使现在不发活动，配置也可能影响未来客户互动。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Capi Agent for Merchants reads a connected merchant store's figures for sales, service concerns and operational priorities, and can update the AI sales agent's knowledge, rules, hours and behaviour. The provider says every change is logged and reversible. Customer names, phones, emails and addresses remain within Capi, with phone/email text masked. Campaigns are proposals for approval and are not sent to customers from ChatGPT. These are published privacy and workflow claims, not independent guarantees. Verify store context and the implications of agent-rule changes, since configuration can influence future customer interactions even without sending a campaign now.

plugins.description_en: Launch SPVs and funds in chat

plugins.overview_zh: Capital Health 搜索运动营养商品、比较卢布现价和产品描述，并按配送地区备购物清单。确认商品数量后，通过有效 24 小时链接登录、导入购物车并完成付款。它销售实体商品，不提供医疗意见、不存账户支付资料、不保留库存或锁价。补剂宣传需独立核查适用性，推荐不证明有效或安全，购买前仍应复核总价与库存。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Capital Health searches a sports-nutrition catalogue, compares current prices in roubles and product descriptions, and prepares a shopping list for a chosen delivery region. After confirming items and quantities, a 24-hour link lets the user sign in, import the list into a cart and complete checkout. It sells physical goods and does not provide medical advice, store account/payment details, reserve stock or lock prices. Supplement claims require independent scrutiny and suitability checks; a product recommendation is not evidence of health benefit or safety. Recheck total price and availability before purchase.

plugins.overview_zh: CapMind 搜索登录用户自己账户保存的录音，读取转写、摘要、决定和行动项，明确只读，不能创建、编辑、删除、发布或代分享录音。适合回查讨论，但自动摘要可能丢失细节，重大结论需对照转写。能读取不等于获准转发或披露参与者资料；正文未说明录音同意、保留和转写准确性。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CapMind searches recordings stored in the authenticated user's own account and retrieves transcripts, summaries, decisions and action items. It is explicitly read-only and cannot create, edit, delete, publish or share recordings on the user's behalf. It is useful for finding what was discussed, but generated summaries can lose nuance and should be checked against the transcript for consequential conclusions. Access to a recording does not itself authorise forwarding it or disclosing participants' information. The public body does not specify recording-consent procedures, retention or transcript accuracy.

plugins.overview_zh: Caprail 分析记录的网站流量、AI 来源、路径及独立代理聊天请求，支持日期比较、筛选和图表。独立访客按 IP 与用户代理估计，页面浏览则为记录事件；漏斗需获准数据源的队列人数，不能只用页面总数。需账户访问自己的站点，安装采集需代码库权限，交互展示需兼容宿主。估计访客不等于真实人数，图表也不是转化因果证明，安装还会改变追踪及隐私影响。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Caprail analyses recorded website traffic, AI referrals, page paths and separate agent/chat requests, with date comparisons, filters and charts. Unique visitors are estimates from IP and user agent, while page views are recorded events. Funnels require authorised cohort counts from another suitable source; page totals alone are insufficient. An account is needed for the user's sites. A coding-agent installation workflow can integrate collection only with codebase access, and interactive displays need a compatible host. Do not confuse estimated visitors with people or a chart with causal conversion evidence; installation can change tracking and privacy implications.

plugins.overview_zh: Capsule CRM 读取实时联系人、商机和管道，辅助跟进排序、会议准备及报告，也可更新联系人、商机和项目自定义字段，沿用权限，公开要求 Growth 及以上套餐。起草邮件示例不证明可发送，字段写入也不等于无限 CRM 管理。修改前需核记录和字段，对外沟通准备应检查历史来源，套餐资格和时效仍取决于账户。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Capsule CRM reads live contacts, opportunities and pipeline context for follow-up prioritisation, meeting preparation and quick reports. It can also update custom fields on contacts, opportunities and projects, while respecting existing permissions. Access is advertised for Growth plans and above. A request to draft an email is not evidence that this connector sends it, and custom-field writes should not be confused with unrestricted CRM administration. Verify the intended record and field before changes and check the source history when preparing external communication; subscription eligibility and data freshness remain account-dependent.

plugins.overview_zh: Capycash 连接个人财务账户，记录收支、整理类别清单并分析消费，提供摘要、重复开支识别、负担能力、储蓄模拟和目标情景。这些是规划和记录功能，不证明可银行转账、付款或投资交易。结果取决于数据完整及分类，负担估算不是授信或目标保证。页面没说明自动银行同步、删除保护、预测假设或费用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Capycash connects a personal finance account to track income and expenses, organise categories or lists and review spending patterns. It offers summaries, recurring-expense detection, affordability checks, savings simulations and goal scenarios. These are planning and record-organisation functions, not evidence of bank transfers, payment execution or investment trading. Results depend on the completeness and categorisation of the user's data; affordability simulations are not credit approval or a guarantee that a goal is achievable. The page does not specify automatic bank synchronisation, deletion safeguards, forecast assumptions or transaction fees.

plugins.overview_zh: Car Dealer Tracker 以实时、经权限检查的数据读取车商库存、费用、销售、债务、账户和财务汇总，帮助分析积压、利润和现金。正文明确不能新增、修改、删除或发送，尽管示例提到准备改里程，也不能据此宣传可写入。连接可在应用撤销。决策前需核库存标识和底层账目，汇总不等于独立审计或车辆状况保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Car Dealer Tracker reads a dealership's inventory, expenses, sales, debts, accounts and financial summaries using permission-checked live data. It helps inspect ageing stock, profitability and cash. The functional body explicitly says it cannot add, change, delete or send records, even though an example prompt mentions preparing a mileage change. That example must not be promoted into write capability. The connection can be revoked in the app. Verify stock identifiers and underlying accounting records before decisions, and do not treat a summary as an independent audit or a vehicle-condition guarantee.

official_product_supplement.overview_en: Official integration docs describe searches of participating dealer inventory in the US and Canada outside Quebec, filtered by location, budget, mileage, make/model, condition and features. Results include listing facts, freshness, dealer locations and source links.

The estimates are expressly planning figures, and provider links disclose possible affiliate commission. It is useful for preparing requirements, not proof of a reservation, insurance coverage or guaranteed delivery price/date. Check carrier credentials, pickup conditions, insurance, cancellation and the binding written quote before committing. A paid referral relationship should be considered when comparing recommendations; the body does not establish automatic booking or payment.

plugins.overview_zh: Car Tax Check 按英国车牌查税务和 MOT 日期、测试历史、失败建议、里程及规格，并可比较车辆。连接账户后可看保存车辆、已购历史报告、代金券余额和移除收藏；移除仅改账户清单，不改官方车辆记录。税检历史不保证当前机械状态或揭示全部事故产权问题，购车前需核车牌和日期；描述不证明会缴税、预约 MOT 或自动购买报告。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Car Tax Check retrieves UK vehicle tax and MOT dates, test history, failures/advisories, recorded mileage and specifications from a registration, and compares vehicles. A connected account adds saved vehicles, previously purchased history reports, voucher balance and removal of saved vehicles. Removing a saved item changes the account list, not the official vehicle record. Tax or MOT history does not prove current mechanical condition or reveal every ownership or accident issue. Check the exact registration and record dates before purchase; the description does not establish paying tax, booking an MOT or buying a report automatically.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Carat creates and edits images, video, audio, branded assets and social content from ideas or reference media. It supports analysis of source media/metadata, variations, upscaling and iterative project work, including timeline editing, previews and video export in Carat Studio. A connected account is required, no separate API key is needed, and generation consumes the same credit balance as the Carat platform. Review costs, media rights, consent and output quality before generation or publication. The description does not promise every model, duration or export format, and creating a social asset does not itself publish it.

It works with the data available in ChartMogul rather than establishing independent accounting truth. The listing does not specify eligible plans, access scopes, write operations or analytical accuracy; these remain untested.

Connecting requires a Chartquery account and consumes the same credits and quotas as its web app. Public output links deserve particular care when the chart or encoded payload contains confidential information.

Access is tied to the selected business and existing authorization. plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chat With PDF supports questions, summaries, comparisons and extraction from supplied documents, with page references for checking answers. Its skills also help produce study materials, citation lists and research summaries, or review contracts and reports for issues. These are document-assistance claims, not professional legal or medical validation. Answers may include a disclosed affiliate link, and users still need to check quoted passages, extraction accuracy and whether every page was readable.

plugins.description_zh: 将聊天保存为可编辑文档

plugins.overview_zh: Chatbase 连接团队现有 AI 客服及工单账户，可查看代理、添加或修改知识来源和配置、导出对话，并读取、创建或更新工单及消息。因此它涉及实际业务内容与客户通信，而非仅查询公开说明。应审核账户范围和变更，尤其是消息及训练来源更新；页面未列出访问套餐和数据保留细节。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需连接 Chatbase 账户，知识、配置和工单消息写入需审核。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chatbase connects to a team's existing AI-agent and help-desk account. It can inspect agents, add or change their knowledge sources and configuration, export conversations, and read, create or update support tickets and messages. It therefore reaches both operational content and customer communications, not merely public chatbot documentation. Review account scope and proposed changes, especially messages and training-source updates; access tiers and data-retention details are not stated in the listing.

plugins.description_zh: 在 ChatCut 中创建视频
plugins.overview_zh: 把视频创作与剪辑交给 ChatCut：导入附件或本地素材、创建可编辑项目、修改时间线、添加字幕、转录及清理口播视频，并加入叠加层或补充镜头；还支持生成素材、导出和核对编辑器中的结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 索引能力标为读取和写入；恢复的正文未说明价格、支持环境和导出额度。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Routes video creation and editing into ChatCut: import attached or local media, create editable projects, edit timelines, add captions, transcribe and clean talking-head footage, and add overlays or B-roll. It also supports generated assets, export and editor-visible verification.

plugins.overview_zh: ChatData Sync 把自然语言需求变成私有结构化追踪表，并在聊天中填入、搜索和更新记录。一个连接可管理多个主题，例如发票、运动、园艺或维护日志，属于持久化追踪，而不是一次性生成清单。页面未说明存储上限、导出格式、团队共享或删除控制，不能从“追踪任何事情”推断这些功能。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChatData Sync creates private structured trackers from a plain-language description, then lets users fill, search and update them in chat. A single connection can host multiple logs, such as invoices, exercise records, gardening or maintenance. This is persistent tracking rather than a temporary generated checklist. The description does not specify storage limits, export formats, team sharing or deletion controls; avoid inferring those from the broad claim to track any topic.

plugins.description_zh: 提升 AI 搜索可见度
plugins.overview_zh: ChatFeatured 通过可见度、竞品、引用、爬虫活动和站点健康信息研究品牌在 AI 回答中的表现，也管理追踪问题、机会和任务，并可向已连接内容系统创建、审核、排期或发布文章。分析不能保证进入 AI 回答或获得排名；发布是外部写入，应具备对应权限并审核内容，不应把一次审计请求当作自动发布授权。
plugins.requirements_zh: 发布需连接内容系统及适当批准，不能保证 AI 可见度。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChatFeatured investigates a brand's presence in AI answers using visibility, competitor, citation, crawler and website-health information. It also manages tracked prompts, opportunities and tasks, and can create, review, schedule or publish articles to connected content systems. Analysis does not guarantee inclusion or ranking in an AI response. Publishing is an external write operation that needs appropriate content-system access and review, rather than an automatic consequence of requesting an audit.

plugins.description_zh: 供工作区所有者或管理员管理 ChatGPT 工作区
plugins.description_en: Manage ChatGPT workspaces for workspace owners or admins.
plugins.overview_zh: 供工作区所有者和管理员管理成员、群组、角色、用量限制和额度增加请求；分析工作区及 Codex 使用情况，包括高用量用户、Token 和额度消耗。
plugins.requirements_zh: 所有操作遵守当前登录用户的工作区权限；目录标注交互、读取和写入能力。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lets workspace owners and administrators manage members, groups, roles, usage limits and requests to increase those limits. It analyzes workspace and Codex usage, including identifying high-usage users and token or credit consumption.

plugins.overview_zh: ChatifyIT 利用已连接账户的品牌资料共同起草 LinkedIn 帖子、公告和电子简报，并保存为草稿；可从已上传视频提炼帖子、附加媒体、列出草稿，并在连接 Instagram 后配置评论关键词。ChatGPT 不直接发布或发信，用户需到 ChatifyIT 审核、排期及最终发送。需 ChatifyIT 账户，插件不能读取线索、访客邮箱、支付或密码。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 ChatifyIT 账户，最终发布发送在其网站完成，评论触发需连接 Instagram。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChatifyIT saves jointly written LinkedIn posts, announcements and newsletters as drafts using the connected account's brand context. It can derive a post from an uploaded video, attach media, list drafts and configure Instagram comment keywords when that account is connected. Posts and emails are not sent from ChatGPT: review, scheduling and final sending happen in ChatifyIT. The plugin cannot read leads, visitor emails, payments or passwords, and requires a ChatifyIT account.

official_product_supplement.overview_en: Official ChatPRD integration documentation describes accessing product and project documents from AI tools, searching and reading PRDs, and asking ChatPRD to write or edit documents using saved project context.

plugins.overview_zh: ChatPRD Product Manager 是需求撰写技能，将初步想法梳理为开发说明，覆盖问题、用户、目标与非目标、流程、页面、数据结构、API、边界情况、指标和分期交付，便于交接给编码工具。它是规划与交接支持，不代表连接了另一个 ChatPRD 服务或能自动部署；假设和缺失产品决策仍需负责人确认。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChatPRD Product Manager is a requirements-writing skill for turning rough ideas into implementation briefs. It organizes problems, users, goals and exclusions, flows, screens, data structures, APIs, edge cases, metrics and phased delivery so a coding tool can take over. This is planning and handoff support, not evidence of a connection to the separate ChatPRD service or automatic deployment. Assumptions and missing product decisions still need an owner to resolve them.

plugins.description_zh: 专业支持家长教师协会的日常事务与组织运营
plugins.description_en: PTAの実務・組織運営を専門的にサポート
plugins.overview_zh: chatPTA 面向日本 PTA 干部、家长和教职员，支持章程、会议、财务、入会、宣传、文书及学校和地方行政协作，强调教育参与及家校社区合作，可帮助整理文件和改进方案。法律、税务、个人信息及会计讨论只是一般资料；实际执行要核对本 PTA 章程、学校或自治体规则和最新权威资料。
plugins.requirements_zh: 限日本 PTA 情境，核对当地章程及官方现行规则，不代替法律会计意见。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: chatPTA supports Japanese PTA officers, parents and teachers with organizational rules, meetings, accounting, membership, communications and coordination with schools or local authorities. It frames PTA work around educational participation and cooperation, and can help structure documents and improvement options. Legal, tax, privacy and accounting discussions are general information only. Actual operation must be checked against the particular PTA's bylaws, school or municipal rules and current authoritative materials.

plugins.overview_zh: ChatRook 按标题或标识搜索公开视频房间，显示近期参与人数并给出查看或加入链接。公开发现无需登录，真正加入在 ChatRook 完成，可能另有登录和访问检查；近期有人出现不等于此刻有实时对话。它不能读取私人房间、消息或录像，不能建会议、联系他人、发起通话或处理支付。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公开发现免登录，加入在外部并受访问检查；无私人资料或通话工具。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChatRook searches public video rooms by title or slug, reports recent participant counts and provides links to inspect or join a room. Public discovery needs no login, but joining occurs on ChatRook and may have separate sign-in or access checks. Recent presence is not proof of an active conversation. It cannot access private rooms, messages or recordings, create meetings, contact people, initiate calls or process payments.

plugins.overview_zh: ChauffeurFlow 查找自愿加入的司机及接送公司，展示服务区域、车辆人数和行李限制、联系方式、按公司费率估算的价格及直订链接。页面说明当前伙伴集中在澳大利亚昆士兰东南部，不能当作全球覆盖。查询无需登录，ChatGPT 不收个人资料、不预订或收费；最终价格、预订和付款由具体运营商网站处理。
plugins.requirements_zh: 当前伙伴在昆士兰东南部，聊天不预订、付款或收个人资料。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChauffeurFlow finds opt-in chauffeur and transfer partners, showing service areas, vehicle capacities, contact details, rate-based estimates and direct booking links. The listed coverage is currently South East Queensland, Australia, rather than a guaranteed worldwide network. No sign-in is required for discovery, and ChatGPT does not collect personal details, book or take payment. Final prices, booking and payment belong to the individual operator's website.

plugins.overview_zh: Cheapest Domains 比较部分注册商的续费，区分首年注册优惠并估算支持的多年成本，也可建议名称和查可注册性或溢价状态，保留来源日期及覆盖不足。购买和准确溢价报价仍在注册商完成。Cloudflare Radar 的可选热度是 DNS 活动而非搜索竞争；网站表单只生成交给助手的请求，网站订阅认证尚未实现。
plugins.requirements_zh: 注册商覆盖有限、续费会变；网站订阅认证尚未实现。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cheapest Domains compares renewal costs across selected registrars, separates introductory registration prices and estimates supported multiyear totals. It can suggest names and check availability or premium status, preserving dates and incomplete coverage. Purchases and definitive premium quotes remain with registrars. Optional Cloudflare Radar popularity measures DNS activity, not search competition; the website form only prepares a request for an assistant, and website subscription authentication is not implemented.

plugins.overview_zh: Cheapest Price 查询 eBay，美国还包含 Best Buy，并给出 Amazon 和当地商店比较链接。支持美国、英国、爱尔兰、加拿大、澳大利亚、德国、法国、意大利和西班牙的地区币种，其他地区回落到美国结果。工具只读且无需登录，部分链接有分成；最低价仅限覆盖店铺和匹配结果，不证明全部卖家、运费或成色条件下的总价最低。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只读免登录，九国本地结果，其他地区回落美国；有分成链接且卖家覆盖有限。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cheapest Price checks eBay listings and, in the United States, Best Buy, then provides Amazon or local-store comparison links. It localizes results for nine named countries; other locations receive US results. Tools are read-only and need no sign-in, with some affiliate links disclosed. Its lowest-price claim is bounded by the covered stores and current matching results, not proof of the lowest total cost across every seller, shipping option or product condition.

plugins.overview_zh: CheapOair 按航线、日期、乘客和舱位查询航班，也按目的地、入住日期、人数和筛选条件查酒店，可在聊天中比较。ChatGPT 不收款、不完成预订；点击预订链接后由 CheapOair 网站校验价格、收旅客信息、付款出票及处理退改。搜索结果不能当作已确认库存或已出票凭证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 聊天只发现比较，最终价格、旅客资料、付款出票和退款在 CheapOair 处理。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CheapOair searches flights using route, dates, passengers and cabin, and hotels using destination, stay dates, occupancy and filters. ChatGPT can compare options, but does not accept payment or finish a reservation. Selecting the booking link transfers the user to CheapOair, where price validation, traveler details, ticketing and later cancellations or refunds are handled. Search results therefore are not confirmed inventory or an issued ticket.

plugins.description_zh: 电脑游戏和电子游戏技巧
plugins.description_en: Tricks for PC and video games
plugins.overview_zh: Cheat-Database 按游戏名搜索社区整理的秘籍、技巧、解锁条件和通关攻略，发布者称覆盖三十多个新旧平台。它是资料查询，而不是修改正在运行的游戏，也不保证代码有效。应准确匹配平台与版本，社区条目或旧攻略可能不适用于当前更新。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入及连接访问条件见介绍；未公开的额度、套餐和权限仍待核实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cheat-Database searches a community-built collection of game codes, tips, unlockables and walkthroughs by game name. The publisher describes coverage across more than thirty platforms, including older and modern systems. It is a reference lookup, not a tool that modifies a running game or guarantees a code works. Match the platform and edition carefully, since community entries and historical tricks may differ from a game's current release.

plugins.overview_zh: Checkin 只读查询已连接账户有权访问的活动、参会者、联系人和订单，可总结售票、签到、支付状态和收入，或比较不同活动，不必手动导出报告。现有权限仍是边界。页面没有声称能修改报名、收款或联系参会者；对比结论还取决于活动口径一致及原始记录质量。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只读并遵循 Checkin 现有账户权限。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Checkin provides read-only access to events, attendees, contacts and orders already visible to the connected account. It can summarize ticket sales, check-ins, payment status and revenue, or compare events without a manual report export. Existing permissions remain the boundary. It does not claim the ability to change registrations, take payments or contact attendees, and derived comparisons depend on consistent event definitions and the stored records.

plugins.overview_zh: Checklist 可在 ChatGPT 查找已有清单、创建新清单、修改任务及保存可复用模板，适合查看未完成工作、整理旅行行李或标准化员工入职。与一次性文字清单不同，它管理的是已保存的清单对象。公开说明未交代团队权限、通知行为、删除或离线支持，不能自动推定。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入及连接访问条件见介绍；未公开的额度、套餐和权限仍待核实。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Checklist can find existing lists, create new checklists, change tasks and save reusable templates inside ChatGPT. Typical uses include reviewing unfinished work, preparing travel packing lists or standardizing employee onboarding. Unlike a one-off checklist answer, the integration manages stored checklist objects. The public description does not specify team permissions, notification behavior, deletion or offline support, so these should be checked rather than assumed.

plugins.overview_zh: ChecklistIQ 根据目的地、时长、同行者和活动生成可编辑的打包及出发准备清单，考虑气候与团体需求，包含行前提醒，并可打印或导出离线使用。页面称其免费，但没有证明无限使用或会自动推送提醒。它是规划辅助，不是对入境规则、天气和行李限制的实时核验。
plugins.requirements_zh: 提供目的地、日期时长、同行者和活动，清单提醒不等于已设置定时通知。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChecklistIQ builds an editable travel packing and preparation list from destination, duration, companions and activities. It considers climate and group-specific needs, includes predeparture reminders and supports printing or exporting for offline use. The listing calls this free, but does not establish unlimited use or automated reminder delivery. It is a planning aid, not live verification of entry rules, weather or baggage restrictions.

plugins.overview_zh: Checkout Page 管理商家结账页、活动报名和表单，以及客户、预订记录和支付、发票、订阅资料，还支持优惠券、固定税率、上传素材和 webhook 配置。这些属于会影响客户及下游系统的业务操作。订阅取消在插件中只做准备，最终需到后台完成，不能理解为聊天中直接取消。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需商家访问，取消订阅必须到后台完成。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Checkout Page manages merchant checkout pages, event registrations and forms, together with customer or booking records and payment, invoice and subscription information. It also supports coupons, fixed tax rates, uploaded assets and webhook settings. These are operational changes that can affect customers and downstream systems. Subscription cancellation is only prepared in the integration and must be completed in the dashboard; the listing does not promise direct cancellation in chat.

plugins.overview_zh: CheckpointGuard 供具有 Aegis 权限的有效管理员查看发现项、每日摘要、保安签到、排班、巡逻和报告，也可分析获授权的工资及诊断信息。既有账户和站点范围保持不变，全部工具只读，不会因分析而修改排班或巡逻记录。资料可能敏感，能看一个站点不代表有权访问其他站点。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需有效管理员及 Aegis 访问，工具只读且限定站点。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CheckpointGuard lets an active administrator with Aegis access inspect findings, daily summaries, guard check-ins, staffing, patrols and reports. It can also examine authorized payroll and diagnostics, while preserving existing site and account scope. All tools are read-only, so operational review does not change staffing or patrol records. Information may be sensitive, and access to one site's data should not be inferred to include other sites.

plugins.overview_zh: CheckTaJob 在求职追踪器中保存职位、申请阶段、招聘沟通、面试及定制简历或求职信，帮助找跟进事项、看漏斗统计，并追踪使用 Greenhouse、Lever 或 Ashby 的公司。疑似虚假职位标记只是提示，不是欺诈定论。每日邮件提醒是可选项；页面没有承诺代投申请或代发邮件给招聘者。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需连接追踪器，每日邮件可选，虚假职位标记不是定论。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: CheckTaJob stores job postings, application stages, recruiter interactions, interviews and tailored CV or cover-letter files in a job-search tracker. It helps identify follow-ups, review pipeline statistics and monitor companies using Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby. Potential ghost-job flags are indicators, not proven fraud. Optional daily email reminders are separate from ordinary tracking, and the listing does not promise to submit applications or email recruiters on the user's behalf.

plugins.overview_zh: ChefBear 把用户选定的菜单照片转成账户中的私有结构化菜单，ChatGPT 可读取菜品和价格，按用户提供的口味偏好比较。识别消耗既有额度，重读已导入菜单不重复扣额。分享需另行提出，链接可撤销；导入不会自动生成菜品图或公开链接。识别文字及过敏适用性仍需核对。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 ChefBear 账户及选定菜单照片，导入扣额度而重读不扣，分享单独请求。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChefBear turns a chosen menu photo into a private structured menu linked to the user's ChefBear account. ChatGPT can read saved dishes and prices and compare them with preferences the user supplies. Recognition consumes the existing allowance, but rereading an imported menu does not. Sharing is requested separately and links can be revoked; importing neither generates dish images nor makes a public link automatically. Menu recognition and allergy suitability still need checking.

plugins.overview_zh: ChefJoJo 保存食谱并让个人食谱集合能在对话中使用，可询问已有做法、边做饭边交流，或与 ChatGPT 创建新食谱后存入 ChefJoJo。页面未说明买菜下单、控制厨具或营养验证能力。制作前应核对用量、食品安全步骤和替代食材，尤其是新生成的配方。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入及连接访问条件见介绍；未公开的额度、套餐和权限仍待核实。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChefJoJo saves recipes and makes a personal recipe collection usable in conversation. Users can ask about existing recipes, discuss cooking while preparing a dish, or create a recipe with ChatGPT and save it back to ChefJoJo. The listing does not describe grocery ordering, appliance control or nutrition validation. Ingredient quantities, food-safety steps and any substitutions should be checked before cooking, especially when a newly generated recipe is involved.

plugins.overview_zh: ChefPlan 根据用户提供的身高、体重、年龄、性别、活动量和目标，用 Mifflin–St Jeor 公式估算基础代谢、每日能量和宏量营养目标，并搜索指定或随机食谱，提供图片、食材及步骤。这是公式估计，不是实测代谢或个人医疗处方。虽然副标题提到热量追踪，正文并未证明持续饮食记账功能。
plugins.requirements_zh: 个人输入用于公式估计，不是实测代谢或医疗治疗。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChefPlan estimates basal metabolism, daily energy needs and macronutrient targets using the Mifflin–St Jeor equation and supplied body, activity and goal information. It also searches named or random recipes with ingredients, pictures and preparation steps. These outputs are formula-based estimates, not a measured metabolic assessment or individualized medical prescription. The listing does not establish ongoing meal logging despite the short tagline about calorie tracking.

plugins.overview_zh: 展示 Chegg 精选学习问答；用户可浏览题目列表，订阅者可打开题目查看完整的专家核验答案。
plugins.requirements_zh: 完整答案面向订阅者；价格、学科覆盖范围和使用额度未说明。
plugins.detail_source_type: 新增历史研究片段恢复
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 幸存历史双语记录恢复，未重新核验，原始证据可能不完整。 仅核对公开文档或索引，未连接账户或实测；索引可能过时，不保证当前可用。未重新打开失败详情网址，也未下载图标。原失败历史字段本次未完整恢复。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Surfaces curated study questions from Chegg. Users can browse a question list; subscribers can open a question to see its complete expert-verified answer.

plugins.description_zh: AI 可完成的待办清单
plugins.description_en: A todo list AI can finish
plugins.overview_zh: Cherry Notes 把手机应用记录的任务带入 AI 工作会话，插件可读清单、选取任务，并在完成工作后标记完成。创建和编辑仍在手机端，不是 ChatGPT 中的完整任务编辑器。页面说明已有 iOS、Android 尚待推出；真正执行任务还取决于助手实际工具和权限，不能由“可标完成”推断所有任务都能自动做完。
plugins.requirements_zh: 在 iOS 手机端创建编辑，插件只读选和完成；Android 标注为待推出。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Cherry Notes links tasks captured in its phone app to an AI work session. The integration can read the list, select an item and mark it complete after work finishes. Creation and editing remain in the mobile app, so it is not a full task editor inside ChatGPT. The page describes iOS availability and Android as forthcoming; completing the underlying work also depends on the assistant's actual tools and permissions.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: 开发者将 CherryDrop 描述为把 ChatGPT 或 Claude 的有用回答存入个人收件箱的工具；保存内容带标题、上下文和标签，便于以后搜索和作为 AI 背景复用。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: The maker describes CherryDrop as a way to save useful AI answers from ChatGPT or Claude into a personal inbox. Saved material receives a title, context and tags so it can be searched and reused as later AI context.
official_product_supplement.requirements_zh: 厂商介绍支持该集成用途，但不是所选 ID 的工具列表；分享权限、保留期限、价格和账户要求未核验。
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅核对公开文档或索引，未连接账户或实测；索引可能过时，不保证当前可用。未重新打开失败详情网址，也未下载图标。原失败历史字段本次未完整恢复。

plugins.description_zh: 进行并分析国际象棋对局
plugins.overview_zh: Chess by Max Health 支持与 Stockfish 或对话模型单人对弈，选择难度、棋色和时限，也有多人大厅；登录用户可用等级分及历史记录。Stockfish 可复盘失误、转折和用时，或在交互棋盘分析单独局面。来源包括当前对局、已保存比赛及公开 Chess.com／Lichess 用户名，不代表未经授权可读私人账户。
plugins.requirements_zh: 提供棋谱或公开用户名，自有等级及历史功能需登录。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chess by Max Health supports single-player games against Stockfish or the conversation model, selectable difficulty, colors and time controls, plus a multiplayer lobby. Signed-in users may retain ranked Elo and match history. Stockfish can review games, highlight mistakes and turning points, or analyze individual positions on an interactive board. Games can come from the session, stored matches or public Chess.com/Lichess usernames; it does not imply access to private accounts without authorization.

plugins.overview_zh: Chess Position Analyzer 提供交互棋盘，可导入 FEN 或手动摆子，拖动棋子探索假设、跟随变化，并针对当前局面问战略问题。正文证明的是基于局面的学习界面，没有说明引擎棋力、必然最佳着法或多人对弈服务。使用解释前应核对棋子布局及轮到哪方走棋。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入及连接访问条件见介绍；未公开的额度、套餐和权限仍待核实。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chess Position Analyzer provides an interactive board that can be initialized from FEN or arranged manually. Users can drag pieces, test hypothetical placements, follow a line and ask strategic questions about that exact position. Its description establishes a position-based study interface, not a particular engine strength, guaranteed best move or multiplayer service. Validate that the board and side to move match the intended position before relying on the explanation.

plugins.description_zh: 关注实时国际象棋赛事
plugins.overview_zh: ChessEver 查找国际象棋赛事、直播及历史结果，查看轮次和走子，并链接到具体对局观看或回放，适合棋迷、教练和棋手跟赛，而非与引擎下棋。广播数据可能延迟或不完整，记录中的积分领先者不一定是官方最终冠军；重要结果需另核实正式排名。
plugins.requirements_zh: 转播可能延迟缺漏，记录领先不等于正式最终排名。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ChessEver finds chess tournaments, live broadcasts and recorded results, then exposes rounds and moves with a link to the exact game for watching or replay. It serves fans, coaches and players following events rather than playing an engine opponent. Broadcast records may lag or be incomplete, and a recorded score leader is not necessarily the certified final winner. Confirm official standings separately when precision matters.

plugins.description_zh: 国际象棋开局、谜题与对局知识
plugins.overview_zh: Chessigma 结合开局指南、约三千七百条线路、规则推导的局面事实、PGN 摘要、每日谜题和近似 Elo 计算。FEN 可查合法走法及将军状态，对局链接会打开外部复盘，由用户浏览器运行 Stockfish。它不在 ChatGPT 内评估局面或下棋，也不读私人棋站账户；Chess.com 和 Lichess 采用 Glicko，Elo 估算不等于真实分数变化。
plugins.requirements_zh: 免账户，不在 ChatGPT 内评估或对弈；Stockfish 在外部运行，Elo 估计不同于 Glicko。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chessigma combines opening guides and a catalog of about 3,700 lines with rule-based position facts, PGN summaries, daily puzzles and approximate Elo calculations. FEN inputs reveal legal moves and check status; game links open external reviews where Stockfish runs in the user's browser. It does not evaluate positions or play games inside ChatGPT, nor read private chess accounts. Chess.com and Lichess use Glicko, so its Elo estimate is not their actual rating adjustment.

plugins.description_zh: 学习常见的国际象棋开局
plugins.overview_zh: Chessvia Openings 是开局资料库，在交互棋盘展示常见防御和变化的具体走子，便于查看关键线路和准备开局学习。公开说明未证明引擎分析、个性化学习进度或实时对弈。应把它视为查询和可视化工具，不要把某条收录的理论变化当作每个局面都最佳的建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 具体输入及连接访问条件见介绍；未公开的额度、套餐和权限仍待核实。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chessvia Openings is an opening-reference library with move sequences displayed on an interactive board. It helps users inspect popular defenses and their variations, visualize defining moves and prepare opening study. The public description does not establish engine analysis, personalized training progress or live game play. Treat it as a lookup and visualization tool, and distinguish a listed theoretical line from a recommendation that is optimal for every position.

plugins.description_zh: 与 ChatGPT 对弈国际象棋
plugins.overview_zh: 提供与 ChatGPT 对弈的国际象棋游戏，ChatGPT 实时思考并回应每一步；用户执白，ChatGPT 执黑。
plugins.requirements_zh: 恢复的正文未证明难度设置、等级分、棋局分析导出或多人对战功能。
plugins.detail_source_type: 新增历史研究片段恢复
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 幸存历史双语记录恢复，未重新核验，原始证据可能不完整。 仅核对公开文档或索引，未连接账户或实测；索引可能过时，不保证当前可用。未重新打开失败详情网址，也未下载图标。原失败历史字段本次未完整恢复。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Provides an interactive chess game against ChatGPT, which reasons through moves in real time. The user plays White and ChatGPT responds as Black.

plugins.overview_zh: Chiedi a Lea 为 LeanEco 用户查询官方手册，定位废物管理、表单、进出登记和 RENTRI 的文档化操作流程。说明针对已记录的标准版本，定制功能或配置可能不同。它属于使用支持，不能据此认定插件会修改记录或提交监管数据；AI 回答可能出错，不能代替法律、法规或专业意见。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅标准文档版 LeanEco，定制可能不同，不保证法律法规结论。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chiedi a Lea helps LeanEco users consult the official manual and locate documented procedures for waste-management records, forms, incoming/outgoing registers and RENTRI. Its instructions apply to standard documented versions; custom implementations or configurations can differ. It is support guidance rather than proof that the plugin edits records or submits regulatory data. AI answers may be wrong and do not replace legal, regulatory or professional advice.

plugins.description_zh: Telegram 客户关系管理和助手
plugins.overview_zh: Chiho AI 连接用户 Telegram 账户，检索和阅读对话，并管理 CRM 标签、公司、任务、摘要、自动化规则和文件夹；消息与群组动作设有预览及批准流程。它是私人账户集成，不是公开 Telegram 搜索引擎。写入前应审核范围和收件人，因为整理操作及获批通信会影响实际账户和他人。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需连接 Telegram 账户，消息及群组动作先预览批准。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体产品限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Chiho AI connects a user's Telegram account to conversation search and reading plus CRM organization. It manages tags, companies, tasks, summaries, automation rules and folders, with previews and approval for messages or group actions. This is a private-account integration rather than a public Telegram search engine. Review scope and recipients carefully before writes, because CRM organization and approved communications can affect actual account data and other people.
