plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flexport's complete public description covers logistics reference searches, shipment tracking and browsing, quote and price review, rate requests and freight-booking creation. It is therefore broader than a shipment-status viewer and may initiate operational commitments. Confirm shipment identity, service, route, quoted charges and booking authority before writing. The page does not specify supported modes, account entitlements, cancellation conditions or whether every displayed quote is binding; these remain offer- and account-specific rather than inferred from the catalogue entry.

plugins.description_zh: 航班状态和登机口提醒
plugins.overview_zh: Flight Gate 用航班号和旅行日期查询最近可得的状态、航站楼、登机口和延误信息。示例虽提到提醒，功能正文却没定义提醒频率、渠道或持续性，须以实际设置回执为准。机场信息随时变化，发布者也明确要求最终登机与登机口信息向航司和机场核实，不能仅依赖聊天结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flight Gate retrieves the latest available status, terminal, gate and delay information using a flight number and travel date. Its examples mention gate notifications, but the functional body does not define an alert schedule, delivery channel or persistence guarantee. Treat alerts as unverified until the service confirms their setup. Airport information can change at any time, and the publisher explicitly directs travellers to confirm final boarding and gate details with the airline and airport rather than relying solely on chat.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: 仅作同名补充：Flight Network 的已观察官方产品页介绍对话式航班搜索与多航司价格、库存比较，但未找到与本条目录 ID 的对应，不能套用候选开发者或版本。标题提到预订，正文主要解释搜索比较，未明确付款出票步骤。未来使用具体报价时，仍需核对最终票价、行李和退改条款。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: Same-name supplemental evidence only: Flight Network's observed official product page describes conversational flight search with pricing and availability from multiple airlines. No bridge to the selected catalogue ID was recovered, so this does not verify that ID or justify applying the candidate's developer/version. The page title mentions booking, while the body mainly explains comparison; it does not settle payment or ticketing steps. Any eventual offer would still need final fare, baggage and cancellation checks.
official_product_supplement.verification_note: 官方产品资料尚未确认与本条插件ID一致，不计插件详情。

plugins.overview_zh: FlightDeck 审阅代码、包装、安全、隐私、公开宣传及上架要求，输出发布建议、可复现问题、实际执行检查、获请求的有限修复和剩余缺口，不能把无证据算通过。它是评审技能，不自动获取所有仓库或提供官方市场认证。检查测试依赖获准工具，发布判断必须区分实际结果与未能运行的项目。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FlightDeck reviews release readiness across code, packaging, security, privacy, public claims and marketplace submission checks. It aims to return a ship decision, reproducible findings, actually executed checks, requested bounded fixes and remaining gaps, without treating absent evidence as a pass. This is a review skill, not access to every repository or an official marketplace certification. Inspection and testing depend on authorized host tools, and any release decision must distinguish observed results from checks that could not run.

plugins.overview_zh: FlightPoints 查询航司里程票库存、比较积分价格，按舱等和路线筛选并查看航段。缓存查询无需登录，实时结果需要连接账户；可提供预订跳转链接，但明确不完成订票或收款。奖励座位可能随时变化，缓存也可能过时；转点或确定行程前应向出票计划核实积分、税费、转点规则和可订情况。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FlightPoints searches loyalty-program award seats, compares points costs and filters cabin or routing preferences, including individual flight segments. Cached availability is accessible without sign-in, while live requests require linking a FlightPoints account. It supplies booking handoff links but explicitly does not complete a reservation or take payment. Award inventory can change and cached results can be stale; verify points, taxes, transfer rules and availability with the booking program before moving points or committing to travel.

plugins.overview_zh: FlightQueue 汇总安检等待与预测、FAA 延误措施、申根边检队列、航站楼、休息室、天气和行李比较，可提交亲历等待时间或设阈值提醒。覆盖数量是发布者声明，模型依赖可得报告；预测不是旅程耗时或及时登机保证。应核对来源时效和航司要求，期待通知前需确认提醒实际已注册。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FlightQueue combines airport security waits and forecasts, FAA delay programs, Schengen border queues, terminals, lounges, weather and baggage-related comparisons. Users may report experienced waits and set a threshold alert, which differs from merely reading a forecast. Coverage and airport counts are publisher claims, and models depend on available reports. Forecasts are not guaranteed journey times or boarding advice. Check source freshness and airline requirements, and confirm an alert was actually registered before expecting a notification.

plugins.description_en: The best flight for your plan
plugins.overview_zh: FLIGHTS Trip & Travel Routes 根据完整行程比较航班，考虑抵达时间、酒店入住、转机耗时与多城市路线，而非只找最低价，也可先从航线反推行程。预订留给用户选择的平台，页面未证明可出票付款。匹配结果依赖输入偏好和时刻准确性，仍需考虑地面交通、延误及具体票价条件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FLIGHTS Trip & Travel Routes compares routes against an overall itinerary, considering arrival timing, hotel check-in, layover burden and multi-city plans rather than price alone. It can help start with a route when the itinerary is still undefined, then compare direct and budget alternatives. The description leaves booking to the user's preferred provider and does not establish ticketing or payment tools. Fit recommendations depend on supplied preferences and accurate schedules; allow for transfers, delays and provider-specific fare conditions.

plugins.description_zh: 管理 SEO 和 AI 可见度
plugins.overview_zh: Flinty 可审阅 SEO 内容与搜索表现、监测 AI 可见度和引用、构建主题群、生成更新文章、安排发布并检查公开页面。它兼有分析和写入发布流程，草稿建议不等于已排期上线。可见度受抽样查询和来源限制，不保证排名或出现在所有 AI 回答；改公开网站前应核对权限、内容权利和发布授权。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flinty helps inspect SEO content and search performance, monitor AI visibility or citations, build topic clusters, generate or refresh articles, schedule publication and audit public pages. It mixes analysis with content-writing and publishing workflows, so distinguish a recommendation or draft from a scheduled live change. Visibility measurements depend on sampled queries and sources; they cannot guarantee rankings or inclusion in every AI answer. Account access, content rights and publication approval should be checked before changing a public site.

plugins.description_zh: 免费将 PDF 转换为翻页书
plugins.overview_zh: Flipbook - Publuu 把上传的 PDF 转为可在线分享、追踪的翻页文档。发布者宣传免费转换，并称注册可保留更久，但未明确保存时限、全部免费限制或隐私默认值。上传会向服务提供文件内容，需先检查保密要求与受众权限；跨设备效果是宣传承诺，仍应实际审阅页面和链接转换。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flipbook - Publuu converts an uploaded PDF into an online flipbook with sharing and tracking. The publisher advertises a free conversion and says registration is needed to keep it longer, but does not specify the retention period, all free-plan limits or privacy defaults. Uploading a document sends its contents to the service; review confidentiality and intended access before using it. Cross-device quality is a promotional claim, so inspect the rendered pages and links rather than assuming flawless conversion.

plugins.overview_zh: Flippo AI 连接转售商账户，查看库存、采购和销售，分析未售商品、回款、月利润、滞销和跨平台毛利，也可记录新销售。结果来自用户已有记录，不是对全部外部市场或税务的完整审计。依赖利润比较前应核对数量、币种、成本和费用，新增交易前确认商品与金额，避免改变错误的业务汇总。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flippo AI connects an existing reseller account to inventory, purchase and sale records. It answers questions about unsold items, purchase returns, monthly profit, ageing stock and margins across platforms, and can record new sales. Results are derived from the user's own records, not a complete audit of external marketplaces or tax obligations. Check quantities, currencies, costs and fees before relying on profit comparisons, and verify the item and transaction before adding a record that changes business totals.

plugins.overview_zh: Flipsnack 上传 PDF、制作含视频链接和线索表单的交互目录、杂志或报告，管理集合并分析阅读、转化数据，也可获取嵌入链接或改变可见性。发布和权限变动可能暴露文件内容，需检查受众和素材权利。可购物目录不证明聊天可直接付款，互动指标也应按服务定义理解，不等于独立认真阅读的人数。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flipsnack uploads PDFs, creates interactive publications, organizes collections and analyzes readership or conversion metrics. It describes enriched catalogues, magazines and reports with video, links and lead forms, plus workflows such as obtaining embed links or changing visibility. Publishing and visibility changes can expose document contents, so review access and asset rights. A shoppable catalogue is not proof of an in-chat payment tool, and engagement analytics should be interpreted using the service's definitions rather than assumed to represent unique, attentive readers.

plugins.overview_zh: Flixly 使用精选模型与账户现有积分生成图片和短视频，可比较模型和估算费用、启动一个任务并跟踪同一任务，结果进入 Flixly 历史。连接明确不支持购买或订阅。估价和提交不代表最终成功，应确认生成意图与额度，再检查成品和使用权后发布。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flixly generates images and short videos using a curated model catalogue and existing account credits. It lets users compare supported models and estimated costs, start one job and follow that same job to an output, with generations retained in Flixly history. Purchases and subscriptions are explicitly unsupported by this integration. Cost estimates and job submission are not final completion guarantees; confirm the intended generation and available allowance, then check the result and rights before using it publicly.

plugins.overview_zh: Flixor 根据心情、风格或观看情境推荐电影与剧集，连接后可在对话中调用。完整正文介绍个性化与调用方式，但未说明流媒体库存、地区版权、年龄过滤或推荐数据来源。建议适合用来发现候选，不保证符合口味或能在某平台观看；页面未证明提供播放、订阅管理或购买能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flixor recommends films or television based on a mood, style or viewing context, using a connected account and conversational invocation. Its full public body describes personalization and how to call it, but does not identify streaming availability, geographic licensing, age-rating filters or recommendation data sources. Treat suggestions as discovery leads rather than guaranteed matches or a statement that a title is available on a particular service. No video playback, subscription management or purchase capability is established.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Floose manages notes, links, addresses, cloud files and idea canvases; Advanced accounts also use Floose Code for text/code editing. Writer or Advanced access is required, and Vault contents are excluded. Selected files can be shared through public read-only links or email invitations, which should be treated separately from private editing. Plan checks may initialize or update billing records without charging. This does not authorize purchases, and the description does not guarantee that every cloud file or external account is accessible.

plugins.overview_zh: Floot 可创建全栈项目、写代码、配置数据库、认证、存储并部署。发布者称构建使用用户 ChatGPT 订阅而非额外 AI 构建积分，但不证明托管和基础设施完全免费。开数据库、改认证和上线均可能产生实际影响，仍需适当授权。生产使用前应验证功能、数据处理和安全，不能把一轮对话即可成品的宣传当作保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Floot builds and hosts full-stack applications through project creation, code editing, databases, authentication, storage and deployment. The publisher says building uses the user's ChatGPT subscription rather than separate AI build credits; this does not prove that all hosting or infrastructure is free. Database provisioning, authentication changes and publication can have real consequences and still require appropriate authorization. A generated app must be tested for functionality, data handling and security before production use rather than accepting a promotional one-conversation success promise.

plugins.overview_zh: FLORA 生成、组织和迭代主视觉、情绪板、场景图及促销素材，需 OAuth 连接已有账户。可结合其他工具取上下文或回写成果，但前提是它们另行连接且获授权，FLORA 本身不提供 Notion、Drive 或 Slack 权限。分享前应核对素材权利、生成细节与目的地；正文未明确模型、积分和保存限制。

It connects through OAuth to an existing FLORA account. Context can be drawn from other tools and results written back only when those tools are separately connected and authorized; the FLORA plugin alone does not supply Notion, Drive or Slack access. Review asset rights, generated details and the destination before sharing. Model choices, credit costs and storage limits are not specified in this public description.

plugins.overview_zh: Flourish 依据提供的数据和表达目标选择模板、整理数据，在账户中创建真正可编辑的图表并给出编辑链接，而不只是截图。最终润色和发布仍由用户在 Flourish 控制，协作、品牌与发布能力取决于套餐。上线前应核对数据变换、单位和视觉编码；可编辑不等于表达无误，创建也不等于已公开。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flourish turns supplied data into a real editable visualization in the user's account, choosing a template and preparing data before returning an edit link. Final polishing and publication remain under the user's control in Flourish, with collaboration, branding and publishing options determined by the plan. This is not a screenshot-only result. Check data transformations, units and the visual encoding before publication; a generated chart can be editable yet misleading, and creating it does not mean it has already been made public.

It is a focused catalogue-discovery tool rather than a search of every property agency. Listing information does not independently establish availability, legal title, condition or the final contract terms. The page does not describe arranging visits, negotiating, signing leases or taking payments, so those should not be inferred from its ability to find a matching property.

plugins.overview_zh: Flow State 连接耐力训练日历、运动员资料和恢复背景，查看历史负荷、创建修改训练或比赛、管理计划；只有账户已连接 Garmin 才能同步选定训练。写入会改变安排并可能影响设备。负荷和恢复信号不是临床评估，是否适合仍取决于个人与数据；同步前需核对内容和目标，不能把插件当作运动医学许可。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flow State connects endurance-training calendars, athlete profiles and recovery context. It can review history/load, create or update workouts and races, manage plans and send selected workouts to Garmin only if Garmin is already connected to that account. These writes change a training schedule and may affect another device. Estimates and recovery signals are not clinical assessments; suitability depends on the athlete and source data. Confirm the workout and destination before syncing, and do not treat the plugin as medical clearance to train.

plugins.description_zh: 面向企业的网站和 AI
plugins.overview_zh: flowboxx 是面向德奥瑞市场的网站与 AI 可见度服务咨询入口，可解释服务、评估需求并留下人工沟通请求。整体业务还涉及建站和电气检查软件，但不代表本插件能实际验电或自动建完网站。通常 24 小时出样站不是保证；提交咨询前核对联系资料，具体范围和价格仍须向供应商确认。

It explains offerings, assesses a stated need and can leave an inquiry for a human. Its wider business includes website delivery and electrical-inspection software, but those descriptions do not establish that this plugin performs inspections or autonomously builds a complete site. The stated typical 24-hour demo is not a guarantee. Review any contact information before inquiry submission and obtain actual scope and pricing from the provider.

plugins.overview_zh: Flowchart Maker 根据文字、文件、代码或图片制作修复流程图，覆盖泳道、BPMN、决策树和技术流程，可修正 Mermaid 并转为 PlantUML、Graphviz、D2 或 draw.io。转换成功和图形整洁不证明流程正确或代码运行，应核对分支假设并在目标工具渲染。可能附明确披露的分佣链接，应保留商业关系说明，不代表必须购买。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flowchart Maker creates or repairs process diagrams from descriptions, documents, code or images, including swimlanes, BPMN, decision trees and technical workflows. It can fix Mermaid and convert to PlantUML, Graphviz, D2 or draw.io. A conversion or visually neat chart does not validate the underlying process or prove code execution. Review branches and assumptions against source material, and check rendering in the intended tool. Responses may include a disclosed affiliate link, which is a commercial relationship rather than a required purchase.

plugins.description_zh: Java 流程与受治理的操作
plugins.overview_zh: Flower 的精确 ID 页面介绍 Java JVM 内工作流和受治理业务操作，含显式状态转移、测试、持久化、观测与本地检查；Action Runtime 提供规则、审批、幂等、状态和审计。正文明确以 Codex 开发为场景，不证明所有聊天界面都能运行云服务。仍需库和获准开发工具，治理机制也不自动授权业务修改或保证安全。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flower's exact-ID page describes a coding workflow for Java's in-JVM Flower runtime and governed business actions, with explicit transitions, tests, persistence, observability and local inspection. Flower Action Runtime adds policy, approval, idempotency, durable state and audit. The body specifically frames setup and maintenance as Codex work; it does not prove a ready-to-run cloud service in every ChatGPT surface. Required libraries and authorized development tools must exist, and policy controls do not themselves authorize business mutations or guarantee safety.

plugins.overview_zh: Flowers Ghana 查看以加纳塞地计价的商品、配送养护说明，用结账邮箱和追踪码查订单，并生成预填结账链接。配送核对与付款在商家网站完成。订单识别资料只应用于对应获准订单；链接不代表预留库存或保证送达，最终费用、地址覆盖和取消条款需按实际报价核实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flowers Ghana browses products priced in Ghana cedis, explains delivery or care, tracks an order using its checkout email and tracking code, and produces a prefilled checkout link. Delivery review and payment are completed on the merchant website. Order lookup identifiers should be used only for the matching authorized order, not exposed elsewhere. A generated link does not reserve stock or confirm delivery, and final charges, address coverage and cancellation terms need to be checked on the actual offer.

plugins.overview_zh: Flowlines 通过汇总指标、结果比较、群组、主题图和具体会话证据研究 AI 代理使用，需有含数据的账户工作区，按请求可保存已独立核实的私人笔记。结果可能包含终端用户对话，应在摘要中遮蔽直接身份信息。发布者也记录工具参数、结果和会话结局到私人遥测；私人存储并不等于不处理或不保留敏感信息。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flowlines reviews AI-agent activity through aggregate metrics, outcome comparisons, cohorts, topic maps and focused session evidence. It requires an account and a workspace containing agent data, and may save independently verified findings as private notes when requested. Authorized results can include end-user conversations, so summaries should mask direct identifiers. The publisher also records tool arguments, results and outcome reports in private telemetry. Private telemetry is still stored data, not a claim that no sensitive information is processed or retained.

plugins.overview_zh: Flowlity Co-planner 让获准用户查看供应链站点、商品、供应商、订单、库存、预测、促销、产能、预警、导入、保存视图、评论和看板指标。完整正文说的是检查现有资料，没有证明可改采购单或执行补货。预测与 KPI 依赖工作区输入和时点，实际运营前应确认单位、库存更新及规划假设。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flowlity Co-planner lets authorized users inspect supply-chain sites, products, suppliers, orders, inventory, forecasts, promotions, capacity, alerts and dashboard metrics, including imports, saved views and comments. It provides conversational access to existing Flowlity data. The complete body describes inspection, not changing purchase orders or executing replenishment, so write capabilities should not be inferred. Forecasts and KPIs depend on the workspace's inputs and timing; confirm units, inventory freshness and planning assumptions before operational reliance.

plugins.overview_zh: Flownato 搜索真实应用流程、截图和 UI 元素，查看完整页面及情境，也可打开较大的工作区，适合界面研究与模式比较；账户通过插件设置管理。公开页未证明能导出源代码、自动实现或获得复制其他产品设计的许可。参考界面的时效、适用性仍需对照自身需求和无障碍要求判断。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flownato searches examples of real application flows, screenshots and UI elements, then lets users inspect full screens and contextual details or open a larger workspace. It is useful for interface research and comparing interaction patterns. Account management is handled through plugin settings. The description does not establish source-code export, implementation generation or a licence to copy another product's design. Screens are references whose relevance and currency should be checked against the project's own requirements and accessibility needs.

plugins.overview_zh: FlowSavvy 创建、修改、完成和组织任务，管理日历，并自动围绕已有安排排程，随计划变化调整优先级。它会实际改变任务或日历，不只是建议时间表，应核对目标日历及受影响事件。自动安排不能保证工时估计可行或必然按期完成；正文未列明所有日历兼容、冲突处理及通知规则。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FlowSavvy creates, updates, completes and organizes tasks, manages calendar events and automatically fits work around existing commitments. It can reprioritize and adapt the schedule as plans change, reducing manual rearrangement. These are real task and calendar changes, not merely a suggested timetable, so confirm the intended calendar and any affected events. A generated schedule cannot guarantee that estimates are achievable or deadlines will be met. The page does not specify every calendar integration, conflict rule or notification behavior.

plugins.overview_zh: FLOWSTACK UI 使用已安装 Atom、Brick、Colors、Theme 包的精确版本知识，指导界面构建维护，以 Brick 为优先并检查包和所有权边界，报告缺口而非虚构 API。能力依赖实际安装版本和可访问项目资料，不证明依赖已齐或代码已编译。应明确审阅测试、集成与产品缺口后再认定可交付。

It prioritizes Brick-based finished interfaces, checks package ownership boundaries and reports real component gaps instead of inventing APIs. Its reliability depends on the relevant installed package versions and accessible project context. This is a development guidance workflow, not proof that dependencies are present or code has compiled. Review tests, integration and product gaps explicitly before considering a generated interface ready.

plugins.overview_zh: FlowyTeam 管理工作区任务、项目、OKR、员工目录、考勤与绩效周期，可更新事项、查目标及上下班打卡。明确不读写薪酬、银行、身份文件、家庭住址、健康和密码。考勤绩效仍涉及人员，应核实身份并审阅变更，不能仅凭摘要决定员工待遇；打卡请求也不等于独立证明实际到场。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FlowyTeam connects tasks, projects, OKRs, employee-directory records, attendance and performance cycles. Users can update work items, inspect goals, clock in/out and review attendance within a workspace. It explicitly excludes pay, banking, identity documents, home addresses, health information and passwords. Attendance and performance records still affect people, so preserve identity and review changes rather than inferring employment conclusions from a summary. The connector does not grant access beyond workspace permissions or turn clock-in requests into verified physical presence.

plugins.description_zh: 首席财务官同行解答和供应商信息
plugins.overview_zh: Floyd 提供两个只读工具，分别查询带来源的 CFO 同行实践及供应商、从业者推荐。需要有效 F Suite 会员和 OAuth，答案限定在本人所属同行网络，按相关请求调用而非主动推送。经验可以帮助比较，但不是经审计的财务法律意见，提及次数也不证明供应商适用；迁移他人经验前应回看来源情境。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Floyd by The F Suite offers two read-only tools: cited peer-practice insights and vendor/practitioner discovery drawn from community discussions and resources. Active membership and OAuth are required, and answers are limited to the member's peer networks. It is invoked when relevant rather than proactively pushing content. Peer experience can illuminate options but is not audited financial or legal advice, and mentions are not neutral proof of vendor suitability. Inspect the linked context before applying another company's experience to a different situation.

plugins.description_en: Fluent UI icon search for code
plugins.overview_zh: Fluenticons 按名称、微软关键词和同义词检索 Fluent UI System Icons，返回真实组件名及多平台代码，可无需登录选择导航图标组。发布者称确定性匹配而不虚构名称，但项目仍需对应包和版本。服务独立于微软，图标采用 MIT 许可；分发应用时仍应核对许可、无障碍标签和视觉适配。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fluenticons searches Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons through icon names, keywords and synonyms, returning existing component names and code for several platforms. It can choose a coherent set for navigation without sign-in. The publisher describes deterministic matching rather than invented icon names, but integration still requires the appropriate package/version in the target project. Fluenticons is independent, not Microsoft-affiliated, and the icons use the MIT licence. Check accessibility labels, visual fit and licence obligations when distributing an application.

plugins.description_zh: 查询你的 Fluix 数据

plugins.overview_zh: FluoTest 为登录用户创建计分测验草稿、查看题目设置、分析汇总结果、编辑和发布，删除必须明确确认。发布删除不同于私人构思，应核对题目和受众。分数或淘汰指标只反映所设问题，不是对个人的客观判断；正文未证明适合高风险筛选，也未详述隐私和删除恢复能力。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FluoTest creates scored quiz drafts, reads questions and settings, reviews aggregate results, edits content and publishes quizzes for authenticated users. Quiz deletion has an explicit confirmation step. Publishing and deleting are consequential changes rather than private brainstorming, so review the target quiz and audience. Aggregate scores or disqualification metrics reflect the configured questions, not an objective assessment of a person. The description does not establish suitability for high-stakes screening, detailed privacy guarantees or recovery after deletion.

plugins.description_zh: 管理工作流管道和卡片
plugins.overview_zh: Flux Control 管理工作流管道、阶段和卡片，含分配、标签、评论、流转、审阅审批，也覆盖表单、数据库、自动化、角色、团队和委派。它可能改变业务流程和权限，应区分读取、流程修改及权限扩大。私人多租户工作区不免除授权要求；正文未明确全部审批、回滚和外部自动化副作用，执行前应审阅具体操作。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flux Control manages workflow pipes, stages and cards, including assignments, labels, comments, movement, reviews and approvals. Its broader workspace tools cover forms, databases, automations, roles, teams and delegations. These capabilities can alter business processes and access, so separate simple record review from workflow mutations or permission expansion. A private multi-tenant workspace does not remove authorization requirements. The page does not define every approval rule, rollback option or external side effect of an automation; review the intended operation before executing it.

plugins.overview_zh: FluxBuilder 管理 WooCommerce、Shopify 和 WordPress 的 Flutter 应用项目，可创建、改屏幕设置、查商品、预览并执行测试或发布构建。发布构建不等于应用商店批准或已上线，账户、签名、平台条款和运行正确性仍需核对。无代码宣传不保证所有定制有效，分发前仍须测试支付、权限和数据处理。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FluxBuilder connects native Flutter app projects for WooCommerce, Shopify and WordPress, allowing creation, screen redesign, settings changes, catalogue search, previews and test or release builds. A release build is not automatically an App Store or Google Play approval or publication. Store accounts, signing, platform terms and runtime correctness still need checking. The advertised no-code workflow does not prove every customization works or remove the need to test payments, permissions and data handling before distributing an app.

plugins.description_zh: 阿尔巴尼亚包机与旅游价格
plugins.overview_zh: Fly Travel Albania 从旅行社预订引擎缓存查询阿尔巴尼亚出发的包机套餐、团期和酒店库存，区分两名成人的欧元套餐总价与每人团费，并给出预订链接。所谓实时资料仍来自缓存，不等于重新确认的报价。应检查人数、项目、日期、总价和条款，正文未证明聊天可直接付款或保证订成。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fly Travel Albania retrieves charter-package prices, tour dates and hotel availability for departures from Albania using the agency's booking-engine cache. It distinguishes package totals in EUR for two adults from per-person tour prices and supplies a booking link. Cached data is not necessarily a newly confirmed offer, even when described as live. Check passenger composition, included services, date, final total and conditions on the selected offer. No direct payment or guaranteed booking completion inside chat is established.

plugins.overview_zh: Flygresor.se 比较航司与旅行社票价以寻找较低价，这是完整正文的功能范围；所谓搜索全部供应商属于宣传，未独立证明无遗漏。页面没有定义结账、出票、账户和更新频率。应按相同行李、退改和支付费用条件比较，再向实际销售方核对当前报价，最低显示价不一定是最低总成本。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flygresor.se compares flight prices across airlines and travel agencies to help locate cheaper options. That is the full functional description; the claim to search all providers should be treated as promotional rather than independently verified universal coverage. The page does not define checkout, ticket issuance, account requirements or fare freshness. Compare like-for-like baggage, change rules and payment fees, then verify the current offer with the actual seller instead of assuming the cheapest displayed result is the best total deal.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 Flyin 查找低价航班
plugins.overview_zh: Flyin 页面介绍以沙特及周边为重点的机票、酒店、套餐和退改保障产品，也提到先飞后付。正文主要描述整体业务，未逐项定义本插件接口，不能推断所有附加服务或融资可在聊天执行。客户数量和年资属宣传；承诺交易前应核实实际票价、资格、信贷条件、保险除外与取消规则。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flyin's page describes a Saudi-focused travel platform offering flights, hotels, packages and optional flexibility or protection products, including fly-now-pay-later offerings. Much of the body describes the broader business rather than enumerating this plugin's exact operations. Do not infer that every ancillary or financing feature can be executed in chat. Customer counts and experience claims are promotional; verify actual fares, eligibility, credit terms, insurance exclusions and cancellation conditions with the chosen offer before any commitment.

plugins.description_en: How much is the good seat?
plugins.overview_zh: Flying Fine 用美国交通部季度机票资料比较国内商务、头等历史低价、典型和高价，也按预算找路线，区分普通躺椅与全平躺座位，并提示小样本。明确不是实时票价，不能保证指定日期价格。没有预订或结账，应向航司核对当前报价、机型和座位，历史区间不证明特定舱位可订。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flying Fine compares historical U.S. domestic business/first-class fares drawn from quarterly Department of Transportation ticket data, including low, typical and high values or routes within a budget. It distinguishes reclining seats from lie-flat products and flags thin samples. These are explicitly historical figures, not live quotes or guarantees for a date. There is no booking or checkout. Confirm current pricing and the actual aircraft/seat with the airline; a route-level historical range cannot promise a particular cabin will be available.

plugins.overview_zh: Flyte 以 SDK 文档为依据辅助编写 Flyte 2 工作流、应用和代理。页面明确区分运行界面：网页 ChatGPT 可查文档示例，真正运行或管理已认证集群需要配置好 Flyte CLI 的本地环境。安装插件不自动完成本地配置或授权集群；生成代码不等于已部署执行，应以实际结果确认。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flyte supports authoring and reasoning about Flyte 2 workflows, applications and agents using SDK-grounded skills. Its page makes an important surface distinction: ChatGPT web can search documentation and examples, while running or managing an authenticated cluster requires a local ChatGPT environment with the Flyte CLI configured. Installation of the plugin alone does not supply that local configuration or cluster permission. Deployment and execution should be verified through actual results, not inferred from a generated workflow or code example.

plugins.overview_zh: Flyweel 的完整正文说明通过 MCP 分析 Google 与 Meta 广告，但未列出指标、账户范围、归因模型、写入工具或套餐。只能按实际获准数据理解分析能力，不能推断可改预算或启动活动。比较时需统一日期、币种和归因设置，并区分平台报告结果与因果结论。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Flyweel's complete public body says its MCP analyzes Google and Meta Ads campaigns through ChatGPT. It does not enumerate metrics, accounts, attribution models, write tools or required subscription tiers. Use the integration as an analytics connection only to the extent authorized account data is actually available, and do not infer budget editing or campaign launching. Reports should distinguish platform-reported results from causal conclusions and account for date ranges, currencies and attribution settings before comparing campaigns.

plugins.overview_zh: FMP 提供证券、加密资产、外汇、商品、披露文件和经济指标，支持财报、筛选、业绩会和内部人交易研究。虽描述历史与实时数据，更新、权益和覆盖仍不能视为统一保证。它是信息服务，不是券商执行或个性化投资建议。使用前需核对时点、报告期、调整和口径，机构级质量属于厂商表述而非独立审计。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FMP exposes market and company research data spanning securities, crypto, FX, commodities, filings and economic indicators, with financial statements, screening and transcript or insider-trade research. The publisher describes both historical and real-time data, but feed timing, entitlements and coverage are not universal guarantees. This is information access, not brokerage execution or individualized investment advice. Confirm timestamps, reporting periods, adjustments and source definitions before comparing figures; institutional-quality wording is a vendor claim rather than an independent audit.

plugins.overview_zh: Focus Session Totals 根据明确提供的同日起止分钟计算总时长、休息和活动分钟，拒绝重叠或休息超长，限成人可控输入。服务端临时计算，独立网站本地处理并可审阅导出 CSV/JSON。活动分钟只是算术，不证明专注或效率；不查询、存储、发送或交易。MCP 请求/响应为 128/256 KiB 上限，另有字段记录限制。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Focus Session Totals calculates elapsed, break and active minutes from explicit same-day start/end values, rejecting overlaps or breaks longer than the session. It uses adult user-controlled inputs only, with transient server computation or local standalone-site processing and CSV/JSON review/export. Active minutes are arithmetic, not evidence of attention or productivity. No lookup, storage, sending or transactions are provided. MCP requests/responses are capped at 128/256 KiB with additional field and record limits; inspect results before export.

plugins.description_zh: 提供附来源、关联市场的新闻
plugins.overview_zh: FocusPulse 汇总过去 48 小时印度及美国与上市公司、商品、指数或卢比有关的新闻，附报道链接和关联说明。只返回通过相关性筛选的内容，结果少不等于没有新闻。无需账户，发布限制每分钟 60 次。软件摘要可能出错，不给目标价、买卖指令或投资建议，应回查原报道。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FocusPulse summarizes instrument-linked news for India and the United States within the previous 48 hours, providing reporting links and a short explanation of relevance to a company, commodity, index or rupee. It returns only stories passing its relevance filter, so few results can reflect the filter rather than no news. No account is needed; the published limit is 60 requests per minute. Software summaries can be wrong and do not provide price targets, trading calls or investment advice; check the original reporting.

plugins.overview_zh: Fodda 连接分析师维护的知识图谱，研究品牌、消费者、市场和业绩会，覆盖多个行业并附来源归属，也可咨询具名专家或其 AI 对应体。AI 对应体不等于专家本人亲自提供意见。精选资料仍可能不完整或过时，应检查证据再把趋势或高管发言用于业务、投资判断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fodda connects analyst-maintained knowledge graphs for brand, consumer, market and earnings research across several industries. Findings include attributed sources, and users can consult named experts or their AI counterparts for a domain perspective. An AI counterpart is not the same as personally obtaining the human expert's advice. Curated graphs may still be incomplete or dated; examine evidence and attribution before turning a theme or executive statement into a business or investment conclusion.

plugins.overview_zh: Folderly AI 读取选定活动、审稿和保存草稿，单封生成须先看费用额度再明确请求；审阅保存不耗生成积分。保存会覆盖当前稿、清除批准，只保留十个版本，再保存可能永久删除最旧版。不能发送、排期或批准，审稿不验证事实或送达率。连接会向助手共享选定内容，保存前应确认范围及不可恢复的版本损失。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Folderly AI reads chosen campaign context, reviews copy and saves editable drafts; generating one email requires explicit request after reviewing cost and available entitlement. Review/save do not consume generation credits. Saving replaces the draft, clears approval and retains only ten versions; a further save may permanently remove the oldest. It cannot send, schedule or approve email. Review is about writing, not factual verification or deliverability. Authorized connection shares selected content with the assistant, so confirm scope and irreversible version loss before saving.

plugins.description_zh: 关注网页、社交媒体和新闻
plugins.overview_zh: Follow Anywhere 跟踪网页、社交主页、新闻和 RSS 的变化并整理近期更新。完整正文未定义轮询频率、保存期限、社交平台权限或通知保证，关注请求应以服务回执确认。公开变化可能延迟或不可读，跟踪不授予绕过登录、采集私人材料或联系站主的权限。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Follow Anywhere follows webpages, social profiles, news sources and RSS feeds to track changes and summarize recent updates. The complete page describes following and catching up, but does not specify polling frequency, retention, supported social-platform access or notification delivery guarantees. A requested follow should be confirmed by the service rather than assumed from conversation. Public changes may be delayed or inaccessible, and tracking a source does not grant permission to bypass logins, collect private material or contact its owner.

plugins.description_zh: 生成 UI 字体搭配
plugins.overview_zh: Font Pairing 按情绪、受众、行业或已有字体推荐标题、强调和正文三种角色的组合，可持续比较替代方案用于网站、品牌和演示。建议是风格辅助，不证明商用许可、可获得性或特定文字系统支持。实际应用应测试可读性、字形覆盖、回退和无障碍，并在嵌入分发前取得对应字体权利。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Font Pairing recommends three-role typography sets: a heading face, accent face and body face, refined by mood, audience, industry or an existing font. It supports comparing alternatives for websites, brands, presentations and other designs. These are stylistic suggestions, not proof of a font's commercial licence, availability or support for a particular writing system. Test readability, glyph coverage, fallback behavior and accessibility in the real medium, and obtain the proper font rights before embedding or distributing it.

plugins.overview_zh: Fonzi Talent 连接工程师求职账户，查看进展、公司和面试请求，显示岗位、基本薪资和回复期限，接受或拒绝需确认。可开始简历上传，并控制可关闭的对话分享。对工程师免费不等于就业保证，也不代表完整薪酬信息。应核对具体请求和传输资料，回应面试不等于接受工作录用。

Review the specific request and data shared; an interview response is not acceptance of a job offer.

plugins.description_en: Log meals and see what's left

plugins.overview_zh: foodora 搜索附近餐厅和菜品，用交互卡展示菜单、价格、评分、预计送达与优惠，再通过链接到其应用或网站下单，不代表聊天已完成购买。本条公开集成仅瑞典可用，不能外推全部品牌市场。位置使用应符合请求，实际下单前核对库存、配送费、最低消费、过敏原与到达估计。

Deep links continue the order in foodora's own app or website; this is discovery rather than a completed purchase. The published integration is currently Sweden-only, not every country where the brand operates. Location access or sharing must be appropriate to the request. Final stock, delivery fees, minimum orders, allergens and arrival times should be checked with the selected offer before ordering.

plugins.overview_zh: foodpanda 提供餐厅菜品搜索、完整菜单、价格、评分、预计送达和促销，展示卡片并跳到外部继续下单。此次说明限定新加坡，不代表全部运营国家。未证明聊天内可付款结账；购买前核对商家报价、饮食要求、地址和费用，菜单匹配或预计时间不保证食材安全或准时送达。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: foodpanda provides restaurant and dish discovery with full menus, prices, ratings, delivery estimates and promotions, returning vendor/menu widgets and links to continue ordering externally. The recovered description limits this integration to Singapore, not all foodpanda markets. It does not establish in-chat checkout or payment. Check the final merchant offer, dietary details, delivery address and all fees before ordering; a menu match or estimated time is not a guarantee of ingredient safety or arrival at that time.

plugins.description_zh: 规划膳食并管理执业业务
plugins.overview_zh: Foodzilla 严格区分教练与客户连接：教练只管自己的食谱、食品、模板、表单、预约及内容，不能读客户名单、日记记录或发消息；获准客户只记录本人活动、查看计划，不能改教练目标。需要账户，Autopilot 从 Professional 套餐提供，客户访问由教练控制。营养计划需专业审阅；不记录姓名邮箱不等于服务不处理健康信息。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Foodzilla separates coach and client access. Coaches manage their own recipes, foods, templates, forms, booking hours and content but cannot read client lists/diaries/records or message people. Authorized clients can log their own activities and read their plan, but cannot alter coach-set targets. An account is required; Autopilot is included from Professional, and coaches control client access. Nutrition calculations and generated plans need review, not medical reliance. The no-name/email logging statement does not mean no health information is processed in the service.

plugins.description_zh: 93 个足球联赛的统计数据
plugins.overview_zh: Football Charts 查询积分榜、赛果、近期赛程、进球时段和蒙特卡洛赛季概率，发布者称覆盖 93 联赛、每日更新。无需登录且只读，不提供赔率、投注建议或球员级数据。赛程只在开赛前数天出现，更早于上赛季的历史需另有 API 密钥。预测只是基线模型，不保证冠军或降级；应核对实际联赛覆盖和时间戳。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Football Charts provides tables, results, near-term fixtures, timing patterns and Monte Carlo season projections across a stated 93 leagues, updated daily. It is read-only without sign-in, with no odds, betting advice or player-level data. Fixtures appear only a few days before kickoff; seasons older than the previous one require a separate API key. Projections are baseline model outputs, not guaranteed title or relegation outcomes. Coverage counts and update claims should be checked against the actual league and timestamp returned.

plugins.description_zh: 足球统计、赛程与比赛信息
plugins.overview_zh: Football- Games+results+scores 整理赛事、球队、赛程、即时比分、赛果与积分榜，可按俱乐部筛选并对话查询。长篇介绍未给出完整联赛列表、数据商、延迟或历史深度。即时标签仍需时间戳验证，改期或争议结果应向赛事官方核对；正文没有描述投注、订阅或交易操作。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Football- Games+results+scores organizes competitions, club details, fixtures, live scores, finished results and standings, with team filtering and conversational questions. It is meant for following a chosen club without navigating multiple websites. The extensive page does not identify a complete league list, data provider, latency or historical depth. Treat live labels as service claims until timestamps confirm freshness, and verify postponed fixtures or disputed results with authoritative competition information. It does not describe wagers, subscriptions or transactions.

It does not describe creating reports, contacting owners or revealing non-public case information. A similar animal in results is a lead rather than proof of identity or ownership. Verify the listing details and use the platform's appropriate contact process; public discovery does not justify spreading an owner's personal details or arranging a handover without checks.

plugins.description_zh: 规划飞行、获取飞行简报并记录航程
plugins.overview_zh: ForeFlight Mobile 在对话中提供天气、NOTAM、预报、航路高度建议及日志管理，可查看或记录飞行、检查资质时效。部分请求会修改航空记录。聊天摘要不是认证飞行简报、运行许可或安全保证，飞行员必须核对权威最新资料与实际机型限制；写日志前确认记录和账户，建议本身不证明某次飞行已发生。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ForeFlight Mobile brings weather, NOTAMs, forecasts, route/altitude suggestions and logbook work into conversation, using connected ForeFlight data and performance information. It can review or log flights and inspect currency, so some requests may change aviation records. Chat summaries and recommendations are not a certified flight briefing, operational clearance or guarantee of safe conditions. Pilots must verify current authoritative information and actual aircraft limitations; check the record and account before logging, rather than treating a suggestion as proof a flight occurred.

plugins.description_zh: 经过核实的攻略与策略
plugins.overview_zh: ForgeMaster Player Guide 根据静态精选知识回答战斗、成长及其他系统问题，展示计算假设，区分已证实机制与推论，未知就说明。没有游戏账户连接、MCP 服务或外部 API，不能看实时背包或代操作。资料可能落后更新，应核对版本与当前进度，不把不确定机制包装成事实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ForgeMaster Player Guide answers game questions from a curated static knowledge base, covering progression, combat and other systems with calculations and explicit assumptions. It distinguishes supported mechanics from inference and acknowledges unknowns instead of borrowing unrelated web results. It has no game-account connection, MCP server or external API, so it cannot inspect the player's live inventory or take in-game actions. Advice can lag updates; compare version and progress context, and keep uncertain mechanics visibly uncertain.

plugins.description_zh: 交付经验证的最小可行产品
plugins.overview_zh: ForgeMind 结合需求探索、创意、现有应用证据和目标，组织考虑成本的 MVP 交付及发布证据；更高级跨代理契约和学习流程需可选 Trust Fabric 附加包。所谓市场验证、可靠交付是工作目标，不证明具体产品已测试部署。实际研究、改代码和发布依赖授权工具、预算与回执，不默认附加包已安装。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ForgeMind describes a product-development workflow combining discovery, creative exploration, existing-app evidence and intended outcomes into cost-aware MVP delivery with release evidence. Advanced cross-agent contracts and learning workflows require an optional Trust Fabric add-on. Claims such as market-tested and verified delivery describe its aims, not proof that a particular product was tested, deployed or validated. Actual research, code changes and releases depend on authorized tools, budgets and observed results; the optional add-on is not assumed to be installed.

plugins.overview_zh: ForInvest 提供行情、分析、组合研究及 BIST/VIOP、KAP 等土耳其市场资料。标题虽提交易集成，正文未明确列出下单操作。发布者说明 OAuth 接入、向 ChatGPT 返回数据及工具输入输出仅会话内保留，相关隐私精度未经独立审计。应核对数据时效权限，不推断具有交易或传输凭据授权。

Although its heading mentions trading integration, the enumerated body does not clearly establish order-entry operations. It describes OAuth account access and returning queried financial data to ChatGPT, with session-limited tool input/output retention claimed by the publisher. These privacy and precision statements were not independently audited. Treat results as research, verify feed timing and permissions, and do not infer authority to trade or transmit credentials.

plugins.description_zh: 从 ChatGPT 运营健身房
plugins.overview_zh: Forj 支持查健身房课程、预约训练和进度，也供教练业主管理排课、比赛、编程和自动化，并包含需确认的会员、消息及计费流程。它不只是只读运动建议，实际能力受角色权限限制。发消息或收费前需核对对象、会员、金额和承诺；训练分析不是医学许可，正文未详述全部退费和数据边界。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Forj supports gym discovery, classes, bookings, workouts and progress, plus owner/coach scheduling, competitions, programming and automations. Its description also includes confirmed member, messaging and billing workflows, so it is not exclusively read-only fitness advice. Capabilities depend on the user's gym role and permissions. Review recipient, membership, amount and commitment before any message or charge; workout analysis is not medical clearance, and the brief public body does not define every billing rule, cancellation policy or data-access boundary.

plugins.description_zh: 在 Fork 沙箱中构建
plugins.overview_zh: Fork 连接获准开发沙箱，可检查、读改工作区文件并预览运行网站。变更作用于选定沙箱，不是未指定的生产环境，需要有该沙箱访问权的账户。编辑前确认目标并保护已有工作；预览成功不等于已部署或完整测试，提到路径或网站也不自动授予其他沙箱、本机文件及账户权限。

Changes affect the selected sandbox, not an unspecified production environment. An account with access to that sandbox is required. Confirm the correct target and preserve existing work before edits; preview success alone is not deployment or complete testing. The description does not grant access to other sandboxes, local user files or connected accounts simply because a path or website is mentioned.

plugins.overview_zh: Forktime 按地区和菜系搜索参与餐厅，查询指定日期时间人数的实时桌位，并可在对话中确认预约；覆盖澳大利亚、美国和加拿大部分餐厅，不是所有门店。订成后短信提供管理链接。确认前核对餐厅、人数、联系方式及取消押金规则，查询有位不等于预约成功，应以实际订位回执为准。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Forktime searches participating restaurants by area and cuisine, checks live tables for date, time and party size, and confirms reservations in conversation. Participating venues are in Australia, the United States and Canada, not every restaurant in those countries. After booking, the service sends a text containing a management link. Verify venue, party details, contact destination and any cancellation or deposit terms before confirming; returned availability can change, and a successful reservation should be based on the booking response rather than the search alone.

This is extraction rather than business-rule validation, so a missing or inferred field must be reviewed against the original. Do not treat normalized labels or a clean structured result as proof that an application is complete or eligible.

plugins.overview_zh: Form Guide 查询英超、英冠、西甲、德甲、意甲和法甲当季赛程、赛果、近况和积分，包含官方扣分并识别常用队名。只读无需登录，发布者称不保存用户资料、无付费排序。范围外俱乐部返回说明而非替代结果；按日期选赛季，页面目前写 2026/27。仍应核对实际日期和延期，不假定覆盖全部历史及联赛。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Form Guide provides current-season fixtures, results, recent form and tables for six named European leagues, including official points deductions and common club aliases. It is read-only, needs no sign-in and says it stores no user information or paid placements. Clubs outside coverage return an explicit unsupported-league response rather than substituted results. Season selection is date-based; the page currently references 2026/27. Verify actual returned dates and postponed fixtures, and do not assume historical seasons, every league or live commentary are supported.

plugins.description_zh: 根据照片和文案创建广告
plugins.overview_zh: Formatry 使用本地商品照片和品牌文案制作广告创意，编辑预览后将栅格图保存到 Codex 工作区，并用原生 OAuth 连接账户。描述明确面向本地 Codex，不保证网页聊天具有相同文件访问。生成可能消耗额度，照片参与服务处理需核对权利和传输范围；保存图片不等于发布广告、投放花费或验证宣传事实。

Native OAuth connects its account. The public description is explicitly local/Codex-oriented, not a promise of identical file access in ChatGPT web. Generation may use available allowance, and local photos are inputs to a service workflow, so check rights and transmission scope. Saving an image is not publishing an ad, placing media spend or validating marketing claims.

plugins.description_zh: 肽相关计算、膳食与训练
plugins.overview_zh: FormBlends Companion 根据输入的肽类数量和液体体积做浓度、单位换算，另有膳食训练计划、购物清单和活动记录。算术不证明剂量安全、注射方法正确、产品纯度或个人适用性，单位错误可能造成伤害，需专业核对，不能作为处方或医疗许可。保存计算与计划涉及健康背景，还应检查服务访问和保留政策。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FormBlends Companion performs concentration and unit arithmetic from supplied peptide quantities and liquid volumes, alongside meal/workout planning, shopping lists and saved activity tracking. Arithmetic does not establish a safe dose, injection technique, product purity or suitability for a person. Incorrect units or inputs can produce harmful results, so measurements need qualified review; do not use the app as prescribing or medical clearance. Saving a calculation or weekly routine also means keeping health-related context, whose access and retention should be checked in the service.

plugins.overview_zh: FormBuilder 在连接账户中建私人草稿，明确请求后才发布，也可列数量、字段和汇总允许的回答。敏感资料流程不可用，附件及看似受限的值会省略；不支持改已有表单、webhook、删除、支付或条件逻辑。须与同名工具区分，审阅摘要时注意过滤缺失，空结果不一定代表无人回答；草稿和发布要分别处理。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FormBuilder creates forms in a connected account as private drafts or explicitly requested publications, lists forms/counts and summarizes permitted responses. Sensitive-data workflows are unavailable; attachments and restricted-looking response values are omitted. It does not support editing existing forms, webhooks, deletion, payments or conditional logic. These are important differences from similarly named form tools. Review supported fields and omissions before using a summary, and distinguish draft creation from authorized publication; an empty result may reflect filtering rather than no response.

plugins.overview_zh: Formbyte 对话生成调查、报名表和投票，可继续修改并分析结果，需连接账户。正文未定义发布隐私、回答保留、敏感字段限制或导出格式。收集真实资料前应审阅问题与访问对象，再把分析与实际回答核对，不能把自动生成表单视作适合任何申请和受众。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Formbyte creates surveys, signup forms and polls through conversation and lets users refine them or analyze results in the same thread. A connection is required, and the description offers examples such as feedback or course evaluations. It does not define publication privacy, response retention, sensitive-field restrictions or export formats. Review questions and recipient access before collecting real responses, and verify analytic summaries against actual submissions rather than treating an automatically generated form as appropriate for every application or audience.

plugins.overview_zh: FormEdge 可建改预览发布表单和落地页，读提交、管理通知、素材和版本，也可配置品牌、公用子域、自定义域及通知邮件语言时区。这些是真实发布与设置操作，不只是草稿生成，需确认工作区、受众和域名；域名可能另需验证。正文未保证无限保留、全部权限或设置均可无损回退。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FormEdge creates, edits, previews and publishes forms or landing pages, reads submissions and manages notifications, assets and saved versions. It also exposes workspace branding, public subdomains, custom domains and notification-email language/time-zone settings. These are real publication and configuration changes, not only draft generation. Confirm the target workspace, audience and domain before applying them; domain settings may require separate verification. The public body does not establish unlimited retention, permission scope or that every setting change is safely reversible.

plugins.description_zh: 创建支持电子签名的表单
plugins.overview_zh: Formesign 制作带签名栏的表单、发给签署人、追踪进度提醒，并将回答和带审计轨迹的签署 PDF 存入 Google Workspace。所谓法律约束力不证明任何文件、签署人或司法辖区都满足法律要求。草稿、发送请求和实际签署是不同操作；发送前核对收件人、正文、权限与后果，生成表单不授权代签或接受协议。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Formesign creates forms with signature fields, routes them to signers and tracks signing, reminders and audit-trail PDFs stored with responses in Google Workspace. Its claims of legally binding signatures are not a determination that every document, signer or jurisdiction meets legal requirements. Creating a draft, sending a signature request and actually signing are separate actions. Verify recipients, final content, authority and consequences before sending; the plugin does not authorize the assistant to sign on someone's behalf or accept an agreement merely by generating the form.

plugins.overview_zh: Formester 按日期状态搜索回答，读取 PDF 图片附件并生成摘要、情绪和类别。它并非严格只读，正文明确可把洞察写回自定义字段，写入前应确认目标和意图。答卷附件须按获准目的处理，情绪分类是解释而非客观事实；抽取可能遗漏，页面未保证所有文件类型及完整隐私控制。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Formester reads and searches submissions by date or status, processes attached PDFs/images and generates summaries, sentiment or categories. Unlike a strictly read-only analyzer, its description says insights can be saved back as custom fields. Confirm the intended submission and writeback before changing records, and handle respondent data or attachments according to their authorized purpose. Model-generated sentiment is interpretation rather than objective fact; extraction may miss content, and the page does not guarantee access to every file type or complete privacy controls.

plugins.overview_zh: Formfacade 可导入 Google Form 或制作品牌引流表单，含计分、计算、个性结果和后续邮件，回答及分数进 Google Sheets，并追踪来源转化。它涉及收集和可能的外发，不只是写表单，发布自动化前应核对所收数据、公式、受众和邮件授权。线索分不评价人的价值，转化指标也不证明因果。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Formfacade imports Google Forms or creates branded lead magnets with scoring, calculations, personalized outcomes and follow-up email content. Responses and scores go to Google Sheets, with campaign/source conversion tracking. It therefore combines collection and potential outbound communication, not just form drafting. Review the data requested, formulas, audience and email authorization before publishing or automating follow-up. A lead score does not establish a person's worth or suitability, and conversion metrics depend on implementation and attribution rather than proving causality.

plugins.overview_zh: FormHug 根据自然语言生成调查、报名、测验、评估和预约表单，包含字段、描述、逻辑和版式，可改主题、发布收集并分析。正文未说明敏感数据防护、额度或预约是否占用真实库存。上线前检查逻辑权限，摘要回查原答；精美表单不自动等于合规收集、成功订位或合格评估工具。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FormHug creates forms for surveys, registrations, quizzes, assessments and bookings, generating fields, descriptions, logic and layout from natural language. Users can refine themes, publish, collect submissions and analyze responses. The public description does not specify sensitive-data safeguards, account quotas or whether booking forms reserve actual inventory. Review logic and access before launch and validate summaries against responses. A polished form is not automatically a compliant collection process, a confirmed reservation or an approved assessment instrument.

plugins.description_en: Build and share forms by chat
plugins.overview_zh: Formloop 实时预览构建含条件追问的表单，每次修改可撤回，已发布表单的编辑先留草稿、重新发布才生效。发布提供链接、二维码和嵌入，答题人只需浏览器；可查数量、完成率、NPS，后台下载 CSV。按需才向 ChatGPT 取回答，摘要样本不含姓名邮箱电话链接，禁止索取密码 PIN 卡信息；其他内容仍需隐私审阅。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Formloop builds forms with live preview, conditional follow-ups and undoable versions; edits to a published form stay as drafts until republished. Publishing yields links, QR and embed codes, and respondents need only a browser. It reports response counts, completion, NPS and breakdowns, with CSV available in its dashboard. Responses reach ChatGPT only when asked; names, emails, phones and links are excluded from sampled summaries. Passwords, PINs and card details cannot be requested. Other response content still needs appropriate privacy review.

plugins.overview_zh: Formly 可在聊天建改发布表单、更新问题设置并获取近期回答。完整介绍简短，未定义字段种类、草稿与实时修改关系、保留期限或集成。发布收集应与私人草稿区分，不能默认每项请求都仅改草稿。上线前测试并核对权限，若摘要影响对受访者的判断，应审阅原始回答。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Formly creates, edits and publishes forms in ChatGPT and retrieves recent submissions, including updates to questions or settings. The complete description is concise and does not specify supported field types, draft/live editing behavior, response retention or external integrations. Treat publishing and collection as separate consequential steps rather than assuming every request is a private draft. Test a changed form and verify access before launch, and inspect the underlying submissions when a summary could affect a decision about respondents.

plugins.overview_zh: Forms AI 建改表单和评分测验，调整题目、分节、设置并搜索汇总新旧自有表单回答。关键是发布者说明修改直接作用于在线表单，不同于另需重新发布的工具。改题或关闭收集前应检查影响，邮箱、次数限制和评分需适当设置；情绪及分组分析必须复核，不能脱离情境作重大判断。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Forms AI creates and manages forms or graded quizzes, adjusts questions, sections and settings, and searches or summarizes responses from existing owned forms as well as new ones. Crucially, the publisher says edits land on the live form, unlike tools with a separate republish step. Check impact before changing a question or closing responses. Collection of emails, per-person limits and grading need appropriate setup; automated sentiment or group comparisons require validation and should not drive consequential judgments without context.

plugins.overview_zh: forms.app 可创建管理表单、获取回答、分析统计与流失并制作展示图。页面宣传免费创建和无限回答，但本次未独立核对账户套餐、存储、功能和公平使用限制，不能外推全部付费能力。收集前检查问题、隐私与发布设置，分析表现或群组差异时应使用正确分母和样本背景。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: forms.app: Form Builder creates and manages forms, retrieves submissions and analyzes response statistics, drop-off patterns or presentation visuals. Its page advertises free creation and unlimited responses, but the exact account plan, storage, feature and fair-use limits were not independently verified. Do not extend those words to every premium feature or integration. Review questions, privacy and publication settings before collection, and use actual denominators and sample context when interpreting performance or comparing respondent groups.

plugins.overview_zh: Formula Genius 生成解释调试比较 Excel、Google Sheets 公式，也可写 SQL、正则、VBA、Apps Script 和 Airtable 脚本。它是可审阅的逻辑辅助，不自动访问工作簿数据库。使用前核对地区格式、范围、类型和执行权限；声称验证不代替代表性测试，脚本运行可能改数据或外发，应先审阅副作用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Formula Genius generates, explains, debugs, validates and compares Excel or Google Sheets formulas, and creates SQL, regular expressions, VBA, Apps Script and Airtable scripts. It is described as reviewable logic assistance inside chat, not automatic access to a workbook or database. Check locale, ranges, data types and execution permissions before using generated code. Claimed validation does not replace running representative tests, and scripts can change data or communicate externally if executed, so review their effects first.

plugins.overview_zh: ForthClear 搜索剩余、积压和退货批次，比较成色、数量价格，可询批量报价并跟进卖家答复；连接后查看订单、保存搜索或管理卖家挂牌、报价和运输。只有合格商品支持即时结账，大宗可能需报价。剩余退货需仔细审查，显示价不一定含运税；采购前核对批次、卖家、总价条款，询价不等于购买。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ForthClear searches surplus, overstock and returned-goods lots, comparing condition, quantities and prices, and supports bulk-quote requests with seller replies. Connected accounts can review orders, save searches or manage seller listings, quotes and shipping. Only eligible listings support instant checkout; bulk orders may need a seller quote. Returned or surplus condition requires scrutiny, and displayed price may not include all freight or taxes. Confirm the lot, seller, total and terms before committing rather than treating a quote request as a purchase.

plugins.name_en: Fortune's Weave Guide | 万紫千紅
plugins.description_zh: 礼物、任务和附有来源的指南
plugins.overview_zh: Fortune's Weave Guide 是所列火焰纹章作品的非官方多语言攻略，结合参考笔记和宿主网页工具按进度查流程、礼物、任务、素材及路线，区分库存与商店并标注名称冲突和缺口。未获任天堂或 Intelligent Systems 背书，也未声称能控制游戏账户。内置词表数量是发布者声明，机制、剧透和推定译名仍需核实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fortune's Weave Guide is an unofficial multilingual fan guide for the named Fire Emblem title, using reference notes and host-provided web tools to check walkthroughs, gifts, quests, materials and routes against shared progress. It distinguishes inventory from shop stock and marks gaps or conflicting localized names. It is not Nintendo- or Intelligent Systems-endorsed and has no stated game-account control. Bundled name counts are publisher claims; current mechanics, spoilers and inferred mappings must be checked rather than treated as official or exhaustive.

plugins.description_zh: 管理营销活动和潜在客户
plugins.overview_zh: FORTVISION 汇总营销活动、线索、商机、对话、多渠道外联、自动化及内容项目，提到多个广告平台和邮件、短信、WhatsApp、LinkedIn。但正文未定义全部权限或集成是否已连。应区分分析草稿与实际发送、改广告、启用持续自动化，后者可能花钱或联系真人，需核对对象预算授权；生成跟进不等于获批发送。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FORTVISION combines campaign planning, leads, deals, conversations, outreach channels, automations and content/work management across a marketing workspace. Its broad description includes ad platforms and email/SMS/WhatsApp/LinkedIn coordination, but does not define every tool permission or whether each integration is connected. Separate analytics and drafts from actual sending, ad changes and recurring automations. Those actions can incur spend or contact real people, so verify recipients, budgets and authorization; a generated follow-up is not automatically approved or sent.

plugins.description_zh: 基于数据提问、获取答案和采取行动
plugins.description_en: Ask, answer, act on your data.
plugins.overview_zh: Fospha 北美与南美条目连接每日全漏斗营销测量，供对话分析渠道及销售位置。完整正文很简短，未列零售商、归因方法、写入或地区数据存储。区域标题用于区分连接器，不证明具体存储司法辖区或套餐权益。测量应结合模型覆盖解释，不天然构成因果证明，也不授予调整预算广告的权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fospha's North & South America entry connects daily full-funnel marketing measurement for conversational analysis of channels and selling locations. The complete body is brief: it does not enumerate supported retailers, attribution methodology, write operations or regional data residency. Treat the regional title as the selected connector identity, not proof of a particular storage jurisdiction or entitlement. Measurement outputs require interpretation of the underlying model and coverage; they are not inherently causal proof or authority to change budgets and campaigns.

plugins.description_zh: 基于数据提问、获取答案和采取行动
plugins.description_en: Ask, answer, act on your data.
plugins.overview_zh: Fospha 的 EMEA & APAC 是单独区域连接器，正文同样介绍每日全漏斗测量对话分析，但不证明各账户功能完全相同、渠道齐全或地区存储控制。显示版本与美洲条目不同，已独立保留而非合并。结果属于基于模型的测量，应核对范围日期；未说明可改广告、授权花费或保证因果归因准确。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fospha's EMEA & APAC entry provides conversational access to the same described daily full-funnel measurement purpose for its separately named regional connector. The public text does not establish functional equivalence of every account, supported channel coverage or regional residency controls. Its displayed version differs from the Americas entry and is preserved separately rather than merged. Use results as model-based measurement, verifying source scope and dates; no campaign editing, spend authorization or guarantee of accurate causal attribution is specified.

plugins.description_zh: 基于数据提问、获取答案和采取行动
plugins.description_en: Ask, answer, act on your data.

plugins.description_en: Find properties to buy or rent
plugins.overview_zh: Fotocasa 根据地点、预算、卧室数、设施或房屋类型搜索西班牙房源，展示照片、说明及位置资料，并可通过追问缩小范围。它帮助发现房产，不证明产权、实时可租售情况或已经成交；目录说明未建立签租约、房贷建议、付款或预留房源的能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 覆盖西班牙房源，需地点、预算和偏好；产权、库存及交易条款需另核。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fotocasa searches property listings across Spain from a description of location, budget, bedrooms, amenities or building type. Results provide photos, descriptions and location information, and follow-up details help refine the shortlist. It is a property-discovery interface, not proof of ownership, availability or a completed transaction. The listing does not establish lease signing, mortgage advice, payment or reservation capabilities.

plugins.overview_zh: Fotoluce 搜索并比较当前摄影商品目录，根据产品资料搭配器材套装，并解释门店政策。连接账户后可管理购物车、进入商家结账及查看本人订单。仍需核对具体型号的兼容性和库存；管理购物车或打开结账链接不同于完成购买，也不保证配送结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 购物车及订单需连接 Fotoluce 账户，结账在商家处；核对具体兼容性及最终费用。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fotoluce searches and compares its current photography catalog, helps assemble camera kits from product evidence, and explains store policies. Connected users can manage their Fotoluce cart, proceed to the retailer's checkout and inspect their own orders. Compatibility and stock should still be checked for the exact product variant; managing a cart or following a checkout link is distinct from completing a purchase or guaranteeing delivery.

plugins.overview_zh: Founder Pulse 分析指定期间 GitHub 或 GitLab issue 的流动，比较期间关闭与期末仍开放的项目，按创建时间分组、汇总标签，并检查提交或合并请求链接。它严格只读，明确区分代码交付证据与人工关闭，避免把每个已关闭 issue 都视为功能已上线。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需获授权 GitHub/GitLab issue 访问，严格只读；关闭不等于交付。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Founder Pulse analyzes GitHub or GitLab issue movement over a chosen period. It compares issues closed during that window with those still open at its end, groups them by age, summarizes labels and checks links to commits or pull/merge requests. It is strictly read-only and deliberately separates evidence of delivered code from manual closure, avoiding the assumption that every closed issue represents shipped work.

plugins.description_zh: 职位、远程工作、简历和薪资
plugins.overview_zh: FoundRole 按职位、地点、薪资、日期和工作方式搜索岗位，并记录收藏、已申请、面试和获邀阶段；提供薪资比较、担保及 E-Verify 指标、可信线索和个人匹配，最多并排比较四个岗位，也有提醒、订阅和职业指南。评分只是研究辅助，不证明职位真实或申请人一定符合资格。
plugins.requirements_zh: 个人资料/简历用于匹配，最多比较四岗；订阅和日历邀请属于通知，不自动申请。
plugins.detail_source_type: 官方同ID索引完整公开说明
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FoundRole searches jobs by title, location, salary, date and work arrangement, and tracks applications through saved, applied, interviewing and offered stages. It adds salary comparisons, sponsor and E-Verify indicators, trust signals and profile-based matching, with side-by-side comparison of up to four jobs. Reminders, alerts and career guides support follow-up. Scores and signals are research aids, not proof that a vacancy is genuine or that a candidate qualifies.

plugins.overview_zh: Fountain 协助播客团队挑选精彩片段、准备社交帖子、管理节目并查看表现，也可搜索公开播客和转录、维护项目偏好、上传媒体、发布或排期内容以及发送报告邮件。因此它不仅分析，还包含对外写入与沟通；发布前应检查目的地、时间、收件人和媒体权利。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受工作区权限及发布连接限制；上传、排期帖子和报告邮件均有对外影响。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fountain helps podcast teams find useful clip moments, prepare social posts, manage episodes and inspect performance. It can search public podcasts and transcripts, manage project preferences, upload media, publish or schedule content and send report emails. Its scope therefore includes external writes and communications, not just analysis; publication destinations, timing, recipient choices and media rights require review before content leaves the workspace.

plugins.description_zh: 构建带评分的表单和测验
plugins.overview_zh: FoxForm 创建带计分的表单、测验、问卷和计算器，答案可决定分支及最终结果。十个工具覆盖制作、发布/撤下、答卷、导出以及逐屏浏览、开始、完成和流失分析。条件逻辑、变量与计算字段属于付费套餐；公开表单由 CDN 提供静态 HTML，但这不代表答卷天然私密或发布没有对外影响。
plugins.requirements_zh: 条件逻辑、变量及计算字段需付费套餐；发布或撤下会改变公众可访问性。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FoxForm builds scored forms, quizzes, surveys and calculators whose answers affect branching and final results. Ten tools cover authoring, publishing/unpublishing, responses, exports and per-screen views, starts, completions and drop-off analytics. Conditional logic, variables and calculated fields are available on paid plans. Published forms are served as static HTML through its CDN; this does not mean response collection is private or publication has no external effect.

plugins.overview_zh: Foxit PDF Editor 支持上传、比较、删除 PDF，编辑与调整页面、拆分合并、格式转换、压缩和线性化，并生成分享下载链接，便于在聊天中整理文档包。修改、删除与分享的后果不同；页面未说明每种链接的访问边界，也不能保证复杂排版转换完全无损。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需文件访问，审核删除及链接分享范围；转换保真度和分享限制未完整说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Foxit PDF Editor handles PDF uploads, comparisons, deletion, page editing and reorganization, splitting and merging, conversion, compression and linearization. It can also create links for document sharing and download, helping assemble or transform document packets within chat. File changes, deletion and shareable links have different consequences; the page does not establish every link's access restrictions or guarantee conversion fidelity for complex layouts.

plugins.overview_zh: Fr8Labs Analytics 根据已连接 FMS 回答货运、营收、成本、利润率、损益及应收应付账龄问题，无需 SQL 即可生成图表、看板和定时邮件报告。查询限定租户隔离的分析仓库，邮件只允许发往本公司域名；实际答案仍受仓库刷新时间及权限配置影响。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅连接的 Fr8Labs FMS/公司仓库，报告邮件限公司自有域名。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fr8Labs Analytics answers freight-forwarding questions about shipments, revenue, costs, margins, profit and loss, and receivables/payables aging from the connected FMS. Answers can become charts, dashboards and scheduled email reports without SQL. Queries use a tenant-isolated analytics warehouse and reports can email only the company's own domain. Warehouse refresh timing and configured access still determine what an answer represents.

plugins.overview_zh: Fragella 帮助了解香调与香气组合，并按个人偏好推荐香水，包括寻找已知香水的类似选项，适合整理试香清单。简短说明未列出库存、价格、购买操作或匹配准确度；个人喜好和皮肤反应不同，推荐不保证适合，也不是过敏评估。
plugins.requirements_zh: 推荐涉及香调/香气组合；价格、库存与过敏适用性未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fragella helps explore fragrance notes and accords and offers personalized scent recommendations, including alternatives to a fragrance the user already knows. It is useful for understanding scent profiles and narrowing a sampling list. The brief description does not specify inventory, pricing, purchase actions or objective matching accuracy; preferences and skin response vary, so a recommendation is not a promise of suitability or an allergy assessment.

plugins.overview_zh: Fraghab 管理香水正装与分装、余量、使用记录、分组、评分、笔记、叠香和愿望清单，记录喷洒量可扣减容量，也可比较商家报价。连接权限逐项批准，改写已有资料前会确认，因为会覆盖旧值；连接器不能删除内容。发布者称服务免费、不收款，修改密码会立即撤销访问。
plugins.requirements_zh: 批准连接权限，已有记录修改会覆盖且需确认；不删除、不收款，改密码撤销访问。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fraghab manages owned fragrance bottles and decants, remaining amounts, wearing history, shelves, ratings, notes, layering combinations and wishlists. Logging sprays can deduct volume, and wishlist research compares retailer offers. Connection permissions are approved separately; existing-data edits require a check because they replace prior values. The connector cannot delete anything. The publisher says the service is free, takes no payments and revokes access when the password changes.

plugins.overview_zh: Frameo 在用户工作区生成短片，组合图片、镜头、旁白、音乐和音效，再用 ffmpeg 与动态图形模板剪辑；也可导入素材、查看画布和资料库、浏览音效。消耗积分的生成会先报价并要求确认。角色一致性和成片质量属于发布者目标，并非独立实测保证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Frameo 工作区和积分，消耗积分前先估价并经用户确认。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Frameo generates short videos in the user's workspace, combining images, clips, voiceovers, music and sound effects and assembling them with ffmpeg and motion-graphics templates. It can import user media, inspect the project canvas and library, and browse a sound-effect collection. Credit-spending generation is estimated first and requires confirmation. Character consistency and finished-video quality are publisher goals, not independently tested guarantees.

plugins.overview_zh: Framework by NewForm 将公开广告资料库整理为 Ad Atlas，包含创意地图、形式占比、覆盖说明和发现。请求需验证公司邮箱，并受容量、确认及隐私同意限制；现有账户可在权限范围比较表现与创意测试。读取报告复用已保存分析，明确不能投放广告、改预算、访问 Drive 或刷新报告。
plugins.requirements_zh: Atlas 需公司邮箱验证、容量允许及隐私同意；业绩访问需账户，不投广告、改预算、读 Drive 或刷新报告。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Framework by NewForm turns public advertising-library data into an Ad Atlas with creative maps, format mixes, coverage notes and findings. Requests depend on a verified company email, capacity limits, confirmation and privacy acceptance. Existing accounts can compare performance and creative tests within their permissions. Reading a report reuses saved analysis; launching ads, changing budgets, accessing Drive and refreshing reports are explicitly unavailable.

plugins.overview_zh: Frase 支持搜索结果研究、内容制作与优化、AI 搜索可见度监测和发布流程，可分析意图、问题、竞争者及内容缺口，再安排优化优先级。正文说明了功能，但未逐项列出发布权限或套餐限制；优化建议不保证排名、被 AI 引用或流量增长。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受 Frase 工作区及发布权限限制，不保证 SEO 或 AI 可见度结果。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Frase supports search-result research, content creation and optimization, AI-search visibility monitoring and publishing workflows from the connected workspace. It can help examine intent, questions, competitors and content gaps, then prioritize improvements. The description is functional but does not enumerate every publishing permission or plan limit. Optimization recommendations do not guarantee search ranking, visibility in AI answers or traffic growth.

plugins.overview_zh: Frasma 帮助获授权团队查看项目工作、搜索关联知识，并创建、更新或移动私有看板任务，可先用项目证据调查问题再安排跟进。它包含真实项目修改，而不只是建议；操作应限于团队获授权范围，创建任务本身不代表问题已经修复。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需团队及项目知识授权，创建/修改/移动任务会改变私有看板记录。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Frasma helps authorized teams review project work, search linked project knowledge and create, update or move private Kanban tasks. It can use project evidence to investigate a reported issue before organizing follow-up work. These are operational changes to the connected project, not just suggestions; access and edits should remain within the team's authorized scope, and task creation alone does not establish that an issue has been fixed.

plugins.overview_zh: Fraud Blocker 检查单个邮箱，解释状态与细分结果、域名/MX、免费邮箱标记及纠错建议，并显示月度剩余额度。这些线索可辅助审查线索、注册或订单，但不证明个人身份或诚信；插件不会自动拦截订单、修改结账流程或处分用户。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅单邮箱检查且受月额度限制，不拦截订单、改结账或处分用户。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fraud Blocker verifies individual email addresses and explains status and sub-status, domain/MX checks, free-provider flags and suggested corrections. It can also show remaining monthly verification capacity. These signals can inform review of a lead, signup or order, but do not establish a person's honesty or identity. The plugin does not automatically block orders, change checkout flows or take action against users.

plugins.description_zh: 使用 FreakUI 构建原生 Apple 应用
plugins.overview_zh: FreakUI 辅助用共享多平台目标开发 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 原生 Swift 应用，提供依赖注入、MVVM、程序化导航、平台根视图和主题组件，并可继续调整界面模块。它属于实现辅助，不证明生成代码一定可编译、通过无障碍测试或无需开发环境与审核就能上架。

It supplies an architecture foundation with dependency injection, MVVM, programmatic navigation, platform-specific roots and themed components, with skills for evolving interface sections. These are implementation aids, not proof that generated code builds, passes accessibility tests or is ready for App Store distribution without the required development environment and review.

plugins.overview_zh: Freckle 用于构建和运行市场拓展流程，寻找公司与人员、补全缺失信息，并把结果送入团队工具，例如定位决策者和检查邮箱。流程可能包含导入及写入联系人数据，而非只看公开网页；资料可得或通过验证不等于获得营销同意，也不代表可随意跨系统分享联系人信息。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Freckle helps build and run go-to-market workflows: find companies and people, enrich missing information and deliver results to the team's connected tools. Examples include locating relevant decision-makers and checking email addresses. This can involve importing and writing contact data, not merely searching public pages. Data availability and validation do not themselves establish consent for outreach or permission to distribute prospect information across systems.

plugins.overview_zh: freddy 连接手环、戒指、连续血糖监测和训练平台等已有健康资料，让睡眠、恢复、心率、活动和锻炼问题基于个人记录回答。发布者介绍跨设备同步与标准化及可撤销访问，但测量不替代临床解读，隐私承诺未独立审计。索引版本出现 2.0.0 与 3.0.0 冲突，不能确定最新发行版。

plugins.description_zh: 创建马拉地语个人资料
plugins.overview_zh: Free Marathi Biodata Maker 将提供的个人、教育、家庭及星盘资料整理为马拉地语或英语婚配简历 PDF，可选十一种传统模板或同时比较多种设计。发布者称免费且无需登录。生成可分享文件不等于已经发给任何人；分享前应核对准确性，并考虑是否包含过多个人或家庭信息。

Users can select from eleven traditional templates or generate several layouts for comparison. The publisher describes free use without login. A ready-to-share PDF is not automatically sent to anyone; review its accuracy and consider how much personal or family information should be included before sharing.

It does not establish automatic filing, a binding tax determination or professional representation; the applicable tax year, jurisdiction and evidence should be checked before relying on a deduction.

plugins.overview_zh: FREETOUR.com 按目的地、日期、语言、价格、评分和类型寻找步行团、导览、体验、一日游及景点门票，比较库存、时间、集合点、评价和价格，并介绍预订流程。所谓免费步行团通常依靠小费，不代表全程零成本；预订前应核对具体包含项目、集合要求、总价及取消条件。

It supports comparison of availability, schedules, meeting points, reviews and prices and describes a booking workflow. Free walking tours are tip-based, not necessarily cost-free experiences. It can track expenses and summarize spending by currency while providing destination inspiration. Planning a hotel check-in or flight entry does not create a supplier reservation; this is itinerary and expense organization, with real edits and deletion inside Fridey.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Frigade Engage supplies skills for product onboarding in React or Next.js, including tours, checklists, announcements, forms, surveys and flow collections. Workflows cover content, targeting, versions and development-to-production promotion. Actual operations need an account, securely configured API credentials and an execution environment with project and network access; chat-only use prepares drafts and guidance. It defaults to development and preserves production and destructive-action safeguards.

plugins.description_zh: 发现鬼屋等惊悚体验景点
plugins.overview_zh: FrightMaps 按城市、州或邮编寻找鬼屋、社区庭院布置、慈善活动及主题步道，显示照片、时间、路线、热度和是否免费，售票项目可从条目进入购买。社区覆盖和宣传不保证营业时间、适合程度或安全；出行前应向主办方核对日期、年龄限制和条件。

Listings can show photos, hours, directions, trends and whether an attraction is free; ticketed attractions link to purchasing from the listing. Community coverage and promotional claims are not guarantees of operating hours, suitability or safety. Verify dates, age restrictions and conditions with the organizer before traveling.

plugins.overview_zh: Frip 寻找韩国各地体验，包括一日课程、爱好、社交聚会、美食手作、健康和户外活动，可按兴趣、地点及预算筛选，发布者介绍发现与预订功能。库存、授课语言、参与条件及取消规则取决于具体提供方；查看推荐不代表已预留名额。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Frip discovers local experiences across Korea, including one-day classes, hobbies, social gatherings, food or craft activities, wellness and outdoor trips. Actual availability, language, participation requirements and cancellation terms depend on the individual provider; browsing a recommendation is not proof that a seat has been reserved.

plugins.overview_zh: Fritto Time Tracker 按项目和客户记录每日工时、提交工时表并生成报告，经理可批准、拒绝记录及锁定历史期间，支持代理公司或多团队租户。记录和审批属于实际流程修改而非被动分析；需核对角色及机构，审批也不独立证明填报工时真实发生。
