Managers can approve or reject entries and lock past periods, with multi-tenant support for agencies or multiple teams. Logging and approval are actual workflow changes rather than passive analytics; role permissions and the selected organization matter, and approval does not independently verify that reported hours were worked.

plugins.description_zh: 发送文档以进行电子签名
plugins.overview_zh: Frondy 可添加文件、放置签名与日期字段，通过邮件、短信、WhatsApp 或链接发送，并跟踪和提醒签署者，也支持英/希伯来语模板、联系人及文件夹。每次签署请求先汇总再确认，需付费套餐并遵守账户权限；不能删除这些记录、购买、修改账单/管理设置或读取国家证件号及密码。

It focuses on contracts, deterministic control boundaries, independent verification, runtime health and optional evidence receipts while keeping the coding assistant outside the deployed runtime. The description is explicitly developer- and Codex-oriented, not a general in-chat management service. Architectural safeguards and evidence receipts do not by themselves certify security or compliance.

plugins.overview_zh: Frontify 搜索品牌指南、素材和模板，并可基于批准模板生成创意；也能上传文件、整理文件夹或集合、添加元数据及进入审核流程。操作会改变品牌资料库或提交审核；使用获批模板不代表新素材自动获批，也不证明拥有所有上传内容的权利。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受 Frontify 访问与审核权限限制，上传及流程流转会改变品牌资料。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Frontify searches brand guidelines, assets and templates and can generate creative from approved templates. It also uploads files, organizes folders or collections, applies metadata and routes assets through review workflows from ChatGPT or Codex. These capabilities can change the brand repository and submit material for review; using an approved template does not automatically approve every new asset or establish rights to all uploaded content.

plugins.overview_zh: Fryd 从园艺数据库检索植物品种、伴生兼容性、逐月播种收获建议及专家种植计划，帮助规划菜园或比较搭配。数据库建议不保证产量，仍需考虑当地气候、生长条件、季节与品种；页面未证明可自动灌溉、购买或监控花园。
plugins.requirements_zh: 园艺建议需按当地气候、季节和条件调整，不保证产量。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fryd searches its gardening database for plant varieties, companion-planting compatibility, monthly sowing and harvest guidance and expert planting plans. It can help organize a vegetable garden or compare plant combinations. Results are database guidance rather than a guarantee of yield; local climate, growing conditions, season and cultivar matter, and the listing does not establish automatic irrigation, purchasing or garden monitoring.

plugins.description_en: Talk to users. Build the thing
plugins.overview_zh: fstack 将创始人工作分流为业务运营和工程技能，涵盖线索、客服、社交内容、策略、竞品及工程方法；支持循环先诊断客户问题、构造失败测试与修复，再起草用户可发送的回复。跨宿主兼容是发布者声明；真实运行代码或对外沟通仍需相应环境和授权，不能只凭技能名推断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 可执行动作取决于宿主工具及权限；支持循环包含回复草稿，不自动授权发送。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: fstack routes founder work between business operations and engineering skills. It covers leads, support, social content, strategy and competitive analysis alongside engineering playbooks. Its support loop investigates a customer issue, develops a failing test and fix, then drafts a reply the user can send. Host compatibility is a publisher claim; real code execution and external communication depend on the available environment and authorization, not the skill name alone.

plugins.description_zh: 连接富果投资平台，管理关注清单、投资笔记、到价提醒和市场信息
plugins.description_en: 串接富果投資平台，管理您的追蹤清單、投資筆記、到價提醒和市場
plugins.overview_zh: Fugle-Stock 连接富果平台，管理追踪股票、投资笔记与到价提醒，并读取市场分析和研究报告，适合组织研究及监测。发布者明确表示资料仅供参考，不提供投资建议；正文未证明支持交易下单、保证提醒时效或带来收益。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需富果连接，资料明确仅供参考，不是投资建议或交易执行。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fugle-Stock connects the Fugle investment platform for managing tracked stocks, investment notes and price alerts and reading market analysis or research content. It helps organize research and monitoring from conversation rather than promising investment decisions. The publisher explicitly states that information is for reference and not investment advice; the description does not establish trade placement, guaranteed alert timing or profitable outcomes.

plugins.description_zh: 呈现富士风格的照片效果
plugins.overview_zh: Fuji X100VI Look Emulator 指导图片朝富士风格色彩和对比度调整，同时保留场景、构图与主体。它是工作流技能，不是经独立验证色彩科学的相机模拟器；转换依赖宿主图像工具，不能推断所有宿主都能编辑，也不保证复现真实机内成像。
plugins.requirements_zh: 转换需宿主图像工具，风格参考不保证精确模拟相机或色彩科学。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fuji X100VI Look Emulator guides image editing toward a Fuji-inspired color and contrast treatment while preserving the scene, composition and subject. It is a workflow skill rather than a camera simulator with independently verified color science. Image transformation depends on the host's image tools, so the listing does not establish that every host can edit an image or reproduce an authentic in-camera Fujifilm result.

plugins.description_zh: 查找 B2B 联系人和公司
plugins.overview_zh: FullEnrich 搜索 B2B 人员和公司，补全邮箱、电话并建立潜客名单。发布者称联系资料经过验证，但这不代表绝对准确、永久有效或已获对方联络许可。简短正文未列出套餐积分、地区覆盖、导出上限或后续销售触达的同意要求。
plugins.requirements_zh: 套餐/积分范围未说明，验证联系人不代表营销同意或绝对时效。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FullEnrich searches for B2B people and companies, enriches prospects with email and phone information and builds prospect lists in conversation. The publisher calls contact details verified, but verification should not be read as perfect accuracy, perpetual freshness or permission to contact someone. The short description does not specify plan credits, geographic coverage, export limits or consent requirements for downstream sales outreach.

plugins.overview_zh: Fullmetrix 查询机构所有活跃网店的订单、销售总额、净营收、税、运费、商品量及独立/新/回头客户，按日期、门店、国家、客户类型或订单状态分组，并采用机构营收规则。多机构账户可指定目标；比较需保持定义与连接数据一致，不等于已审计财报。
plugins.requirements_zh: 使用已连接活跃门店及机构营收规则，需选对机构并统一定义。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fullmetrix answers ecommerce questions about orders, gross sales, net revenue, tax, shipping, units and unique, new or returning customers across an organization's active stores. Results can be grouped by date, store, country, customer type or order status, with the organization's revenue rules applied. Multi-organization accounts can choose a target. Comparisons need consistent definitions and connected data; this is not proof of audited financial statements.

plugins.description_zh: 将任务单推进为已审查的 PR
面向智能体的产品分析
plugins.overview_zh: Fullstory 连接产品行为数据，可建立并保存用户分组和指标、计算趋势与维度拆分、检查漏斗，以及读取数字背后的会话和事件。会话回放与挫败信号帮助排查转化和错误，但保存分组会改变共享分析；自动采集受配置与数据可用性限制，观察到模式并非自动证明因果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需配置行为采集和账户访问；保存分组/指标改变共享分析，会话可能含敏感资料。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fullstory connects product behavioral data to conversational analytics: build and save segments or metrics, compute trends and breakdowns, inspect funnels and retrieve sessions and events behind a number. Session replay and frustration signals can help investigate conversion changes and errors. Saving segments affects shared analytics, and autocapture only covers configured, available data; observing a pattern is evidence for investigation, not automatic proof of causality.

plugins.description_zh: 创建 SEO 和 AEO 文章
plugins.overview_zh: Fully SEO Optimized Articles 制作面向 SEO、答案引擎和生成式引擎的研究型内容，包括 FAQ、链接、元数据、结构化标记及配图计划，可组织文章或内容方案。名称属于宣传，成稿仍需事实、权利与实现检查，不保证排名、流量或被 AI 答案收录。
plugins.requirements_zh: 内容技能不保证排名或答案收录；发布前审核事实、链接、结构化标记及权利。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fully SEO Optimized Articles prepares research-based SEO, answer-engine and generative-engine content, including FAQs, links, metadata, schema and image plans. It can help assemble an article or content plan rather than merely produce a headline. The skill's name is promotional: content still needs fact-checking, rights review and implementation checks, and no ranking, traffic or AI-answer inclusion outcome is guaranteed.

plugins.overview_zh: FunkyJobs 按关键词、地点半径、工作比例、行业和发布日期搜索瑞士全职、兼职、副业及假期岗位，显示雇主、地点、工时比例和原链接，单条详情可含摘要及已公布薪资。无需账户，未公布薪资不应猜测；结果不证明岗位仍开放、移民资格或已经投递申请。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需账户，仅在职位提供时显示薪资；库存与申请人资格仍待核实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FunkyJobs searches Swiss full-time, part-time, side and holiday jobs by keyword, location radius, workload, field and publication date. Results show the employer, location, workload and source link; individual listings can include an excerpt and salary when stated. No account is required. A missing salary is not inferred, and search results do not establish current vacancy availability, immigration eligibility or a completed application.

plugins.overview_zh: FunkyTime 可查看客户和项目、记录工时、管理计时器及相关费用，并汇总时间与计费情况，帮助理解项目投入。它操作账户记录，并非自动核实的工资系统；小时与费用仍需审核，正文未证明能发送发票、收款或保证税务合规。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受连接账户及记录权限限制，工时/费用记录不是收款或核实工资服务。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FunkyTime supports inspecting clients and projects, recording work time, controlling timers, managing related expenses and reviewing time or billing summaries. It can combine duration and expense records to understand project effort. These are account operations rather than an automatically verified payroll system; recorded costs and hours should be checked, and the listing does not establish invoice delivery, payment collection or tax compliance.

plugins.overview_zh: Funlearny 从主题或教案生成一至二十道选择题，每题二至四个选项、一个正确答案，可审阅、简化和翻译。保存须打开 Funlearny 预览、登录并点击 Save，保留为私有草稿，绝不自动发布。面向教师及成年内容创作者，仍需检查知识准确与学生适用性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 一至二十题、二至四选项、一个正确答案；预览登录后点 Save 保存私有草稿，绝不自动发布。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Funlearny creates multiple-choice quizzes from a topic or lesson notes, with one to twenty questions, two to four options and one correct answer each. Users can review, simplify or translate them. Saving requires opening the Funlearny preview, signing in and selecting Save, which keeps a private draft; quizzes are never automatically published. It targets teachers and adult content creators, who should verify educational accuracy and suitability.

plugins.overview_zh: Funnel 汇集已连接广告、分析、电商和 CRM 的营销数据及业务定义，可比较花费、CPA、ROAS、营收、预算进度和商机贡献。连接器数量多不代表所有来源已接入或可直接比较，结果受权限、刷新周期、归因与语义定义影响；正文证明的是分析，不是自动改广告预算。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅访问已连接来源和定义语义，刷新及归因影响跨渠道比较。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Funnel brings connected marketing data and business definitions into conversation across advertising, analytics, ecommerce and CRM platforms. It supports comparisons of spend, CPA, ROAS, revenue, budget pacing and pipeline contribution. Broad connector coverage does not mean every source is already connected or directly comparable; permissions, refresh schedules, attribution rules and semantic definitions shape the results. The description establishes analysis, not automatic campaign-budget changes.

plugins.overview_zh: Funnel Conversion Worksheet 根据明确提供的同批用户有序人数计算相邻及整体转化、流失；下游人数不得增加，分母为零不返回百分比。计算临时进行，不建账户记录、不外查、发送、交易或调用付费模型；独立网站支持本地计算及审核导出 CSV/JSON，不自动采集事件或分析因果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需有序且不递增的同批人数，零分母不出百分比；请求≤128 KiB、结果≤256 KiB，另有字段/条数限制。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Funnel Conversion Worksheet calculates adjacent-stage and overall conversion and drop-off from explicitly supplied ordered cohort counts. Counts cannot rise downstream, and a zero denominator yields no percentage. Computation is transient with no account records, external retrieval, sending, transactions or paid model calls. A separate website supports local computation and reviewed CSV/JSON export; this is arithmetic on supplied counts, not automatic event tracking or causal funnel analysis.

plugins.overview_zh: FunNow 按位置、口味与场合寻找亚洲受支持城市的餐厅和订位，强调临时空位与优惠，覆盖台湾、日本、香港、泰国、马来西亚、新加坡及菲律宾等市场。库存优惠随时变化；预订前需核对门店、人数、预付承诺、取消规则及确认结果，推荐不等于已订位。
plugins.requirements_zh: 限受支持亚洲城市及实时库存，最终费用、取消和确认需核对。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FunNow finds restaurants and reservations across supported Asian cities using location, tastes and occasion. It emphasizes last-minute availability and offers, covering markets including Taiwan, Japan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines. Search can help narrow dining options, but inventory and discounts are time-sensitive. Before booking, check the actual venue, party size, prepaid commitment, cancellation rules and confirmation rather than assuming a recommendation is a reservation.

plugins.overview_zh: Furgonetka 查询用户账户关联的已订或已寄包裹、跟踪和监控列表、单个包裹详情及可用承运商，便于快速了解快递记录。正文范围是信息访问，未证明可创建面单、购买邮资、修改地址，也不保证跟踪记录就是包裹当前精确位置。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Furgonetka 账户关联货运访问；说明仅建立查询，不代表买面单或改配送。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Furgonetka retrieves shipment information associated with the user's account, including ordered or dispatched parcels, tracked or monitored shipments, details of a particular package and available carriers. It provides quick access to courier-service records in conversation. The described scope is information access; it does not establish creating labels, purchasing postage, changing delivery addresses or guaranteeing that tracking data reflects the parcel's exact current position.

plugins.overview_zh: Further 根据已连接基金管理数据回答基金及载体表现、资本催缴、分配、投资组合、回报、银行对账、总账和试算平衡等问题，辅助细查 LP 基金业务记录。能查询不代表有权转账、发起催缴或作投资决策；仍需注意权限、数据时效及专业会计解读。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Further 基金连接，查询财务记录不授权转移资产或作出承诺。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Further answers questions from connected fund-administration data, including fund and vehicle performance, capital calls, distributions, portfolio holdings, returns, bank reconciliation, general ledger and trial balances. It can support detailed operational analysis of the user's LP fund records. Querying these records is not authority to move funds, issue a capital call or make investment decisions; permissions, data currency and professional accounting interpretation remain important.

plugins.overview_zh: Futrumi 提供署名评论家、厨师、侍酒师及美食记者已发布的捷克餐饮推荐，保留捷克语原话、场所信息和应用链接。主要覆盖布拉格、布尔诺且仅限捷克，境外明确无推荐。匿名只读，无需账户或密钥；专家偏好不保证空位或订位，营业时间仍需核实。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅捷克，主要布拉格/布尔诺；匿名只读，无需账户/密钥；专家原话保留捷克语，可另译。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Futrumi supplies published Czech dining recommendations from named critics, chefs, sommeliers and food journalists, retaining each expert's Czech quote with venue details and an app link. Coverage focuses on Prague and Brno and stays within Czechia; unsupported countries return no recommendations. It is anonymous, read-only and needs no account or API key. Expert preference is not an availability or booking guarantee, so check current opening hours.

plugins.description_zh: 定时发布社交媒体帖子
plugins.overview_zh: Fuxux 连接已绑定社交账户，起草、排期、发布、编辑或删除帖子，并查看队列、已发内容和失败原因。虽然支持多平台，但仅限 Fuxux 已连接账户及套餐额度，不能改账单、密码、套餐或社交连接。草稿、排期和立即发布是不同操作，上线前需确认受众与时间。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅 Fuxux 已绑定账户及套餐额度，不改账单、密码或连接账户；可在连接应用处撤销。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fuxux connects previously linked social accounts to draft, schedule, publish, edit or delete posts and inspect queues, published items and failures. It supports many networks, but only accounts already connected in Fuxux and within the user's plan. The integration cannot change billing, passwords, plans or social-account connections. Drafting, scheduling and immediate publishing are different external actions; check audience and timing before a post goes live.

plugins.overview_zh: FX Hedge 展示 C8 定量外汇模型，按基准币种和敞口提供对冲比率及宏观、趋势、利差、价值信号，并可结合欧洲央行参考价逐月分析。它仅供分析决策支持，发布者明确排除投资建议、推荐和交易执行；需 C8 订阅，以邮箱和一次性验证码登录，无需 API 密钥。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 C8 FX Hedge 订阅及邮箱/验证码登录，仅分析，不建议、推荐或交易。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: FX Hedge exposes C8's quantitative currency models, reporting hedge ratios for a base currency and exposure alongside macro, trend, carry and value signals. It can provide month-by-month analysis with ECB reference rates. It is analytics-only decision support: the publisher excludes investment advice, recommendations and transaction execution. A C8 FX Hedge subscription is required, with email and one-time-code sign-in rather than API keys.

plugins.description_zh: 通过聊天制作电影感 AI 视频
plugins.overview_zh: FXI Studio 通过用户账户生成电影风格图片与视频，选择模型并把版本保存到资料库。连续帧可连接二至八个场景描述，让下一段从上一段末帧开始，也可复用角色、查历史和积分。需账户及生成额度，衔接与画面质量不能仅凭目录介绍保证。

Frame chaining links two to eight scene descriptions by starting each clip from the previous clip's last frame. Users can reuse saved characters, inspect earlier generations and check credits. Account access and generation allowance are required; continuity and cinematic quality are not guaranteed by the catalog description.

plugins.description_zh: 在 FyneDesk 中安全工作
plugins.overview_zh: FyneDesk 搜索和查看获准工单、联系人、公司、资产、知识、日历备注、工时及工作区资料。Business 套餐中获启用用户可执行权限校验后的修改，保留正常流程约束与 AI 辅助标记。它不是无限管理权限，写入取决于角色、套餐和启用状态，不应越权访问其他记录。
plugins.requirements_zh: 读取受权限限制，写入需获启用 Business 用户并遵守流程校验及 AI 标记。

This is not unrestricted administration: the role, plan and enabled features determine which writes exist, and other users' inaccessible records should remain outside the conversation.

plugins.overview_zh: Fyrebox 在现有账户创建和管理知识、人格、评估及分支测验，编辑题目、计分、路径、品牌及线索表单，生成背景、使用模板、复制删除并查看答卷。它不仅生成草稿，还修改已存表单并可能处理个人资料；需另行检查发布设置、受访者同意及评估有效性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Fyrebox 账户，复制/删除和答卷查看涉及存储资料；检查线索收集及发布设置。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fyrebox creates and manages trivia, personality, assessment and branching quizzes in an existing account. Users can edit questions, scoring and paths, style branding and lead-capture pages, generate background images, use templates, clone or delete quizzes and review responses. It is more than draft generation: changes affect stored forms and potentially collected personal data. Publication settings, respondent consent and assessment validity require separate attention.

plugins.overview_zh: Fyxer 从既往邮件学习写作风格，并结合日历及会议笔记生成个性化邮件草稿，供用户审阅后发送。公开说明证明的是起草，不是无限自动发送或访问所有邮箱；发送前应核对收件人、背景事实和承诺，历史沟通也可能含敏感资料。
plugins.requirements_zh: 利用历史邮件及日历/会议背景起草，未证明自动发送或通用邮箱访问。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Fyxer drafts emails in the user's style by learning from prior email and using calendar or meeting-note context. Describe the intended message and it prepares wording for review and sending. The public description establishes personalized drafting, not unrestricted automatic sending or access to every mailbox. Users should check recipients, factual context and commitments before sending, and connected historical communications may contain sensitive information.

plugins.overview_zh: Gabriel Operator 通过提问构建 AI 角色，组织研究、工具、待执行动作、用户批准及执行流程，也可设计列表、管道阶段、对话文案和团队智能体协作。需 Gabriel 账户及安全连接的 Gabi token，不能把原始令牌贴入聊天。创建角色后，真实流程仍受权限和审批边界约束。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gabriel Operator builds an AI persona through questions and a workflow spanning research, tools, prepared actions, user approval and execution. It can help define lists, pipeline stages, conversation copy and team-agent coordination rather than disconnected prompt fragments. It requires a Gabriel account and a securely connected Gabi token; raw tokens must not be pasted into chat. Actual workflow permissions and approval boundaries still matter after the persona is created.

plugins.overview_zh: GadgetOS 服务单一孟加拉电子店的销售、序列号库存、保修、维修和供应商记录。店主启用后可开单、调库存、记费用/付款及更新维修，销售先确认；退款、作废和拒绝/退款保修仍在应用内受经理控制。仅已配置收据及维修就绪/交付短信可联系客户，默认关闭。金额用孟加拉塔卡，日期用达卡时区。
plugins.requirements_zh: 限单店，写入须店主启用；确认销售会影响付款库存。作废/退款及拒绝/退款保修留在经理控制内；短信默认关，不接受聊天自填号码/消息。

Owner-enabled writes can create sales, move stock, record expenses or payments and progress repairs, with sales confirmed first. Refunds, voids and rejected/refunded claims stay in-app behind manager controls. Only configured receipt and ready/delivered repair SMS can contact customers; SMS is off by default. Amounts use BDT and dates Asia/Dhaka.

plugins.overview_zh: Gainium 只读查看交易机器人工作区，包括机器人、交易记录、余额、连接交易所、策略结构、筛选器、精选预设及既有回测请求，帮助理解当前配置。它明确不能创建机器人、启动交易、下单或改账户状态；查看预设与回测不构成推荐，也不保证未来表现。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只读，不创建机器人、启动交易、下单或改账户；既有回测不证明未来收益。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gainium provides read-only inspection of a trading-bot workspace: bots, deals, balances, connected exchanges, strategy schemas, screeners, curated presets and existing backtest-request information. It helps understand what is already configured or recorded. It explicitly cannot create bots, start deals, place trades or change account state. Viewing a preset or backtest is research, not a recommendation or a promise of future performance.

plugins.description_zh: 向 AI 询问社区洞察
plugins.overview_zh: Gainsight Customer Communities 从连接社区提取未回答问题、内容缺口和互动趋势，管理员可查看审核队列、排行榜、讨论和社区结构，无需自行导出。正文支持调查与总结，查看审核队列不代表可删帖、处分成员或发布回复；信息范围仍受社区连接和权限约束。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gainsight Customer Communities surfaces unanswered questions, content gaps and engagement trends from a connected community. Managers can review moderation queues, leaderboards, discussions and community structure without preparing custom exports. The described functions support investigation and summaries; reading a moderation queue is not evidence that the app can remove content, sanction members or publish responses. Available information remains bounded by the connected community and permissions.

The Mac must remain awake and online; remote SSH uses only locally configured aliases. It is not a sandbox: operating-system permissions can allow destructive changes. Requested content travels through an authenticated relay, and device revocation stops future access. No computer was paired in this research.

plugins.overview_zh: Gangwaze 按目的地、日期、邮轮公司、船只、舱位和预算研究航次，比较可用历史价格，并提供船舱、港口、岸上活动、着装、饮品套餐及月度气候资料和来源。覆盖价格受数据限制，明确不提供预订、付款、取消或改订单；比较结果不是锁价或预留。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gangwaze researches cruises by destination, dates, line, ship, cabin and budget, with comparisons and available fare history. It also provides ship and cabin details, port guides, excursions, dress codes, beverage packages and monthly climate averages with source links. Coverage and prices depend on available data. Booking, payment, cancellation and reservation changes are explicitly absent; a useful cruise comparison is not a held fare or reservation.

plugins.description_zh: 计算车库地面涂层用量

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Garage Floor Epoxy Calculator estimates coating quantities, kits, decorative flake and DIY-versus-professional cost ranges from floor area, coating type and coats. It includes porosity/topcoat allowance and preparation or curing guidance that can flag unsuitable temperature, humidity, moisture or new concrete. Results link to supplies and local quote services. This is planning arithmetic, not an on-site inspection or a guarantee that a coating system is safe for the actual slab.

These actions affect the selected CMS space rather than merely returning a standalone draft. Access, publication state, image rights and schema requirements must be checked before changes appear on a website or app.

plugins.overview_zh: Gasti 管理个人财务记录，新增、编辑或删除收支、整理账户类别、登记已经完成的转账，并按币种、账户及类别报表。它不持有资金、不发起支付或兑换；账号/别名和卡尾号为可选元数据。发布者称启用用量分析时记录标识、工具结果状态和耗时，而非交易输入或内容。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只记已完成转账，不托管资金、支付或换汇；可选账户元数据及用量遥测需隐私审查。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gasti maintains personal finance records: add, edit or delete income and expenses, organize accounts/categories, record transfers already completed and review reports by currency, account or category. It does not hold money, initiate payments or exchange currencies. Account numbers/aliases and last four card digits are optional metadata. Enabled usage analytics record identifiers and tool outcomes/duration, not transaction inputs or results, according to the publisher.

plugins.overview_zh: Gastrosync 支持餐饮及酒店活动运营，把询盘整理为活动，并管理客户、商品、装箱清单、报价、协议、发票和报告，也可维护获批准商品库及准备运营简报。流程可能修改商务记录；生成报价或协议不等于获准发送、接受条款或代表企业承诺，财务与合同准确性仍需审核。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受酒店餐饮工作区权限限制，报价、协议及发票对外发送或承诺前需审核。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gastrosync supports catering and hospitality event operations, turning inquiries into events and managing clients, products, packing lists, offers, agreements, invoices and reports. It can maintain approved product-library information and help prepare operational briefings. These workflows can alter commercial records; generating an offer or agreement is not by itself authorization to send it, accept terms or commit the business, and accounting or contractual accuracy still requires review.

plugins.description_zh: 加密货币市场研究数据
plugins.overview_zh: Gate Info 提供公开只读加密资产资料，包括币种简介、市场快照、K 线、盘口和受支持现货及衍生市场成交。无需登录，不访问账户余额、不下单或转账；新闻社交及文档工具属于独立服务。数据仅供信息参考，应注意时间与覆盖，不是投资建议或成交价格保证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公开无认证只读数据，不查余额、不下单转账，新闻社交及文档另属服务。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gate Info offers public read-only cryptocurrency data, including coin profiles, market snapshots, candlesticks, order-book depth and trades across supported spot and derivative markets. No login is needed and it does not expose account balances, place orders or transfer funds. News/social and documentation tools belong to separate services. Treat the figures as informational market data with timestamps and coverage limits, not investment advice or an execution price guarantee.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 SSH 管理服务器
plugins.overview_zh: Gateway 连接自有 Linux 或 Windows OpenSSH 服务器，检查健康与配置、运行可审计命令和类型化管理操作、传输文件并跟踪持久任务。它支持实际运维而不只是报告状态；远程命令可能改删数据，必须核对服务器范围、凭据与具体命令，页面未证明通用沙箱或回滚保障。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅自有 OpenSSH 服务器及授权访问，管理命令和传文件可修改破坏数据，不保证通用沙箱。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gateway connects owned Linux or Windows OpenSSH servers for health and configuration inspection, auditable commands, typed administration, file transfer and durable jobs. It can support operational troubleshooting and controlled maintenance rather than just reporting status. Remote commands and administrative operations can change or delete data; server scope, credentials and the exact command must be reviewed. The public listing does not establish a universal sandbox or rollback guarantee.

plugins.description_zh: 美国进口关税和 HTS 编码
plugins.description_en: US import duty and HTS codes
plugins.overview_zh: Gateway Tariff Calculator 根据 HTS 编码和原产地估算美国进口税，叠加基础税率、适用贸易措施、政府费用及到岸总额，也可查归类与带来源的政策变化。数字是基于公布税则的规划估算，不是海关裁定；商品特性、原产地和入境时间重要，约束性结论可能需报关专业人员或正式裁定。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需正确 HTS、原产地和入境时间，数字仅规划估算，不是约束性海关裁定。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gateway Tariff Calculator estimates U.S. import duties from HTS classification and origin, combining base rates, applicable trade actions, government fees and a landed total. It also helps research classifications and dated trade-policy changes with sources. Figures are planning estimates based on the published tariff and actions, not customs rulings. Product characteristics, origin and entry timing matter, so a broker or authoritative ruling may be needed for a binding determination.

plugins.overview_zh: Gathrd 保存聊天中发现的商家商品链接，并按集合整理，支持创建集合、浏览收藏、按商家或价格筛选及查看喜爱项目，再到 Gathrd 继续查看。它属于收藏与组织流程；正文未证明实时降价提醒、锁库存、结账或保证商家链接永久有效。
plugins.requirements_zh: 保存商家链接与集合，未证明结账、预留、自动价格提醒或外链永久可用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gathrd saves retailer product links discovered in chat and organizes them into collections for later review. Users can create collections, browse saved items, filter by retailer or price and inspect favorites, then open the collection in Gathrd. It is a bookmarking and organization workflow; the description does not establish live price alerts, stock reservation, checkout or guaranteed persistence of the linked retailer page.

plugins.overview_zh: Gauntlet 按任务调整质量控制流程，可执行工作、审查改进已有结果，或构建可复用提示词，组织评审、基准、验证、压力测试、实现检查及停止条件，同时避免过度复杂化简单请求。流程辅助不证明独立评审确已运行或所有错误已消除，结果可信度仍取决于工具和证据。
plugins.requirements_zh: 评审测试执行依赖宿主工具及证据，质量流程不保证零错误。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Gauntlet adapts quality-control workflows to a task, either executing work, auditing and improving an existing result or constructing a reusable prompt. It can organize reviewers, benchmarks, validation, stress tests, implementation checks and stopping gates without overcomplicating simple requests. These are process aids, not an assurance that independent reviewers actually ran or every error was found; evidence and available tools still determine the strength of the result.

plugins.description_zh: 法律团队 AI 助手

plugins.overview_zh: GdeNaPlaninu 按目的地、类型、设施、参考价和日期搜索山地住宿，提供交互卡片、照片与视频；可准备含联系资料的房东咨询，先审核再明确确认发送。咨询不构成预订或付款，价格和可订情况必须直接向房东确认。
plugins.requirements_zh: 房东咨询含姓名、邮箱、电话及消息，明确确认后才发送；不预订付款，价与库存向房东核实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: GdeNaPlaninu searches active mountain accommodation by destination, type, amenities, indicative price and dates, with interactive cards, photos and video. It can prepare an owner inquiry containing contact details and a message, display it for review and send only after explicit confirmation. An inquiry is not a reservation or payment. Prices and availability must be confirmed directly with the owner before relying on a stay.

plugins.overview_zh: Geckoboard 从已连接 Zendesk、HubSpot、Pipedrive、Intercom、Aircall、Google Analytics 等服务提供业务指标，无需逐项导出或手算即可分析表现、变化及报告。可用性受集成配置与权限限制，仍需核对定义、时间窗和刷新时效；指标变化本身不证明原因。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需可用 Geckoboard 集成及权限，解释受指标定义、期间与新鲜度影响。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Geckoboard exposes business metrics from connected services such as Zendesk, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Aircall and Google Analytics. Users can analyze performance, investigate changes and prepare reports without exporting records or manually calculating each measure. Availability depends on configured integrations and permissions; metric definitions, time windows and freshness still need checking, and a metric change alone does not establish its cause.

plugins.overview_zh: Geekbot 将付费账户接入 Slack 或 Microsoft Teams 的异步站会、签到、状态更新、投票和问卷，可提交本人更新、创建投票、查看团队报告及总结。流程可能向同事发送信息，而非只读私人笔记；需检查工作区、受众和问卷隐私，互动指标也不能作个人定性结论。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需付费 Geekbot 套餐，Slack/Teams 提交和创建投票可联系同事，需核对范围及匿名假设。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Geekbot connects paid accounts to asynchronous standups, check-ins, status updates, polls and surveys in Slack or Microsoft Teams. It can submit the user's updates, create polls, read team reports and summarize recaps. These workflows may communicate with coworkers, not just retrieve private notes. Check workspace scope, recipients and survey privacy before creating a poll or submitting an update; engagement measurements should not be treated as definitive individual assessments.

It can help answer questions about commercial performance using the organization's own records. The short description establishes inspection rather than invoicing, collections or editing contracts. Connected permissions, data completeness and consistent accounting definitions govern how the results should be interpreted.

plugins.overview_zh: 汇集国会议员交易、联邦及国防合同、游说、流动性和基础设施变化等公开市场线索，将它们关联到股票代码并评估信号重合。还会追踪管理层过去承诺的兑现情况，并整理政策、监管或企业事件催化剂、情景分析和预测市场信息。
plugins.requirements_zh: 页面说明提供免费层级，但完整未遮盖信号、Alpha Score、催化剂雷达和提醒取决于订阅权益。公开记录分析仅供信息参考，不是投资建议；评分和预测不代表已验证结果。

It relates signals to tickers, evaluates convergence, tracks whether executives deliver on earlier commitments, and highlights approaching policy, regulatory or corporate catalysts with scenarios and prediction-market context.

plugins.description_en: See how your teams are doing
plugins.overview_zh: 用项目组合卡片和可展开的层级展示团队完成目标的信心。打开项目可查看当前分数、两周趋势、匿名反馈及阻碍或评论，便于在传统进度汇报之前发现风险；还支持从 Jira、Asana 导入事项。
plugins.requirements_zh: 连接只能看到授权者原有的 Genchi 权限范围。个人反馈保持匿名，提交渠道是 Slack 或邮件，页面未称可直接在本聊天界面提交。发布者说明不足十人的团队可免费使用。

Initiatives can also be imported from Jira and Asana.

Users can vary the design, add occasion-appropriate backgrounds or decorations, personalize with first names, download the image, or continue editing the reusable design on the service's website.

plugins.overview_zh: 为发布、事故处理、迁移、测试及重复工作编制操作手册，明确进入条件、原子步骤、预期结果、验证、恢复触发条件和最终决策负责人。草稿与就绪结构检查及持久执行记录帮助跨会话续作，避免重复已完成步骤或已消耗的授权。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Builds operational runbooks for releases, incidents, migrations, testing and repeated work. Procedures include entry signals, atomic actions, expected results, checks, recovery triggers and a final decision owner. Draft/ready structural checks and durable execution records help resume work without repeating completed steps or consumed approvals.

plugins.description_zh: 跨 AI 应用共享记忆
plugins.overview_zh: 在兼容的 AI 助手之间维护可解释的因果记忆图谱，以有类型的关系连接记忆，检索时可说明相关性、连接程度和再次激活历史。用户可追踪决策与后果、固定重要记忆、检查图谱状态或删除内容，不局限于某一家模型的记忆列表。
plugins.requirements_zh: 发布者说明支持 ChatGPT、Claude 和兼容 MCP 的模型，提供固定记忆与彻底删除。自动清理只针对未固定、被判定无关且没有因果连接的记忆。页面未说明账户条件、存储配额或价格。

Memories are linked by typed relationships, and retrieval can expose relevance, connectivity and reactivation history. Users can trace decisions and consequences, pin important memories, inspect graph health and delete stored information rather than rely on isolated vendor-specific memory lists.

plugins.overview_zh: 提供对话式猜谜游戏：用户在心中选定一个事物，Genie 根据回答调整是非题，逐步缩小范围并尝试猜中。页面同时列出配套游戏技能，适合互动娱乐，并非真正读取思想。

plugins.overview_zh: 将会议或对话录音接入转写流程，对音频进行采集、转写、摘要和整理，形成可检索记录、简明笔记及后续行动素材。示例包括概览最近一份转写稿，以及依据指定会议起草邮件或追问问题。
plugins.requirements_zh: 页面描述处理录音，但没有明确音频格式、时长上限、支持语言、账户层级或是否可发送后续消息。起草邮件的示例不能当作已支持邮件发送的证据。

Audio can be captured, transcribed, summarized and organized into searchable records, concise notes and useful follow-up material. The examples include reviewing the latest transcript and drafting an email or questions from a particular meeting.

plugins.description_zh: 符合 Genius 的内容（原文未进一步说明）
plugins.overview_zh: 围绕个人沟通档案指导网站、LinkedIn 内容、简报、社交帖文、Reels 和商业提案的创作。其 Genius Formula 方法结合 Gallup 优势、精神才能、价值观、愿景、使命、经历、受众及产品服务，形成更一致的个人表达。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公开说明和入门示例为波兰语，并包含沟通档案的建立流程。未明确支持直接发布、自动进行优势测评、保证哪些语言或具体收费。

Users supply a screenshot or describe an audio message; it suggests the next step, ready-to-copy wording and a short rationale, with course references where available. It explicitly avoids inventing prices, stock or deadlines, using a holding response when store facts are unconfirmed. This is response preparation, not a connected WhatsApp sending tool. Remove unnecessary customer details and verify store policies before copying a draft externally.

plugins.overview_zh: Hermoso AI 研究公开竞品广告、生成品牌图视频、存素材、排社交帖并分析已连接账户。付费广告审阅只读，社交发布仅按指示作用于选定账户；研究生成耗积分，广告库覆盖有限，视频声称需一至三分钟。草稿与获准排期应区分，长期投放或数据相关性不证明广告效果，使用前仍核对品牌权限。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hermoso AI researches publicly visible competitor ads, creates branded images/videos, stores assets, schedules posts and analyzes connected social or ad accounts. Paid-campaign review is read-only, while social publishing occurs only on instructed connected accounts. Research and generation use account credits; some ad libraries have sparse coverage and video renders take a stated one to three minutes. Account and brand access are required. Distinguish a creative draft from an approved schedule, and do not interpret long-running ads or performance correlations as proof of effectiveness.

The broader Hero product may join calls or write follow-ups, but this connector cannot create, modify or delete anything. A Hero account and OAuth are required. Drafting from retrieved evidence does not send an email or book a call, and transcript summaries should be checked for omissions or speaker errors before use in sales decisions.

Findings are review support, not certification of ISO, SOC 2 or GDPR compliance, and a neutral check is not evidence every issue was resolved.

These safeguards do not replace verifying the correct brand, recipient and final text. A recommendation based on previous metrics is not a growth guarantee, and a drafted reply or schedule is not evidence of successful delivery.

At partner venues it can send a reservation or real-time question to the owner and return approval, refusal or an answer; other venues are not promised that workflow. A request is not a confirmed table, and owner responses or opening hours can change. Review the venue, party details and information shared before contacting it.

获取 IT 支出洞察及合同相关情报

Correctness depends on the relevant hgraph version, accessible project context and actual tests. The description does not guarantee performance or safe migration; verify interfaces, lifetimes and runtime behavior rather than treating generated C++ or a graph diagram as a tested implementation.

plugins.overview_zh: Hidden Patterns 通过聚焦追问讨论反复出现的行为情境、可能影响、遗漏因素和下一步，适用于工作、习惯、关系和目标反思。解释明确是假设，不是医疗或心理诊断。不要把一种解读认定为他人动机事实或用户固定特质，也不具备独立事件知识、临床治疗或危机服务能力。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hidden Patterns explores recurring behaviors or situations through focused questions about context, possible influences, overlooked factors and a practical next step. It can support reflection about work, routines, relationships or goals. Its explanations are explicitly hypotheses, not medical or mental-health diagnoses. Avoid treating one interpretation as a factual account of another person's motives or a fixed trait of the user. Use the conversation to test possibilities gently; it does not establish clinical treatment, crisis support or independent knowledge of events not described.

plugins.description_zh: 图像和视频模型（原文称涵盖所有模型）
plugins.overview_zh: 据目录介绍，以想法、商品照片或参考媒体为起点，生成图像、视频和商品广告。
capabilities_zh: 从文字或参考资料生成图像及视频、探索风格并让静态图动起来
使用 Marketing Studio 制作商品宣传视觉及短广告
浏览效果和预设，使用特定创作命令
用 Genjutsu 迁移参考视频动作或替换片段中的主体
创建及调整 AI Influencer 角色作为参考
从文本生成配音并选择声音

Administrators may inspect audit history across sites and iSheets. Access is always read-only and follows existing HighQ permissions, so this connector does not change matter records or expand access. Retrieved text and audit summaries still require checking for scope and completeness; they are not independent legal conclusions, proof of misconduct or authorization to disclose confidential client material.

plugins.overview_zh: Highspot 搜索总结销售内容，回答 CRM 商机和市场问题，推荐资料并创建修改推介、Digital Rooms 与演练场景，兼有读取和写入。客户可见资源更新前需确认目标及可见性。简短完整正文未说明发送发布、价格或全部 CRM 权益，建议取决于已连资料，应核对时效和可向客户披露的范围。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Highspot searches and summarizes sales content, answers CRM/deal and go-to-market questions, recommends material and creates or updates pitches, Digital Rooms and roleplay scenarios. It therefore combines information retrieval with content mutation. Confirm the intended resource and visibility before updates, particularly when a room or pitch could be customer-facing. The brief complete description does not specify sending, publishing, pricing or every CRM entitlement. Recommendations depend on the connected content and should be checked for currency and permitted customer disclosure.

plugins.overview_zh: Hill Monitor 查询加拿大议会政府资料，包括辩论、委员会、法案、公报、命令及公开政治帖子、工作人员信息。登录用户可查看关键词提醒命中或创建提醒。摘要不是已生效法律原文，也不保证全部发言覆盖；设置提醒与收到通知不同，应确认范围和服务回执，不能默认持续监控及特定渠道。

Signed-in users can view phrase alerts and recent hits or create alerts. Search coverage and source freshness matter: a summary is not the enacted legal text or a complete record of every statement. Creating an alert is distinct from receiving one; verify its scope and service confirmation rather than assuming continuous monitoring or a guaranteed delivery channel.

plugins.overview_zh: Hilton Hotel Search 按地点找希尔顿酒店、比较住宿价格和详情，再进入希尔顿预订流程，是品牌专属查询而非所有酒店比价。正文未证明聊天内能支付退改。现金积分库存、税费、度假费及房价规则须按日期核对，显示选项不是保留房间或保证可兑换。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hilton Hotel Search finds Hilton properties by location, compares stay prices and opens hotel details before passing the user into Hilton's booking flow. It is a brand-specific discovery tool rather than a comparison of every hotel chain. The public body does not establish payment, cancellation or booking changes inside chat. Cash or points availability, taxes, resort fees and rate rules must be verified for the selected dates and offer; a displayed option is not a held room or a guaranteed award redemption.

plugins.description_zh: 更多匹配，更合适的匹配
plugins.overview_zh: Hinge Profile Optimiser 依据截图、照片选择、访谈与提示文案帮助打造真实有特色的交友档案，也可审阅设置和辅助实施。它不自动连接 Hinge 或授权改公开档案、发送消息和修图。建议应保留真实身份声音、尊重照片中他人隐私，不虚构特质；更多更好匹配只是目标，非保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hinge Profile Optimiser uses supplied screenshots, photo selection, conversation and prompt-writing to build a more distinctive, honest dating profile, with settings review and implementation support. It does not inherently connect to the user's Hinge account or authorize public changes, messaging or image manipulation. Suggestions should preserve the person's real identity and voice, respect the privacy of anyone in photos and avoid invented traits. More or better matches are an aspiration, not a guaranteed outcome from the published workflow.

plugins.description_zh: 通过聊天开展技术招聘
plugins.overview_zh: Hireinator 查看技术招聘队列、答题、AI 评分理由、代码和作业讨论，提供诚信信号供人审阅，可比较申请人、起草测试、邀请、换阶段和记录决定，邮件与改动前确认并遵循角色权限。分数或诚信信号不证明不诚实或适任，重大聘用需授权人工按相关公平标准决定，不能使用敏感特征或无据推断。

It can compare applicants, draft tests, invite candidates, move stages and record decisions, with confirmation before email or changes. Access follows the recruiter's role. Scores and integrity signals are evidence to inspect, not proof of dishonesty or suitability; consequential hiring decisions require authorized human judgment and relevant, fair criteria. A confirmation safeguard does not justify using sensitive traits or unsupported inferences.

plugins.overview_zh: HireOtto 用获准 OAuth 和 Google Ads API 查表现、关键词、审计，并改活动、广告、预算、竞价和转化设置，也取 Search Console 报告。部分操作耗积分或生成会定期删除的临时 CSV。写入可能花钱或改变测量，需核对范围预算设置；服务独立于 Google，使用官方 API 不等于背书或全部账户授权。

It also reads connected Search Console reports. Some operations consume HireOtto credits or produce temporary CSV exports that are later deleted. Ad writes can spend money or change measurement, so verify scope, budget and settings rather than treating them as analytics. The service is independent of Google; API usage does not imply Google endorsement or permission for every account.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索 HireSeeker 职位空缺
plugins.overview_zh: HireSeeker 用俄语引导搜索当前职位，按支持的职业、工作方式、国家城市、薪资区间和发布时间筛选，明确标缺失并给详情链接。搜索免注册，联系方式受来源权限控制。明确不支持精确薪资门槛、职级和自由文本；不能把精确要求静默近似成粗筛，申请前应核对原岗位。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HireSeeker searches current listings with Russian guidance, using supported profession categories and filters for work format, country, city, salary range and recency. It labels missing details and links to available employer, duties and conditions. Search needs no registration, but website contact access depends on source permissions. Exact salary thresholds, seniority filtering and free-text search are explicitly unsupported. Do not silently translate a user's precise requirement into a supported coarse filter; explain the mismatch and verify the actual posting before applying.

plugins.description_zh: 雇用拉丁美洲远程人才

plugins.overview_zh: Hirevire 读取岗位、录制回答、转录和评分卡，可汇总、调整招聘阶段和改岗位。连接可选只读或读写，团队仅见分配岗位；阶段变更可附预设邮件，不支持任意消息、删岗位申请或改账单。需账户，招聘判断应公平核对证据；AI 比较不是定论，换阶段可能向真人传达实际决定。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hirevire connects jobs, recorded interview answers, transcripts and scorecards, supporting summaries, stage changes and job-posting edits. The user chooses read-only or read/write, and team members see only assigned jobs. Configured stage emails may be sent with a stage change, but arbitrary candidate messages, job/application deletion and billing changes are unsupported. A Hirevire account is required. Review hiring criteria and candidate evidence fairly; a transcript or AI comparison is not a definitive assessment, and stage changes can communicate real decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: HiringCafe Job Search 按职位技能、地点、薪资、工作场所、雇佣类型和日期找公开职位，给描述链接或卡片。匿名严格只读，不申请、不收藏、不改账户，需到 HiringCafe 继续。活跃状态可能变化，缺薪资地点不能编造；发送简历前核实雇主当前岗位和资格，筛中不等于录用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HiringCafe Job Search finds active public vacancies using titles, skills, location, salary, workplace/employment type and posting date, with descriptions, application links or cards. It is anonymous and strictly read-only: no submitting applications, saving jobs or modifying accounts. Users continue to HiringCafe to apply. A result described as active may change, and missing salary or location detail should not be invented. Confirm the employer's current listing and eligibility before sending a resume or treating a filtered match as an offer.

plugins.overview_zh: HisabWala 用十进制核对明细总额，审阅后生成收据、发票或估价 PDF 图片，限二十项八币种，税额由用户给，收据需确认全额付款。测试版只支持可打印 ASCII，图片识别依赖宿主且须复核。私密分享链接十分钟失效可撤销；不收款连银行、存云历史或发消息，不能把未付款包装成已付。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HisabWala calculates itemized totals with decimal arithmetic and, after review, creates receipt/invoice/estimate PDFs and images. It supports twenty items and eight currencies; tax is user-supplied, and a receipt requires full-payment confirmation. Beta text is printable ASCII only, and host photo extraction needs review. Secret shareable links expire after ten minutes and can be revoked. It does not collect payments, connect banks, keep cloud history, send messages or provide tax advice; generated paperwork must not imply an unpaid amount was paid.

plugins.description_zh: 根据车牌查询汽车数据
plugins.overview_zh: Historial de Vehiculos España 用西班牙车牌查品牌型号、年份、燃料、排量功率等基础资料，宣传免费且源自官方。完整车主、年检、里程、负担、盗损和估值需跳到付费报告。基础结果不是清白历史或道路安全合格证明，不能推断未取得的付费字段；应核对报告条件和车牌资料的使用目的。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Historial de Vehiculos España looks up basic Spanish-registered vehicle attributes from a registration plate, including make, model, year, fuel, displacement and power, advertised as free and sourced from official data. Detailed ownership, inspection, mileage, liens, theft/damage and valuation are instead linked to a premium report on the provider's website. A basic result is not a clean-history certificate or proof of roadworthiness. Verify report terms and permitted use of registration data, and do not infer paid-report facts from the free lookup.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HITCLICKS Marketing Assistant guides creation of inquiry-focused posts, ads, posters, video ideas, Google Flow concepts and product-to-model or lifestyle imagery. It is a creative skill, not evidence of connected ad-account publishing or an automatic stream of leads. Image generation depends on host capabilities and legitimate source assets. Realistic-looking outputs must not falsely imply a real endorsement, customer or product feature. Review factual claims, rights and brand fit before distribution; creating a concept is distinct from executing a campaign.

The sampled instrument is not a physical piano, and broader repertoire or automated technique assessment is not established.

plugins.overview_zh: Hiver 读取 Gmail 共享收件箱对话、成员标签和 SLA，可加团队内部笔记、改标签、存回复草稿，管理员另可查支持表现报告。操作用本人权限并归属本人；应用本身从不向客户发送，草稿由同事审阅发送。内部笔记仍向团队披露，情绪工作量统计需结合情境，不是员工表现定论。

Internal notes still disclose information to the team, and sentiment or workload summaries require context rather than being treated as objective judgments of staff.

plugins.overview_zh: Hjarni Notes 通过 MCP 管理 Markdown 笔记、文件夹和标签，可搜索创建修改并共享团队文件夹。文件夹写作偏好可指导格式，但存储内容不能凌驾用户权限。共享会让获准团队看到内容，需确认范围；宣传的持续记忆不意味着每段对话自动加载保存，实际持久性依赖写入、访问及宿主调用。

Shared folders expose content to the permitted team, so confirm scope before sharing. The page's broad claims about universal memory should not imply every conversation is automatically loaded or saved; persistence depends on actual writes, access and the host's use of the service.

plugins.overview_zh: HMY Yacht Sales 查 HMY.com 公开游艇，默认可能包含其他经纪商，可限定 HMY，筛条件看规格照片及公开联系信息。明确不能约看、发消息、报价、改库存、付款买船。价格库存需经纪人确认，挂牌不是独立检验、产权或估值，适合初筛而非证明船况或形成交易承诺。

A listing is not an independent survey, title check or valuation, so use it to shortlist options rather than as proof of condition or a binding transaction offer.

The short body does not establish domain verification, access controls, hosting limits, pricing or how deletion works. Claims of instant, setup-free publishing should not be treated as guarantees for every content type or account.

plugins.overview_zh: Hobbes 审阅产品演示代理、脚本版本、对话和互动，支持教练建议与个性链接。账户按组织授权，改代理、教练、发布和个性链接需管理员；草稿、知识批准和上线分开，上线经确认与对话测试。不能外联、改 CRM 或付款。漏斗信号不证明客户意图，应只发布确切审阅版本。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hobbes reviews product-demo agents, playbooks, versions, conversations and engagement, with coaching and personalized links. Existing accounts are organization-scoped; agent edits, coaching, publishing and personalized links require an organization admin. Draft edits, knowledge approvals and production publication are separate, with confirmation and conversation tests for the approved version. It cannot send outreach, change CRM records or process payment. Funnel signals can guide investigation but do not prove a prospect's intent; publishing should target the exact reviewed version.

plugins.description_zh: 冰球比赛、技术统计、球员与冰上赛事应用

It is a fan-information interface, not a guarantee of complete historical coverage or zero-latency scoring. The extensive public description does not identify a data provider, exact refresh interval or licensing scope. Check timestamps and official schedules for postponed games or disputed statistics, and avoid assuming that player comparisons represent predictive models or that the app supports wagers or transactions.

plugins.description_zh: 运营你的 HOJA 工作区

Permissions mirror the account, with writes disabled by default and enabled per connection. Reversible requested edits may run directly, while deletion, approval or publication needs confirmation. Payroll finalization, payment execution, refunds and permission changes are never executed here; users are linked to the HOJA screen. Check the intended record and side effects even for an easy-to-undo change, and do not infer broader authority from a connected workspace.

plugins.overview_zh: HoldsUp 将播客健康科学说法与研究比较，给结论、确定性、证据级别、PubMed 和撤稿信息，新核查用 PubMed/OpenAlex，声称二十至七十秒。需邮箱登录及预付积分，一分对应一积分，读/搜/实时核查列为 1/2/30 积分，未经计费实测。摘要非医疗意见，付费前看费用，结论回查研究情境。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HoldsUp compares health/science podcast claims with published studies, reporting a verdict, certainty, evidence level, PubMed references and retraction information. New checks use PubMed/OpenAlex; the stated runtime is 20–70 seconds. Email sign-in and prepaid credits are required: one credit equals one cent, with published read/search/live-check costs of 1/2/30 credits. These are vendor-listed rates, not independently tested billing. Summaries can be incomplete and are not medical advice; inspect studies and context, and review cost before requesting paid verification.

plugins.description_zh: 通过租车节省费用并探索目的地

It does not detail specific search filters, payment, reservation changes or cancellation tools, so those should not be added merely from the brand's wider business. Claims of the best car and price are promotional, not independently verified comparisons. Use returned offers as leads and compare total fees, deposit, insurance, driver eligibility and cancellation terms with the actual rental provider before treating an option as bookable.

plugins.overview_zh: Holiday Planner Assistant 是预算导向行程规划技能，权衡费用与舒适，完整正文未证明实时票价、酒店库存、预订付款或自动监控。方案依赖宿主可用信息工具，费用需实时核对。可比较目的地和安排顺序，但最低预算不保证交通住宿、签证活动均能按总价落实。

Its complete body does not establish live fare searches, hotel inventory, booking, payments or automatic monitoring. Plans depend on the information and tools available in the host, and cost estimates need current verification before committing. It can help compare destinations or sequence a trip, but the lowest suggested budget is not a guarantee that transport, lodging, visas and activities will all be available at that total.

plugins.overview_zh: Hologrow 对已连电商、广告、分析和 ERP 做只读比较、调查变化和报告，涵盖已授权的 Amazon、Google、Meta 等。明确不改广告、商品、订单或店铺设置，覆盖由连接权限决定。跨平台差异可能来自归因、时区、退货或币种口径，不必然是业务原因，应先检查底层和假设。

It supports comparisons, change investigation and reports but explicitly does not modify ads, listings, orders or store settings. Source connection and permissions determine coverage. plugins.overview_zh: Home 查英国买卖租赁房源，比较收藏、补充可匹配地址信息、通勤和看房路线，查询计算免账户。不能估价挂牌、联系中介、预测房价或判房贷资格。税贷估算基于输入，印花税仅英格兰北爱；通勤非实时、状态为快照。环境学校犯罪资料应回查来源，不能当作特定住户或区域保证。

No account is needed for searches or calculators. It cannot value or list homes, contact agents, predict prices or decide mortgage eligibility. Mortgage/tax estimates use supplied figures, and stamp duty covers England/Northern Ireland only. Commute times are typical, not live traffic, and statuses are snapshots. Property risks, schools or crime context must be checked from their sources rather than treated as guarantees about a household or neighborhood.

Crucially, this published phase is backed entirely by the deterministic synthetic review-demo-node fixture, not a real private-network node. Real-node OAuth connection is described as a future phase, not current capability. All operations are read-only and cannot write, execute or reach private networks. Treat returned status as demonstration evidence, never as proof that the user's machine, repository or production task is online or progressing.

plugins.description_zh: 为新入职员工安排公寓搬迁
plugins.overview_zh: HomeBase Services 帮新员工迁往达拉斯、休斯顿或奥斯汀，比较街区、读核准指南、按预算找公寓，以办公室和到岗频率讨论通勤。租金是存储的起价，不是实时库存。只读且不约看、付款申请或查客户记录；资格解答不等于房东批准，须核对空房费用、筛选及实际通勤。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HomeBase Services helps new hires relocating to Dallas, Houston or Austin compare neighborhoods, read approved guidance and find apartments by budget. Employer/office location and office-day patterns inform commute discussion. Rent figures are stored starting-price references, not live inventory. The connector is read-only and cannot book tours, accept payments, submit applications or access customer records. Guidance about qualification is not a landlord decision; verify current availability, full fees, screening criteria and an actual commute before choosing or applying for housing.

plugins.description_en: Rent or buy property in Iraq
plugins.overview_zh: Homele 按伊拉克城市街区、价格、房间和租期查买卖租赁，多语言卡片链接完整房源，也查开发项目、中介和部分地块图。覆盖多个城市不保证无遗漏。价格产权房况库存需核实，地图和翻译名称不是测绘界线或产权证明；正文未提供签约、约看或支付能力。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Homele searches Iraq property listings for sale/rent by city, neighborhood, price, room counts and rental frequency, with multilingual cards and full listing links. It also discovers developments, agencies and available interactive plot maps. Coverage includes several named Iraqi cities but should not be assumed exhaustive. Listing prices, legal ownership, condition and availability require confirmation; a map or translated title is not a surveyed boundary or verified title document. The description does not establish contracting, viewing appointments or payment tools.

plugins.overview_zh: HomePins 查班加罗尔新盘、价格、交付、开发商履历、认购和通勤，并可请求看房或回电。RERA 核验和覆盖是发布者声明，不独立保证产权、交付或收益，风险排名也不证明开发商必然成败。约看回电会共享联系方式与意向，须确认接收范围，买前核对官方记录、合同全部费用与交付承诺。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HomePins searches Bangalore new-launch apartments with pricing, possession schedules, developer histories, booking activity and commutes, and can request visits or callbacks. The publisher's RERA-verified and coverage claims are not an independent guarantee of title, delivery or investment performance. A risk ranking is an analytical aid, not proof a developer will fail or succeed. Visits/callbacks share contact and interest information, so confirm recipients and scope. Verify current RERA records, contract terms, all costs and delivery commitments before buying.

plugins.overview_zh: Homesage.ai 读取美国住宅做自动估值、可比、装修租赁、市场筛选及屋顶太阳能和业主记录分析。多数工具耗积分，数据库搜索先免费预览数量费用再收费；不改账户、转款或代行动。非公开成交价地区可比有限，AI 房况与议价信号非验房或卖家意图证明，业主资料不授权外联或侵扰调查。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Homesage.ai reads U.S. residential-property data for AVM/comparable analysis, renovation or rental economics, market filters, roof/solar signals and owner-related records. Most tools consume credits; database search previews count and cost for free before charging. It does not modify accounts, move money or act on the user's behalf. Comparable/ARV data is restricted where sale prices are non-public. AI condition and seller-flexibility estimates are not inspections or proof of intent, and owner contact data does not authorize outreach or invasive investigation.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找 HomesNI 房产信息
plugins.overview_zh: HomesNI 按北爱尔兰地区、预算、卧室、类型和关键词查买卖租赁，返回可得照片、价格地址及链接，范围是 HomesNI 目录而非全部市场。未说明约看、报价签约付款。库存与要价会变，应回看完整来源并核对产权形式、房况费用后作决定。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HomesNI Property Search finds Northern Ireland properties for sale or rent using area, budget, bedrooms, type and keywords, returning available photos, prices, addresses and listing links. Its scope is the HomesNI catalogue, not every local property or agent. The description does not establish appointment, offer, contract or payment functions. Treat availability and asking prices as listing information that can change; inspect the full source and relevant tenure, condition and fees before relying on a shortlist or making a housing decision.

plugins.overview_zh: HomeToGo 正文宣传搜索大量度假房、酒店、别墅等住宿，属于整体发现功能，不是付款退款、账户或筛选接口说明。最大精选库属营销，不独立保证质量。具体房源需核对日期人数、总费与规则；推荐不等于预留，也不证明满足全部无障碍或家庭要求。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HomeToGo's complete page promotes searching a large collection of vacation homes, hotels, villas and other stays. It is a broad discovery description, not a specification of payment, refunds, account requirements or every available search filter. Claims of curation and the largest collection are marketing statements, not independently verified quality guarantees. Compare an actual property's dates, occupancy, total charges and rules on its booking page; a suggested retreat is not a held reservation or proof that it meets every accessibility or family requirement.

plugins.overview_zh: Homey 连接 Cloud、Pro/mini 或自托管服务，控制设备、建 Flow 和启动 Mood，会产生真实物理变化或持久自动化。简短页未列全部设备权限和安全触发限制。尤其涉及门禁安防温控时需确认家庭设备与流程；连接不等于无限控制授权，结果也须实际确认。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Homey connects Homey Cloud, Homey Pro/mini or Self-Hosted Server to device control, Flow creation and Mood activation. This can cause real physical changes or persistent automation rather than merely answer questions about a home. The short page does not specify every device, permission, safety constraint or supported trigger. Confirm the intended home, device and routine before acting, especially when security, heating or access could be affected; connection does not authorize unrestricted control or guarantee that a requested change succeeded.

plugins.description_zh: 经过筛选的犬只繁育者与领养渠道
plugins.overview_zh: HonestDog 只读德国公开繁育者、领养和品种健康，含自有 S–E 等级、遗传病及俱乐部检测要求。免账户、不销售交易，联系去完整页面；对被认定有繁育健康问题的品种不列繁育者并解释替代。评级批准不是某只犬的兽医证明，领养购买前仍需核实健康材料和福利。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HonestDog reads public German breeder/adoption listings and breed-health information, including its own S–E grade, hereditary conditions and club testing requirements. It needs no account, never sells or transacts, and directs contact to the breeder or shelter's full page. For breeds it regards as harmed by breeding-related problems, it omits breeder listings and explains alternatives. Grades and approval labels are the platform's assessments, not veterinary certification of a particular dog; verify health documents and welfare conditions before adoption or purchase.

plugins.overview_zh: HoneyBook 连接客户咨询、建议书、合同、发票与付款相关工作，使用模板及已有业务记录。资源先获准访问，用户发送前不会到客户，可先审阅建议书。隔离执行和凭据不交模型属发布者声明，未独立审计。创建收款请求不等于收到钱或签合同，外发前核对客户、金额条款和披露。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HoneyBook connects client inquiries, proposals, contracts, invoices and payment-related work, using saved templates and account bookings. Resource access is approved before use, and nothing reaches a client until the user sends it; proposals can be reviewed first. The publisher describes isolated request execution and keeping credentials away from the model, which are not independently audited here. Creating a payment request is distinct from collecting money or signing a contract. Verify client identity, amount, terms and disclosure before any external action.

plugins.overview_zh: Honeycomb 查询观测数据、追踪、AI 对话与异常，做 BubbleUp，管理告警看板并指导埋点迁移，兼有调查和配置写入。需核对数据集、告警目标与改动；遥测可能含敏感业务对话，按授权范围汇总。相关异常不证明根因，正文未保证全部保留权限或自动修复。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Honeycomb queries observability data, traces, AI conversations and anomalies, including BubbleUp analysis, alert/dashboard management and instrumentation-migration guidance. It includes possible configuration writes as well as investigation, so verify the dataset, alert target and intended change. Telemetry may contain sensitive application or conversation content and should be summarized within authorized scope. A correlation or anomaly is not proof of a root cause, and the page does not establish complete retention, permissions or automatic remediation for every deployment.

plugins.overview_zh: Honeycomb (EU) 以独立地区条目提供相同描述的观测调查、追踪 AI 对话、查询、BubbleUp、告警看板及埋点流程，版本与另一条单独保留。EU 名称本身不证明存储、合同或跨境控制。读取遥测或改告警前核对环境权限，异常解释需证据，不能作确定事故诊断。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Honeycomb (EU) publishes the same described investigation, trace/AI-conversation analysis, queries, BubbleUp, alert/dashboard and instrumentation functions under a separate regional entry. Its version is preserved independently from Honeycomb's other entry. The EU name alone does not prove particular residency, contractual or cross-border controls. Check the connected environment and permissions before reading telemetry or changing alerts, and verify causal explanations against evidence rather than treating anomalous signals as definitive incident diagnoses.

plugins.description_zh: 查找和分析热门传播内容
plugins.overview_zh: Hook Layer 分析 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube 账户、高表现视频和常见开场，给想法评分及原创脚本拍摄概念。爆款模式分数不证明成功原因或预测下次效果，平台数据权限覆盖仍待核对。参考时不应复制受保护创意或虚构背书，正文未证明能发布投放或保证增长。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hook Layer audits Instagram, TikTok and YouTube performance, finds high-performing videos and recurring hooks, scores ideas and drafts original scripts or filming concepts. Its analyses can guide experimentation, but a viral pattern or score does not establish why a video succeeded or predict the next result. Access and coverage of platform data remain to be checked. Use inspiration without copying protected creative work or misrepresenting endorsements; the public body does not establish publishing, ad spend or guaranteed audience growth.

plugins.description_zh: 社交媒体营销与广告创意研究
plugins.overview_zh: HookRadar 用自身数据研究竞品付费广告和自然创意趋势、分析开场与行动号召、比较势头并出情报报告。属于研究，不执行活动或授权复制竞品。覆盖时点和筛选偏差会影响结论，长投放或热度不证明盈利；正文未说明私有广告账户、花费控制和发布工具，不能自行推断。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HookRadar researches competitor paid advertisements and organic creative trends from its own data, examines hooks and calls to action, compares momentum and prepares intelligence reports. This is research rather than campaign execution or a licence to reproduce competitors' assets. Dataset coverage, timing and selection bias can affect findings, and ad longevity or apparent momentum is not proof of profitability. The page does not specify access to private ad accounts, spending controls or posting tools; verify those separately rather than inferring them.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 HopeGoo 寻找酒店
plugins.overview_zh: HopeGoo 官方找酒店工具根据自然语言给建议、价格、评分和详情链接，属于发现界面。简短正文未证明支付退改或保证实时库存。应按房源日期核对总费、人数、取消和设施，家庭豪华或交通偏好匹配不独立证明服务质量与无障碍条件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HopeGoo's official hotel finder takes natural-language requirements and returns hotel recommendations with prices, ratings and links to its detail pages. It is a discovery interface; the short body does not establish payment, booking changes or guaranteed real-time inventory. Check the selected property and dates for total charges, occupancy, cancellation terms and amenities, particularly where a recommendation is based on family, luxury or transport preferences. A rating or nearby-location suggestion is not independent verification of service quality or accessibility.

plugins.description_zh: 预订机场接送和出租车
plugins.overview_zh: hoppa 比较机场接送、出租车、共享巴士及其他地面交通，按路线车型价格时间选择，并宣传广覆盖预订和固定价。网络数量可靠性属发布者声明；承诺前核对上下车、航班、人数行李、总价、等待取消。出现路线不保证有司机，正文也未明确每项最终支付步骤。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: hoppa searches and compares airport transfers, taxis, shared shuttles and other ground transport, with route, vehicle, price and travel-time choices. It promotes booking and fixed prices across a broad provider network, but coverage numbers and reliability are publisher claims. Before committing, confirm pickup/drop-off, flight details, passenger/luggage capacity, total fare, waiting and cancellation rules with the actual offer. The page does not settle every final payment step or guarantee a driver merely because a route appears in search.

plugins.overview_zh: Horizon Forge 通过规划、专门研究、证据审计、情景、怀疑性评审和透明评分分析长期行业机会，可更新预测。它不是增长保证或个人投资建议，结论依赖来源假设与不确定性，推测应标注。Ko-fi 打赏明确自愿，不是分析前提，存在链接不授权付款或金融行动。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Horizon Forge structures long-range industry research through planning, specialist investigation, evidence audit, scenarios, skeptical review and transparent scoring, with an update workflow. It is a forecasting skill rather than a guarantee that an industry will grow or a personal investment recommendation. Outcomes depend on available sources, assumptions and uncertainty; unsupported projections should remain labelled. The optional Ko-fi tip is explicitly voluntary and not a requirement for analysis. No payment or financial action is authorized by the presence of that link.

plugins.description_zh: 获取宠物粪便清理报价
plugins.description_en: Get a pet waste removal quote
plugins.overview_zh: Horizon Pet Waste Solutions 介绍佐治亚州 Marietta/East Cobb 的犬粪清理方案，起草由用户发送给店主的询价。起价随地点、庭院和犬数变化，最终由店主确认价格排期。插件不开户预约确认或收款，不是自动派工；先核对服务范围，仅分享所需地址联系资料。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Horizon Pet Waste Solutions explains dog-waste cleanup options around Marietta/East Cobb, Georgia, and drafts a quote request for the user to send to the owner. Starting-price information varies with location, yard size and dog count; the owner confirms the final price and schedule. No account, booking, confirmed appointment or payment is handled by the plugin. This is a local service inquiry aid, not autonomous dispatch, so verify service coverage and share only the address/contact details needed for the requested quote.

Coverage is limited to tracked sources and forecasts are uncertain; check current room/bed availability, fees and conditions before continuing outside chat, and do not assume transport is included.

A useful ranking reflects supplied preferences and available evidence, not an objective best hotel or a promise that all suggested amenities and rates remain available.

Check taxes, cancellation and room occupancy before confirming, and do not treat a displayed rate or widget selection as authorization to send personal information.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找可直接预订的度假住宿
plugins.overview_zh: Houfy 按地点日期、人数价格、类型设施查度假租房，比较照片评分和公开详情，再到 Houfy 直接订。正文未说明聊天付款取消。直订不代表各房东保障条款相同，应核对具体库存、总费、规则取消及真实房东支付渠道，再承诺或分享必要资料。

plugins.description_zh: 记录出租业务参与时数
plugins.overview_zh: HourProof 记录物业管理活动、筛选日志、对照年度目标并参考同步入住，代理记录有标识且同步手机。所列 100/750 小时是产品跟踪目标，不是完整法律测试或税务资格证明。只能记真实完成的日期时长，审计轨迹不能证明编造工作，税务处理需专业人员按适用规则审阅。

Log only work actually performed with accurate dates and durations. A software audit trail does not independently substantiate an invented activity, and tax treatment should be reviewed against applicable rules by a qualified professional.

plugins.overview_zh: House of Prayer 是基督教祷告社区，可提出请求、支持他人、查本人活动及阅读分享经审核见证，提交先预览确认，发布者称不公开身份联系方式。匿名不保证故事无法间接识别人，发布前检查本人和第三方细节；宗教支持不能代替医疗法律紧急协助，见证标签不证明结果独立核验。

Anonymous presentation is not a guarantee that sensitive stories cannot identify someone indirectly. Review personal and third-party details before posting, and separate spiritual support from medical, legal or emergency assistance. No claim that prayer outcomes are independently verified should be inferred from a testimony label.

plugins.overview_zh: HOUSE ’N’ STARS 搜索精选公开豪宅数据，覆盖摩纳哥、法国里维埃拉、迪拜、阿布扎比及其他选定地区，返回价格显示、面积、卧室、设施和原链接。它严格只读，不修改房源、预订或交易，不提供法律、估值或投资建议，也不要求身份/付款文件或精确用户位置。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HOUSE ’N’ STARS searches a curated public luxury-property dataset covering Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected other destinations. It returns structured listing details such as price display, size, bedrooms, features and source URL. It is strictly read-only: no listing changes, reservations or transactions, and no legal, valuation or investment advice. The connector does not request identity/payment documents or precise user location.

plugins.overview_zh: HouseToSpot 按城市搜索房源，在交互地图显示价格、位置和关键信息，辅助比较社区及周边设施，用于租买或了解市场。正文说明的是可视化发现，不是完成交易或核实库存；具体覆盖、房源准确性、法律状态及中介委托仍应另行检查。
plugins.requirements_zh: 地图发现，覆盖、时效及中介/交易条件需另核。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HouseToSpot searches properties by city and places listings on an interactive map with price, location and key details. It helps compare neighborhoods and nearby amenities for renting, buying or market exploration. The description establishes visual discovery, not a completed property transaction or verified availability. Geographic coverage, listing accuracy, legal status and any brokerage engagement should be checked separately for a chosen property.

plugins.description_zh: 了解聊天机器人遗漏的内容
plugins.overview_zh: HoverBot 为单个获批准客服机器人工作区提供九项只读工具，查看配置、知识源、顾客对话、低依据/未回答问题、分析及捕获线索，帮助比较质量和找信息缺口，不修改机器人或联系客户。工作区由授权固定，撤销在下次请求生效；知识查询是关键词匹配而非语义检索。
plugins.requirements_zh: 单个授权工作区、九个只读工具，不改机器人知识、不联系线索；知识检索仅关键词，撤销下次生效。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HoverBot provides nine read-only tools for one approved support-bot workspace, covering bot configuration, knowledge sources, shopper transcripts, weakly grounded or unanswered questions, analytics and captured leads. Workspace scope is fixed by authorization, revocation applies on the next request, and knowledge search matches keywords rather than semantic meaning.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找 AI 工作流和技能

A workflow's inclusion in the catalog is not proof that it works unchanged in the user's tools or environment.

plugins.overview_zh: How is my trip? 根据公布的官方来源，评估目的地及日期范围的出行干扰风险，介绍重大变化监测、平静期间说明及当前事件和旅游背景。风险评估不保证旅行安全或覆盖所有干扰，目录也未说明监测频率、通知渠道，安装本身不等于已有运行提醒。

The publisher's description does not establish official ACT affiliation, guaranteed score improvement or complete reproduction of the current exam; learners should verify important explanations and use appropriate official preparation material.

plugins.description_zh: 查询各地步行友好度评分
plugins.overview_zh: How Walkable 根据开放地图设施及路网密度估算 0–100 步行分数，比较地点或大城市排名，并列出日常设施及估算步行时间。距离不经真实路线计算，地图缺漏会拉低评分，且不考虑坡度、人行道、安全或公交；城市排名不含中国大陆。只使用提交地名，不读设备位置，无需账户。

Mainland China is absent from city rankings. It uses submitted place names, not device location, and needs no account.

plugins.description_en: Find words for how you feel
plugins.overview_zh: How We Feel 通过精力和愉快程度探索情绪，浏览定义并选最多三个感受词，点 Done 后把选择分享进当前对话。无需账户，可用于自我觉察或谈话准备；它不诊断疾病、不判断情绪成因，也不会保存到独立 How We Feel 应用。
plugins.requirements_zh: 最多选三个词，Done 分享到对话；不诊断、不判断成因、不保存至独立应用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: How We Feel helps name emotions by exploring energy and pleasantness, browsing definitions and selecting up to three feeling words. Tapping Done shares that selection into the current conversation. It requires no account and can support a personal check-in or preparation for talking with someone. It does not diagnose conditions, explain the causes of emotions or save the check-in to the separate How We Feel app.

plugins.description_zh: 为 Aggies 提供公寓指南
plugins.overview_zh: Howdy Apartments 为 Texas A&M 毕业生、校友和家庭提供达拉斯、休斯敦、奥斯汀公寓及社区只读指导，使用已批准指南与存储起租价，通勤建议先问实际办公室及到岗日。价格非实时库存报价；不预约看房、提交申请、收款或读客户记录，未获学校官方背书。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HPRG Hotel Concierge explores participating Paris hotels, room pricing and availability, nearby places, weather and travel distances, with booking links. With explicit consent it can send contact details and stay preferences to a selected hotel and its configured integrations, creating a contact and conversation. This does not hold a room or take payment. Repeated submission creates another record rather than safely deduplicating the prior request.

It treats properties separately and considers represented branches, priority, property source, disqualifications and legal-review triggers. Exact arithmetic is not a binding legal determination; disputed facts, jurisdiction and current interpretation require qualified review before distribution.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HubPost connects linked social accounts to inspect drafts, queues and published posts and create, edit, reschedule or delete content. It supports major social networks and can help check whether a scheduled item went live or where gaps remain. A connected HubPost account is required and a free plan is advertised, but limits are unspecified. Scheduling can publish externally later, so audience, content and time require deliberate review.

plugins.description_zh: 将 HubSpot 洞察转化为行动
plugins.overview_zh: 基于实际 HubSpot 数据进行客户关系管理、模式分析和销售管线整理，同时支持读取及写入授权范围内的业务对象。
capabilities_zh: 读取、创建和更新商机、联系人、公司、工单、互动及其他有权访问的对象。
准备报告，更新商机阶段，记录通话和邮件。
创建任务，或在会议前查看销售管线详情。
use_cases_zh: 使用示例：会前整理重点商机、联系人与管线状态。
使用示例：将销售跟进进展写入记录，并创建后续任务。
plugins.requirements_zh: 可操作范围受当前账户对 HubSpot 对象的访问权限限制。

plugins.description_zh: 适合 AI 使用的员工队伍洞察
plugins.overview_zh: Hubstaff 将员工数据带入对话，分析生产力趋势、负荷不均和运营情况，辅助了解模式而非手动查看看板。正文未列出全部读写动作，也不证明生产力指标公平反映个人贡献；需结合权限和背景，不应凭脱离情境的活动指标作人事决定。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需员工数据访问及背景，具体操作权限和个人生产力评估公平性未核实。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hubstaff brings workforce data into conversational analysis for productivity trends, workload imbalance and operational insights. It can help teams inspect patterns instead of manually navigating dashboards. The description does not enumerate every read/write operation or prove that a productivity signal fairly represents an individual's work. Access scope and data context matter, and personnel decisions should not be based on a decontextualized activity metric.

plugins.description_zh: 构建和发布 iOS 应用
plugins.overview_zh: Hugging App 根据想法、截图或代码指导原创 iPhone 应用，涵盖 SwiftUI/UIKit、无障碍界面、小组件、Live Activities、测试与发布准备，最多列出三个有证据和验证步骤的优先改进。构建发布依赖开发工具及用户批准，不独立上架或下载第三方设计库，仍需实测。
plugins.requirements_zh: 使用可用开发工具并需批准，不独立发布或取第三方设计库。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hugging App guides original native iPhone development from ideas, screenshots or code, covering SwiftUI/UIKit, accessible interfaces, widgets, Live Activities, testing and release preparation. It can prioritize up to three improvements with evidence and validation steps. Building and shipping depend on the user's development tools and approval; it does not independently publish an app or fetch third-party design libraries, and generated work still needs testing.

plugins.description_zh: 减少 AI 写作习惯，保留作者语气
plugins.overview_zh: Human Prose Editor 审查、编辑和起草文章，减少模板化修辞、重复说明、生硬节奏及机械对话；小说还考虑叙事结构与动作，而非单纯换词，尽量保留事实、声音、速度和体裁。它改善风格，不证明人类创作或保证通过 AI 检测，采用改稿前需检查实质变化。
plugins.requirements_zh: 保留事实声音是编辑目标，不保证作者检测或正确性。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Human Prose Editor audits, edits and drafts prose to reduce formulaic rhetoric, redundant explanation, awkward cadence and mechanical dialogue. For fiction it considers narrative structure and movement rather than only swapping words, while aiming to preserve facts, voice, pacing and genre. These are stylistic editing goals, not evidence that text was written by a human or a guarantee against automated authorship detectors; review substantive changes before using a rewrite.

plugins.overview_zh: Human Writing 通过句子编辑起草、改写、审阅及模仿所给写作风格，遇到故事才分析叙事结构。它强调保留事实主张，不靠故意加入错误制造自然感。属于编辑辅助，而非作者身份认证；用户仍须审核含义、归属及需要独立验证的事实。
plugins.requirements_zh: 句子编辑保留主张，仅故事用结构分析，不人为加错或认证人类作者。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Human Writing drafts, rewrites, reviews and matches a supplied voice using sentence-level editing and, for stories, narrative structure. Its stated approach preserves factual claims and avoids inserting artificial mistakes merely to sound natural. Story analysis is applied only when the text actually tells a story. It is an editorial aid rather than authorship certification; users should review meaning, attribution and any facts that need independent verification.

plugins.description_zh: 润色巴西葡萄牙语文本
忠实地将文本改写得更自然
plugins.overview_zh: Humanização de Texto 改写已有文本以改善自然度和流畅性，保留事实、数字、姓名、日期、术语、限定和论证顺序，并按要求格式返回；明确不编造例子意见，也不设定品牌声音。它忠实编辑，不独立核查事实、不扩充创意或证明人类作者；精确文本需对照原文。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只改已有文本，保留限定顺序，不编例子意见或定义品牌声音。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Humanização de Texto rewrites existing prose for more natural flow while preserving facts, figures, names, dates, technical terms, caveats and argument order. It returns the revision in the requested format and explicitly avoids inventing examples or opinions or defining a brand voice. Its role is faithful editing, not independent fact-checking, creative expansion or proof of human authorship; compare the revision with the source when precision matters.

plugins.description_zh: 将文字改写为自然文风

plugins.overview_zh: Humantic AI 通过平台从 LinkedIn 或工作邮箱推断 DISC 风格买家画像，研究企业及意向信号，并起草个性化触达，需订阅并消耗现有积分。性格输出是模型推断，不是已核实心理事实或临床评估，也不应决定就业资格；起草触达不等于对方同意接收联系。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Humantic 订阅积分，DISC 风格为推断非核实心理事实，不暗示获准触达。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Humantic AI uses the connected platform for buyer intelligence: inferred DISC-style profiles from LinkedIn URLs or work email, company research with intent signals and tailored outreach drafts. It requires a subscription and consumes existing credits. Personality outputs are model inferences, not verified psychological facts or a clinical assessment, and should not determine employment eligibility. Drafting tailored outreach does not itself establish consent to contact the recipient.
