plugins.description_zh: 规划和排列工作优先级
plugins.overview_zh: HUMMBL Operations 把用户提供的有限工作信号整理为运营简报、优先级解释和行动计划，考虑紧急性、影响、依赖、可信度及可逆性，记录责任人、证据、检查点和停止条件，也保存决策备选及复审触发。初版仅技能咨询，不连账户、不读系统或执行变更，结论受输入完整性限制。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅咨询技能、使用有限输入，不连外部账户、不读系统或执行。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HUMMBL Operations turns a bounded set of user-supplied work signals into operating briefs, priority explanations and action plans. It weighs urgency, impact, dependencies, confidence and reversibility and records owners, evidence, gates and stopping conditions. Decision records can retain alternatives and review triggers. This initial skills-only release is advisory: it does not connect accounts, read systems or execute changes, so recommendations are only as complete as the supplied material.

plugins.description_zh: 自拍塔罗、爱情与是非问答
plugins.overview_zh: Hunch Tarot 将自拍及确认后的姓名、生日、偏好发送给 Hunch，制作个人塔罗图和单牌解读，可转至受支持聊天软件。每日任务取决于定时能力、Hunch 工具及获准自拍访问；无需账户，不含多牌阵，仅供娱乐和自省，不是预测或专业意见。
plugins.requirements_zh: 自拍与确认姓名生日偏好发送 Hunch，仅单牌；定时生成需宿主工具、获准图片及额度。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hunch Tarot turns a selfie and confirmed name, birth date and preferences into personalized tarot art and a one-card interpretation. It can hand the same card to supported messengers; a daily task depends on compatible scheduling, Hunch tools and approved selfie access. Details and the photo are sent to Hunch. No account is needed, multi-card spreads are excluded, and readings are entertainment/self-reflection rather than predictions or professional advice.

plugins.overview_zh: Hunter 此精确 ID 正文聚焦公司而非个人联系人：按地区、行业、规模或技术搜索，查看域名层业务资料并保存到 Hunter Leads，返回行业、人数区间、总部及技术栈。虽然截图示例提到联系人，正文明确公司层级且不含个人数据，不能凭品牌其他产品推断找邮箱或外联能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 正文仅公司数据，虽截图措辞提联系人；保存公司会改变 Hunter Leads。
plugins.detail_source_type: 官方同ID索引完整公开说明
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hunter's retrieved exact-ID description focuses on companies, not personal contact enrichment. Search by location, industry, size or technology, inspect domain-level business information and save relevant companies to Hunter Leads. It can return industry, headcount range, headquarters and technology stack. A screenshot example mentions contacts, but the functional body explicitly says company-level, no personal data; do not infer email-finding or outreach functions from Hunter's broader product reputation.

plugins.overview_zh: Hustle Got Real 连接卖家的现有店铺，查看商品、订单与销售，并在确认后添加供应商商品、修改或发布。价格库存按正常同步周期到市场；不能删商品、联系买家、履约或改账单订阅，聊天中无推荐商品筛选器。推荐或上架不证明质量、合规或盈利。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需账户和店铺，修改发布均确认；不删除、联络买家、履约或改账单，适用正常同步延迟。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hustle Got Real connects a seller's existing stores to inspect listings, orders and sales, add supported supplier products and change or publish listings after confirmation. Price and stock reach the marketplace on HGR's normal synchronization schedule. It cannot delete listings, contact buyers, fulfill orders or change billing/subscriptions, and recommended-product search filters are unavailable in chat. Listing a suggested product does not establish product quality, compliance or profitability.

plugins.description_zh: 填写和编辑 HWPX 文档
plugins.overview_zh: HWPXkit 打开 HWPX 附件或链接，识别可编辑单元格、段落、公式和行，填写空白或修改文字、格式与表格，返回下载副本，支持一步回退且不改原文件。它编辑文档，不提交表单或签署；使用前应在兼容阅读器检查排版与内容。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 HWPX 输入，仅改副本、原文不变、一步回退，不含提交签署。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HWPXkit opens an HWPX attachment or link, identifies editable cells, paragraphs, equations and rows, and fills form blanks or changes text, formatting and rows. It returns an edited downloadable copy with one-step rollback while leaving the source untouched. This is document editing rather than form submission or signature; review layout and content in a compatible reader before relying on the output.

plugins.overview_zh: Hyatt 查询全球旗下酒店度假村，展示官网房型说明、照片、设施、动态价格及当前库存，并可对话细化需求后到官网预订。会员登录或加入在预订流程中完成以获取适用权益。搜索不锁房，最终价格条件、税费、取消及会员资格仍需核对。
plugins.requirements_zh: 在 Hyatt.com 完成预订，会员权益依条件，搜索不锁库存。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hyatt searches its worldwide hotel and resort catalog with room descriptions, photographs, amenities, dynamic rates and current availability from Hyatt.com. Users can refine preferences in conversation and follow the site link to complete booking. World of Hyatt login or enrollment happens during that booking flow for applicable benefits. Search results do not reserve a room, and final rate conditions, taxes, cancellation and member eligibility need review.

plugins.description_zh: 将可穿戴设备连接到 ChatGPT
plugins.overview_zh: HYBRD 连接受支持穿戴数据，在 ChatGPT/Codex 分析健身记录、准备训练计划并把训练发送到设备。示例提及 Garmin、Whoop，但未完整列出兼容设备或套餐限制。计划不保证安全或效果；使用前核对集成、设备写入行为和个人运动适宜性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需受支持穿戴连接及宿主，未保证全面兼容或个体训练安全。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HYBRD connects supported wearable data to ChatGPT or Codex for fitness analysis, training-plan preparation and sending workouts to devices. The description gives Garmin and Whoop as examples but does not enumerate complete device compatibility or plan limits. Training guidance is not a guarantee of safety or results; check supported integrations, device write behavior and personal exercise suitability before using a generated plan.

plugins.description_zh: 以 Markdown 格式读取实时网页
plugins.description_en: Read the live web as markdown
plugins.overview_zh: Hydrafetch 把网页主要内容转为清理后的 Markdown，支持 JavaScript 渲染、搜索、列举/抓取网站、提取 JSON 字段和查看域名品牌元素，需账户。广泛读取宣传不等于能访问需登录或受限内容，仍受网站访问规则、渲染限制、提取质量和额度约束。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Hydrafetch 账户，读取抓取不越过访问控制，额度和提取保真未核实。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hydrafetch reads web pages into cleaned Markdown, including JavaScript-rendered content, and can search, enumerate or crawl sites, extract structured JSON fields and inspect domain branding. It requires a Hydrafetch account. The publisher's broad page-reading claim should not be taken as access to authenticated or restricted content; site access rules, rendering limits, extracted-data quality and the service's quotas still apply.

plugins.description_zh: 与智能体一起跟踪问题
plugins.overview_zh: Hydrant 在单个用户批准工作区读取、创建和更新 issue，查分配工作、阻塞、重复报告并总结讨论。OAuth 将访问限定在所选工作区及用户权限；创建更新会改变真实项目记录，不提供跨工作区权限，也不表示追踪问题就自动修复。
plugins.requirements_zh: OAuth 所选单工作区和权限，写 issue 改真实记录，不自动修复。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hydrant reads, creates and updates issues in one user-approved workspace. It can find assigned work, inspect blockers, check for duplicate reports and summarize discussions before organizing follow-up. OAuth authorization fixes the selected workspace and the user's permissions. Creating or updating an issue changes live project records; the description does not grant cross-workspace access or establish that tracking a bug automatically fixes it.

plugins.overview_zh: Hydrosight 连接土壤传感器，查看当前及历史湿度、温度、盐度，结合天气预报辅助灌溉判断，也可查看地点和设备。正文描述监测分析，不是自动开阀；数据受布点、校准和连接影响，单个读数不能决定所有作物土壤的合适灌溉计划。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需传感器连接，仅说明监测而非灌溉控制，校准连接影响读数。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Hydrosight connects soil sensors for current and historical moisture, temperature and salinity readings, alongside weather conditions and forecasts. It helps inspect locations and sensors and inform irrigation decisions in conversation. This describes monitoring and analysis, not automatic valve control. Data depends on sensor placement, calibration and connectivity, and a reading alone does not establish the appropriate irrigation schedule for every crop or soil.

plugins.overview_zh: HyeAn 按自然语言视觉描述搜索用户连接的图片与游戏素材库，并查看套餐、额度和索引状态。空库会返回明确标记的共享演示素材，不能当作用户文件。搜索结果不证明拥有版权或许可，未索引和不可用素材也可能不出现。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受连接资料库、套餐额度及索引限制，空库显示标记共享演示，非个人素材。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: HyeAn searches the connected user's image and game-asset library from a natural-language visual description. It also reports plan, quota and indexing status to help explain what is searchable. An empty library returns clearly labeled shared demonstration assets, not the user's own files. Search results do not establish ownership or licensing rights, and unavailable or unindexed assets may not appear.

plugins.overview_zh: HyNote 搜索列举已认证工作区笔记、打开预览并读取内容；获写权限后可新建文本笔记，但不能编辑或删除已有笔记。PDF 和图片可能只返回片段，因此摘要可能不完整。适合查找积累知识，不代表所有附件已完整解析或旧笔记已被改写。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需认证工作区，写权限仅新建文本笔记，不改删旧笔记；PDF 图片可能只片段。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Iberia searches the airline's flights, compares available options and suggests destinations or flexible travel dates. It helps narrow an itinerary when the traveler has a specific destination or only a general trip idea. Once a flight is selected, booking continues through Iberia. Search or comparison does not reserve a seat or guarantee the cheapest fare; baggage, passenger eligibility, total charges and cancellation conditions require final review.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找波兰的健身房和课程
plugins.overview_zh: iBody 查询波兰健身房、瑜伽普拉提、舞蹈及武术场地，提供地址、价格、接受的运动卡和每周课程，链接公开资料查看日期、教师及线上预订。自动刷新宣传不保证实时名额；报名或参加前应核对具体课程、卡资格、取消规则与运动适宜性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 覆盖波兰场地课程，时间价格可变，资料链接转预订，不保证名额或卡适用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: iBody searches Polish gyms, yoga/Pilates studios, dance and martial-arts venues with addresses, prices, accepted sports cards and weekly schedules. Listings link to public profiles for exact dates, instructors and online class booking. The publisher describes automated refresh, not guaranteed live inventory. Verify the specific class, pass eligibility, cancellation rules and exercise suitability before booking or attending.

plugins.description_zh: 通过模拟示例学习 ICD-10
plugins.description_en: Học ICD-10 bằng ví dụ mô phỏng
plugins.overview_zh: ICD-10 Assistant 通过来源比较和假设例子教授 ICD-10-WHO、ICD-10-CM 的结构、术语与规则，供自学、教学和分类练习。明确排除真实患者记录、医疗服务、收费、审计、临床文档及正式编码，也不作诊断治疗决定；示例不应直接用于真实病历或报销。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅学习假设例，不用于真实记录、医疗、收费、审计、文档或正式编码决定。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ICD-10 Assistant teaches ICD-10-WHO and ICD-10-CM structure, terminology and rules using source comparisons and hypothetical examples. It is for self-study, teaching and classification practice. The publisher excludes real patient records, healthcare delivery, billing, auditing, clinical documentation and official coding, and does not make diagnostic or treatment decisions. Educational examples should not be copied directly into a real patient or reimbursement workflow.

plugins.overview_zh: Icebreaker 跨受支持 LinkedIn、X、GitHub 等来源搜索用户扩展人脉，寻找相关人员及潜在熟人介绍，辅助招聘、销售或社交研究。转化提升属于宣传，未核验；查到关联不等于对方有空、背书或同意介绍，实际覆盖取决于连接设置。
plugins.requirements_zh: 限受支持连接人脉，转化宣传未核验，出现联系人不等于同意联络。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Icebreaker searches a user's extended network across supported sources such as LinkedIn, X and GitHub to identify relevant people and potential warm introductions. It can support recruiting, sales or general networking research. The claimed conversion uplift is promotional, not a verified outcome. Finding a network connection does not establish the person's availability, endorsement or consent to an introduction, and actual source access depends on the connected setup.

plugins.overview_zh: Iceflower 用北美消费交易样本分析商家和顾客，涉及营收增长、门店、RFM、交叉购物、留存、地区客群及购物中心排名。工具全只读，返回登录账户可见数字。样本不等于全体人口，覆盖、抽样与定义影响解释，汇总分析也不应冒充某个人的行为识别。
plugins.requirements_zh: 登录后只读样本数据，北美覆盖及定义限制总体推断。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Iceflower analyzes retail merchants and consumers through a North American transaction panel, covering revenue/growth, store presence, RFM segments, cross-shopping, retention, local profiles and shopping-center rankings. All tools are read-only and return numbers visible to the signed-in account. A panel is not the entire population; coverage, sampling and metric definitions affect interpretation, and aggregate customer analytics should not be presented as identifying a particular individual's behavior.

plugins.overview_zh: Icelook 连接客户与独立美容专家，查看空位、预约、改期或取消；专家可管理日程、客户、服务并查看业务表现。预约动作先显示详情确认，不静默改日历。它是真实预约服务而不只是发现，确认前应理解价格、项目、时间及取消条件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 每次预约动作先确认，专家与客户权限不同，不静默改日历。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Icelook connects clients with independent beauty specialists and lets them check availability, book, reschedule or cancel appointments. Specialists can inspect their day, manage bookings, clients and services and review business performance. Booking actions show the details for confirmation, with no silent calendar changes. This is an operational appointment service, not just discovery; price, service, timing and cancellation conditions should be understood before confirming.

plugins.overview_zh: IcePanel 把协作架构模型带入 ChatGPT/Codex，支持理解系统数据流、创建模型对象、与代码保持一致及管理架构决策记录。它处理设计文档，不证明实际部署行为；同步一致性依赖真实代码、权限和评审，图示不等于安全或运行正确。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需架构项目连接，模型代码一致及运行正确需验证。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IcePanel brings collaborative software-architecture models into ChatGPT and Codex. It supports understanding systems and data flows, creating model objects, keeping models aligned with code and managing architecture decision records. These are design and documentation workflows rather than proof of deployed behavior. Synchronization and consistency depend on the actual code, configured access and review; an architecture diagram alone does not establish security or operational correctness.

plugins.description_zh: 生成原创图标，衔接 Icon Composer
plugins.description_en: 生成原创图标，衔接 Icon Composer
plugins.overview_zh: Icon Design 根据应用和参考探索原创图标，比较真实小尺寸效果，再重建干净 SVG 或透明图层，衔接 Icon Composer 与原生资源。需本地工具及生图能力，第三方路线费用先确认，保留提示词、来源和成本；不自动授予图片权利或保证平台接受。本次未访问本机工具或图标。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需本地工具和生图，先确认第三方地址费用，Icon Composer 原生导出依赖本地支持。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Icon Design explores original icon directions from app ideas and references, compares real small-size previews and prepares selected designs as clean SVG or transparent layers for Apple Icon Composer and native resources. It requires local tools and available image generation; third-party routes and fees are confirmed before use. The workflow preserves prompts, references and costs, but does not itself grant image rights or guarantee platform acceptance. No local tools or icons were accessed here.

plugins.description_zh: 创造性地融合不同想法
plugins.overview_zh: Idea Generator 将概念拆成可复用组成部分，再交叉组合或变异，同时保留明确约束和锁定项，用结构化方法探索变体。简短介绍不证明市场验证、技术可行或绝对原创，实施前仍需对照需求并独立研究。
plugins.requirements_zh: 保留明确约束锁定，创意不等于市场验证、可行证明或保证原创。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Idea Generator decomposes concepts into reusable components, combines or mutates them and preserves explicit constraints or locked elements. It is a structured ideation method for exploring variations rather than merely producing a random list. The brief description does not establish market validation, technical feasibility or originality guarantees; promising ideas still need checking against the user's requirements and independent research before implementation.

plugins.overview_zh: Idea To Prototype Beta 在实现前将粗略产品想法整理为有边界的规划包，包括来源清单、机会说明、页面地图、原型简报、设计契约、构建规格及验证清单，并设防泛化检查点。结果是可评审计划，不是成品上线；有规格不代表已写码、测试或托管。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅实现前计划，未证明执行代码、部署或交付可运行原型。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Idea To Prototype Beta converts a rough product idea into a bounded planning package before implementation. It includes source inventory, opportunity reasoning, screen maps, prototype brief, design contract, build specification and verification checklist, with a gate against generic output. The result is reviewable planning, not a finished deployed application; it does not establish that code was written, tested or hosted simply because a build specification exists.

plugins.overview_zh: Ideaflow 连接个人笔记和文件夹，搜索筛选、读取、标签链接和整理，也支持新建、编辑、发布、删除、恢复及确认登录账户。不是纯只读，发布可能暴露内容，删除会改变记录；需核对账户、所选资料及受众，列出恢复功能不代表所有删除都有相同恢复期限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 账户笔记写入含发布删除恢复，操作前核对受众及恢复限制。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ideaflow connects personal notes and folders for search, filtering, reading, hashtags, links and organization. It also supports creating, editing, publishing, deleting and restoring content and confirming the signed-in account. This is not read-only note retrieval: publishing can expose content and deletion changes stored records. Check account, selected notes and intended audience, and do not assume every deletion has the same recovery window merely because restoration is listed.

plugins.description_en: Find properties to buy or rent
plugins.overview_zh: idealista 搜索西班牙、意大利、葡萄牙房源，提供照片、说明和地图，可用语音文字细化城市、社区、预算及公寓、房间或车库等要求。它筛选住房，不认证房产或完成租买；提交敏感资料或付款前须核实库存、准确性、业主身份、费用与条款。
plugins.requirements_zh: 西意葡房源发现，不核验产权法律或完成租买。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: idealista searches properties in Spain, Italy and Portugal with photos, descriptions and maps. Users can refine city, neighborhood, price and specific requirements through voice or text, from apartments to rooms or garages. It helps shortlist housing, not certify the property or complete a lease or purchase. Availability, listing accuracy, owner identity, fees and contractual terms should be verified before sending sensitive information or paying.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索、管理和更新虚拟数据室
plugins.overview_zh: Ideals 管理虚拟资料室项目、文件夹、上传、文档检索摘要、活动日志和用户群组，辅助尽调整理与访问追踪。邀请用户或撤权属于重要权限修改，不同于查文档；安全宣传未独立审计，应遵守现有治理，分享敏感交易材料前核对人员、群组及级别。
plugins.requirements_zh: 资料室用户群组变更影响访问，邀请撤权前核对人员及最小权限。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ideals manages a virtual data room through projects, folder structures, uploads, document search and summaries, activity logs and user/group administration. It can support due-diligence organization and track which materials were accessed. User invitations and access removal are consequential permission changes, distinct from searching documents. The publisher's security claim was not independently audited; use existing governance and carefully verify recipients, groups and access levels before sharing sensitive deal material.

plugins.description_zh: 游玩你的放置类大型多人在线游戏角色
plugins.overview_zh: idle.am 通过 OAuth 连接角色，查看技能、背包、任务并执行训练、采集、旅行、装备、做食物及任务切换等玩法，仍受游戏原有条件限制。不能购买、交易、转银行物品、发聊天或改账户。排除财务沟通不代表玩法无影响，操作仍可能消耗资源或改变进度。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 OAuth 及原等级地点装备资源，不购买交易转银行物品、聊天或改设置。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: idle.am connects a game character through OAuth to inspect skills, inventory, quests and current tasks and perform supported gameplay such as training, gathering, travel, equipment, food preparation and task changes. Normal game requirements still apply. It cannot purchase, trade, transfer bank items, send chat or change account settings. Gameplay can consume resources or change progress even though financial and communication functions are excluded.

plugins.description_zh: 管理 IDrive e2 存储
plugins.overview_zh: IDrive e2 连接对象存储，浏览区域、管理桶和对象、设置生命周期或 Object Lock，并生成预签名链接。操作涉及保留期、删除保护和访问，而不只是列文件；使用前核对链接对象、有效期、权限及生命周期变更后果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受存储权限限制，生命周期/锁定和预签名影响保留访问，需核对范围到期。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IDrive e2 connects object storage for browsing regions, managing buckets and objects, configuring lifecycle or Object Lock settings and generating presigned links. It can support storage organization and controlled file exchange. These operations can affect retention, deletion protection and access, not just list files; review the object, expiration and permission scope of each link and the consequences of lifecycle changes before applying them.

plugins.overview_zh: IDYORA 查询印度菜每百克和常见份量的热量营养，按餐次、饮食或目标搜食谱，提供材料、做法、每份营养及发布页链接。不访问个人账户资料，只给一般食物信息，不是医疗建议；实际份量、材料和制作方式会改变摄入。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公开食谱营养，无个人账户访问或医疗建议，份量随做法变化。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IDYORA retrieves calories and nutrients for Indian dishes per 100 grams and typical serving, and searches recipes by meal, diet or goal. Full recipes include ingredients, method and per-serving nutrition, with links to the published source pages. It does not access personal data or accounts and offers general food information, not medical advice. Portion size, ingredients and preparation can materially change an individual's actual intake.

plugins.overview_zh: IELTS Speaking Simulator 提供口语考试模拟、主题提问和反馈，可按考试部分推进；页面建议使用语音模式并把应用语言设为英语避免自动翻译。它是练习技能，不是官方考官或认证成绩，题目新鲜度与反馈准确性未独立核验，实际语音取决于宿主能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 语音依宿主，应用英文可避免自动翻译，练习非官方 IELTS 测评。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IELTS Speaking Simulator offers speaking-test practice, topic prompts and feedback, including progression through test parts. The description suggests using voice mode and setting the application language to English to avoid automatic translation. It is a rehearsal skill, not an official IELTS examiner or certified score. Topic freshness and feedback accuracy are publisher claims, and availability of actual spoken interaction depends on the host's voice capability.

plugins.overview_zh: IELTS Writing Coach 审阅粘贴的写作任务和答案，涉及作文、书信及学术写作，提供语法纠正和规划改进指导。属于教育反馈，不是官方分数或提分保证；应保留本人创作并依据题目评分标准核对建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 粘贴任务及本人答案，语法作文反馈非认证评分或提分保证。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IELTS Writing Coach reviews a pasted writing task and response, including essays, letters and academic-writing exercises. It offers grammar corrections and guidance for planning or improving an answer. This is educational feedback rather than an official band score or guarantee of examination improvement; users should preserve their own authorship and verify advice against the task's scoring criteria before adopting revisions.

plugins.overview_zh: IFG 检索覆盖地区官方税法、指引、判例、协定、欧盟及 OECD 文献，定位条款、比较可用版本与生效时间，并附官方发布者链接。覆盖、历史与适用证据各异，会标明缺失；辅助专业研究，不保证所有法律最新完整，也不对纳税人情形作约束性意见。
plugins.requirements_zh: 来源地区及历史适用各异，专业结论应保留缺失与部分证据。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IFG searches official tax legislation, guidance, case law, treaties, EU law and OECD publications across its available jurisdictions. It can locate provisions, compare available versions and effective dates and cite official publisher links. Coverage, history and applicability evidence vary and missing evidence is identified. It supports professional research, not a universal current-law guarantee or a binding opinion about a taxpayer's situation.

plugins.overview_zh: Ignition 管理客户、提案、表单、发票、付款、服务和模板，正文区分读取、创建草稿、私有更新及明确向客户发送。草稿不自动送出，管理付款记录不等于全面授权扣客户款；重要操作前核对收件人、商务条款及权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 区分读取草稿私有更新和明确发送，账单记录不授权未审核扣款承诺。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ignition manages practice-client workflows across clients, proposals, forms, invoices, payments, services and templates. The public description distinguishes reading, draft creation, private updates and explicit client-send actions for proposals, forms or invoices. A draft is not sent automatically, and managing payment-related records is not blanket authority to charge a client. Review exact recipients, commercial terms and account permissions before a consequential action.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找有空档的本地维修工
使文本更自然、检测和排版
plugins.overview_zh: IHate.ai Humanaizer 提供简短改写预览和变化标记、自然度评分及 Markdown 结构整理；完整改写、并排差异和导出在网站。文字像人类的评分不能可靠证明作者身份或违规，改写后仍需审核事实与引文，不应把检测结果当作定论。
plugins.requirements_zh: 聊天仅预览，完整改写差异导出在网站；检测自然度不证明作者身份。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IHate.ai Humanaizer offers a short rewrite preview with highlighted changes, a naturalness score and Markdown formatting for messy drafts. Full rewrites, side-by-side differences and export are accessed on ihate.ai. A score about how human prose sounds is not reliable proof of who authored it or evidence of misconduct. Review factual meaning and citations after rewriting rather than using detection output as a definitive judgment.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索全球七千多家酒店
plugins.overview_zh: IHG Hotels & Resorts 根据地点、预算和旅行目的搜索比较旗下酒店，再转 IHG.com 完成预订。发布者称覆盖七千多酒店、百余国家及会员优惠积分，但数量和权益不等于所有人通用资格；预订前核对日期、总费、取消与会员条件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 在 IHG.com 预订，数量权益属发布者声明，依实际库存及会员价格条款。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IHG Hotels & Resorts searches and compares its hotel portfolio from a description of location, budget or travel purpose, then sends users to IHG.com to complete a reservation. The publisher describes more than 7,000 hotels across over 100 countries and member-rate/reward benefits. Those figures and benefits are listing claims, not universal eligibility; check actual dates, final charges, cancellation conditions and membership terms before booking.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找全球 IT 工作
plugins.overview_zh: iitjobs 按职位、技能、经验、地点和工作方式搜索全球 IT 职位，展示公司、要求及已提供薪资，可细化分页后到原链接申请。搜索免费无需账户，不等于投递；发送个人文件前应核对岗位时效、雇主真实性及资格。
plugins.requirements_zh: 搜索免费无需账户，到网站申请，薪资有才展示，未独立核实雇主。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: iitjobs searches its global IT-job index by role, skills, experience, location and work arrangement, with job title, company, requirements and salary when supplied. Users can refine and paginate results and follow the direct posting link to apply. Searching is free without an account. Search results are not applications, and listed freshness, employer legitimacy and eligibility should be verified before sending personal documents.

plugins.overview_zh: iLands.io 按地区、预算、规划状态、风险类别和投资期限搜索比较土地项目，提供详情及术语说明，辅助整理符合偏好的选项。这些只是研究输入，不独立核实产权、不保证规划获批或提供投资建议；承诺前需法律、规划和财务尽调。
plugins.requirements_zh: 土地比较是研究，非产权规划核实或适当建议，仍需独立尽调。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: iLands.io searches and compares land-investment projects by region, budget, planning status, risk category and investment horizon, returning project information and explanations of key terms. It can help organize options matching stated preferences. These are research inputs, not independent title verification, guaranteed zoning approval or investment advice; land projects require legal, planning and financial due diligence before a commitment.

plugins.description_zh: 控制 ILEVIA 智能家居
plugins.overview_zh: ILEVIA 操作用户自己绑定的家居系统，包括灯、卷帘、温控、场景、排程、灌溉、受支持电视音响及能源数据，初次经二维码或序列号密钥绑定。它实际改变环境而非只看状态，尤其排程灌溉需核对设备和时间；不意味着可访问他人系统。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅本人 ILEVIA、二维码或序列号密钥绑定，设备排程有现实影响，本次未设置。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ILEVIA operates the user's own linked home-automation installation, covering lights, shutters, thermostats, scenes, schedules, irrigation, supported TVs/speakers and energy information. Initial linking uses a QR code or serial/key flow. It can change the physical environment rather than merely report status; device scope and timing need review, especially for schedules or irrigation. The description does not establish access to other people's installations.

plugins.requirements_zh: B12 精确 ID 条目，尺寸一致属发布者声明，可选网站和上传另行操作。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: This B12 Image Generator creates website-oriented images at target dimensions, including hero, social-preview and headshot formats, and aims to keep batches visually consistent. It supplies descriptive alt text and filenames and avoids text baked into pictures. An optional B12 website can use matching colors, with image upload as a separate step. This is distinct from the other same-named catalog entry; exact dimensions, rights and generation quality still need verification.

plugins.overview_zh: 这个 The Doers Firm 的 Image Generator 是多技能视觉流程，涵盖缩略图、标志、favicon、插画、三维风格、商品图、海报和编辑，保留文字约束并返回提示词或生成素材。精确 ID 来源将其与 B12 网站图片插件区分；真正生成依赖工具，返回提示词不代表已渲染图片。
plugins.requirements_zh: The Doers Firm 精确 ID，非 B12；按宿主工具可能只返回提示词或素材。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: This Image Generator from The Doers Firm is a multi-skill visual workflow for thumbnails, logos, favicons, illustrations, 3D-style imagery, product visuals, posters and edits. It chooses a workflow, preserves stated text/constraints and returns prompts or generated assets suited to the use case. The exact-ID source distinguishes it from B12's website-image plugin. Actual generation depends on available tools; a prompt deliverable is not necessarily a rendered image.

plugins.overview_zh: ImageToCode 从提供或生成的视觉参考出发，分析布局外观并尽可能实现匹配前端。它是参考到代码流程，不是图片素材库；正文未限定框架、部署服务或像素级保证，响应式、无障碍、功能及复现权利需另核。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需视觉参考和实现工具，保真响应式及复现权利须审。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ImageToCode starts with a supplied or generated visual reference, analyzes its layout and appearance and implements matching frontend code as closely as practical. It is a reference-to-implementation workflow rather than a general image library. The description does not specify a framework, deployment service or pixel-perfect guarantee; responsive behavior, accessibility, functionality and rights to reproduce the reference require separate checks.

plugins.overview_zh: Imagina RPG 管理世界创作，包括创建、编辑、审阅、调试旅程及所选精确 ID 索引描述的分析，辅助维护叙事内容和检查体验路线。访问受账户世界及权限限制，创作修改不只是建议；未证明公开发布或游戏内购买能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 受世界连接权限限制，索引列示分析范围不同，未实测安装功能。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Imagina RPG manages authoring workflows for game worlds: create, edit or review worlds, debug journeys and inspect world analytics as described in the selected exact-ID indexed source. It can help maintain narrative content and diagnose a player's route through a designed experience. The account's available worlds and permissions constrain access; authoring changes are not merely suggestions, and the description does not establish public publishing or gameplay purchases.

plugins.overview_zh: ImagineArt 生成图片、视频、音乐等创意，编辑已有媒体，并在工作区保存可复用商品、角色、模特和设置，需账户且消耗套餐积分。另一同 ID 索引补充：Adobe/Canva/Blender 流程需自有应用或集成，参考照仅用本人或同意成年人；媒体由第三方 AI 处理，质量和权利仍需审核。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需账户工作区积分，参考经第三方 AI；限本人/同意成人照，Adobe/Canva/Blender 应用集成另需。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ImagineArt generates images, video, music and creative assets, edits existing media and keeps reusable products, presenters, models and settings in workspace folders. It requires an account and consumes plan credits. A second same-ID index adds important limits: related Adobe/Canva/Blender workflows need their own apps or integrations, and reference photos should depict oneself or consenting adults. Reference media is processed by third-party AI providers; quality and usage rights still require review.

plugins.description_zh: 创建和编辑精致视觉素材
plugins.overview_zh: Imago 将提示词、参考、截图、文档或数据转成海报、图解、界面、幻灯及局部编辑，强调直接视觉输出、保留要求细节，并用核实数字而非编造数据。这些是流程目标，不是独立准确保证；仍需检查文字、数据呈现、编辑保真及宿主生图能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 依赖生图工具及事实来源，需检查文字数字引用和编辑保留。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Imago turns prompts, references, screenshots, documents or data into visual outputs such as posters, diagrams, interfaces, slides and focused image edits. It emphasizes direct visuals, preserving requested details and using verified source numbers for factual graphics rather than inventing data. These are workflow commitments, not independent accuracy guarantees; inspect text legibility, data representation and edit fidelity, and confirm the host has the needed generation tools.

plugins.description_zh: 受治理且适合 AI 使用的知识
plugins.overview_zh: iManage Work 连接受治理文档，搜索读取、整理、查看工作区文件夹、上传更新，操作受权限约束且可审计，无需批量复制。它并非全只读，更新会影响业务记录；应遵守文档治理，核对工作区版本，不把安全宣传当作独立审计结论。
plugins.requirements_zh: iManage 权限约束可审计，上传更新属写入，需核治理和版本。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: iManage Work connects governed documents for searching, reading, organization, workspace/folder inspection, uploads and updates. Operations are permission-bound and auditable, with content accessed in iManage rather than requiring bulk replication. This is not purely read-only: updates can affect matter or business records. Respect document governance, verify the selected workspace and version, and do not treat a security-oriented product description as independently audited assurance.

plugins.overview_zh: IMEB - Eva Buchholz 以地图查找慕尼黑及周边精选住宅和投资房，比较位置、交通设施及社区，并提供联系当地专家的入口。显示开发者为 Wordliner GmbH，不同于中介品牌；浏览不证明产权、库存、已完成交易服务或投资适合。
plugins.requirements_zh: 慕尼黑精选房，开发者 Wordliner 与中介品牌不同，不保证交易产权。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IMEB - Eva Buchholz offers map-based discovery of selected residential and investment properties in Munich and nearby communities. It helps compare location, infrastructure and neighborhood characteristics and provides a route to the local real-estate expert. The app's displayed developer is Wordliner GmbH, distinct from the brokerage branding. Browsing does not establish a verified title, guaranteed availability, transaction service or investment suitability.

plugins.description_zh: 根据 IMEI 识别手机
plugins.description_en: Identify any phone by its IMEI
plugins.overview_zh: IMEI Checker by Kelpom 根据十五位 IMEI 查询手机/平板型号，提供可用商品名、品牌厂商和型号，使用内部 TAC 缓存及外部提供方备用查询。它识别设备类型，不识别主人或位置；未证明可查失窃黑名单、保修、真伪或设备当前持有者。
plugins.requirements_zh: 十五位 IMEI 仅型号查询，不判断主人位置黑名单保修或真伪。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: IMEI Checker by Kelpom uses a 15-digit IMEI to identify a phone or tablet model, returning marketing name, brand/manufacturer and model number when available. It relies on an internal TAC cache with a provider-backed fallback. This identifies a device type, not its owner or physical location. The description does not establish theft/blacklist status, warranty, authenticity or that a device with that identifier is currently in the user's possession.

plugins.overview_zh: Immo der VR Bank Rhein-Neckar 以地图展示莱茵-内卡地区精选住宅、公寓、土地和投资房，比较城市设施及社区并联系当地专业人员。正文混有中介公司介绍，显示开发者 Wordliner GmbH；地图发现不是银行服务、核实估值、购房或法律状态证明，具体向责任机构确认。
plugins.requirements_zh: 莱茵内卡房源发现，开发者 Wordliner，不是银行账户服务或核验投资评估。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Immo der VR Bank Rhein-Neckar maps selected homes, apartments, land and investment properties across the Rhine-Neckar region, helping compare municipalities, infrastructure and neighborhoods and contact local real-estate professionals. The page mixes a brokerage/company description with the app, and its displayed developer is Wordliner GmbH. Map discovery is not a banking service, verified valuation, property purchase or proof of legal status; confirm details with the responsible agency.

plugins.description_zh: 房产买卖平台（原文自称第一）
plugins.description_en: The N.1 for selling and buying
plugins.overview_zh: Immobiliare.it 描述意大利买卖、租赁和拍卖房搜索，可按城市社区或地图区域及价格、面积、房间设施筛选，也可收藏隐藏、记笔记、保存搜索通知并跨端同步。它不是成交或房源准确保证；需核对账户条件、通知同意及当前法律商务情况。
plugins.requirements_zh: 描述意大利房源及保存搜索通知，需核账户同意、库存和交易条款。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Immobiliare.it describes Italian sale, rental and auction listing search by city, neighborhood or drawn map area, with filters for price, size, rooms and features. It also describes saving/hiding listings, personal notes, saved-search notifications and synchronization across app/web devices. These are publisher-listed workflows, not a completed deal or guaranteed listing accuracy; check account requirements, notification consent and the property's current legal and commercial conditions.

plugins.overview_zh: Immobilien Franzen 以互动地图展示德国埃菲尔及特里尔地区的住宅、公寓和土地，方便先比较位置、周边基础设施和居住区域，再联系当地房产专家。它侧重精选区域房源与咨询，是本地找房入口，而非全球房源搜索服务。
plugins.requirements_zh: 覆盖重点是埃菲尔和特里尔。公开页没有证明可在对话中完成买卖、融资或法律审查；房源实际可用性、费用和账户要求未明确说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Immobilien Franzen presents houses, apartments and land in Germany's Eifel and Trier area on an interactive map. It helps users compare locations, surrounding infrastructure and residential areas before contacting local real-estate specialists. It can inspect campaign or mission KPIs, call operators, call states, activity timelines, appointment results and working-time indicators, helping teams understand performance without modifying the underlying operation. Its focus is the user's existing JobPhoning account, including outsourced prospecting work.

plugins.overview_zh: Jobs by Workable 将公开职位搜索与可选的个人求职工具结合。无需登录即可按岗位、地点、办公方式、雇佣类型、发布时间和公司查询，并阅读职位及公司详情。连接账户后，可获得个性化推荐、查看已提交申请、更新个人档案及撤回申请。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公开搜索无需认证，但个人档案和申请管理需要登录授权。页面明确不支持提交新申请、候选人排名或作出雇佣决定；撤回会改变已有申请，不能与纯查询操作混为一谈。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jobs by Workable combines public job discovery with optional account-specific jobseeker tools. Anyone can search using role, location, workplace arrangement, employment type, recency and company and read job/company details. After connecting an account, users can obtain personal recommendations, review submitted applications, update their profile and withdraw an existing application.

plugins.overview_zh: JobsDXB.com 查找阿联酋职位，也包括向阿联酋求职者开放的远程岗位，可提供完整招聘说明及申请方式，方便比较工作要求与地区适配性。薪资仅在雇主公开提供时显示。
plugins.requirements_zh: 覆盖以阿联酋为主，远程资格需逐条确认；未公布的薪资不会据此估算。页面未承诺自动申请、已核验的雇主审查、签证担保或覆盖全部空缺职位。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JobsDXB.com searches jobs in the United Arab Emirates, including remote positions open to applicants in the UAE. It returns full job postings and instructions for applying, helping users compare role requirements and location suitability. Salary information is included only when the employer has disclosed it.

plugins.overview_zh: JobsPipe 提供实时职位搜索，发布者称汇集 30 多个招聘管理系统和职位平台，并可识别公司的技术栈，便于结合雇主所用技术进行求职研究。公开正文较简短，没有逐一列明全部来源和字段。
plugins.requirements_zh: 来源数量和实时性是发布者陈述，不保证每个职位或技术信息均为最新。页面未说明自动申请、具体更新服务等级、价格或账户权益。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JobsPipe provides live job search across a publisher-described collection of more than 30 applicant-tracking systems and job boards. It also describes detecting a company's technology stack, allowing job research to be considered alongside the technologies an employer uses. The verified listing is concise and does not enumerate all sources or fields.

plugins.overview_zh: JobTread 将建筑业务记录接入对话，页面涵盖创建或更新项目、查看状态、估算条目和预算对实际支出、查看日程及里程碑，以及查询联系人、供应商、沟通、施工日志和文件。它侧重协同已有项目资料，而不是替代底层项目管理系统。
plugins.requirements_zh: 功能通过已认证 API 运作，只能使用账户明确获准的访问范围。查看与修改项目记录是不同操作，写入需相应授权；具体字段、套餐上限及商业条款未完整说明。
plugins.detail_source_type: 官方同ID索引完整公开说明
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JobTread brings construction-business records into conversation. The page describes creating or updating jobs, reviewing status, estimate lines and budget-versus-actual figures, reviewing schedules and milestones, and consulting contacts, vendors, communications, daily logs and documents. It is aimed at coordinating existing construction project information rather than replacing the underlying project system.

plugins.overview_zh: Joby by joblet 是对话式职位搜索入口，用户提供职位名称或关键词，浏览当前职位卡片，再通过招聘信息到外部流程继续申请。它定位于 Joblet 体系中的职位发现，而非完整的招聘管理平台。
plugins.requirements_zh: 申请在聊天列表之外继续。页面未确认自动投递、申请状态同步、筛选保证或精确市场覆盖；实际机会取决于底层招聘信息。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Joby by joblet is a conversational job-search interface. Users provide a job title or keywords, review current job cards and follow a posting to continue the application elsewhere. It is a focused discovery workflow within the Joblet ecosystem rather than a general recruiting-management platform.

plugins.overview_zh: Jockey by TwelveLabs 可按自然语言在已连接的照片和视频库中寻找人物、地点或片段，并通过 Jockey Interactive Language 展示带引用的回答和可播放结果，减少逐个翻找素材的工作。发布者说明其底层使用 TwelveLabs 的 Marengo 与 Pegasus 视频理解模型。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要连接有权访问的媒体库。搜索是模型结果，不保证身份核验准确或穷尽全部目标；页面未列出存储服务、额度或格式限制，也不意味着可以访问未连接的素材库。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jockey by TwelveLabs searches a connected photo and video library for people, places or moments described in natural language. Answers can include citations and playable results rendered through its Jockey Interactive Language, helping users locate relevant footage rather than manually browse a whole collection. The publisher identifies TwelveLabs Marengo and Pegasus as the underlying video-understanding models.

plugins.overview_zh: JoeSpeaking 围绕当前雅思口语题目和个人练习历史组织备考，可区分已练与未练话题，回看录音或实时对话练习记录、评分及反馈，从而选择下一步练习重点。它重视持续练习记录，而非一次性的通用语言回答。
plugins.requirements_zh: 评分与反馈是练习辅助，不是官方雅思成绩或考试结果保证。可用内容取决于用户的练习记录；页面本身未证明连接器能启动新录音，也未明确存储、订阅或音频格式限制。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JoeSpeaking organizes IELTS speaking preparation around current question sets and a learner's practice history. It helps distinguish practiced from unpracticed topics and review saved recordings or live-conversation sessions, scores and feedback to choose the next practice focus. The emphasis is continuity across speaking practice rather than a one-off generic language answer.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找 Johns Hopkins 的工作
plugins.overview_zh: Johns Hopkins Careers 可按职位名称或关键词、地点和薪资条件寻找工作机会，供用户浏览后通过 View & Apply 进入外部招聘网站申请。它是面向 Johns Hopkins 求职机会的发现入口。
plugins.requirements_zh: 正式申请在链接的招聘网站完成。搜索结果不保证申请资格、薪资信息一定存在，或申请时职位仍开放；本次未确认聊天内投递或作出雇佣决定的能力。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Johns Hopkins Careers searches career opportunities using job title or keywords, location and salary criteria. It presents roles for review and provides a View & Apply route to the external career site, making it a discovery front end for jobseekers interested in Johns Hopkins opportunities.

plugins.overview_zh: JoinLayer 用于管理已连接的数据传输流程，可检查连接、创建和验证管道、预览转换或补充后的记录，再运行或停止已批准的传输。它还提供运行监控、失败诊断及容量和用量信息，覆盖准备和后续运营环节。
plugins.requirements_zh: 预览数据不等于执行传输。启动运行或修改流程需要相关系统权限及批准；公开描述未具体列明连接器覆盖、传输额度、补充数据费用或保存规则。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JoinLayer manages connected data-transfer pipelines. Users can inspect connections, create and validate a pipeline, preview transformed or enriched records, and then run or stop approved transfers. It also provides run monitoring, failure diagnosis and capacity or usage information, supporting both preparation and operational follow-up.

plugins.overview_zh: Joinways 为活动场地提供 CRM 与预订管理支持，涉及咨询和资格判断、报价、可用档期、预订状态、宴会活动单资料、后续邮件以及销售和已确认收入分析，面向婚礼、企业活动等场地业务。
plugins.requirements_zh: 私人场地资料需要相应账户访问权。准备报价或跟进内容不等于自动获准发送或形成有约束力的预订。收入分析取决于已有记录；页面未证明收款、供应商保证或完整会计处理能力。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Joinways assists event venues with CRM and booking administration. It can handle inquiries and qualification, quotes, availability and booking status, prepare banquet event order information, support follow-up email work, and analyze sales or confirmed revenue. The workflow is intended for venues serving events such as weddings and corporate functions.

plugins.overview_zh: Jooble 可按关键词、地点和工作类型搜索职位。发布者称汇集全球数千个来源，适合广泛发现机会，减少逐个平台查询的工作。公开描述没有进一步说明聊天内申请流程。
plugins.requirements_zh: 全球聚合不保证覆盖完整、实时有效或没有重复。申请方式和资格以具体招聘信息为准；页面未说明自动投递、雇主核验以及精确访问或收费条件。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jooble searches job opportunities using keywords, location and job type. The publisher describes aggregation from thousands of sources worldwide, making it useful for broad initial discovery instead of searching each source separately. The description does not detail a subsequent in-chat application workflow.

plugins.overview_zh: JoomPulse 使用结构化数据仓库回答有关巴西 MercadoLivre 的自然语言问题，涉及商品、类目、卖家、价格、评价和关键词，支持竞争研究及类目、商品表现分析，无需用户编写 SQL。列出的流程包括寻找增长较快的子类目、新上架且已有销量的商品，以及需求高但评分较低的产品。
plugins.requirements_zh: 页面描述的是巴西 MercadoLivre，并非全球所有电商平台。数据仓库覆盖、更新延迟及指标属于估计还是直接观测仍需确认；价格和额度未说明。分析发现的机会不保证销售增长或投资回报。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JoomPulse answers natural-language questions about MercadoLivre Brazil using a structured data warehouse. It covers product listings, categories, sellers, prices, reviews and keywords for competitor research and category or listing-performance analysis without requiring the user to write SQL. Listed workflows include finding fast-growing subcategories, new selling products and high-demand products with weak ratings.

plugins.overview_zh: Jotform 可在对话中创建和调整在线表单，包括字段、顺序、布局、设置与主题，也可查找管理表单、分享以收集回复，并按日期、状态、关键词或字段筛选和汇总提交内容。调查、测验、报名回执、订单、同意书及预约请求都是表单场景，实时回复视图可用于比较和观察趋势。
plugins.requirements_zh: 表单和回复访问受已连接账户权限限制。付款或预约表单本身不证明已完成付款或订位，同意书也不自动满足所有法律要求。提交上限、付费功能和数据处理方式取决于实际服务配置。
plugins.detail_source_type: 官方同ID索引完整公开说明
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jotform creates and refines online forms in conversation, including fields, order, layout, settings and themes. It can find and manage forms, share them for response collection, and filter or summarize submissions by dates, status, keywords or fields. Surveys, quizzes, RSVPs, orders, consent forms and booking requests are examples of form workflows, with live response views supporting comparison and trend review.

plugins.description_zh: 用 AI 构建无代码应用
plugins.overview_zh: Jotform Apps 可从对话需求构建无代码应用，涵盖布局和品牌样式、组件与表单、用户和权限、数据及付款相关组件，以及分享或发布。示例包括内部门户、活动应用、订购流程、会员服务和仪表盘。
plugins.requirements_zh: 功能受账户权限和服务权益限制，具体额度与价格未说明。添加付款组件不等于已经扣款；这里的发布也不证明自动上架苹果或 Google 应用商店，用户访问权限仍需有意配置。
plugins.detail_source_type: 官方同ID索引完整公开说明
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jotform Apps builds no-code apps from a conversational brief. The described tools cover app layouts and branding, widgets and forms, users and permissions, data and payment-related components, and sharing or publication. Examples include internal portals, event apps, ordering, membership services and dashboards assembled from these components.

plugins.latest_detail_attempt_status: 只找到条目线索 / 详情未取得

plugins.overview_zh: Joti 将训练计划与个人历史记录连接，可读取用户自己的训练、已完成活动，以及训练量、连续性、个人最佳成绩和主要动作等汇总指标，并访问约 800 个动作及用户自建动作的资料库。写入功能包括新建或复制训练计划，以及管理日历中的训练安排。
plugins.requirements_zh: 连接器不能修改或删除已有训练的动作和组数，也不能开始、记录或更改实际训练，这些操作仍在 Joti 应用中完成。身体测量和进度照片不在范围内；只能读取本人拥有的数据，写入可在 Activity 动态中撤销。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Joti connects workout planning with the user's own training history. It can read workouts, completed sessions and aggregate measures such as training volume, consistency, personal bests and top lifts, alongside a shared exercise library of roughly 800 exercises and the user's custom entries. Supported writes create or duplicate workouts and manage scheduled-workout calendar entries.

plugins.overview_zh: JotScout 打开本地富文本记事本，支持 Markdown 快捷格式、文字样式和颜色；可为不同项目建立文件，并通过可收起的抽屉切换。笔记保存在设备上，可单独导出 Markdown，或把全部文件备份成 JSON，再通过导入或粘贴 JSON 手动迁移到其他设备或网址。
plugins.requirements_zh: 聊天工具仅负责打开编辑器，不能读取、修改或同步本地笔记，也不能列出 ChatGPT 项目。项目名称需手动导入；若宿主不支持下载文件，应复制导出文本自行保存，界面位置也由宿主决定。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JotScout opens a local rich-text notepad with Markdown shortcuts, formatting and colors. Users organize separate files for projects and switch among them in a collapsible drawer. Notes are saved on the device, with individual Markdown export or a JSON backup of all files, plus import or pasted JSON for manually transferring notes between devices or website addresses.

plugins.description_zh: 在 AI 对话之间传递背景信息
plugins.overview_zh: Jotter 在用户明确要求时保存私人笔记或交接摘要，之后可在后续对话或其他支持的 AI 助手中读取，并提供关键词搜索、列表和删除。它更像由用户主动管理的上下文笔记本，而不是自动记录所有聊天内容。
plugins.requirements_zh: 保存和删除都由明确请求驱动，页面排除了自动保存及自动删除。跨助手使用取决于已连接的 Jotter 账户及受支持集成；保存期限、容量、导出选项和价格未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jotter saves a private note or a handoff summary when explicitly asked, then lets the user retrieve that context in a later conversation or another supported AI assistant. It includes keyword search, note listing and deletion, providing a deliberate memory notebook rather than automatically recording every conversation.

plugins.overview_zh: Jotterful 管理已有账户中的 Markdown 笔记本，可列出、搜索和读取内容，添加、移除或编辑笔记，并新建笔记本；嵌入式界面支持撤销修改和移动笔记。AI 归档会依据提交的笔记及现有笔记本资料决定合适位置。
plugins.requirements_zh: 私人笔记需要账户授权。归档会把提交的笔记及已有笔记本背景交给服务的 AI 处理，移动操作也会处理笔记和目标信息。建议归档位置与获准实际写入应区分，并应了解数据处理条款。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jotterful manages Markdown notes in an existing account's jotpads. Users can list, search and read pads, add or remove notes, edit content and create new pads, with embedded controls for undoing changes or moving a note. AI-assisted filing uses the submitted note and existing pad information to suggest its destination.

plugins.description_zh: 升级 AI 骑行教练体验
plugins.description_en: Level up your AI cycling coach
plugins.overview_zh: Joules 协助骑行者回顾训练并维护可执行的周计划，可按生活安排调整训练周、记录已完成训练，并保留比赛和教练背景供后续讨论。重点是让计划、实际训练和变化的日程保持衔接。
plugins.requirements_zh: 页面未确认具体码表集成、生理测量准确性或医疗资质。训练建议不等于医疗评估；账户要求、导入格式、套餐和使用上限未详细说明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Joules supports cyclists in reviewing training and maintaining a practical weekly plan. It can adjust a training week around life events, record completed sessions and keep race or coaching context available for future discussions. The described benefit is continuity between planning, actual workouts and changing commitments.

plugins.overview_zh: Journaling with Medome 可建立多个日记本，并通过自然语言添加记录，持续整理想法、经历、目标和反思；示例包括个人成长、工作进展、健康历程及旅行。本次确认的功能是在 ChatGPT 中维护个人文字记录。
plugins.requirements_zh: 健康日记示例不代表临床服务，也不证明能读取医疗档案。页面未说明导出、删除、加密、订阅限制或外部健康数据集成；敏感日记内容应按服务的实际条款审慎提供。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Journaling with Medome creates multiple journals and adds entries through natural conversation. It organizes thoughts, experiences, goals and reflections over time, with examples such as personal development, work progress, health journeys and travel. The verified workflow is maintaining a personal written record within ChatGPT.

plugins.overview_zh: JourneyBay 将旅行整理成逐日行程，可搜索并保存地点、创建或编辑旅行、从聊天导入计划，并协助生成和调整活动，同时提供旅行及签证相关信息，适合把零散讨论变成结构化计划。
plugins.requirements_zh: 修改行程不证明已预订酒店、机票或活动。签证信息应向有关官方机构核实，不能作为资格判定；账户条件、实时数据覆盖和费用未说明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JourneyBay organizes trips into day-by-day itineraries. It can search and save places, create or edit trips, import a travel plan from a chat and help generate or adjust activities, while also offering travel and visa-related information. This makes it useful for turning a loose conversation into a structured planning record.

plugins.overview_zh: Jourvanta 处理已连接账户中的过去、当前和未来旅行，可查看行程及预订参考号、保存地点和想法、创建或编辑定时活动，并发现计划缺口。它管理的是旅行记录和规划，重大变更或删除需要确认。
plugins.requirements_zh: 连接涉及浏览器登录和授权。在 Jourvanta 修改或删除记录，并不等于向航空公司、酒店或其他供应商订位或取消预订。访问限于授权账户，商业条款和同步保证未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jourvanta works with a connected account's past, current and future trips. Users can review itineraries and booking references, save places and ideas, create or edit scheduled activities, and identify planning gaps. It manages travel records and plans while requiring confirmation for major changes or deletion.

plugins.overview_zh: Joy 支持婚礼网站、场地研究、宾客名单、出席回执和日程安排，把多种婚礼筹备资料放入对话式流程，便于一起管理人员、信息和时间，而不必将每项工作拆成独立文档。
plugins.requirements_zh: 宾客和活动资料需要相应账户访问权。场地研究和计划日程不等于已订场地、签订供应商合同或完成付款；页面未确认价格、宾客数量限制或第三方预订保证。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Joy supports wedding planning through wedding websites, venue research, guest-list management, RSVP handling and schedules. It brings several planning records into a conversational workflow so couples can organize people, information and timing together rather than treat each task as a separate document.

plugins.description_zh: 比较 JSON 并清晰显示差异
plugins.overview_zh: JSON Change Lens 比较两个 JSON 配置或 API 响应，重视语义差异：忽略对象键顺序、识别类型和小数精度变化、按唯一标识匹配数组元素，并可排除时间戳等易变字段。结果可输出为带原始路径的 Markdown 或 JSON 报告，便于审查。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要 Python 3.9 或更高版本及终端或代码环境。本地处理无需联网，仅在要求时写出新文件；不会应用补丁，也不能在缺少接口契约时证明 API 兼容性。页面将其作为社区工具介绍。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JSON Change Lens compares two JSON configurations or API responses with attention to semantic differences. It ignores object-key ordering, detects type and decimal-precision changes, can match array entries by a unique identifier and exclude selected volatile keys such as timestamps. Reports can be written as Markdown or JSON with original paths for review.

plugins.overview_zh: Jsonify 可创建一次性或定时运行的网页数据采集流程，检查结构化结果、查询比较或导出数据，并诊断源网页变化导致的采集故障。场景包括价格、菜单、房产、职位及新闻数据；数据集、仪表盘和来源记录可跨对话保留。
plugins.requirements_zh: 采集和存储受账户及套餐限制。定时任务不保证持续访问任意网站，页面变化和访问限制仍会影响结果。本次未确认对所有网站的采集许可、精确额度或数据准确性保证。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jsonify creates web-data collection pipelines that run once or on a schedule. It can inspect collected structured records, answer questions over them, compare or export data, and diagnose changes in source pages that break collection. Example uses include price, menu, property, job and news datasets, with persistent datasets, dashboards and provenance across conversations.

plugins.description_zh: 通过智能体和洞察寻找候选人
plugins.overview_zh: Juicebox 协助招聘寻访，查找候选人并提供相关分析，也涉及用量、项目和外联流程，可从职位描述启动寻访代理。其重点是组织搜索和候选人研究，而不是证明具备完整的录用决策能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 私人项目和外联受账户权限限制。找到个人资料不等于建议作出雇佣决定，页面也未证明背景调查准确性或未经批准联系他人的权限。价格及详细额度未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Juicebox supports recruiting-sourcing work by finding candidates and surfacing related insights. The described interface includes usage information, projects and outreach workflows, and can launch sourcing agents from a job description. Its scope is helping organize a search and candidate research rather than establishing a complete hiring decision process.

plugins.overview_zh: JuicyProfit Analytics 将 Shopify 业务表现与 JuicyProfit 的财务和营销记录结合，可分析收入、广告支出、损益视图、订单成本与利润率、商品明细和归因触点，帮助从服务已有数据解释盈利表现及营销贡献。
plugins.requirements_zh: 结果依赖已连接记录、成本完整度和归因假设，不是独立审计的财务报表，也不能替代会计核验。私人数据需要账户访问权；精确更新频率、套餐限制和价格未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JuicyProfit Analytics connects Shopify-related business performance with JuicyProfit's financial and marketing records. It can examine revenue, advertising spend, profit-and-loss views, order costs and margins, item-level information and attribution touchpoints. It is designed to help explain profitability and marketing contribution from the data already held in the service.

plugins.overview_zh: JuicyLucy Ads 可从需求或参考广告制作视频及静态广告变体，生成首帧和视频素材、保留或改变指定元素、按 Meta、Instagram 或 TikTok 版位剪辑、制作获准语言的本地化批次、检查文案和质量，并导出可追溯命名的文件。品牌事实、视觉风格和禁止宣称内容来自关联的品牌技能。
plugins.requirements_zh: 必须使用 macOS 上的 Codex，明确不能在 ChatGPT 网页或手机中使用。本地合成、剪辑和导出无需 JuicyLucy 账户，但素材生成需要；安装流程会在每次下载前询问。本地完成渲染，生成提示、设置和必要参考素材会传给服务及供应商。可选 Meta 分析须授权且只读，文案检查不保证广告审核通过。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JuicyLucy Ads produces video and static-ad variants from a brief or reference creative. It can generate first frames and footage, retain or alter selected creative elements, cut to Meta, Instagram or TikTok placement specifications, localize approved language batches, check copy and quality, and export traceably named files. Brand facts, visual style and prohibited claims come from an associated brand skill.

plugins.overview_zh: Julien Accounting Tutor 用于管理会计学习，可逐题讲解和练习、提供测验与学习指南、辅助备考并反馈，重点是帮助理解方法，而不是替用户经营账簿或处理企业财务业务。
plugins.requirements_zh: 学习讲解应与课程要求和原始教材核对。页面未证明专业会计意见、税务申报、财务记录访问或考试成绩保证，访问条件和价格亦未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Julien Accounting Tutor teaches managerial accounting through guided explanations and practice. It can work through one question at a time, offer quizzes and study guides, prepare for tests and give feedback, making it a learning companion for understanding methods rather than an operational bookkeeping service.

plugins.overview_zh: Julius Homework 根据提供的题目、笔记和阅读材料生成讲解、例题及学习资料，可制作测验、闪卡和练习计划，利用 Python 计算或绘图，并处理文字及可访问的 PDF 等文件。学习成果可生成文档或文本、CSV 闪卡资料，并保存到用户个人 Julius 资料库。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要相应 Julius 账户及可访问输入。除非用户要求公开发布，内容保持私密。生成解答和计算仍需按题目核对；工具不保证学术正确，也不授权违反课程规则提交作业。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Julius Homework turns supplied problems, notes and readings into explanations, worked examples and study material. It can create quizzes, flashcards and practice plans, use Python for calculations or charts, and work from text or available PDF/document inputs. Study outputs include documents and text/CSV flashcard material that can be saved to the user's personal Julius library.

plugins.overview_zh: Julius Math 使用 Python 处理数值和符号数学，包括方程、微积分、概率、线性代数、绘图和模拟。统计流程涉及 t 检验、卡方、方差分析及非参数方法，并关注假设、p 值、置信区间和效应量。可把可复用计算与说明整理成文档或 HTML 成果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要账户和可用输入。定义域、单位、精度和统计假设必须核对，算出数值不代表已独立验证。个人 Julius 资料库成果默认不公开，只有明确要求才公开发布；精确计算额度未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Julius Math uses Python for numerical and symbolic mathematical work, including equations, calculus, probability, linear algebra, graphing and simulations. Statistical workflows include tests such as t-tests, chi-square, ANOVA and nonparametric alternatives, with attention to assumptions, p-values, confidence intervals and effect sizes. Reusable calculations and explanations can be packaged as documents or HTML outputs.

plugins.description_zh: AI 演示文稿和幻灯片制作
plugins.overview_zh: Julius Slides 可把提示、提纲或提供的文档转为可编辑 PowerPoint，包括标题、支持的图表、表格和演讲备注；也可调整已有演示的布局、顺序和品牌样式，并保存到个人 Julius 资料库。相应流程还可输出 HTML 幻灯片或讲义。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要账户及可访问源文件，修改范围取决于支持的演示功能。从 PDF 重建不保证像素级复刻；除非要求发布，成果保持私密。字体、特效或复杂结构不能假定完全转换，仍需检查。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Julius Slides converts a prompt, outline or supplied document into an editable PowerPoint deck, with titles, supported charts, tables and speaker notes. It can revise layouts, ordering or branding in an existing deck and save resulting files to the personal Julius library. Optional outputs include an HTML slideshow or handout when supported by the requested workflow.

plugins.overview_zh: Jumpseat 可搜索航班、加入个人档案并更新个人航班资料，展示即将出行的计划、朋友的旅行安排及实时航班状态资源，把个人行程整理与航班信息查询结合起来。
plugins.requirements_zh: 私人档案和朋友信息取决于获准账户访问。把航班加入档案不等于购买机票或修改航空公司订单；页面未具体说明航司覆盖、状态延迟、费用或出票能力。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Jumpseat helps users track their flight plans by searching flights, adding them to a profile and updating personal flight details. It can show upcoming trips, friends' travel plans and links or resources for live flight status, combining personal trip organization with flight-information lookup.

plugins.overview_zh: JUNE 将律所案件工作与组织的案件管理资料连接，可处理案件、文件、期限、预约、任务、联系人和事实，创建或更新私人案件记录，并准备往来文书。它是基于已授权案件资料的流程助手，而非独立法律结论来源。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要有效 JUNE 账户、由组织配置的租户及相应权限。准备文书不表示已经发送或正式提交。机密案件资料须限于获准范围，期限和法律成果仍需专业复核。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: JUNE connects law-firm case work with the organization's case-management records. Users can work with cases, documents, deadlines, appointments, tasks, contacts and facts, create or update private case records and prepare correspondence. It is a workflow assistant for authorized matter information rather than an independent source of legal conclusions.

plugins.description_zh: 为你的企业提供预订服务
搜索摩洛哥法律和判决
plugins.overview_zh: Juridata 搜索摩洛哥法律资料，包括判决和法律全文，可按审判庭、年份及类别筛选，并提供较易理解的解释，帮助定位和理解相关材料。发布者称拥有数千条记录，但未证明覆盖所有司法机构和时期。
plugins.requirements_zh: 实际正文确认的是摩洛哥法律，较宽泛的地区口号不等于完整覆盖北非。重要用途应查阅原判决或现行法律；解释是研究辅助，不能替代合资格律师或保证法律正确。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Juridata searches Moroccan legal material, including full-text court decisions and laws. The description supports filtering decisions by chamber, year and category and obtaining plain-language explanations, helping researchers locate and understand relevant material. The publisher describes thousands of records, without proving exhaustive coverage of all jurisdictions or periods.

plugins.overview_zh: Juris AI by ICIDA 聚焦塞浦路斯法律研究，可搜索分析判例、最高法院资料和立法，并提供带引用的见解，帮助追溯答案依据。其定位是查找和理解法律权威资料的助手，而非司法机构或法律代理人。
plugins.requirements_zh: 重要用途前应核对引用、现行有效性和管辖适用性。页面未说明完整覆盖、更新保证、收费或专业意见责任；生成解释不构成有保证的法律建议。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Juris AI by ICIDA focuses on Cypriot legal research. It searches and analyzes case law, Supreme Court material and legislation and provides cited insights to help users trace an answer back to relevant sources. The description positions it as an aid to finding and understanding legal authority, not a court or legal representative.

plugins.description_en: Plan and track work in chat
