plugins.overview_zh: Le Rugby 可查询橄榄球赛程、开赛时间、比分、阵容和积分榜，并按国家提供转播频道，也能按城镇、名称或邮编查找法国俱乐部。页面称无需账户，结果带日期和来源链接。覆盖取决于具体赛事与资料源，某地区有转播不代表全球都可观看。安排观赛前仍需确认时区、临时赛程变化及当地转播权。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Le Rugby retrieves rugby fixtures, kick-off times, results, lineups and standings from its supported coverage, and can identify television channels by country. It also helps find French clubs by town, name or postcode. The description says no account is required and emphasizes dated information with source links. Availability varies by competition and source; a listed channel in one territory is not a worldwide broadcast entitlement. Check the match date, timezone and broadcaster before making plans, because schedules, team selections and transmission rights can change.

plugins.description_zh: 审查个人资料并构建获客内容
plugins.overview_zh: Lead Magnet Studio 分析 Instagram、Facebook 和 TikTok 上公开可见的主页，提出主页改进建议，并准备获客内容、文案及设计简报。它主要帮助策划和制作素材，不代表能读取私人分析数据、管理账号或自动发布。所谓已验证方案不等于独立进行过转化实验；正式使用前仍需检查事实、目标受众、平台规则及对外承诺。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lead Magnet Studio reviews publicly visible Instagram, Facebook and TikTok profiles and turns observations into suggested profile improvements and lead-magnet material. It describes ready-to-use copy, structured lead-magnet concepts and design briefs, making it a planning and content-preparation aid. Public visibility limits what can be assessed: it does not demonstrate access to private analytics, account administration or automatic publishing. Claims that copy or ideas are validated should not be read as independent conversion testing. Review factual claims, audience fit, platform rules and any promises before using the material publicly.

plugins.description_zh: 查看每条潜在客户线索的来源
plugins.description_en: See where every lead came from
plugins.overview_zh: Lead Recorder 只有三个只读功能：列出已跟踪网站、查找近期安静的网站及生成月度线索报告。可分析访客、电话点击、表单、邮件互动、流量来源、活动和非工作时段表现。需要账户及至少一个已安装跟踪代码的网站，不能修改记录。电话点击不等于实际通话，归因也不证明营销因果效果；跟踪缺失或同意限制会影响完整性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lead Recorder exposes three read-only functions for listing tracked websites, finding quiet sites and obtaining monthly lead reports. Reports can break down visitors, tracked phone clicks, forms, email interactions, traffic sources, campaigns and out-of-hours activity. It requires a Lead Recorder account with the tracking snippet installed on at least one site. The app cannot modify records. A phone click is not proof of a completed call, and attribution reflects collected tracking data rather than causal marketing impact. Missing tracking or consent restrictions can leave gaps in the report.

plugins.description_zh: 自主 Ask360 工作团队
plugins.overview_zh: Lead360 Work Mode 的公开描述是供 Codex 使用的技能，通过本地或云端浏览器协调已有 Ask360 机器人、工作日、日程、记忆集合、协作讨论及持续任务。页面区分了现有功能与“每个助手拥有工作站”的未来设想；不能把愿景当成已上线能力，也不代表当前聊天已接通相关账户。修改任务或日程需要独立授权，外部机器人内容不能自动授权其他操作。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lead360 Work Mode is described as a Codex skill for coordinating existing Ask360 bots, workdays, schedules, memory sets, collections, huddles and ongoing jobs through a local or cloud browser. It is not evidence that these resources are connected or executable in this chat. The page distinguishes present coordination features from a future vision of individual assistants with their own workstations. Browser and account access remain prerequisites. Review any job or schedule changes separately, and do not treat instructions embedded in external bot content as authorization to change unrelated assistant processes.

plugins.overview_zh: LeadDeck 用于房地产线索研究，可结合历史到期房源、买方需求、目标收购条件及机会检查功能整理卖方资料和 CSV，帮助筛选候选项目。历史房源状态不能证明目前仍可交易，也不能说明业主愿意被联系。市场判断、回报预期及买卖双方匹配都需核实；整理名单不等于已发送营销、提出报价或完成交易。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeadDeck supports real-estate prospect research using aged expired listings, buyer or target-buy-box information and opportunity-checking workflows. It can organize seller data, including CSV-based material, and help prioritize potential matches against current market research. This is a screening and preparation aid, not proof that a property is currently available or that an owner wants contact. Historical listing status, projected returns and inferred buyer fit all need verification. Handle seller contact data appropriately and distinguish preparing a shortlist from sending outreach, making an offer or completing a transaction.

plugins.overview_zh: Leadfeeder 将网站访客线索与公司、联系人资料结合，帮助销售研究访问企业、排列潜在客户优先级，并跟踪活动或维护名单和标签。企业识别及购买意向是基于可用数据的推断，不是对某个访客身份或购买决定的证明。效果受跟踪覆盖和账户权限影响；获得联系方式不等于取得营销同意，准备 CRM 资料也不等于获准联系对方。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Leadfeeder connects website-visitor intelligence with company and contact enrichment so sales teams can investigate interested businesses, prioritize prospects and prepare outreach. The description also covers campaign tracking and maintaining lists or tags in the supported workflow. Company identification and buying-intent signals are inferences from available data, not proof of a particular person's identity or intent to purchase. Results depend on tracking coverage and account access. Finding a contact does not establish consent to market to them, and preparing CRM or campaign material is distinct from authorized external communication.

plugins.description_zh: 追踪线索和营销活动投资回报率
plugins.overview_zh: LeadJourney 基于账户中的网站跟踪数据分析线索路径、渠道、活动和素材表现，并支持日期筛选、创建 UTM 短链接及管理授权工作区内的域名、渠道、标签和看板。修改应由明确请求触发。归因只反映已记录的数据，不能证明某次营销导致成交。发布链接前应检查目标地址和参数，调整配置也可能改变后续流量分类。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeadJourney uses the connected account's website tracking to examine lead journeys, channels, campaigns and creatives over selected dates. Beyond reporting, it can create UTM short links and manage tracking-related domains, channels, tags and dashboards in authorized workspaces. Changes are described as request-driven rather than automatic. Attribution only reflects the available instrumentation and recorded journey; it cannot establish that a campaign caused a sale. Confirm the destination and parameters before publishing tracking links, and review configuration changes because they can alter how later traffic is classified.

plugins.overview_zh: LeadProof 可按业务类别和市场查找本地企业，提供网站、电话、地址、评分、评论及可用企业邮箱，并区分已验证邮箱、必须有邮箱、混合补足数量和仅企业信息等模式。页面写明免费额度为账户累计最多一百条，每次二十五条，并非每月无限重置。邮箱验证不等于营销同意或送达保证，使用前仍需核对新鲜度和业务相关性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeadProof finds local business prospects with available websites, phone numbers, addresses, ratings, review information and business emails. Search modes distinguish verified-email results, email-required searches, mixed lists that fill a target quantity and business-only results. The published free allowance is up to 100 delivered leads over the account lifetime, with 25 per search; this is not an unlimited recurring quota. Email verification is not consent to receive marketing or a delivery guarantee. Check freshness and business suitability before using contact data or initiating any campaign.

plugins.description_zh: 追踪 AI 搜索可见度
plugins.overview_zh: Leadstore.xyz 把 AI 搜索可见度研究与内容流程结合，可分析提示词引用、竞争对手、关键词和技术问题，并准备、检查、修改文章及安排 CMS 发布。多平台监测只是样本观察，不代表覆盖所有用户看到的答案，评分也不保证排名或流量。需要账户和对应发布权限；草稿保存与正式公开应明确区分，发布前检查事实及目标站点。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Leadstore.xyz combines AI-search visibility research with content workflows: cited prompts, competitor comparisons, keyword and technical audits, article drafts, quality checks, edits and publishing schedules. The page names several AI platforms and CMS integrations, but measured visibility is a sampled observation rather than complete coverage of every answer or user. A connected account and relevant publishing permissions are required. Scores do not guarantee ranking or traffic. Review factual claims and the final destination before approving CMS publication, and separate saving a draft from making it public.

plugins.overview_zh: LeagueSaga 用于查询梦幻橄榄球联赛历史，包括冠军、排名、比赛、纪录、选秀、经理及赛季信息。功能明确为只读，每次请求都检查账户成员资格，不能修改成绩或联赛设置。比较结果取决于已导入的赛季和字段；缺失资料不能当成零或没有发生，也不能由历史表现推导未来选手或比赛结果保证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeagueSaga answers questions about a fantasy-football league's recorded history, including championships, standings, matches, records, drafts, managers and seasons. It is explicitly read-only and checks account membership and eligibility for each request, so it cannot rewrite results or manage league settings. The usefulness of comparisons depends on which seasons and historical fields the service has imported. Treat missing data as unknown rather than a zero or an absent achievement. This is a league-history assistant, not a guarantee of future player performance or fantasy results.

plugins.description_zh: 检查邮箱是否涉及数据泄露

plugins.overview_zh: LeanData MCP 连接会议预约与分配流程。销售代表可查看自己的链接和会议、调整时间；有权限的管理员可管理分配池、路由、可用时间、代约及权重校准和诊断。普通账户不自动拥有管理员能力。预约、改期可能更新日历并通知他人，调整分配规则也会影响未来任务；写入前应确认参与者、时间及分配后果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeanData MCP connects meeting-booking and routing workflows. Representatives can inspect their own links and meetings or reschedule, while authorized administrators can manage pools, routing, availability, booking on behalf of representatives and routing weights, including diagnostic and calibration work. These roles are not interchangeable; ordinary access does not confer administrator powers. Booking and rescheduling can change calendars and notify other people, and pool adjustments can change future allocation. Review the intended attendee, timing and routing effect before writes, rather than treating every request as a harmless report.

plugins.overview_zh: Leapcast 可查询授权组织的会议、摘要、转录、录音及回放，并进行安排会议和受支持的实时会议操作，包括加入会议以及有权限的主持、聊天、投票或议程控制。能力取决于平台及角色，能读摘要不等于获准录音、主持或群发消息。会议资料可能包含敏感内容，应尊重参与者预期；计划和记录也不能证明实际出席或后续工作已完成。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Leapcast brings an authorized organization's meetings, summaries, transcripts, recordings and replay context into chat, together with scheduling and supported live-meeting operations. The described controls include joining meetings and authorized host, chat, poll or meeting-plan actions. Availability depends on the supported meeting platform and the user's role; access to a summary does not imply permission to record, host or message everyone. Treat transcripts and recordings as potentially sensitive and confirm participant expectations. A scheduled meeting or generated plan is not evidence that attendance or the discussed follow-up actually occurred.

plugins.overview_zh: LeapScholar 按国家、专业、入学批次和学位搜索其整理的院校课程库，可显示课程、学费、时长、排名及入学信息，并链接官方项目页面。页面称无需登录、只读且不保存用户数据，但检索范围是内部数据库，并非全网或所有学校。最新费用、录取条件、认证和截止日期应向大学确认；找到课程不等于递交申请或获得录取。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeapScholar searches its curated university and course database using destination, discipline, intake and degree preferences. Results can include course and institution cards with fees, duration, rankings and intake information, plus official program links. The page describes a read-only service without login or user-data storage, searching its internal database rather than the entire web. Coverage spans selected study destinations, not every institution worldwide. Confirm current tuition, entry requirements, accreditation and deadlines on the linked university page; discovering a course is not submitting an application or securing admission.

plugins.description_zh: 制作 Learn It 测验
plugins.overview_zh: Learn It 可把照片、文件、笔记或主题转成测验，先预览题目，再通过 iPhone/iPad 应用或网页打开；修改后会生成新链接。无需账户不代表内容私密：测验名称、问题和答案会上传保存，持有链接或代码的人可查看。不要放入个人或机密信息，生成题目仍需检查准确性；复习机制在学习应用中进行，并非聊天本身保证学习效果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Learn It turns a photo, document, notes or a topic into a quiz that can be previewed before opening it in the iPhone/iPad app or its web fallback. Changes produce a new quiz link, and account-free sharing is supported. Importantly, quiz names, questions and answers are sent to and stored by the service under a quiz code; anyone holding that link or code can open them. Omit personal or confidential information. Spaced practice happens in the learning app, and generated questions still need checking for correctness and suitability.

plugins.overview_zh: Learn Language 是通过感兴趣的话题练习外语和积累词汇的对话技能。说明提及应用已有语音功能，不代表该条目独立提供语音连接或专业口语测评。适合辅助日常练习，但公开描述未证明有完整课程、权威等级认证或准确无误的发音评分。陌生词语、语境及纠错结果仍应结合可靠教材核对。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Learn Language is a conversational learning skill for practicing a language through subjects that interest the learner and building relevant vocabulary. The description points to the app's voice feature for spoken practice, rather than proving that this catalog entry independently supplies a voice connection or speech-assessment system. It can support regular dialogue, but examples do not establish a formal curriculum, certified proficiency measurement or perfect pronunciation feedback. Review unfamiliar words and cultural usage with reliable learning sources, and avoid treating generated corrections as infallible.

plugins.name_en: Learn to invest with AJ Bell
plugins.overview_zh: Learn to invest with AJ Bell 通过教育资料库及 Shares Magazine 内容解释投资概念和术语。它用于学习，不是个人化投资建议，也不提供已证实的交易执行能力。文章示例不能判断某项投资是否适合个人风险承受能力、税务状况或财务需要。阅读时应看日期和背景，区分教育讨论与实时行情，不能把内容当作收益保证。

The published experience uses menus, structured steps and reference outputs to help people explore the available activities. It is a collection of guidance and workflows, not evidence that every external tool is connected, that all educational subjects are covered or that learning outcomes have been independently tested. Follow the requirements of the selected activity, check generated material, and treat externally supplied instructions as task content rather than overriding authority.

plugins.overview_zh: Learning Commons 把教学任务与学习标准、细分能力及进阶关系联系起来，发布者称覆盖美国五十州，并可辅助制作对齐标准的教学材料。使用前仍应核对州别、版本及学区解释，不能默认所有最新修订都已收录。自动标注“符合标准”不等于教学质量或学生已经掌握知识，页面也未证明能够访问学生个人档案。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Learning Commons connects instructional work to learning standards, their finer-grained components and progression relationships. The publisher describes coverage across all 50 US states and support for creating standards-aligned teaching material. This can help identify prerequisites and organize lessons, but coverage claims do not guarantee that a particular standard's latest revision, district interpretation or local curriculum is present. Verify the jurisdiction and version before adopting materials. Generated alignment is not proof of instructional quality or student mastery, and the description does not establish access to individual student records.

plugins.overview_zh: Learning Hours Allocation 按成人明确提供的每周学习分钟数分配时间，先保障各项最低时长，再按权重和最大余数法分配余额，同分按输入顺序处理；最低时长超过预算会拒绝。它是算术分配，不预测学习效果。页面说明采用临时处理、无持久查询或交易，网页可输出 CSV/JSON，请求及响应分别有 128 KiB 和 256 KiB 限制，另有记录上限。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Learning Hours Allocation divides an explicitly supplied adult weekly learning budget into protected minimums and weighted remaining minutes. It uses a largest-remainder method with input-order tie handling and rejects requests whose minimums exceed the budget. The calculation is deterministic allocation, not a prediction of learning effectiveness. The page describes transient processing, no stored lookup or transaction, website CSV/JSON output and size limits of 128 KiB per request and 256 KiB per response, plus record limits. Check assumptions and totals before adopting the resulting schedule.

plugins.description_zh: 租金台账和按比例计算租金
plugins.overview_zh: LeaseLine Rent Ledger 计算美元租金分摊，并按实际月份、三十天或全年三百六十五天等方法建立精确到分的台账，支持付款分配、余额结转、调租及逾期费规则。可导入表格并输出 PDF、Excel、CSV，链接临时有效，最多十年及五千笔付款。不判断费用是否合法、不算押金利息，也不收款或发通知；台账记录不能证明真实到账。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeaseLine Rent Ledger calculates USD rent proration using actual-month, 30-day or annual-365 methods and builds a cent-based ledger with configurable payment allocation, credits, rent changes and late-fee rules. It accepts tabular inputs and produces PDF, Excel or CSV outputs, with temporary links, a ten-year span limit and up to 5,000 payments. It does not validate whether a fee is lawful, calculate deposit interest, collect rent or send notices. Check inclusive dates, allocation rules and local requirements; a ledger entry is not proof that money was received.

plugins.overview_zh: Leave 按旅行成员、角色及隐私设置整理共享行程，可查看时间安排、住宿背景、受限预算、费用、余额、安全的文件元数据、笔记和任务，并准备需审批的修改。以 Leave 内记录为准，不应假定所有成员都同意每次编辑或披露。余额不代表已经转账，文件元数据不等于可读取完整文件，保存计划也不证明旅行已经执行。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Leave organizes group-travel information under the trip's membership, roles and privacy settings. Its published scope includes itinerary times, accommodation context, limited budget information, expenses, balances, safe document metadata, notes and tasks, with changes prepared for the required approval. It is useful for reconciling a shared plan, not for assuming everyone has consented to every edit or disclosure. Leave remains the authoritative record system. Expense balances do not mean a payment has occurred, document metadata is not unrestricted document access, and saved plans should not be mistaken for completed travel.

plugins.overview_zh: Ledger Botje - Exact Online 可通过自然语言查询所连接 Exact Online 的客户、发票、交易及其他财务资料，帮助定位和理解账务记录。完整正文仍较概括，没有证明所有会计操作、支付或申报都能执行。实际范围取决于账户和权限；结论应与原始凭证核对，不能把查询能力直接当成已获准修改账簿或进行交易。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ledger Botje - Exact Online brings connected Exact Online accounting information into natural-language queries, including customer, invoice, transaction and other financial records. It can help people locate and understand business data without manually navigating every screen. The complete description is broad rather than a detailed tool specification: it does not establish that every accounting operation, payment or filing is available. Actual scope depends on the account and granted permissions. Reconcile outputs against source records and obtain appropriate review before relying on financial conclusions or attempting changes to books or transactions.

plugins.overview_zh: LedgerLens 分析用户上传的银行账单交易，整理商户和消费信息。连接采用 OAuth，由账户所有者控制，页面称 ChatGPT 在主动请求时读取资料。但数据会保存在 LedgerLens，不能理解为只留在本机。上传前检查敏感财务内容，分类结果应与账单核对；消费摘要不是完整财务状况证明，也不能代替对账或个人财务建议。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LedgerLens analyzes transactions from bank statements that the user uploads, organizing merchant and spending information for review. The connection uses OAuth and is described as remaining under the account owner's control, with ChatGPT reading data during active requests. This does not mean uploaded statements stay only on the user's device: the service stores the relevant records. Review what is included before uploading sensitive financial material, and verify categorization against the statement. Spending summaries are informational, not proof of complete finances, a bank reconciliation or personalized financial advice.

plugins.overview_zh: Leela Online 以传统七十二格 Leela 棋盘、提问和掷骰进程组织自我反思，并引导用户到网站体验完整流程。更适合作为文化或反思活动，不应当作查证事实、预测未来或诊断心理问题的方法。随机落点不能决定医疗、财务或重要关系选择；公开说明没有证明专业咨询资质、临床效果或相关灵性说法的真实性。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Leela Online offers guided self-reflection through the traditional 72-square Leela board, using a question and a die-based progression to structure the conversation. The page points to its website for the fuller journey. It is best understood as a reflective or cultural activity, not a reliable way to determine facts, predict events or diagnose psychological problems. Random positions and interpretive prompts should not decide consequential medical, financial or relationship choices. The description does not establish professional counseling, clinical effectiveness or independent evidence for spiritual claims.

plugins.description_zh: 管理你的店内购车融资经销店
plugins.overview_zh: LeftLane 可查看车商库存、进行中的交易、当事方、车辆、融资背景和应收账款，包括逾期及催收相关记录，也可在支持范围内添加评论。权限受账户限制，不代表可以自动扣款、修改融资协议或联系债务人。逾期信息可能敏感且不完整，写入评论或判断个人财务可靠性前应核对原始记录及可见范围。

It can help review a deal or portfolio and add comments in the supported account. Access remains permission-bound, and the description does not establish authority to collect payments, alter financing agreements or contact debtors automatically. Delinquency data can be sensitive and may be incomplete or outdated. Verify source records and the intended audience before writing comments or drawing conclusions about a person's financial reliability.

plugins.overview_zh: Legacy JRXML Toolkit 面向旧版 iReport、JasperReports 2.x 报表，可创建、检查、编译及验证 JRXML，并尽量保留旧格式规范。页面包含 JDK 8 示例，运行时和依赖仍需满足。它不保证新版功能可向后移植，也不保证所有旧模板完全不变。替换生产报表前应在目标环境验证并比对输出；本次只核验公开描述，未安装或执行代码。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Legacy JRXML Toolkit supports creating, inspecting, compiling and validating report definitions for older iReport and JasperReports 2.x environments while preserving legacy schema conventions. The page includes JDK 8-oriented examples, so the required runtime and dependencies still matter. This is a compatibility-focused development toolkit, not proof that modern JasperReports features can be backported or that every old template will render unchanged. Inspect generated definitions, run validation in the intended environment and compare rendered output before replacing production reports. No software was installed or report code executed during this catalog review.

plugins.overview_zh: Legal Data Hunter 检索来自官方登记和法律来源的跨法域资料，发布者称超过三千二百万份文件、覆盖一百八十多个法域。功能包括关键词与语义搜索、引文解析、全文读取及覆盖范围查询。索引说明免费每日二十次，付费方案最高每月十万次，实际权益仍需确认。规模和准确率属厂商陈述；引用找到不等于法律结论正确，应核对法域、版本及原文。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Legal Data Hunter searches a publisher-described corpus of over 32 million legal documents across more than 180 jurisdictions, collected from official registries. It combines keyword and semantic search, citation resolution, full-text retrieval and jurisdiction-coverage discovery. The indexed description states 20 free searches daily and paid allowances reaching 100,000 monthly; current entitlements still require checking. Corpus size and citation-accuracy figures are vendor claims, not independent validation. Confirm the applicable jurisdiction, version and original source before relying on a result, and do not equate a resolved citation with correct legal advice.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LegalQuants Litigation packages source-grounded litigation workflows, including citation checking, client updates, correspondence, depositions, document review, discovery and legal-design skills. Examples use a matter's documents to examine opposing motions or prepare a witness outline with exhibits. The complete public body is brief, even though its identity and metadata are present; it does not specify comprehensive court coverage or accuracy guarantees. Supply only authorized matter files and review cited authorities and privilege implications. Preparing an outline, client update or letter does not authorize sending it, filing it or replacing a lawyer's judgment.

plugins.overview_zh: LegalQuants Transactional 面向交易律师，辅助检查定义术语、准备交割清单及签署文件包，以提供的交易资料为依据进行结构化起草和审阅。正文完整但简短，未详列格式、法域覆盖和操作限制。应检查交叉引用、当事方名称及文件版本。生成签署包不等于已经签署，清单完成也不能证明成交或授权转款、接受义务及向对手方交付文件。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LegalQuants Transactional offers source-grounded workflows for transactional lawyers, with examples such as checking defined terms, preparing closing checklists and assembling signature packages. It is a structured drafting and review aid around the supplied deal materials, rather than evidence that a transaction has closed. The complete description is short and leaves supported document formats, jurisdiction coverage and operational limits unspecified. Review cross-references, party names and document versions carefully. A generated signing package is not a signature, and neither drafting nor checklist completion authorizes moving funds, accepting obligations or delivering documents to counterparties.

plugins.overview_zh: LegisGraph 介绍连接欧盟、意大利及地方立法和判例的法律信息基础设施，提供关系图、时间版本、语义搜索、语言分析及更新监测。适合追溯规则之间的联系，但关系图和生成解释不是法律权威。本条有独立 ID 和开发者元数据，即使正文与 LegisRatio 相近，也不能直接合并。覆盖、新鲜度及监测频率仍受服务限制，应核对原文和生效日期。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LegisGraph describes a legal-information infrastructure linking European Union, Italian and regional legislation with jurisprudence through a graph, temporal versions and semantic search. Its published scope also mentions linguistic analysis and monitoring updates, useful for tracing relationships rather than reading isolated provisions. This selected ID has its own displayed publisher metadata even though the body closely resembles LegisRatio's description; the entries should not be silently merged. Coverage, freshness and monitoring frequency remain service-dependent. Check source texts and effective dates before treating a graph relationship or generated interpretation as legally authoritative.

It can consolidate information across locations the account is allowed to manage. The description supports analytics and operational visibility, not an assumption that it can charge customers, refund payments or modify every subscription. Define the date range and metric carefully, because bookings, attendance and collected revenue measure different things. Reconcile important totals with source records and protect client and payment-related information.

Sharing and edits affect collaborators, and rendered appearance may differ from the original even when the underlying diagram is valid.

This is a broad write-capable surface, not permission to send messages or change security settings indiscriminately. Enrichment may consume credits and campaigns can contact real recipients. It returns a voting link and a separate administration link, with the latter acting as the private means to edit the poll. Results can include counts and voter names, making visibility and sharing relevant privacy considerations. Keep the administrative link separate from the public invitation. A winning option is not a confirmed appointment, attendee acceptance or calendar booking, and the description does not establish automatic invitation delivery or calendar synchronization.

plugins.overview_zh: LetsPackUp 管理共享行程、地图、笔记、打包清单、费用余额、投票和聊天，按所选旅行授权，修改以用户名记入。支持网页、Android 及加载后的离线内容。明确不能读取同行者邮箱、位置、文件或紧急联系人，不能移除人员、修改他人贡献或删除用户创建的旅行，也不实时跟踪位置。共享改动需审阅，余额和计划不代表付款或预订已完成。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LetsPackUp manages shared trip days, maps, notes, packing, expenses, balances, polls and trip chat, with selected-trip permissions and writes attributed to the user. It supports web and Android use and loaded offline content. The page explicitly excludes reading co-travellers' emails, location, files or emergency contacts, removing people, changing others' contributions and deleting user-created trips. It does not track people in real time. Review shared edits and messages because others may see or modify them, and distinguish recorded balances and travel plans from actual payments or completed bookings.

plugins.description_zh: 使用 AI 审查 Markdown
plugins.overview_zh: Letter.md 可搜索阅读 Markdown 文档，结合上下文审阅、评论、提出修改建议，并处理图片及版本。生成内容可在 OAuth 允许写入的范围内保存为未发布的新文档或衍生文档。公开发布需明确请求和权限，发布页面不会默默改写源文件。编辑或公开前应确认版本和受众，尤其是引用私人资料时；建议、草稿、已接受修改和公开内容需明确区分。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Letter.md supports Markdown document search and reading, contextual review, comments, suggested edits, images and version-aware work in its editor. Generated material can be saved as an unpublished new or derivative document within writable OAuth scopes. Public publication is a distinct action requiring an explicit request and the necessary permission; creating a public page does not silently rewrite the source document. Check the document version and intended audience before edits or publication, especially where private source material is reused. Suggestions and drafts remain different from accepted changes and publicly accessible content.

plugins.description_zh: 文字游戏求解与乱序字母重组
plugins.overview_zh: LetterLab Word Solver 使用筛选后的 ENABLE 英文词库，支持字母重组、通配符、长度筛选、字母基础分及四至八字母猜词反馈，处理重复字母并提供信息量建议。词库不含专有名词、缩写及单字母词，缺词不代表所有游戏都不接受。空白块零分、不计棋盘加成，也不解释语义谜面、提供定义或保证每日谜题答案，应匹配实际游戏规则。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LetterLab Word Solver solves English letter and pattern puzzles with a filtered ENABLE dictionary, including unscrambling, wildcards, length filters, face-value scoring and four-to-eight-letter guessing feedback. Its repeated-letter handling and information-based suggestions support structured play. The dictionary excludes proper names, abbreviations and one-letter entries, so missing words are not necessarily invalid in every game. Blank tiles score zero and board bonuses are excluded. It does not provide semantic crossword-clue interpretation, definitions or a guaranteed daily-puzzle answer; check the rules and dictionary used by the actual game.

plugins.description_zh: 加利福尼亚州交易事实与日期
plugins.overview_zh: LetterScript 读取所选加州住宅交易资料，从已签署文件提取事实、日期及披露状态，并提供页码。功能明确只读，不能发送、编辑文档、改日期、上传、删除或转款；访问限于连接账户选定交易，直至断开。AI 可能误读合同及生效日期，重要期限应回看签署原文。覆盖加州各县不等于法律意见，也不能保证交易文件已经齐全。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LetterScript reads selected California residential real-estate transaction records and extracts facts, dates and disclosure status from executed documents with page references. It is explicitly read-only: no sending, document editing, date changes, uploading, deletion or money movement is described as permitted. Access is limited to selected transactions through the connected account until disconnection. AI extraction may misread a contract or its operative date, so compare every consequential deadline and fact with the executed document. Coverage across California counties is not a substitute for legal advice or confirmation that all transaction files are present.

plugins.description_zh: 辅助商业房地产工作流
plugins.description_en: AI for all CRE workflow needs
plugins.overview_zh: Lev 连接商业地产融资工作区，涵盖项目、文件索引、备忘录、清单、公司、联系人、笔记、资金方匹配、进度及条款书，也提及账单、账户访问背景和参考利率。功能广泛不代表可以任意批准融资、转款或改权限。应确认工作区及授权，保护交易方资料并审阅修改；参考利率、条款书或流程状态不能证明资金承诺已生效或贷款已完成。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lev connects commercial-real-estate financing workspaces, including deals, indexed documents, memos, checklists, companies, contacts, notes, lender placements, pipeline status and term sheets. The description also names billing or account-access context and reference rates. Its broad operational scope does not mean a user may approve financing, move money or change access without further authority. Verify the target workspace and permissions, protect deal and counterparty information, and review changes before committing them. A displayed rate, term sheet or pipeline stage is not proof of a binding funding commitment or completed loan.

plugins.overview_zh: Levanta 可分析所连接卖家账户中的品牌、创作者、商品、佣金及联盟营销表现，涉及 Amazon、Shopify 和 Walmart，指标包括销售、点击、转化及广告回报。可辅助比较合作关系，但正文未明确证明任意改活动或执行佣金付款。联盟归因销售不等于增量销售，应核对时间和口径；权限取决于账户，重要金额需与电商原始记录对账。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Levanta brings seller-account affiliate information into analysis across supported Amazon, Shopify and Walmart workflows. The described records include brands, creators, products, commissions and performance measures such as sales, clicks, conversion and return on ad spend. It can help compare partnerships and identify areas for review, but the public body does not explicitly establish arbitrary campaign editing or commission-payment execution. Interpret attribution and date ranges carefully: recorded affiliate sales do not prove incremental sales. Access depends on the connected seller account, and important totals should be reconciled with the underlying commerce records.

plugins.overview_zh: LevelUp 将房地产 CRM、任务、交易、开放日、品牌或培训资料及获授权的 Listing Exchange 联系起来，可支持维护联系人和准备、发布相关报名内容。不能理解为可访问所有房源或任意向联系人发消息。修改 CRM 或公开表单前应检查数据、受众和具体操作；活动计划、联系人记录不证明活动已举行、线索已同意联系或交易已完成。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LevelUp combines real-estate CRM context with tasks, deals, open-house work, branding or training resources and an authorized Listing Exchange connection. It can support maintaining contacts and preparing or publishing supported signup material within the connected workflow. The page does not imply unrestricted access to all listings or permission to message every contact. Review data quality, sharing audience and the exact write before changing CRM records or public forms. A prepared open-house plan or contact entry is not proof that an event occurred, a lead consented or a transaction closed.

plugins.description_zh: 面向 AI 的金融数据
plugins.overview_zh: Lexfi 提供股票、宏观经济、固定收益、持仓、情绪及另类数据，辅助金融研究与比较。明确不提供交易执行或投资建议。不同数据集的覆盖、时间和方法可能不同，分析结果不保证是实时价格或可直接对比。使用前检查单位、币种、报告期及来源，不能把情绪信号或历史关系当成收益保证或适合某位投资者的结论。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lexfi supplies structured financial information across equities, macroeconomics, fixed income, holdings, sentiment and alternative datasets for research and comparison. It can help locate and interpret relevant data, but the published boundary excludes trading execution and investment advice. Coverage, timestamps and methodology vary by dataset; a computed comparison is not a guarantee that prices are live or figures directly comparable. Check units, currency, reporting periods and provenance before relying on an analysis. Do not treat sentiment signals or historical relationships as a promise of returns or suitability for a specific investor.

plugins.description_zh: 比利时和卢森堡法律岗位
plugins.overview_zh: LexGO Jobs 按结构化条件查找比利时和卢森堡法律行业岗位、培训及活动，返回经过清理的详情和 LexGO 正式页面，可能使用点击追踪链接。它用于发现机会，明确不能代为申请，也不返回雇主招聘系统地址。应核对职位是否仍开放、要求和期限；看到岗位不代表符合资格、获得面试或已递交申请，单纯浏览无需提交个人申请材料。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LexGO Jobs finds legal-sector jobs, training and events in Belgium and Luxembourg using structured filters and sanitized listing details. Results point to canonical LexGO pages and may use tracking links for navigation. It is a discovery service rather than a full recruitment agent: the page explicitly excludes applying on the user's behalf and returning employer applicant-tracking-system URLs. Verify the current vacancy, requirements and deadline on the relevant page. A listed opportunity does not establish eligibility, an interview or a submitted application, and personal application materials are not needed merely to browse.

plugins.overview_zh: Lexgraph 通过专门数据接口检索德国法律、判例及法律资料间关系，可帮助从条文追溯相关裁判。但完整说明没有证明覆盖所有法院、保证合并文本最新或逐项独立验证关联。依赖结果前需核对权威原文、裁判背景和日期。研究链接不是法律结论，目录页面本身也不提供客户机密案件文件访问权或授权法律行动。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lexgraph supports German legal research by retrieving statutes, cases and relationships among legal sources through its focused data interface. It can help trace an issue from a provision to related decisions, but the complete description does not establish exhaustive court coverage, guaranteed current consolidation or independent validation of every relationship. Inspect the authoritative text, decision context and relevant date before relying on a result. Research links are not legal conclusions, and the catalog page does not itself provide access to a client's confidential matter files or authorize legal action.

plugins.overview_zh: LexIA Asistente Legal 研究厄瓜多尔法律、税务、公司、劳动及会计相关资料，覆盖规则、法院裁判和税务机关解释，强调引用、适用日期、全文阅读及文档页码，不应重构缺失原文。这有助于核查，但不保证资料完备或分析正确。尤其涉及税务处理和期限时，应确认法域、时间及原文；它不是自动律师、会计师，也不授权提交申报。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LexIA Asistente Legal researches Ecuadorian legal, tax, corporate, labor and accounting-related materials, including legislation, court decisions and tax-administration interpretations. It emphasizes citations, applicable dates, full-source reading and document or page references rather than reconstructing missing text. This helps practitioners verify an answer, but the stated workflow is not proof that every source is complete or the analysis correct. Check jurisdiction, temporal applicability and the original document, particularly for tax treatment or deadlines. It is assistance for professional review, not an autonomous lawyer, accountant or authority to submit filings.

plugins.description_zh: 研究附引用的法律法规
plugins.overview_zh: Lexiara 研究欧盟和英国立法，提供条文、来源、修订、转化关系及权威语言版本比较，并说明覆盖和新鲜度。适合定位规则及追踪变化，但不保证包含所有判例或配套措施。比较结果应核对适用日期、法域和权威版本；语言对齐或立法关系本身不能解决有争议的解释，也不能代替专业法律分析。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lexiara researches European Union and United Kingdom legislation with provision text, provenance, amendments, transposition relationships and comparisons between authentic language versions. It also exposes coverage and freshness context so users can judge what the corpus actually contains. This is useful for locating the right rule and tracing changes, not a guarantee that every case or implementing measure is present. Verify the operative date, jurisdiction and authoritative version before relying on a comparison. Language alignment and legislative relationships do not by themselves resolve a disputed interpretation or replace qualified legal analysis.

plugins.description_zh: 聊天中的每日文字谜题
plugins.description_en: A daily word puzzle in chat

plugins.description_zh: 获取有关接案信息的解答
plugins.overview_zh: Lexidesk 分析所连接账户的接待会话、客户和结果，归纳疑虑、改进话术并查找尚未预约的合格线索。可比较渠道带来的线索与预约，只有存在关联委托及归因记录时才能追踪签约来源。需要账户和权限，录音缺失或关联错误会影响结论。应审阅转录解读及客户保密问题，建议跟进名单不等于获准联系客户或改动预约。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lexidesk analyzes connected intake conversations, clients and outcomes to identify objections, improve scripts and find qualified leads that have not booked. It can compare marketing channels by recorded leads and appointments, and trace signed cases only when linked retainer and attribution records exist. A Lexidesk account is required and permissions apply. Missing recordings or inconsistent links limit conclusions; reported channel performance is not proof of causation. Review transcript interpretation and client confidentiality, and distinguish a recommended follow-up list from permission to contact clients or alter appointment records.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索巴拿马法律和案例
plugins.overview_zh: Lexistmo 检索巴拿马法律、法院及采购裁判，读取全文，将引用解析为现行合并条文，并说明修订、废止或替代状态。资料来自官方公开来源，每周更新多次，全部工具只读，发布者称不保存查询文本。需要 Pro 或 Scale 账户，内容为西班牙语。更新并非必然实时，重要结论尤其效力变化应回看官方公报，不能当作法律意见。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lexistmo searches Panamanian legislation and court or procurement decisions, retrieves full documents and resolves citations to current consolidated provisions and legal-status information. It harvests official public sources several times weekly and links originals; all tools are read-only and the publisher says query text is not stored. A Pro or Scale account is required, and content is Spanish. Updates are not necessarily instantaneous. Verify consequential conclusions against Panama's Official Gazette, especially amendments and repeals; this is a research service, not legal advice or a guarantee that a particular law remains applicable.

plugins.description_zh: 云端浏览器自动化：浏览、提取与交互
plugins.description_en: 云端浏览器自动化：浏览、提取与交互

plugins.overview_zh: Lexplorer Swiss Law Research 检索瑞士联邦及州法律、法院裁判和立法资料，提供精确引用及原始链接。发布者称收录约百万份裁判、覆盖二十六州，并用引用图寻找后续讨论旧判例的决定。需要 Lexplorer 账户登录。资料规模不保证找到所有相关案例或旧判例仍有效；应核对州别、现行条文及后续裁判评价。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lexplorer Swiss Law Research searches Swiss federal and cantonal law, court decisions and legislative materials, using precise citations and original-source links. The publisher describes roughly one million decisions, coverage across all 26 cantons and a citation graph for finding later decisions that discuss earlier authorities. A Lexplorer account and login are required. Corpus size and planned research order are not proof that every relevant case was found or remains controlling. Check the relevant canton, effective statutory text and judicial treatment before relying on an answer, especially when comparing historical and current law.

plugins.overview_zh: Lexplorer Swiss Tax Research 结合联邦税法、二十六州税法、二十四州行政指引、联邦实践及评注，按法规优先的方式提供引用和原始链接，也可比较州间规则。需要 Lexplorer 账户。二十六州立法与二十四州实践资料的范围不同，不能默认覆盖一致。应核对日期、纳税人情况及行政指引法律效力；研究结果不保证申报立场或应纳税额正确。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lexplorer Swiss Tax Research combines federal tax acts, all 26 cantons' tax legislation, administrative guidance from 24 cantons, federal practice and commentary. It organizes statute-first research with precise citations and original links, including comparisons of canton-specific rules. A Lexplorer account is required. The distinction between 26 legislative collections and 24 practice collections matters; do not assume identical coverage everywhere. Check dates, taxpayer circumstances and the legal weight of administrative practice versus legislation. The service supports tax research but does not guarantee a filing position, individualized advice or correct tax payable.

plugins.description_zh: 附带来源的玻利维亚法律
plugins.overview_zh: LeyNova 研究玻利维亚法律及宪法法院、最高法院判决，按条文提供效力说明和可公开核查的链接，既能按编号也能按规则作用搜索，并提示废止情况。资料包括宪法、法典、法律、法令和行业规则，但“已验证来源”不是独立完整性审计。应打开原文检查日期及后续变化；该工具提供分析依据，明确不能替代执业律师判断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LeyNova researches Bolivian legislation and constitutional or supreme-court decisions, returning article-level material with stated validity and public source URLs. It can search by the function of a rule, not only its number, and flag repealed provisions. The corpus includes the constitution, codes, laws, decrees and sector regulations, but verified-source language is a publisher description rather than an independent completeness audit. Open the linked authority and check dates and later developments. The app supplies research foundations for analysis; it explicitly does not replace the judgment of a licensed lawyer.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 LFmall AI 购物发现个人喜好
plugins.description_en: 나를 나답게 만드는 취향 발견, LFmall AI 쇼핑
plugins.overview_zh: LFmall 按风格、场合和喜好，通过对话推荐自家商城的时装及生活方式商品，页面提及品牌商品与官方商城优惠。它不是对所有零售商的独立比价，简短正文也未证明自动结账、全球配送或库存保证。应在具体商品页核对尺码、材质、价格、运费和退换政策；个性化推荐不保证合身或品质，优惠可能有资格及时间限制。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LFmall helps discover fashion and lifestyle products from its own shopping catalog through style, occasion and preference-based conversation. The page describes recommendations from premium brands and access to official-store benefits, rather than an independent comparison of every retailer. Its short complete body does not establish automatic checkout, universal delivery coverage or guaranteed inventory. Review the specific product's size, material, current price, shipping terms and return conditions on the seller's page. Personalized suggestions are not proof of fit or quality, and an advertised benefit may have eligibility or timing restrictions.

plugins.description_zh: 解答 LG 产品问题
plugins.overview_zh: LG.com 从 LG 官方目录查询家电、电视、显示器、电脑和音频产品，可比较型号、解释规格，并按空间、预算及用途缩小选择范围。它是品牌资料源，不是跨品牌独立评测，也不证明当地有货。正文未确认可直接购买、预约维修或提交保修。购前应核对地区型号、库存、总价和安装条件，重要性能可参考独立测试。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LG.com searches LG's official product catalog for appliances, televisions, monitors, laptops and audio equipment, helping compare models and explain specifications. Recommendations can use room size, budget and intended use to narrow a shortlist. This is a manufacturer-specific information source, not a neutral review of competing brands or proof of local stock. The complete description does not establish purchase, repair booking or warranty-claim execution. Confirm the exact regional model, current availability, total price and installation requirements before buying, and check independent testing where performance claims matter.

plugins.overview_zh: LIAM 保存和回忆用户提供的事实、偏好、笔记、联系人、食谱及流程，也可记录餐食和收据，汇总每日营养与消费。图片会转成结构化记录，餐厅收据可能同时记为费用和餐食。页面称只保存提取文本与数值、不留原图，但衍生资料仍可能敏感。应核查识别和分类，避免保存不必要的个人信息，估算营养及消费记录不能当作医疗或会计测量。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LIAM saves and recalls user-provided facts, preferences, notes, contacts, recipes and routines, and records meals or receipts for daily nutrition and spending summaries. Photos can be interpreted into structured entries; a restaurant receipt may create both an expense and a meal record. The publisher says only extracted text and values are stored, not raw images, which still leaves potentially sensitive derived information. Review extraction and categorization before relying on totals, avoid storing unnecessary personal details and distinguish estimated nutrition or recorded spending from verified medical or accounting measurements.

plugins.overview_zh: LibreJustice 检索法语及欧洲判例，并按指定日期读取法律文本，覆盖法国多类法院、行政及监管机构和欧洲法院，可按法院、结果、日期及引用条文筛选。支持裁判全文、条文版本历史以及部分条约和外国法典。整理后的资料不等于全球法律全覆盖，历史文本也不证明当前适用；用于法律建议、诉讼或合规前应核对法域、程序背景和官方来源。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LibreJustice searches French-language and European case law and retrieves legal texts as they stood on a selected date. It covers several French judicial, administrative and regulatory bodies plus European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions. Users can read full decisions, inspect article version history and search curated treaties or foreign codes. Curated coverage is not all law everywhere, and historical wording alone does not establish present applicability. Verify the jurisdiction, procedural context and official source before using a result for legal advice, litigation or compliance decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: LicitaLAB 从公共采购文件提取技术要求、期限、金额及评审标准，帮助发现和比较招标机会，也可查询相关文件、供应商、采购方及平台使用问题。它是分析辅助，不保证已捕捉所有补充公告或投标满足全部硬性要求。决策前需核对原始公告和附件；正文没有证明可代为投标、注册供应商、保证中标或作出合同承诺。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LicitaLAB helps discover and analyze public-procurement opportunities by extracting requirements, deadlines, amounts and evaluation criteria from tender documents. Users can review associated files and ask questions about specific opportunities, suppliers, buyers or the platform's operation. It is a document-analysis aid for comparing processes, not proof that all tender amendments have been captured or that a bid meets every mandatory requirement. Check the original notice and attachments before deciding. The complete description does not establish bid submission, supplier registration, guarantees of winning or authority to make contractual commitments.

plugins.description_zh: 查看 IAS 研究记录
plugins.overview_zh: Life Analytics IAS 让获授权研究团队查看工作区中的实验记录、分析摘要和报告背景。范围明确为只读摘要，不提供原始文件导出、个人资料、诊断、治疗决定或临床建议。适合了解已记录研究进展，不能据此索取全部数据或决定患者治疗。摘要取决于工作区内容及归纳方式，重要结论仍需通过适当渠道检查原始研究材料。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Life Analytics IAS lets authorized research-team members review experiment records, analysis summaries and report context from their IAS workspace. Its scope is deliberately narrow: read-only access to summarized research context, without raw-file export, personal data, diagnosis, treatment decisions or clinical advice. It is therefore useful for understanding recorded research status, not for retrieving every underlying dataset or making patient-care decisions. Conclusions depend on what the workspace contains and how it was summarized. Consult the underlying authorized research materials through appropriate channels before treating a summary as a complete or independently validated result.

plugins.overview_zh: Life Analytics Mail 可创建邮件活动草稿、管理受众和联系人、检查收件及送达准备情况、发送测试、安排或取消排期，并发送已批准活动及分析结果。正文未详列全部权限、额度和送达方法。草稿、已排期和发送被接受是不同状态，都不保证进入收件箱。应确认受众、内容和时间，尊重同意与退订要求；测试邮件也是真实对外通信，不只是预览。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Life Analytics Mail supports email-campaign drafts, audience and contact management, recipient-readiness checks, test sends, scheduling, cancellation and sending of approved campaigns, followed by delivery and engagement analysis. Its public description makes approval relevant to campaign execution, but does not detail all account permissions, volume limits or deliverability methods. A draft, scheduled campaign and accepted send are different states; none alone proves inbox delivery. Confirm recipients, content and timing before a send, respect consent and unsubscribe requirements, and treat test messages as real external communications rather than harmless previews.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找带向导的探险旅行
plugins.overview_zh: Life Happens Outdoors 按日期和难度查找经营方的小团探险旅行，提供行程、包含项目、出发名额，并可提交咨询。页面介绍机场间支持及领队陪同，具体仍以相应产品为准。发送咨询前需在聊天中确认，并展示体能、医疗准备和最终许可提示。有名额不等于已预订，咨询不是购买或健康评估；应另查高海拔风险、排除项目及最终条款。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Life Happens Outdoors searches the operator's guided small-group expeditions by date and difficulty, retrieves itineraries and inclusions, checks departure availability and can submit a consultation request. The page describes airport-to-airport support and team leaders on departures, but these are operator claims subject to the specific trip. Each consultation is confirmed in chat before sending, with a fitness, medical-readiness and final-clearance disclaimer. Availability is not a reservation, and a consultation is not a purchase or fitness assessment. Check altitude risks, exclusions and final trip terms before committing.

plugins.name_en: Life in the UK Practice Tests
plugins.overview_zh: Life in the UK Practice Tests 提供计时的二十四题模拟卷，含单选和多选，按答对十八题计算通过，并列出错题。发布者称十套完整试卷无需账户，注册免费网站账户可看完整答案、解释和记忆提示。这是仿正式题型的练习，不是官方考试或通过保证，也不判断资格、代约政府考试或授予身份；应核对官方备考指引和有争议答案。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Life in the UK Practice Tests provides timed 24-question practice papers with single- and multiple-answer questions, scoring against an 18-correct threshold and showing missed questions. The publisher offers ten complete tests without an account; a free account on its site unlocks fuller answers, explanations and memory tips. These are official-style practice materials, not an official examination or a guaranteed pass. The app does not establish eligibility, book the government test or grant citizenship or settlement. Check the current official preparation guidance and verify disputed answers before relying on practice results.
plugins.observed_public_name: Life in the UK Practice Tests

plugins.description_zh: 一般生命科学研究，包括流程分派、证据综合，以及可选的并行子智能体分析
plugins.description_en: General life-sciences research with routing, evidence synthesis, and optional parallel subagent analysis
plugins.overview_zh: Life Science Research 的正文描述的是 Codex 内部研究工作流：理解问题、规范实体、选择技能，并综合公开生命科学资料，涉及遗传、表达、通路、结构、化学、药理、文献、临床证据及研究发现，可选并行分析。精确目录身份已核验，但不能把 Codex 技能当成当前已接通的聊天数据库。应保留来源、区分假设和确证结果，研究综合不能当作临床诊断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Life Science Research is described as an internal Codex research workflow that interprets a question, normalizes entities, selects relevant skills and synthesizes evidence from public life-science resources. Its scope spans genetics, expression, pathways, structures, chemistry, pharmacology, literature, clinical evidence and public studies, with optional parallel analysis. Exact catalog identity is verified, but the stated Codex surface should not be mistaken for an already connected ChatGPT data service. Database coverage and evidence quality still vary; preserve provenance, distinguish research hypotheses from established findings and do not use generated synthesis as a clinical diagnosis.

plugins.description_zh: 查询结构化公共生命科学数据库
plugins.overview_zh: Life Sciences Databases 提供针对公开结构化资料源的技能，覆盖遗传变异、表达、蛋白结构、通路、化学、药理、临床证据及组学数据，建议结合少量互补数据库研究。精确 ID 索引含完整开发者和版本，但能力标签不代表可以修改公共数据库或访问私人病历。应检查标识符、版本、物种及证据来源，研究解读不能直接作为临床变异定性、治疗建议或实验验证结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Life Sciences Databases provides focused skills for querying structured public resources across genetics, variants, expression, proteins, structures, pathways, chemistry, pharmacology, clinical evidence and public omics datasets. It encourages combining a small set of complementary databases rather than assuming one source answers every question. The exact-ID indexed page includes developer and version metadata, but catalog capability labels do not establish permission to modify public databases or access private patient records. Check identifiers, database versions, species and evidence provenance. Research interpretation is not a clinical variant classification, treatment recommendation or independently validated experimental result.

plugins.description_zh: 查找生物医学论文、预印本和开放获取全文
plugins.description_en: Find biomedical papers, preprints, and open-access full text

plugins.description_zh: 为测序分析提供下一代测序（NGS）流程引导与本地执行
plugins.description_en: Guided NGS routing and local execution for sequencing analysis
plugins.overview_zh: Life Sciences NGS Analysis 引导 Codex 在本地检查测序输入、补问实验信息、选择流程，并带验证、日志、清单和质控产物执行分析，涉及 BCL/FASTQ、DNA 变异、整体 RNA、染色质实验及计数后的单细胞质控。会先检查已有工具，仍需本地文件、算力和依赖。本次未执行任何流程；人类基因组资料需严格控制访问，计算输出不能自动视为临床验证结果或诊断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Life Sciences NGS Analysis guides Codex through local sequencing-analysis intake, input inspection, assay-specific questions, workflow selection and validated execution with logs, manifests and quality-control artifacts. Supported areas include BCL/FASTQ processing, DNA variants, bulk RNA, chromatin assays and post-count single-cell QC. It checks existing tools before considering installation, but still requires suitable local files, compute and dependencies. This catalog review did not execute a pipeline. Human genomic data requires careful access and sharing controls, and computational outputs are research results rather than automatically validated clinical findings or diagnoses.

plugins.overview_zh: Lifeinvader Ads Editor 使用编辑器、可搜索目录和模板整理游戏相关广告，可复用旧稿，或保存带公开原始来源及 Cloud Agent 标注的已批准修改。页面称免费且无需登录或许可证，并明确是独立粉丝项目，与 Grand RP、Rockstar 或 Take-Two 无官方关联。保存前检查文案及公开范围；格式化或保存不代表已经在游戏发布，也不保证符合所有社区广告规则。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

The publisher describes it as free without sign-in or a license requirement, and explicitly identifies it as an independent fan project rather than an official Grand RP, Rockstar or Take-Two service. Review approved text and public-source visibility before saving. Formatting or storing an ad does not establish that it has been posted in the game or complies with every community's advertising rules.

plugins.overview_zh: LifeLinks 在私人工作区整理物品、地点、集合、例行流程、笔记及获授权日历，可查询已记录位置并通过支持的原生日历或 Google、Outlook 工具改动事件。范围由账户和权限决定，删除需确认，可选二维码不等于实时定位。应区分计划与已完成活动，确认目标日历和事件；它只能找到有人记录的位置，不能自动知道物品现在在哪里。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: LifeLinks maintains a private workspace of possessions, places, collections, routines, notes and permitted calendar events. It can find recorded item locations, organize related items and update supported calendar entries through native or eligible Google/Outlook tools. Access is limited to the connected account and chosen permissions, while removals require confirmation. Optional QR labels do not imply live physical tracking. Keep recorded plans separate from completed activity, verify which calendar and event will change, and remember that the service can only find location details someone actually recorded rather than know where an object currently is.

plugins.overview_zh: 为烹饪、旅行、娱乐、学习和心理等日常问题补充有来源的背景、专家材料和实例，仅在确实有帮助时采用；找不到合适来源则正常回答，不强行引用。它是知识辅助，不代表能订购服务，也不提供专业法律或财务建议。发布者声称不收集个人数据，此声明未在本轮独立实测。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Adds source-backed context to everyday questions about cooking, travel, entertainment, learning and psychology. Relevant expert material and examples are used when they improve the answer; if no suitable source is found, the conversation proceeds without external references. This is contextual assistance, not a booking service or professional legal or financial advice. The publisher states that it does not collect personal data, a claim not independently tested here.

plugins.description_zh: 以证据为先的市场排名
plugins.overview_zh: 按结构化流程研究公开市场，覆盖固定核心、97 个标的、挑战者及持有现金／等待选项；检查催化因素、来源质量与反证，排列证券观察名单并选择重点标的，同时单独说明整体比较结果。公开版本不使用私人券商账户数字、持仓或交易记录，不提供买卖或不交易指令、执行准备建议，也不下单。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Runs a structured public-market research and ranking workflow across a permanent core, a 97-symbol universe, challengers and a cash/wait alternative. It checks catalysts, source quality and contradictory evidence, ranks a securities watchlist, selects one spotlight ticker and separately states the overall research winner. This is not personalized brokerage analysis: the public build excludes private account figures and trading records and neither recommends transactions nor places orders.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接已同步的 Liftin' 训练数据，查看历史训练、动作进展与计划，还能在私人 iCloud 数据中创建或修改训练项目、日程、动作、计划组数、训练最大重量及当前项目。它既做分析也会保存计划变更，并非单纯生成通用健身建议。页面未说明医疗适用性、价格或各类修改的详细确认流程。
plugins.requirements_zh: 须能访问私人 iCloud 中同步的 Liftin' 数据；写入会改变保存的训练计划，账户配置、费用和安全负荷未核实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects the user's synced Liftin' training data for reviewing workout history, exercise progression and training plans. It can also create or modify programs, routines, exercises, planned sets, training maximums and the active program in the user's private iCloud data. This combines analysis with persistent planning changes; it is not merely a generic workout generator. The page does not establish medical suitability, pricing or the precise confirmation sequence for edits.

plugins.overview_zh: 为运动者及获授权教练提供训练、营养计划、近期训练和双方消息管理，可按目标与偏好使用多语言动作库生成方案，教练还可查看执行情况或从文档、图片整理计划。正文另外说明 Codex 可集中处理客户消息和待审草稿。创建计划、启用菜单、发送消息等每次变更均需确认，教练只能访问当前授权自己的客户。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需本人账户及 Liftory 授权，每次变更均确认；教练需客户当前授权，可从已连接助手设置断开，不保证医学适用性。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Supports athletes and authorized coaches with training and nutrition plans, recent workouts and coach-client messages. Plans can be built from goals and preferences using a multilingual exercise catalog; coaches can review adherence and digitize plans from documents or pictures. The Codex workflow additionally organizes client conversations and reviewed drafts in one session. Every plan, menu or message change requires confirmation, and coaches can access only clients who currently grant permission.

It combines operational campaign context with reporting rather than offering only copy suggestions. The page does not spell out sending permissions, recipient controls, billing or which changes require approval, so those conditions need checking before using its communication or campaign-write functions.

plugins.overview_zh: 基于 Lightning Leads 后台信息解释外勤销售流程、检查入门进度、准备约见，并查看路线与业绩背景；可以给已确认线索追加笔记或标记跟进。它侧重销售辅导和有限记录维护，正文并未证明具备导航、自动联系客户或任意改写线索档案的能力。

This is a sales coaching and record-assistance workflow; the description does not establish route navigation, autonomous customer contact or unrestricted modification of lead records.

Users can look for influencers or micro-creators relevant to a topic and derive possible hooks or formats from existing examples. The publisher's viral-strategy framing is not a guarantee of reach. The description establishes research, not campaign publishing, creator contracting or access to a private social account.

plugins.overview_zh: 分析 LightSite 中记录的 AI 爬虫访问、AI 引荐访问与转化、跟踪提示词、页面诊断及内容和权威度机会，并比较不同期间。缺失审计数据须标为未知，未核实提及须与已证实覆盖分开。经同意的操作只是待审批提案，可查询或撤回；必须在 LightSite 内批准后才执行，不是聊天建议即生效。

It compares periods while identifying missing audit data and distinguishing unverified mentions from confirmed coverage. Agreed actions become pending proposals that can be checked or withdrawn; execution occurs only after approval inside LightSite, not merely because a chat suggests a change.

plugins.description_zh: 在聊天中分摊团体费用
plugins.overview_zh: 为旅行、家庭或团队维护共享账本，可建群、登记支出收入与结算，按均分、权重或自定义方式处理多币种分摊，并管理收据、预算、分类统计和共同待办，可通过网页、LINE 或 Telegram 共享访问。优化结算是计算债务与建议减少转账次数，正文并未证实能执行银行转账或支付。

It also supports receipts, budgets, spending categories and shared tasks, with access through Web, LINE or Telegram. plugins.overview_zh: 分析用户共享的 Lightweight 历史训练、已完成训练及无动作的健身房签到，读取日程，并在精确确认后保存日程修改；可归入现有或新建的私人文件夹。数据范围包含训练指标、技术标识与日程容量，并非完整健康或位置数据源。不能删除日程或文件夹、启动训练，也不能改写已完成记录。

It can organize a routine in an existing or newly named private folder. Data includes training metrics, technical identifiers and routine-capacity information, not a broad health or location feed. It cannot delete routines or folders, start a workout or rewrite completed workout history.

plugins.overview_zh: 为另行安装的 LinkupAPI 应用提供两种外联流程：将目标客户要求转为公司与决策者研究，核查现职和关系后准备邀请、跟进；或从相关帖子的评论与互动者中评分筛选，拟写有背景的联系内容。每次发送都需确认，受每日上限限制，积分仅用于批准的名单；技能本身不是独立社交或邮箱连接。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需单独安装 LinkupAPI 且至少连接一个账户；逐次确认发送，执行每日上限，积分仅用批准名单。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Supplies two outreach playbooks for the separately installed LinkupAPI app. One turns a target-customer brief into researched companies and decision-makers, checks current roles and relationships, then prepares connection requests and follow-ups. The other scores people who reacted to relevant posts and drafts contextual outreach. Each send must be confirmed; daily caps apply and credits are spent only on an approved shortlist. It is not a standalone connection to LinkedIn or email.

plugins.overview_zh: 利用 Lion Lift 训练历史安排跑步、泳池游泳、骑行和举重，比较跨项目进展、计划与实际训练，并生成报告。页面同时标明可读可写，但正文没有列全日程和修改操作。应理解为基于数据的训练辅助，而非诊断、运动安全保证或自动执行的训练项目。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需可访问 Lion Lift 历史；虽标明读写，具体写入和审批未详述；健身计划不是医疗。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Uses Lion Lift workout history to plan running, pool swimming, cycling and lifting sessions, review cross-sport progress, compare planned versus completed workouts and prepare reports. The page also declares read/write capabilities, but does not spell out every scheduling or modification operation in its body. It should be treated as data-informed training assistance, not diagnosis, a guarantee of safe exercise or an automatically executed training program.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索团体旅游、机票、住宿和票券
plugins.description_en: 搜尋團體旅遊、機票、住宿與票券
plugins.overview_zh: 按目的地、日期、人数、预算或偏好搜索雄狮旅游的团体行程、机票、住宿和票券，比较价格、日期与行程重点后跳转官网。最终商品内容、机位、房况、票券库存及订购条件以官网当时显示为准，购买在官网完成，不能理解为已具备聊天内交易能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 最终价格、机位房间、票券库存和条款以官网为准；订购在官网完成，搜索不等于预留或锁价。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches Lion Travel group tours, flights, lodging and tickets using a destination, travel dates, party size, budget or preferences. Results help compare products, prices, dates and itinerary highlights, with onward links to the official site. Final product details, seats, rooms, ticket stock and booking conditions are governed by what the official website shows at the time; purchase is completed there, not established as an in-chat transaction.

plugins.description_zh: 撰写和审阅阿拉伯语内容

plugins.overview_zh: 读取 Listen Labs 研究、回答数据、研究设计与分析结果，也能在 ChatGPT 中创建、编辑及启动新研究，用于产品发现、易用性测试、市场探索或假设检验。启动研究可能影响参与者和预算；公开正文未说明招募条款、知情同意、价格或具体审批流程，实际启动前需核对。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需研究项目权限；启动前审阅参与者、同意、范围和费用，细节未实测。

It supports qualitative synthesis for discovery, usability work, market exploration or hypothesis testing. Launching research can affect participants and project budgets; the public description does not establish recruitment terms, consent procedures, pricing or the exact approval flow, so those must be checked before launch.

plugins.overview_zh: 把用户明确批准的 ChatGPT 文本、网址或 PDF 发送至 Listen Later 转成播客音频，并通过该用户的订阅源交付。这是外部内容转换，不是仅本地朗读。正文未说明文件大小、声音选项、处理时间、费用或生成音频的再分发权利。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅发送用户批准的文本、网址或 PDF 至 Listen Later；需可用订阅源，隐私、大小限制和费用需核对。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Converts selected material into podcast audio through Listen Later. The user can approve ChatGPT text, URLs or PDF files for transmission, after which the service delivers generated audio through the user's Listen Later feed. This is an external conversion workflow, not local-only speech playback. The description does not establish supported document sizes, voices, turnaround time, pricing or rights to redistribute the resulting audio.

plugins.overview_zh: 比较明确提供的来源值与商品／房源等列表中的原文值，并检查引文是否确实出现在所给文本中。它是字面核对工具，不会自行抽取、推断或独立查证声明。服务器计算为临时处理，独立网站可在浏览器本地计算及审阅、导出 CSV／JSON；不检索外部来源、不保存账户记录，也不发送、交易或调用付费模型，受大小限制。
plugins.requirements_zh: 须明确结构化输入，MCP 请求 128 KiB、计算响应 256 KiB，另有字段条数限制；不核实声明，独立网站导出前审阅。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Compares explicitly supplied source values with exact quoted listing values and checks whether each quote occurs in the supplied text. It produces a literal review aid, not extraction, inference or independent verification of claims. Server processing is transient; the separate website supports local-browser calculation and CSV/JSON review or export. No external retrieval, stored account records, sending, transactions or paid model calls are described; bounded request, response and record sizes apply.

plugins.overview_zh: 比较明确输入的列表字段修改前后值，生成供人工审阅的字面变更清单，不判断事实或法律正确性。计算是临时的，独立网站可浏览器本地处理及审阅、导出 CSV／JSON。不检索外部资料、不长期存储账户内容，也不发送、交易或调用付费模型；结构化输入受请求、响应、字段和条数限制。
plugins.requirements_zh: 须明确前后结构化数据，请求 128 KiB、响应 256 KiB 并有字段条数限制；仅字面对比，事实法律正确性另审。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Compares supplied before-and-after values for listing fields and generates a literal change list for a reviewer. It does not determine whether the changes are factually or legally correct. Processing is transient, with local-browser calculation and CSV/JSON review/export on the separate website. There is no external source retrieval, persistent account storage, sending, transactions or paid model invocation, and structured inputs must stay within request, response, field and record limits.

plugins.overview_zh: 用 EAN 条码、制造商料号或商品名查找资料，整理标题、说明、规格、品牌和图片链接，并以 Excel 文件交付。任务异步处理，需跟踪进度直到结果完成，首次请求不是最终结果。需 ListingForgeAI 账户；正文未保证数据准确、图片许可或能直接发布到电商平台。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需账户，异步完成后才交 Excel；商业使用前核对资料准确、图片权利及额度。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Looks up products by EAN barcode, manufacturer part number or product name and prepares a structured card containing a title, description, specifications, brand and image links. Results are delivered as an Excel download. Processing runs asynchronously with task progress until completion, so the initial call is not the final result. A ListingForgeAI account is required; source accuracy, image licensing and marketplace publication are not guaranteed by the description.

plugins.overview_zh: 所选 Litera ID 当前显示为 Lito，可搜索律所经验数据，返回带引文的回答、实体链接及可排序分页表格，并深入案件、客户、人员和营销经验资料包，通过追问缩小范围。访问受律所权限、利益隔离墙和用户权利约束。发布者的准确性宣传不等于独立保证，也不能把知识检索当作法律意见或案件修改权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 遵守律所权限、隔离墙和用户权利；名称改为 Lito，不保证法律意见或绝对准确，不推断案件写入权。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: The selected Litera ID now displays Lito. It searches a firm's experience data and returns cited answers, linked entities and sortable, paged tables. Users can drill into matters, clients, people and marketing experience packets, refining searches conversationally. Access respects firm permissions, ethical walls and user entitlements. The publisher's accuracy language is not an independent guarantee, and this is firm-knowledge retrieval rather than verified legal advice or permission to alter case records.

plugins.overview_zh: 读取获授权的 LiteTMS 员工司机资料、工作联系方式、证件到期状态、分配车辆／挂车背景、语言、ADR 资质与分支，并管理本人提醒及提供记录链接。公司须先启用 AI 应用访问。修改受角色控制并记入审计；提醒默认私人，除非明确共享。尚无通用订单、车辆或 GPS 工具，敏感身份、薪资和附件资料被排除。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公司须启用 AI 并使用本人登录，角色分支限制回答；不返回家庭地址生日、银行薪资证件号或附件；提醒修改审计，全公司可见须明确请求。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Reads authorized LiteTMS employee and driver information, business contact details, document expiry status, assigned vehicle/trailer context, languages, ADR qualifications and branches. It also manages the user's reminders and links to source records. Company AI-app access must first be enabled. Changes are role-limited and audited; reminders remain private unless explicitly shared. General order, vehicle and GPS tools are not yet available, and sensitive identity, payroll and attachment data are excluded.

plugins.overview_zh: 按标题、日期或主题查找 Littlebird 会议，阅读现有摘要、手工笔记和转录以找回决定与后续事项；还可搜索工作背景、保存指定文本、读取例行报告和按要求创建或更新例行任务。访问受 OAuth 所连账户权限限制。它使用已有资料，不代表能录制新会议、每场都有转录或跨账户读取。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Littlebird 本人账户 OAuth 及现有权限；并非每场有转录，仅按要求保存记忆或创建更新例行任务。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Finds Littlebird meetings by title, date or subject and reads available summaries, manual notes and transcripts to recover decisions and follow-ups. It also searches saved work context, saves requested text, reads routine reports and creates or updates requested routines. Access follows the OAuth-connected account's permissions. This uses existing Littlebird records; the description does not establish recording a new meeting, universal transcript availability or access beyond that account.

plugins.overview_zh: 帮助教育者和学习设计者创建、检查及编辑互动案例，包括角色、章节、对话、问题、评分特征、徽章、复盘及辅助媒体，只能操作登录用户有编辑权的案例。发布、改可见性、转移所有权及删除整个案例仍须在 LiveCase 网站完成，聊天编辑不会自动公开或转交案例。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅可编辑本人有权案例；发布、可见性、所有权转移和整案删除留在网页产品。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Helps educators and learning designers create and edit interactive case simulations, including characters, chapters, dialogue, questions, scoring characteristics, badges, debriefs and supporting media. It works only on cases the signed-in user may edit. Publishing, changing visibility, transferring ownership and deleting a whole case remain in the LiveCase website, so an edited simulation is not automatically public or reassigned through this connector.

plugins.overview_zh: 按风格、主题或模型搜索 LivePair 的图像和视频提示词库，查看具体提示、实际生成结果及不同变体，便于选择和调整方案。正文说明实际运行要到 LivePair Studio 打开提示并执行，不能据此认定聊天中直接生成、免费送积分或保证复现完全相同结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 提示库研究及跳转 Studio，不证明聊天内生成；模型结果可变化，账户积分和媒体权利需另核。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches LivePair's image and video prompt library by style, subject or model. Each example includes the exact prompt, an actual generated result and variations to compare, helping users choose or adapt an approach. Running a prompt is described as opening it in LivePair Studio and executing it there. The connector does not thereby establish in-chat media generation, free generation credits or a guarantee of reproducing identical results.

plugins.overview_zh: 计算太阳、月亮、行星、冥王星及梅西耶天体的位置与观测窗口，包含日落、曙暮光、方位、星座和最高位置时刻，并比较黑暗时段与月亮位置。每次问题和追问都需选择应用，无位置背景时提供城市或地标。结果只是几何条件，不涵盖天气、遮挡、望远镜适用性或可见性保证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 每问及追问选 LiveSky，必要时给城市地标；无需账户，仅几何，不含天气遮挡、设备适用或可见保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Computes sky positions and observing windows for the Sun, Moon, planets, Pluto and Messier objects, including sunset, twilight, compass directions, constellations and when targets are highest. It can compare darkness with the Moon's position. Use the app for each question and follow-up, supplying a city or landmark if location context is absent. These are geometric calculations, not weather forecasts, obstruction checks, telescope recommendations or guaranteed visibility.

plugins.overview_zh: 按文字、城市、类别、日期和预算搜索瑞典活动，查看说明、场馆、价格、余票与票务链接，也可浏览音乐会、戏剧、运动、节庆和亲子活动及相似推荐。发布者称独立指南每天汇集 13 家票务提供商数据。免费、只读，无需账户或 API 密钥，实际购票通过外部链接完成。
plugins.requirements_zh: 免费只读无需账户密钥，覆盖瑞典且按日更新；余票和最终购买条款归票务方。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Finds Swedish events by free text, city, category, dates or budget, with descriptions, venues, prices, availability and ticket-provider links. It also suggests similar events and supports browsing concerts, theatre, sport, festivals and family activities. The publisher says its independent guide refreshes data daily from 13 providers. It is free and read-only without an account or API key; actual tickets are booked through external links.

plugins.description_zh: 面向智能体的文档处理
plugins.overview_zh: 提供文档解析、按模式提取、分类、拆分、索引和检索，适合把材料转为结构化可搜索信息。发布者称支持广泛格式，解析有免费和付费选项，但未逐一列出格式或额度。页面不保证 OCR 完全准确、无限处理，也不表示机密文件仅在本地处理。
plugins.requirements_zh: 解析有付费免费，格式额度及处理隐私条件需核对；广泛格式宣传不是已实测万能保证。
