plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Provides document-processing operations including parsing, schema-based extraction, classification, splitting, indexing and retrieval. The publisher describes broad file-format support and both free and paid parsing options, but does not enumerate every format or quota. It can support turning documents into structured, searchable information; the page does not guarantee perfect OCR, unlimited processing or that confidential files remain entirely local.

plugins.overview_zh: 组织按揭贷款文档收集，并从已有档案材料准备保险行政文件，例如 AMF 更换预告和说明信，可依据所给转录与凭证形成草稿。它是材料整理和文件准备，不等于贷款决定、保险推荐或已证实的监管提交服务；缺失信息不可编造，重要文件仍需专业审阅。
plugins.requirements_zh: 依赖所给档案，按揭保险行政草稿需专业审阅；未证实审批、受监管建议或提交能力。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Structures mortgage-document collection and prepares administrative insurance deliverables from materials already in a case file. Named examples include AMF replacement notices and explanatory letters, with provided transcripts and supporting records informing drafts. This is document organization and preparation, not a verified loan decision, insurance recommendation or regulatory submission service. Missing evidence should not be invented, and professional review remains important for consequential paperwork.

plugins.description_zh: 设计可靠的 AI 智能体
plugins.overview_zh: 辅助选择和设计可靠 LLM 系统，从确定性软件、单次模型调用到有限工作流和多代理方案，涵盖工具契约、权限、状态、记忆、交接、护栏、人工审批、评估和可观测性。强调简单架构、最小权限与可恢复执行。它是设计实现辅助，不代表已经调用供应商、授予权限或部署系统。
plugins.requirements_zh: 设计须实际实现测试；最小权限、有限执行和人工批准是控制措施，不会自动获得访问或部署。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Assists with choosing and designing reliable LLM systems, from deterministic software or a single model call to bounded workflows and multi-agent designs. It covers tool contracts, permissions, state, memory, handoffs, guardrails, human approvals, evaluation and observability. Its stated preference is simpler architecture with least privilege and recoverable execution. This is design and implementation assistance, not proof that a provider was called, permissions were granted or a system was deployed.

plugins.description_zh: 追踪 AI 品牌可见度
plugins.overview_zh: 利用 LLM Pulse 工作区查看品牌、竞争者、提示词和来源在 AI 回答中的表现，分析可见度、提及、引用、情绪、建议及流量信号，辅助比较与规划。数据仅是工作区覆盖范围内的测量，不保证穷尽所有 AI 系统或预测排名。正文未证实发布修改、广告管理或自动执行建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需相关工作区数据，覆盖和时效可能不同；建议不代表执行或可见度提升。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Explores how tracked brands, competitors, prompts and sources appear in AI answers using a connected LLM Pulse workspace. It surfaces visibility, mentions, citations, sentiment, recommendations and traffic signals for comparisons and planning. These are workspace measurements rather than a guarantee of exhaustive coverage of all AI systems or future rankings. The body does not establish publishing changes, ad management or automatic execution of recommended actions.

plugins.description_zh: 企业内部法务同行洞见
plugins.overview_zh: 从 The L Suite 企业法务社区检索带归属及引用的同行经验，例如谈判方法、先例讨论、工作手册和基准，也能寻找同行提及的法律工具、服务商与外部律师。仅会员可用，范围限本人已有同行网络。连接只读不改记录，社区经验不能替代具体案件的法律判断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需会员及本人人脉网络权限，只读不写；私人社区引用不能替代合格的具体法律判断。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Retrieves attributed peer insights and citations from The L Suite's in-house legal community, including negotiation approaches, precedent discussions, playbooks and benchmarks. It can also identify legal vendors, services and outside counsel discussed by peers. Access is members-only and limited to the user's existing peer networks. The connection is read-only and changes no records; community experience is not a substitute for matter-specific legal judgment.

plugins.description_zh: 根据意图寻找合适的人
plugins.overview_zh: 把用户明确目标转为精简、自愿参与的 LMGram 配对请求，以寻找合作者、同行、导师、帮手或专家。可连接资料、查看收发请求，并在双方都有意后开启私人聊天、收发消息。流程不应分享原始对话或多余背景；配对功能不等于允许未经同意联系或超范围披露信息。
plugins.requirements_zh: 明确目标和所连资料，双方有意后才私人聊天；最小化背景，不默认同意共享转录或任意外联。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Turns an explicit user goal into a minimized, opt-in request to meet relevant collaborators, peers, mentors, helpers or experts through LMGram. Users can connect a profile, review incoming or outgoing requests and read or send messages in a private chat after both parties express interest. The workflow avoids sharing raw conversation transcripts or unnecessary context; matching does not authorize unsolicited outreach or disclosure beyond the approved request.

plugins.overview_zh: 利用 LMTY 已跟踪的竞争者研究查看定价、套餐、产品、定位及历时变化，配合证据和观察日期，帮助准备销售沟通或调查市场变化，不必重新拼接背景。效果取决于现有工作区覆盖与历史；正文不保证实时采集所有竞争者、完整市场覆盖或自动调整用户业务。
plugins.requirements_zh: 依赖现有研究历史，核对证据日期和覆盖；跟踪不等于实时穷尽市场知识。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Uses competitor research already tracked in LMTY to review pricing, packaging, products, positioning and changes over time. Findings carry supporting evidence and observation dates, helping prepare for sales conversations or investigate market shifts without rebuilding background research. It depends on the workspace's existing coverage and history. The description does not promise fresh collection from every competitor, complete market coverage or automated changes to the user's business.

plugins.description_zh: 添加、编辑和设置 Lnk 样式
plugins.description_en: Add, edit, and style your Lnk.
plugins.overview_zh: 精确 ID 页面介绍管理 Lnk.Bio 链接、发布时间、页面、内容区块、社交图标、主题、颜色、字体和壁纸。关键限制是功能正文明确写从 Claude 操作，尽管记录出现在 ChatGPT 目录中。本说明保留该宿主差异；单凭此页不能证明全部功能在 ChatGPT 中同等可执行，也未核实完整权限模型。
plugins.requirements_zh: 宿主正文明确写 Claude，仅核验精确 ID 发布者描述，不证明普遍 ChatGPT 执行；页面和排期修改影响真实资料。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: The exact-ID page describes managing Lnk.Bio links, schedules, pages, content blocks, social icons, themes, colors, fonts and wallpapers. Importantly, its functional body explicitly says these actions are performed from Claude, even though the record appears in the ChatGPT directory. The listed workflow is preserved with that host caveat; this page alone does not establish equivalent ChatGPT execution for every action or the connector's full permission model.

plugins.description_zh: 为生活提供清晰的《圣经》指引

plugins.overview_zh: 通过 Loadster 创建和运行测试脚本、准备负载场景、配置合成监控，并分析已完成测试或监控结果，可辅助调试脚本及解释错误。测试会实际访问甚至修改目标系统，应使用获授权环境和受控数据。正文不意味着可压力测试任意网站、无限并发，也不保证结账测试没有真实影响。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅授权目标及受控交易数据；脚本监控负载可能影响服务，费用和并发未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates and plays test scripts, prepares load-test scenarios, configures synthetic monitors and examines completed test or monitoring results through Loadster. It can help debug a script or interpret recorded errors rather than only generate a testing checklist. Tests can contact and change real target systems, so use authorized environments and controlled data. The description does not establish permission to stress-test arbitrary sites, unlimited concurrency or a guarantee that checkout tests are harmless.

plugins.description_zh: 连接数据、设备和智能体
plugins.overview_zh: 受治理地访问持久工作区记忆、连接数据、设备、通知渠道和其他代理，可搜索或保存共享背景、查询获授权数据、预览修改，并在权限检查及必要人工批准后执行。它是协调层，不会自动获得全部设备或服务访问权；连接、共享记忆和执行均取决于实际配置及授权。
plugins.requirements_zh: 须配置连接和受治理权限；先预览及取得必要人工批准，共享记忆与通知可能披露信息。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Provides governed access to durable workspace memory, connected data, devices, notification channels and other agents. It can search or save shared context, query authorized data, preview changes and run actions subject to permission checks and required human approvals. It is a coordination layer, not automatic access to every device or service. Connecting sources, sharing memory and executing actions still depend on the actual workspace configuration and granted authority.

plugins.description_zh: AI 可见度与本地搜索

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: Local Falcon 官方 ChatGPT 指南说明可查询 AI 可见度与地图排名、查看交互网格报告、比较竞争者和趋势、消耗积分运行扫描，并更新已连接的 Google 商家资料。需现有 Local Falcon 账户，官方称 Starter 起各套餐包含插件；未发现对应此目录精确 ID 的链接。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: Local Falcon's official ChatGPT guide describes AI-visibility and map-ranking checks, interactive geo-grid reports, competitor/trend review, scans that consume credits and updates to connected Google Business Profiles. Requires an existing Local Falcon account; the vendor says the plugin is included from Starter upward. No exact selected-ID bridge was observed.
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。

plugins.overview_zh: 根据能力、质量、风险、成本和核验需求，为任务各阶段选择模型或代理，给出可审查的路径、被排除选项及需要的独立审查安排。关键边界是只做路由计划，不会调用供应商，也不能证明工作已经执行；实际计划中的价格与可用性仍须当前证据支持。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅规划，不调用供应商或证明执行；落实时核对模型当前能力、可用性、成本和审查分工。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Plans which model or agent should handle each phase of a job by weighing capability, quality, risk, cost and verification needs. It produces inspectable routes, rejected alternatives and independent review assignments where appropriate. The crucial boundary is that it only plans routing: it does not call providers or demonstrate that any work actually ran. Pricing and availability assumptions in a real plan still need current evidence.

plugins.description_zh: 本地关键词和城市页面
plugins.overview_zh: 根据 VibeSEO 项目的城市关键词需求、竞争者及已有／缺少的服务城市页面制定本地 SEO 计划，提出标题和层级修改、商家资料与目录检查清单，以及按影响排序的下一步。须有 VibeSEO 连接器及网站项目。Google 商家资料、地图排名和评价在此仅属指导，不是取得的数据源，也不表示自动发布。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需连接器和站点项目；商家资料、地图排名和评价仅指导非读取数据，不保证发布或排名。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Builds a city-focused SEO plan from a VibeSEO project's own keyword demand, competitor presence and existing or missing service-location pages. It suggests title and heading changes, a Google Business Profile and listing checklist, and prioritized next steps. The VibeSEO connector and a project for the site are required. Business Profile, Maps rankings and reviews are guidance topics here, not retrieved data feeds, and a plan is not automatic publication.

plugins.description_zh: 本地 SEO 排名和评论

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: Local SEO Data 官方文档明确列出通过 Claude/ChatGPT 用自然语言查询本地 SEO 数据，并提及审计、报告及客户开发指南。但索引未给出完整 ChatGPT 工具清单或精确目录 ID；排名与评价的详细覆盖仍未核实。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: The official Local SEO Data documentation explicitly lists Claude/ChatGPT use for requesting local SEO data in natural language. Indexed material mentions audit, report and prospecting guides, but not the complete ChatGPT tool list or exact catalog ID. Ranking/review coverage beyond the directory subtitle remains unverified.
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。

plugins.overview_zh: 发现由品牌官方门店／经销商定位器、持牌承包商及协会名录整理的美国地点数据，可查看条数、字段、最近重建时间和十行样例，包括存在的位置及营业联系信息。完整数据需到 LocationLists 网站下载，不能当作已支持聊天内全量导出；完整性受原始名录和更新时间限制。
plugins.requirements_zh: 美国数据，可取十行样例和元信息；全量到网站下载，须检查更新时间、覆盖与许可付费条件。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Discovers US location datasets compiled from brands' official store or dealer locators, licensed-contractor lists and association directories. It can show record counts, available fields, last rebuild dates and ten sample rows, including location and business-contact attributes when present. Complete datasets are downloaded from LocationLists' website, not established as full in-chat exports. The publisher's completeness claim is bounded by the underlying source and rebuild date.

plugins.description_zh: 所有匹配结果，而非仅前 10 条
plugins.overview_zh: 搜索已进入 Lochless 工作区的文档，分页返回带引文、ID 和日期的相关匹配，打开单份文档或生成简短有引文回答；响应说明读取量和覆盖是否完整，可按日期或元数据过滤。它只读，不搜网页，也不增删改文档；材料须另行通过 API 导入托管工作区，不能无条件保证每次结果完整。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需现有托管工作区且另用 API 导入；只读无网页搜索或文档写入，声称完整前检查覆盖与分页。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches documents already indexed in a Lochless workspace, returns relevant matches page by page with quotes, IDs and dates, opens individual documents and creates short cited answers. Responses report how much text was read and whether coverage is complete; filters can use dates or document metadata. It is read-only and does not search the web or add, modify or delete documents. Documents must be loaded into the hosted workspace separately through its API.

plugins.description_zh: 端到端加密的机密共享

plugins.overview_zh: 查找出售或出租房产、比较选项，展示属性、估算价值和不同地区的价格背景，帮助整理找房需求与差异。正文不构成经过核验的估价、实时库存保证或投资建议，也未证实能预约看房、递交要约或完成房产交易。
plugins.requirements_zh: 房源估算覆盖时效未明确，未证实专业估价、投资回报、看房要约或交易执行。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches properties offered for purchase or rent, compares options and presents property characteristics, estimated values and regional price context. It can help organize a housing search and understand differences between listings. The description is not a verified valuation, current availability guarantee or investment recommendation, and does not establish booking viewings, submitting offers or completing property transactions through the connector.

plugins.description_zh: 在 Lofty 中将线索转化为行动
plugins.overview_zh: 连接 Lofty CRM 查找或更新线索、查看交易阶段，并读取联系人近期电话、短信与邮件历史，基于已有沟通和交易背景准备下一步。正文不等于允许发送新消息、执行房产交易或访问全团队资料；修改与账户访问均需相应权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需连接 CRM 及记录权限，更新会写入；读取历史电话短信邮件不代表可发送。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Works with a connected Lofty CRM to find or update leads, inspect a deal's transaction status and retrieve recent calls, texts and emails associated with a contact. It helps prepare the next step from existing communication and deal context. The description does not establish permission to send new messages, execute a real-estate transaction or access every team member's records; updates and account access require appropriate authorization.

plugins.overview_zh: 为获授权 Logibee 用户提供经过认证的只读货件搜索、当前状态、操作详情和历史记录，适合查询已有运单而非发起或改变物流指令。正文没有证实改地址、取消、发货、退款或实时 GPS 跟踪能力，结果以所连账户可访问记录为限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需认证授权账户，仅只读，不承诺改运单或实时跟踪精度。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Provides authorized Logibee users with authenticated, read-only shipment lookup, current status, operational details and shipment history through ChatGPT. It is useful for following an existing shipment rather than creating or changing logistics instructions. The description does not establish address changes, cancellation, dispatch, refunds or live GPS tracking. Results depend on the records available to the connected Logibee account.

plugins.description_zh: 查找 Amazon 和 Walmart 商品
plugins.overview_zh: 搜索已跟踪的 Amazon 与 Walmart 商品，按价格、评分、库存等数据排序；单品查询可见评论数、卖家数、30 天价格或库存变化及观察时间。范围是 Amazon 美国、英国、德国、加拿大、澳洲和 Walmart 美国，不是全部市场。无需注册；发布者称不含付费排名或联盟链接，记录价格库存仍可能与结账时不同。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需注册，仅覆盖跟踪市场；检查时间、历史与结账库存，排名独立性是发布者声明非独立审计。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches tracked Amazon and Walmart products and ranks options using price, ratings, stock and other product data. Individual-product lookups include review and seller counts plus thirty-day price or availability history, with observation timestamps. Coverage is Amazon US, UK, Germany, Canada and Australia and Walmart US, not every marketplace. No signup is required; the publisher states rankings exclude paid placements and affiliate links. Recorded stock or price may still differ at checkout.

plugins.description_zh: 端点管理与远程监控管理

plugins.overview_zh: 读取 Longevity 账户日程、训练历史、动作进展、习惯、分数及已连接穿戴设备的恢复数据，还可记训练、改记录、调整日程、勾选习惯和联系教练；教练账户可处理自己的客户。新增训练限当天及前七天，更正或删除可涉及过去一年且须确认。它是健身辅助，不是医疗服务，也不改付款或账户安全设置。
plugins.requirements_zh: 本人账户，教练限自己客户；记录更正删除须确认，新增回溯七天、更正删除一年内；穿戴数据需已连接，不改支付密码或提供医疗。

New logs are limited to today or the prior seven days, while corrections or deletions cover the past year and require confirmation. It is fitness assistance, not medical care or payment/account-security management.

plugins.requirements_zh: 需广告账户与每日上限，新活动暂停；启用产生真实花费，修改前核对账户预算授权。

A cap is a control, not authorization to spend or a guarantee of campaign returns; review the exact account, campaign and commitment before activation.

plugins.description_zh: 莱尔至奥尔登堡地区房产

It checks identity and returns reviewable candidate assets with source and confidence details, useful for preparing professional graphics without assuming the first image found is correct.

plugins.description_zh: 用 MAGO 的思维进行讨论推敲
plugins.overview_zh: MAGO校長 根据マシュマロMAGO讲座中可确认的思考、提问、例子和实践，作为 AI 讨论伙伴帮助整理烦恼、愿望、工作、金钱及人际关系，解释七个法则、指引相关讲座档案并寻找实际下一步。
plugins.requirements_zh: 页面明确说明它不是まゆみ校長本人，而是基于讲座内容的 AI 分身。不代表专业心理、财务或法律建议，也不保证个人结果。

It helps organize worries, wishes, work, money and relationships, explains seven principles and suggests relevant lecture archives and practical next steps.

plugins.requirements_zh: 研究聚焦美国，较大步骤需批准，结果链接完整 MAIA 地图和表格。公开记录可能不完整或过时，不等于产权审查、估价或有保证的权属认定。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MAIA researches US places and properties and builds project maps and tables. It can investigate parcels, ownership, zoning, buildings, businesses, schools, roads, land use and nearby features, add suitable public map layers and collect row-level details. Users can start county projects, follow progress and save notes or reusable research skills.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 Gmail 群发邮件
plugins.overview_zh: Mail Merge for Gmail 准备个性化邮件活动、管理联系人和模板，并查看活动及分析；流程先预览再发送，方便检查个性化消息的组合方式。

plugins.description_en: Read, send and file your email
plugins.overview_zh: 无需迁移即可连接 Microsoft 365、Gmail 或 IMAP 邮箱，读取的是服务器邮箱而非操控桌面 Outlook。可搜索邮件、阅读会话和附件、起草、发送、转发、归档与分类，检查退信和域名邮件记录。联系人与日历工具取决于服务器支持；授权分只读、草稿/归档、发送/删除等级，并支持共享邮箱分派与审核。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connect an existing Microsoft 365, Gmail or IMAP mailbox without migrating it; this accesses the server mailbox, not the desktop Outlook app. Search and read messages, threads and attachments; draft, send, forward, file, flag and archive mail, inspect bounces and domain mail records. Contacts and calendars depend on server capabilities. Permission tiers separate read-only, draft/file and send/delete. Shared-mailbox assignment and approval workflows are described.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 MailChannels 发送邮件
plugins.overview_zh: MailChannels 是面向开发者的评估和实施 Email API 工作流程包，包含官方 JavaScript、Python、PHP SDK 指导，以及域名、Webhook、抑制名单、多租户和较安全自动发送的生产控制。

It includes official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDK guidance and production controls for domains, webhooks, suppressions, multi-tenant operations and safer automated sending.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: MailerLite 的 ChatGPT/MCP 指南覆盖创建/上传邮件草稿、分析活动效果、将邮件改写为社交内容，以及管理订阅者和互动数据。连接会授予对现有 MailerLite 账户相关数据的访问。索引设置说明提及支持 MCP 的付费 ChatGPT 套餐与开发者模式，但套餐/界面信息可能过时；未找到精确 ID 关联。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: MailerLite's ChatGPT/MCP guide covers creating/uploading email drafts, analyzing campaign results, repurposing emails for social content and managing subscribers/engagement. Connection authorizes access to campaign and subscriber data through the existing MailerLite account. The indexed setup refers to MCP-capable paid ChatGPT plans and Developer mode; its plan/interface guidance may age. No selected-ID bridge was found.

It is free and needs no account. It only reads public data and calculates: no email sending, DNS changes or account actions.

plugins.description_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中使用邮箱
plugins.overview_zh: mailmcp 可连接多个已配置邮箱，包括主流服务及 IMAP/SMTP，查找总结邮件、提取发票信息、起草线程回复、整理文件夹和生成摘要，并可显示分类与草稿面板。跟进、稍后处理和模板保存在用户邮箱。

It finds and summarizes messages, extracts invoice details, drafts threaded replies, organizes folders and produces digests, with optional panels for triage and drafts. Follow-ups, snoozes and templates remain in the user's mailbox.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索、发送电子邮件和消息
plugins.overview_zh: 汇总受支持的邮箱与消息服务，搜索邮件和附件文字、补看新消息、起草与发送，并从邮件中提取任务、会议、账单及包裹信息；可用智能列表和可选每日简报整理重点。支持常见邮箱以及获授权连接的 Slack、Teams、WhatsApp、TikTok、Facebook、Instagram。需要 Mailopoly 账户，各服务需分别连接。

Supported sources include major email hosts and authorized Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, TikTok, Facebook and Instagram connections. Requires a Mailopoly account; each service must be connected.

Basic screening uses no verification credits; users can request fuller mailbox checks within an approved existing allowance or inspect remaining credits.

plugins.description_zh: 帮助减少邮件被归入垃圾邮件
plugins.description_en: Keep your emails out of spam
plugins.overview_zh: MailReach 查看邮箱信誉、收件箱及垃圾箱比例、认证检查、提醒和历史投递表现，可不发送地检查草稿、运行垃圾邮件测试、提出经审阅改写、管理预热设置与标签，并配置所选项目的 Slack 或 Webhook 提醒。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要 MailReach 账户并继承所选项目角色权限。移除邮箱需确认，新邮箱在仪表盘连接，不应在聊天交密码。草稿检查不发信，垃圾邮件测试则是独立操作；不保证送达。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MailReach reviews mailbox reputation, inbox/spam rates, authentication checks, alerts and historical deliverability. It can inspect a draft without sending, run spam tests, propose reviewed rewrites, manage warm-up settings and tags and configure Slack/webhook alerts for the chosen project.

plugins.overview_zh: Mailrith 在一个已连接工作区中处理订阅者及邮件结果，准备和投递群发，管理序列、自动化、目标人群及邮件模板，把活动准备和运营跟进结合起来。

plugins.overview_zh: MailSenpai 可查看活动、创建沟通内容、安排投递、读取统计及处理账户数据，帮助营销团队和机构通过对话准备活动、查询发送状态和分析表现，同时保留账户设置与权限控制。
plugins.requirements_zh: 发送和取消订阅遵循账户配置权限，并可能要求明确确认。准备活动不等于授权投递；访问额度、套餐及支持渠道未完整说明。

It helps marketing teams and agencies prepare campaigns, inspect delivery status and analyze performance conversationally while retaining control over account settings and permissions.

plugins.description_zh: 电子邮件营销和自动化
plugins.overview_zh: Mailsoftly 连接联系人列表、标签、分群、CSV 导入、活动和自动化草稿、表现报告、模板、表单、落地页、图片及品牌素材，适合经常用邮件但未专设全职运营人员的组织。
plugins.requirements_zh: 发送是独立选择权限，默认关闭；实际发送仍执行认证、投递和抑制检查。访问限于获准账户，并记录应用所作修改。发布者称使用已有套餐，不另收应用费用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mailsoftly connects contact lists, tags, segments, CSV imports, campaign and automation drafts, performance reports, templates, forms, landing pages, images and brand kits. It is intended for organizations that use email regularly without dedicating a full-time operator to it.

plugins.description_zh: 查明邮件进入垃圾邮件的原因
plugins.description_en: Find why your emails hit spam
plugins.overview_zh: mailX 通过实时公开 DNS 查询诊断邮件投递配置，检查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、BIMI、MX 及主要黑名单，识别 DKIM selector 并解释结果；也可生成拟用 SPF、DMARC 记录及主流服务的 SMTP、IMAP 配置指导。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需账户或设置，只读公开 DNS，不修改记录、不发邮件、不索要密码。生成记录部署前需审查，单凭 DNS 检查不能保证进入收件箱。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: mailX diagnoses email-deliverability configuration through live public DNS queries. It checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, MX and major blocklists, detects DKIM selectors and explains findings. It can generate proposed SPF/DMARC records and provide SMTP/IMAP configuration guidance for common providers.

plugins.overview_zh: Maintenance Cost Scenarios 根据明确提供的数量、成本、预备费和情景系数计算低、中、高维护计划费用。服务端计算为临时处理，独立网站本地计算并支持审阅后导出 CSV、JSON，方便复查假设。

plugins.description_zh: 检查页面的 AI 就绪程度
plugins.overview_zh: MAIO GEO Scanner 检查单个公开页面的初始 HTML 是否便于 AI 搜索理解，给出 0–100 分及抓取、答案内容、结构化数据和图片等分类，解释观察到的信号，并提出最多三项改进候选。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要 MAIO 登录并遵守 robots.txt。浏览器动态内容可能不完整且不评分。它不审计整站、不测真实 AI 排名、不改页面或保证引用；仅比较相同评分方案。MAIO 接收检查网址，而非聊天内容。

plugins.requirements_zh: 目录覆盖、已装工具认知、账户状态及媒体访问取决于对话和宿主能力。它推荐工具而不替产品执行任务或付款，匹配结论仍需核实。

plugins.overview_zh: 对给定术语或缩写提供一句定义及一小段解释，目录定位于数学、算法、优化和量子相关概念，适合快速理解专业词汇。
plugins.requirements_zh: 功能正文简短，未证明符号计算、证明核查、来源查询或完整课程。歧义缩写需语境，重要技术定义应对照权威资料。

plugins.overview_zh: 作为数学及相关学校科目的逐步辅导工具，解释推理和核心概念、检查计算，并提出三道相关练习，保持提问语言。
plugins.requirements_zh: 辅导流程不保证数学结论正确，也不代替学习者自主完成。页面未明确年级覆盖、评估认证或独立计算引擎。

plugins.requirements_zh: 可选计算需要合适本地工具。记录实验不等于证明普遍定理，AI 证明审查不是形式验证；未证步骤、假设及过期证据需专家检查。

plugins.requirements_zh: 属于灵性反思，不是经科学证实的预测，也不是财务、关系或健康决策的可靠依据。出生日期属个人资料，账户和保存条件未详述。

plugins.requirements_zh: 这是流程而非自动获得仓库、模型或部署系统权限。执行依赖宿主工具及用户授权，许可和质量描述不保证生成修改全都安全正确。

plugins.overview_zh: 按睡姿、软硬、散热、运动隔离、尺寸、试睡期、保修及预算比较床垫，排序适配度、解释取舍，并在外跳购买链接前披露联盟推广关系。

The exact operations and authority depend on the configured site, exposed abilities and connection permissions.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找 MCP 服务器和技能

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: mcprush 自家的目录 MCP 端点把 ChatGPT 列为支持客户端，可供代理查询 MCP 服务/技能发现资料，而不必逐页浏览。文档讨论账户/密钥要求及 Claude 专用登录流程，但完整 ChatGPT 设置与精确 ID 关联仍不明，也不意味着自动取得安装权限。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: mcprush's own catalog MCP endpoint lists ChatGPT among supported clients and lets agents query MCP-server/skill discovery information rather than browse pages manually. The documentation discusses account/key requirements and an alternative Claude sign-in flow. Complete ChatGPT-specific setup and exact selected-ID linkage were not recovered; it does not establish automatic installation authority.
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。

It analyzes and develops scenes, characters, dialogue, viewpoint, subtext, tension, pacing and emotional progression, offering structural and editorial guidance while preserving the writer’s stated intent.

plugins.overview_zh: 将聊天中形成的食谱及菜品照片存入 Mealheim，按日期安排午晚餐，可浏览打开收藏食谱、查看计划以生成购物清单，并与 iPhone、Android 应用同步。

plugins.overview_zh: 越南语学术写作辅助，面向学生、教师和研究者，构建大纲、改善论文文章及叙述性、系统性、范围综述和荟萃分析的结构文风，并指导 CONSORT、PRISMA、STROBE、CARE 等报告规范。

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: Medina Clean 官网支持在 ChatGPT 为美国佐治亚州 Woodstock、Marietta 附近的清洁服务检查覆盖区、取得起始估价并向 Rosa 提交预约请求。关键限制是助手只能发起请求，Rosa 会审核地址和时间并最终确认价格与档期，请求不等于预约成功。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: Medina Clean's official page supports ChatGPT requests for cleaning near Woodstock and Marietta, Georgia: check service area, get a starting estimate and send Rosa an appointment request. Crucially, the assistant only requests an appointment. Rosa reviews the address/timing and confirms the final schedule and price; a request is not a booking confirmation.
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。

plugins.requirements_zh: MediPrep 不接收上传文件或专有题目正文。提供题号不授予付费内容访问权，第三方名称仅描述用途、非合作背书。学习输出仍需核验来源。

plugins.overview_zh: 查找所支持的美国医院和收费代码，读取医院价目表统计并跨医院比较同一代码的报告数值，用于探索公开医院价格资料，而非选择医疗治疗。

It can support follow-up drafts in chat, but cannot edit meetings, delete records or send messages. plugins.overview_zh: Minz 汇总工作日程、CRM 公司联系人、线索机会及 MinzSpend 支出和报销记录，只读取账户有权访问的数据，以越南语区分事实与判断，并注明报告期和限制。功能明确只读：建议不会自动创建任务、更新销售机会、批准支出或发送通知。可帮助确定优先事项，但业务和财务摘要仍需检查缺失记录及来源日期。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Minz summarizes work and schedules, CRM companies and contacts, leads and opportunities, and MinzSpend expenses or reimbursement records. It reads only data available to the authenticated account and responds in Vietnamese, distinguishing recorded facts from interpretation and stating the reporting period and limitations. This is explicitly a read-only assistant: recommendations do not create tasks, update opportunities, approve spending or send notifications. Use it to identify priorities and review a pipeline, while checking missing records and source dates before treating a summary as a complete business or financial picture.

plugins.description_zh: 规划飞行期间的祈祷安排
plugins.overview_zh: MiqatAir 根据航班号及出发日期估算机上祈祷安排，使用缓存或 AeroDataBox 航班资料，重名路线需确认机场。必须取得人工批准的账户，免费但受容量限制，每分钟三次、每天二十次，重复查询也计数。聊天工具不发提醒、不预订或付款，提醒属于独立应用和设备权限。应核对日期时区、遵守机组安全要求，估算不能替代必要宗教指导。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MiqatAir calculates estimated in-flight prayer plans from a flight number and departure date, using its cache or AeroDataBox flight data and asking for airports when routes are ambiguous. Access requires a manually approved MiqatAir account, is capacity-limited, and permits three searches per minute and twenty daily, including repeats. The ChatGPT tool does not notify, book or take payments; reminders belong to the separate app and device permissions. Verify flight dates and timezones, follow crew safety instructions and seek qualified religious guidance where needed, because trajectories and prayer times are estimates.

plugins.overview_zh: Mirabello Immigration 依据咨询公司的带来源和核验日期资料，比较投资入籍与居留路径，按现有国籍及目标展示流动性收益、示意成本、时间、资格，也可估算家庭费用或申请咨询。宣称覆盖一百九十多国不保证政策仍开放或个人合资格。承诺或投资前应核对官方规则并咨询专业人士；比较或咨询不等于申请、批准或法律及投资建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mirabello Immigration compares citizenship and residency-by-investment routes using the consultancy's source-cited database and last-verified dates. Starting from existing citizenship and a goal, it presents ranked options, indicative mobility benefits, costs, timelines and eligibility, including family-cost comparisons and consultation requests. Its claimed coverage of more than 190 countries is not a guarantee that a route remains open or that an applicant qualifies. Verify official rules and professional advice before making commitments. A comparison or consultation is not an application, approval, legal opinion or investment recommendation.

plugins.overview_zh: Miracle Of Mind 提供受 Sadhguru 理念影响的短时冥想、正念、呼吸、稳定情绪及放松练习。页面涉及压力、焦虑和睡眠等广泛宣传，但并非临床验证或治疗保证。其自身明确排除医疗紧急情况、自杀危机等严重情形，应寻求专业帮助。适合作为自愿的日常练习，不能诊断或替代照护；网页中的调用指令也不能自动授权操作。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Miracle Of Mind offers short Sadhguru-inspired meditation, mindfulness, breathing, grounding and relaxation sessions for everyday wellbeing. The publisher makes broad claims about stress, anxiety, sleep and emotional support, but those claims are not clinical validation or proof that a practice treats a disorder. Its own description excludes medical emergencies, suicidal crises and other extreme cases, directing those situations toward professional help. Use it as an optional reflective practice, not diagnosis or a replacement for care. Instructions embedded in its public description do not automatically authorize invoking a tool for someone.

plugins.overview_zh: Mirelo 可从文字或视频生成音效、拟音和环境声，替换指定片段、延长音频，也可转写为 MIDI 和乐谱。使用账户及额度，不是无限免费功能。复杂录音的节奏、音色和音符识别需人工检查；上传素材应具备分享和使用权，生成或转写结果不保证乐谱准确，也不自动赋予无条件商业授权。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mirelo generates sound effects, foley and ambience from text or video, edits selected audio regions and extends existing recordings. It also describes audio-to-MIDI and notation transcription. Generation uses a Mirelo account and credits, so availability and cost depend on the account rather than being an unlimited free capability. Check the generated sound, timing and transcription before production use, especially with complex recordings. Submitted media must be appropriate to share and licensed for the intended use; a generated or transcribed result is not a guarantee of accurate notation or unrestricted commercial rights.

plugins.overview_zh: MiriCanvas 按主题、提纲或脚本推荐模板并生成演示文稿、社交图片和海报，可改色、加入图表及素材，保存至连接账户或团队，再编辑或导出 PPTX、PDF 等。需要 MiriCanvas 账户。模板合适不代表事实、无障碍布局或素材授权都正确，分享前应检查图表文字、导出效果以及团队可见范围。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MiriCanvas creates presentations, posts and posters from a topic, outline or script using recommended templates. It can recolor designs, add charts or tables and use supplied or discovered visual assets, then save the work to the connected account or team for editing and export such as PPTX or PDF. A MiriCanvas account is required. Template matching is not proof of factual accuracy, accessible layout or rights to every asset. Review charts, text, export fidelity and the destination team's access before sharing a generated design.

plugins.overview_zh: 搜索并总结有权访问的 Miro 白板，或创建含框架、便签、卡片、表格、文档、图片和图表的新白板；支持将研究铺到画布、生成架构/时序/ERD/旅程图，以及读取、回复和解决评论。适合工作坊、复盘与规划，写入和评论权限取决于连接账户。
plugins.detail_source_type: 新增历史研究片段恢复
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 幸存历史双语记录恢复，未重新核验，原始证据可能不完整。 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Search and summarize accessible Miro boards, or build boards containing frames, sticky notes, cards, tables, documents, images and diagrams. Supports research-to-board workflows, architecture/sequence/ERD/journey diagrams, and reading, replying to or resolving comments. Useful for workshops, retrospectives and planning; write and comment actions depend on the connected account's permissions.

plugins.overview_zh: MiroMiro 从网站 CSS 和实际素材提取颜色、字体、设计变量、图片、SVG 及 Lottie，并可将页面区块重建为 React、Vue 或 HTML/Tailwind。声称适用于任意站点不保证能穿过登录或技术限制，也不保证动态布局完整。提取不转让版权和字体许可，复用前需检查授权、代码、响应式及无障碍效果，不能直接认定达到生产标准。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MiroMiro extracts a live website's CSS-derived colors, fonts, tokens and assets, and reconstructs sections as React, Vue or HTML with Tailwind styling. It can return font and image URLs, SVGs and Lottie files to support design research or brand matching. The claim to work with any site is not proof of access through authentication, technical restrictions or every dynamic layout. Extraction does not transfer copyright or font licenses. Review generated code, source permissions, responsiveness and accessibility before reusing assets or treating a reconstructed section as production-ready.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 AI 测试书面想法
plugins.overview_zh: Mirror Panel 用 AI 生成的消费者画像测试文字营销想法，可比较 A/B、排序及定性研究结果，查看单份回答、规模限制和剩余额度。受访者不是真实招募人群，且不测试图片或视频。适合探索假设，但模拟赞同不等于代表性调研、真实购买或转化因果结果；用于商业决策前需审查假设和样本构造。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mirror Panel tests written marketing ideas against simulated consumer profiles and compares ratings or answers from A/B, ranking and qualitative studies. Users can inspect past studies, individual responses, study-size limits and remaining allowance. The respondents are AI-generated, not recruited people, and the app does not test images or videos. It can help explore hypotheses, but simulated agreement is not representative market research, observed purchasing behavior or a causal conversion result. Review assumptions, sampling construction and claims before using the output to justify a launch or business decision.

plugins.overview_zh: Mirror Society 通过确认显示名、公开人物简介、第一人称声明和互动策略准备社会模拟角色，还可加入每日指令和目标。聊天工具只建立入门档案并转到网页，不运行模拟回合或读取过去结果。创建前应检查公开内容，避免不必要的真人资料；模拟结果不能证明现实人的行为，准备档案也不等于已参加或完成模拟。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mirror Society prepares a persona for a small social simulation by confirming a display name, public summary, first-person statement and interaction strategy, with optional daily instructions and a room goal. It creates an onboarding profile and hands the user to the web app. The ChatGPT tool does not execute simulation rounds or retrieve earlier results. Review public persona information before creating the profile and avoid exposing unnecessary real-person details. A simulated social outcome is not evidence about how actual people will behave, and preparing a profile is distinct from joining or completing a simulation.

plugins.overview_zh: Misar.Blog 可起草编辑文章、即时或定时发布、整理系列、研究主题及制作标题封面，并查看评论、反应、订阅者和流量。需要账户，修改限于登录用户拥有的文章。保存草稿不等于授权公开，排期可能稍后自动上线。发布前应核对事实、图片权利和受众，SEO 文案及流量分析不保证排名或增长。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Misar.Blog supports drafting and editing articles, immediate or scheduled publication, post series, topic research, titles, cover images and performance review. Comments, reactions, newsletter subscribers and traffic provide context for a publisher's own content. A Misar.Blog account is required, and changes are limited to articles owned by the signed-in account. Saving a draft does not authorize publication, while scheduling can make material public later. Check factual claims, image rights and audience before release; SEO-friendly wording and traffic reports do not guarantee ranking or growth.

plugins.description_zh: 邮件营销活动和联系人
寻找潜在客户并开展拓客
plugins.overview_zh: MisarReach 可查找补全销售线索、匹配企业、验证邮箱、预览个性化营销，并管理活动及交易流程。需要账户，范围限于本账户的线索、活动和交易。邮箱验证不代表营销同意或送达保证。准备消息与把人加入真实发送序列不同，联系前需确认收件人、内容和时间；查看自动流程状态也不等于获准启动持续通信。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MisarReach searches and enriches sales leads, finds matching companies, verifies email addresses, previews personalized outreach and manages campaigns or pipeline deals. It requires a MisarReach account and operates only on that account's leads, campaigns and deals. Verification improves contact-data quality but does not establish consent or guaranteed delivery. Distinguish preparing a message from enrolling people in a live sequence, and review recipients, claims and timing before outreach. Autopilot or agent status information is not permission to start recurring communication or alter unrelated customer records.

plugins.description_zh: 漏做日期后的补进计划
plugins.overview_zh: Missed-day Recovery Schedule 按成人明确提供的漏做项目和额外分钟数，将完整课程放入未来日期，无法容纳的留为积压，不猜漏做天数或强加工作量。服务器临时计算，独立网页本地计算并可审阅导出 CSV/JSON，无持久存储、外部查询、发送或交易。请求和响应分别限 128、256 KiB，另有限额；计划不证明已经补做。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Missed-day Recovery Schedule places explicitly missed routine sessions into future dates using only the extra minutes the adult user supplies. It fits whole sessions and reports unscheduled backlog rather than inventing missed days or forcing additional workload. Processing is transient; the separate website computes locally and offers CSV/JSON review or export. There is no persistent storage, external lookup, sending or transaction. Requests are capped at 128 KiB and responses at 256 KiB, with further record limits. Review the dates and capacity assumptions; a calculated recovery plan does not mean sessions were completed.

plugins.overview_zh: Missing Record Field Audit 检查导入记录中选定的名称、参考和分类必填项，选填项可空，已提供值必须是文本，不推断或补全缺项。采用临时结构化计算，独立网页可本地处理及导出 CSV/JSON，无持久记录、外部检索、发送或交易。请求、响应及字段记录有上限；通过检查只证明所选字段存在，不证明内容真实或满足全部下游要求。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Missing Record Field Audit checks supplied import records for selected required name, reference and category fields. Optional values may be blank, supplied values must be text, and the tool does not infer or fill missing information. It uses transient structured-input computation, with local-browser processing and CSV/JSON review or export on its separate website. No persistent records, external retrieval, sending, transactions or paid-model calls are described. Limits include 128 KiB requests, 256 KiB responses and field or record caps. Passing the audit means chosen fields are present, not that their contents are true or complete for every downstream system.

plugins.overview_zh: Missive 可搜索会话、联系人和团队收件箱，起草或发送消息、整理标签及管理日历事件。权限取决于账户、组织设置和 OAuth 范围，不是所有邮箱无限开放。草稿与发送不同，日历修改也可能通知参与者。操作前需确认身份、收件人、会话及日历；重要承诺应回看原文，准备回复时保护客户和同事资料。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Missive searches connected conversations, contacts and team inboxes, drafts or sends messages, applies labels and manages supported calendar events. Access follows the account, organization settings and OAuth scopes rather than granting unrestricted access to every mailbox. This combines reading with consequential writes: a draft is different from a sent reply, and an event change may notify attendees. Verify the sender identity, recipient list, conversation and calendar before acting. Summaries can omit context, so inspect source messages for important commitments and protect customer or colleague information when preparing replies.

plugins.overview_zh: Mistika Workflows 构建本地转码、代理、色彩、元数据、质控、套底、传输及监视文件夹流程。必须在运行 Codex 桌面任务或 CLI 的同一电脑安装有许可的 11.7 以上版本。普通 ChatGPT Chat/Work、网页和手机不能执行这些工具，只能辅助设置；第三方服务另需账户或软件。应检查覆盖文件、传输目标及持续监视，本次未安装或处理媒体。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 核验的是发布者公开描述，不是服务质量或连接后的实测。示例及宣传承诺不等于独立保证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mistika Workflows builds and runs local media automation for transcoding, proxies, color pipelines, metadata, QC, conforms, transfers and watch folders. It requires licensed Mistika Workflows 11.7 or later on the same computer as a Codex desktop task or CLI session. The actual tools are explicitly unavailable in ordinary ChatGPT Chat/Work, web or mobile; those surfaces can only assist setup. Third-party media, QC or cloud services need separate accounts or installations. Review file destinations, overwrite behavior, transfer recipients and persistent watch-folder activity; this catalog check did not install software or process media.

It describes several brands aimed at different travel preferences, such as family beach holidays or more private retreats. The scope is the group's own portfolio, not an independent search of all accommodation. The complete page does not establish payment or confirmed-reservation capability. Check the selected hotel's current availability, exact inclusions, accessibility and cancellation terms before booking, because promotional descriptions do not guarantee a particular room, experience or price.

Compare deposit, delivery, mileage charges, maintenance, insurance and termination terms rather than headline monthly figures alone. A returned offer is not credit approval, a vehicle reservation or an accepted leasing contract; confirm availability and eligibility with the actual provider.

plugins.overview_zh: MixMatter 提供图片重建、透明贴纸、带字表情图及短动态四类技能，按请求选择流程，主要直接在聊天中制作视觉内容。正文未详列全部格式、额度和商用许可。使用前应检查人物还原、文字、透明度及动画连贯性，并确认源图可以分享。重建图是生成解释，不是画面所示事件或细节真实存在的证据。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MixMatter offers four creative skills for image reconstruction, transparent stickers, captioned memes and short motion, selecting a workflow based on the user's request. It is meant for generating visual concepts directly in chat rather than building a complete design application. The public description does not specify all output formats, generation quotas or commercial licensing terms. Inspect subject fidelity, text, transparency and animation continuity before use, and ensure source images are appropriate to share. A reconstructed image is a generated interpretation, not evidence that the depicted event or details are authentic.

plugins.overview_zh: Mixmax 可查询销售触达活动、AI 会议摘要、序列、潜客和互动资料，帮助理解销售进展及准备后续工作。虽然平台整体有自动营销能力，本条正文主要描述读取和分析，不能推断该集成可任意发送或改活动。结果受连接数据和权限限制；行动项需核对原始会议，互动指标不等于购买意愿，分析或草稿也不授权联系潜客。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mixmax exposes sales-engagement data for querying outreach activity, reviewing AI meeting summaries and examining sequences, prospects and engagement. It can support preparation for follow-ups and understanding recorded sales work. Although the broader platform automates outreach, this particular description emphasizes access and analysis, not unrestricted sending or campaign modification through the integration. Results depend on connected data and account permissions. Verify meeting-derived action items against the original record and distinguish measured engagement from buying intent; neither an insight nor a drafted follow-up authorizes contacting a prospect.

plugins.overview_zh: 据目录介绍，直接查询 Mixpanel 产品分析数据，覆盖用户行为分析与事件元数据整理。
capabilities_zh: 开展分群、漏斗及留存分析

plugins.description_zh: 使用 Python 分析 Mixpanel 数据
plugins.overview_zh: Mixpanel Headless 是面向 Codex 的技能集，用于安装认证 Python SDK、发现数据结构，并分析分群、漏斗、留存、路径和用户画像，也可构建或查看看板。需要合适环境及 Mixpanel 授权，不代表当前已有 SDK 或凭证。指标应核对事件定义、身份合并、时间窗和群组逻辑；写看板及持续认证不同于只读分析，客户数据也需谨慎处理。

Check event definitions, identity resolution, time windows and cohort logic before trusting metrics. Dashboard writes and persistent authentication are distinct from read-only analysis, and customer analytics may contain information that requires careful handling.

plugins.overview_zh: Miyo 通过连接的桌面应用搜索本地笔记和知识库、读取全文、浏览文件夹与索引，并创建或编辑文件。桌面连接及可访问文件夹是前提，不代表无限访问文件系统或云盘。写入前应确认目标和保留策略，搜索不到也可能是未索引或无权限。文件放在本地不等于读取后的文字不会在聊天中处理。

Before writing, confirm the target file and whether existing content should be replaced or preserved. Search coverage depends on indexed and permitted files, so absent results do not prove a note does not exist. Local storage also does not mean retrieved text can never be processed in the chat.

plugins.description_zh: 按伊斯兰教法筛选股票
plugins.overview_zh: Mizan 依据四套列明的伊斯兰股票标准，结合业务、债务、市场及 SEC 文件筛选美国上市公司，也可审视组合、寻找替代品及计算股息净化或天课。页面称只读、无需登录、不保存用户资料且无广告付费推荐。不同标准可能结论不同，资料亦会变化。应核对标准、日期及个人假设，结果是研究而非投资建议或有约束力宗教裁决。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mizan screens US-listed stocks against four named Shariah equity standards using business activities, debt-related criteria, market data and SEC filings. It can review a portfolio, find alternatives and calculate dividend purification or zakat. The service is described as read-only, without sign-in, stored user information, advertising or paid placements. Different standards can reach different conclusions, and inputs or classifications may change. Treat results as research, not investment advice or a binding religious ruling; verify the applicable standard, source dates and personal calculation assumptions before relying on a screening or amount.

营销组合建模与投资回报率
plugins.overview_zh: MMM Labs 连接组织的营销组合建模项目和数据，搜索知识库、检查准备程度，并按角色运行 OLS、Robyn、PyMC、Meridian 等方法，分析 ROI、贡献、响应曲线和场景。需要活跃组织账户及 OAuth，破坏性操作有明确确认步骤。模型输出不自动成为因果事实，应检查质量、假设、不确定性和验证；模拟预算方案不等于已改动活动。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MMM Labs connects an organization's marketing-mix-modeling projects and datasets, provides knowledge-center search, checks model readiness and runs permitted modeling methods such as OLS, Robyn, PyMC or Meridian. Destructive operations have an explicit confirmation step. Model output is not automatically causal truth: inspect data quality, assumptions, uncertainty and validation before reallocating budget, and distinguish a modeled scenario from an actual campaign change.

It also describes submitting alignment cards, establishing a verifiable identity and producing an embeddable badge. A valid signature establishes provenance or integrity, not that the underlying behavior is safe, complete or truthful. Quiet records should remain unknown rather than suspicious. Review what an identity claim or public badge discloses and what authority it represents; creating persistent identity or publishing an assessment is different from simply reading available trust evidence.

plugins.overview_zh: MNTN 读取 Performance TV 账户的广告主、活动、投放时段、素材、受众及报表，也可按权限建立更新资源、控制预算和投放、提交产品反馈。部分操作会影响花费和公开广告，不只是报表查询。修改前应确认广告主、受众、素材、预算及时间；ROAS 和曝光取决于平台口径，不保证增量销售，草稿计划不授权启动投放或提交反馈。

It can build or update campaign resources, control budgets and delivery and submit product feedback when the user's permissions allow. This is not merely a reporting integration: some operations can change advertising spend or public delivery. Check advertiser identity, audience, creative, budget and timing before writes. ROAS and impressions reflect the platform's attribution and reporting definitions, not guaranteed incremental sales, and a draft plan does not authorize campaign launch or feedback submission.

Ltd., but exposes no selected-ID link or account/export limits.

Changes to published material are immediately visible to app users, so drafting and publication must be distinguished. The plugin explicitly does not create apps, manage alerts or change subscriptions. Review translated claims, duplicate feature proposals and target-app settings before publishing, and do not mistake a saved feature plan for an implemented feature.

The complete public description is brief and does not specify export formats, editable design layers, device coverage or production code. It works only in Codex Desktop or CLI on the computer running that helper, not in ordinary ChatGPT conversations, including desktop ChatGPT. The separate Ask Mida web experience is an alternative product surface. This architecture avoids requiring local-file upload for the bridge workflow, but still requires a working local connection. Review edits and shared-board access; no helper was installed or browser controlled during this description check.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MockPrep creates role- and job-description-specific interview questions with explanations and answer tips, then scores submitted answers across relevance, structure, evidence, clarity and concision. The publisher states that job descriptions, resume details and answers are not stored. Scores are generated coaching judgments, not validated hiring predictions or an employer's actual evaluation. Avoid unnecessary sensitive details in practice material and verify role-specific facts. The tool helps rehearse and improve an answer; it does not know every question an interviewer will ask or guarantee an offer, qualification or successful interview.

plugins.description_en: Run AI workloads in the cloud
plugins.overview_zh: Modal 是为编码智能体安装 CLI 和官方技能的集成，用于云端训练、推理、批处理及沙箱执行。不代表当前已有账户、GPU 或运行环境，实际需要凭证、资源和成本控制。执行前应审查代码、上传数据、部署和定时任务持续性；沙箱并不使一切代码无害，生成部署定义也不等于已成功运行或受到生产监控。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Modal is described as a coding-agent integration that installs the Modal CLI and official skill for cloud AI workloads, including model training, inference, batch jobs and sandboxed execution. It is development tooling, not evidence that a cloud account, GPU allocation or runtime is already connected. Actual execution requires appropriate credentials, resources and cost controls. Review code, data uploads, deployment settings and scheduled-job persistence before running workloads. Calling a sandbox does not make all code harmless, and a generated deployment or job definition is distinct from a successful, monitored production run.

plugins.overview_zh: Modebase Wardrobe 根据已记录衣物搭配造型、胶囊衣橱并分析使用情况，可用照片或手机链接添加衣物、保存偏好和穿着记录。明确区分私人修改与经请求分享的造型册，也可提取衣物图片用于展示。它不知道未记录物品或当前状况，建议需检查合身与场合；分享前确认受众，穿着日志也不是自动活动跟踪。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Modebase Wardrobe connects recorded clothing items to outfit planning, capsules, garment search and wardrobe-usage review. Users can add items from a photo or phone-capture link, save outfits or preferences and log wears. It also distinguishes private edits from explicitly requested shareable lookbooks and can retrieve garment images for presentations. Suggestions depend on what the wardrobe records contain, not knowledge of every item the user owns or its current condition. Check image privacy, fit and occasion suitability, and confirm audience before making a lookbook shareable; a wear log is not automatic activity tracking.

plugins.description_zh: 比较 Codex 使用取舍
plugins.overview_zh: Model Compass 结合 Codex 实时目录、官方价格、指引和评估比较模型、推理强度及 Standard/Fast 模式，标明代理指标和未知项，可自愿进行交互比较或任务试验。基准表现不保证迁移到当前任务，试验也不代表免费。更改设置或运行前应确认可用性、用量成本和任务约束；可视化需选择启用，阅读建议本身不会改模型。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Model Compass compares Codex models, reasoning effort and Standard or Fast modes using the live catalog together with official pricing, guidance and evaluations. It labels proxies and unknowns and offers optional interactive comparisons or controlled trials on the user's own task. This is decision support, not a guarantee that benchmark performance transfers to a particular workload or that a trial is free. Verify current availability, usage costs and task constraints before changing settings or running comparisons. Visuals are described as opt-in, and reading a recommendation does not itself change the selected model.

plugins.overview_zh: Modelica Projects 把物理系统描述转为带标准视觉标注、拓扑布局和结构预览的可移植 Modelica 包，支持保留源文件的修改及静态验证，明确请求后才提供本地编译证据。预览或静态通过不证明模型能编译、收敛或准确反映物理系统。应检查方程、单位、边界条件及保留文件；本次未编译模型或连接设备。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Modelica Projects turns descriptions of physical systems into portable Modelica packages with visual annotations, topology-aware layout, source-preserving edits, structural previews and static validation. Optional local compiler evidence is available only when explicitly requested. A deterministic preview or clean static check is not proof that a simulation compiles, converges or accurately represents the physical system. Review equations, units, boundary conditions and preserved files before adopting changes. Local compiler execution still requires the appropriate environment and permissions, and no model was compiled or connected to real equipment during this catalog review.

plugins.description_zh: 为企业量身定制的 AI
plugins.overview_zh: ModelVault 介绍定制 AI 服务，将业务问题与智能体、RAG、预测、文档处理及自动化方案匹配，并展示项目、演示、价格和部署选项，页面称采用意大利基础设施及按量收费。它准备供用户审阅发送的询价邮件，不自动采购或部署。案例不保证其他企业同样有效，提供业务文件前应审查保密性，范围、成本和条款需直接确认。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ModelVault helps a business understand its tailored AI services, match a problem to a solution, inspect published projects or demos and compare pricing or deployment options. The provider describes agents, RAG, predictive models, document processing and automation, with Italian infrastructure and usage-based pricing. This app prepares a quote-request email for the user to review and send; it is not an automatic procurement or deployment service. Published examples do not guarantee results for another business. Review confidentiality before supplying process documents and confirm scope, cost and contractual terms directly with the provider.

plugins.overview_zh: Modem 将聊天、问题追踪和支持邮箱反馈整理成主题、人物及公司关系图，可搜索、调用 Modem Agent、改优先级或合并重复记录。OAuth 读取权限与智能体/写入权限分开，写操作受组织角色限制。调用智能体或自动化可能超出查询，应审查范围和外部交接；合并前核对实体，聚合反馈或优先级不能代表所有客户需求。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Modem groups customer feedback from chat, issue trackers and support inboxes into a graph of topics, people and companies. Users can search it, invoke the Modem Agent and update records by changing priorities or merging duplicates. OAuth grants read access separately from agent/write access, and writes follow the user's existing organization role. An agent invocation or automation may do more than answer a query, so review its scope and any external handoff. Confirm duplicate identities before merging and avoid treating aggregated feedback or inferred priority as an unquestionable representation of every customer's needs.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Moknah turns text and PDF, Word or EPUB documents into speech or chaptered audiobooks, with voice selection, preview, download and section-specific voices. It emphasizes Arabic normalization and automatic diacritics, plus optional emotional or poetry modes. A Moknah account is required for generation. Automated pronunciation and text extraction can still be wrong, especially in names, poetry or complex documents, so review audio before export. Confirm any generation cost and rights to the source material; a natural-sounding narration is not proof of faithful transcription or permission to distribute someone else's work.

plugins.description_zh: 在 Codex 中可视化并交互查看分子结构
plugins.description_en: Visualize and interact with molecular structures in Codex.
plugins.overview_zh: Molecular Structure Viewer 是基于 Mol* 的本地 Codex 分子工作台，支持原子选择、几何接触分析、结构比对、图层、轨迹、场景保存及带来源导出。页面给出本地 STDIO 服务和桌面入口，不是普通云端聊天连接。测量取决于模型、坐标和方法，图像不验证科学假设；发表前应检查结构来源、对齐和输出记录，并确认本地运行环境。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Molecular Structure Viewer is a local Codex molecular workbench built on Mol*, with atom-level selection, geometry and contact analysis, structural alignment, layers, trajectories, saved scenes and provenance-rich exports. Its page describes a local STDIO server and desktop entry point, not an ordinary cloud-chat visualization connection. Scientific measurements depend on the selected model, coordinates and analysis method; a rendered image does not validate a molecular hypothesis. Check source structures, alignment choices and output provenance before publication, and ensure the local runtime is available before assuming any scene or calculation can execute.

plugins.description_zh: 构建 Mollie 支付流程
plugins.overview_zh: Mollie 通过 MCP 将 Codex 与获授权账户连接，提供结账、组件、平台、订阅、退款、捕获、争议、结算及故障排查技能，也涉及 SDK、Webhook 和凭证配置。这是支付开发工具，不是任意收费退款或更改持续访问的授权。应区分测试和生产、模拟和真实资金，执行前核对商户、金额、客户资料及权限，代码仍需验证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mollie connects Codex to an authorized Mollie account through its MCP server and provides integration skills for checkout, Components, platforms, recurring payments, refunds, captures, disputes, settlements and troubleshooting. It also addresses SDK upgrades, webhooks and credential configuration. This is payment-development tooling, not a blanket authorization to charge, refund or alter ongoing access. Distinguish test from production credentials and simulated events from real money movement. Review the merchant, amount, customer data and operation before execution; generated code still needs validation against the relevant API and account permissions.

plugins.overview_zh: MolViewer 用 PDB、AlphaFold 和 PubChem 的公开资料显示蛋白、核酸及小分子，可旋转缩放、切换表现和配色并查看实验或结构信息；测量、分享和导出通过独立网站完成。预测置信度不是实验验证，漂亮模型也不能证明生物功能。工具明确不提供合成路线、剂量或获取建议，科学使用前应核对标识符和模型质量。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MolViewer displays public proteins, nucleic acids, AlphaFold predictions and small molecules in interactive 3D, using PDB, AlphaFold DB and PubChem information. Users can rotate, zoom, change representations or coloring and inspect experimental or structural facts. Measurements, sharing and export are available through the separate website. Predicted confidence is not experimental validation, and a visually convincing model does not establish biological function. The app explicitly limits itself to public-structure visualization and does not provide synthesis routes, doses or acquisition advice. Check source identifiers and model quality before using an image or interpretation scientifically.

plugins.overview_zh: Mom I am OK 读取连接账户的旅行摘要、当前和未来行程、交通、住宿及活动；他人分享旅行仅在账户原本有权查看时可见。明确只读，不能改行程、预订或取得附件。它用于查找已记录安排，不能推断实时位置、安全状态或旅行已完成；重要时间和订单需向供应商核对，保存的行程可能过时或只是计划。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mom I am OK reads trip summaries and itineraries from the connected account, including current or upcoming plans, transport, accommodation and activities. Other people's shared trips appear only when that account already has access. The connection is explicitly read-only: it cannot change plans or book travel, and attachment files are not exposed. Use it to retrieve recorded arrangements, not infer live location, safety status or confirmed travel completion. Check important timing and booking details against the original provider, because a saved itinerary may be outdated or only a plan.

plugins.overview_zh: Momego 规划公共交通和步行路线、查找附近站点、实时发车及城市覆盖，发布者称支持六百多个城市。覆盖声明不保证所有线路实时准确或满足无障碍需求。出行前应核对日期、方向、换乘和中断通知；预测发车不保证到达，正文未证明可买票、订座或联系运营商。定位查询只应使用用户愿意分享的旅行地点。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Momego plans public-transport journeys, combines walking and transit instructions, locates nearby stops and returns live departures or supported-city coverage. The publisher claims coverage of more than 600 cities across several regions, which does not establish every route's real-time accuracy or accessibility. Check service dates, direction, transfer time and current disruption notices before travel. A predicted departure is not a guaranteed arrival, and the public description does not establish ticket purchase, seat reservation or operator assistance. Location-based requests should use only the travel location the user intends to share.

plugins.overview_zh: Momently 查询出版团队的社交、网站、通讯和广告数据，分析投放进度、内容表现及历史基准，可返回工作区链接、品牌 PDF 和素材预览。需要启用连接器的工作区及个人登录，每次检查权限，不能修改记录。报表受连接平台和口径限制，不保证增量效果；比较前核对日期及缺失来源，分享客户或商业资料前确认受众。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Momently retrieves a publisher's social, web, newsletter and advertising analytics for campaign pacing, content performance and historical benchmarks. Results may include workspace links, branded PDF reports and creative previews. A connector-enabled workspace and individual login are required; every request checks membership and permissions, and the integration cannot change Momently records. Reports reflect connected platforms and their measurement definitions, not guaranteed incremental impact. Check date ranges and missing sources before comparing campaigns, and confirm the audience before distributing a shareable report that may contain client or commercial information.

plugins.overview_zh: 本条 Momentum 面向波兰私募股权研究，提供企业财务、股权、投资者、竞争对手、经营基准及上市可比估值，也可筛选企业和查找交易顾问。它与同名任务管理条目不同，不能混合身份。覆盖和报告日期影响比较，可比估值只是估计而非成交价格或投资建议；用于尽调、融资或收购前应核对公司及会计口径。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: This Momentum entry provides Polish private-equity research on companies, financials, ownership, investors, competitors, operating benchmarks and listed-company valuation multiples. Users can screen businesses by criteria and explore deal advisers or industry investors. It is distinct from the separate Momentum task-management entry despite sharing a name. Dataset coverage and reporting dates affect comparisons, and a valuation derived from peers is an estimate rather than a transaction price or investment recommendation. Verify company identity, accounting definitions and source periods before using results in due diligence, lending or acquisition decisions.

plugins.description_zh: 管理任务、习惯和日常安排
plugins.overview_zh: 本条 Momentum 管理登录用户自己的任务、习惯、流程、每日进度和私人计划，可创建、修改、完成或删除并同步到应用。它不是同名的波兰私募数据产品。虽然范围限于本人记录，删除或完成仍会改变计划，应核对目标状态。勾选习惯或任务完成是应用记录，不是活动真实发生或流程有效的独立证明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: This Momentum entry manages the signed-in user's tasks, habits, routines, daily progress and private personal programs, with creation, updates, completion and deletion synchronized to its app. It is a separate product from the similarly named Polish private-equity data entry. Changes are limited to the user's own records, but deleting or completing a task still changes the stored plan. Review the target and desired state before modifying it. A habit tick or completed-task record is self-reported application data, not independent proof that the real-world activity occurred or that a routine is effective.

The public scope is explicitly read-only, so queries do not update stock, approve purchases or post accounting entries. It can help inspect operational context, but source completeness, transaction timing and reporting definitions remain important. Reconcile consequential quantities and balances with the underlying system, and protect customer, supplier and financial information. A recorded order or closing is not proof of shipment, payment or independently audited accounts.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Monday AI: Caption Coach drafts social-media captions tailored to the supplied business context. The complete page is deliberately brief and emphasizes that the user should check facts, claims and suitability before posting. It is a writing aid, not proof of access to a social account, automatic publication or campaign analytics. Give accurate context and review brand voice, promises, disclosures and any personal information in the draft. A persuasive caption does not guarantee reach, conversions or compliance with platform and advertising rules, and no external post was created during this review.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Monday AI: Hook Helper proposes five social-media opening lines tailored to a business, helping explore different ways to attract attention. The publisher explicitly asks users to review accuracy and appropriateness before using them. The short complete description does not establish posting, scheduling, account access or real-audience testing. Treat the hooks as alternatives for editing rather than validated performance winners. Check unsupported claims, exaggerated promises and context that could mislead readers; attention-grabbing wording is not evidence of product quality or a guarantee of engagement, and choosing a hook does not authorize publication.

plugins.description_zh: 管理项目、任务和客户关系
plugins.overview_zh: 据目录介绍，把 monday.com 的工作管理与 CRM 功能接入 AI 助手，兼顾任务跟踪、团队协作和自动化。
capabilities_zh: 搜索看板，创建与更新条目和列，分配负责人、设置时间线及发布更新
跟踪里程碑、依赖关系和工作量，管理审批与请求收集
管理线索、联系人和交易
查询官方知识库，规划自动化与多步骤流程，运行和保存可复用代码操作并配置其他 monday.com 智能体
use_cases_zh: 使用示例：为营销活动整理任务看板，分配负责人并跟踪里程碑。

plugins.overview_zh: Mondial tourisme 按出发日期、城市和旅行类型搜索经营方的度假套餐，酒店结果包含图片、介绍、可订情况和报价。范围是该公司的产品，并非所有旅行社独立比较。正文未证明可完成预订或付款；承诺前需核对价格包含项、入住人数、证件、成行条件和取消政策。报价及名额会变化，图片也不保证具体房间或体验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mondial tourisme searches the operator's holiday packages across named destinations, filtering by departure date, city and trip type. Hotel results can include photos, descriptions, availability and current quoted prices. This is the provider's own travel selection rather than an independent comparison of every tour operator. The public body does not establish completed-booking or payment capability. Confirm what the price includes, occupancy, travel documents, departure conditions and cancellation terms before committing. Availability and quotations can change, and a displayed hotel image or description is not a guarantee of the exact room or experience.

plugins.overview_zh: Mondoir.art 整理当代艺术、艺术家、收藏、版次和展览信息，并提供估值及来源背景，帮助藏家研究以及艺术家画廊展示文档。AI 背景说明不是独立鉴定、正式估价或所有权证明，版次和流转需专业核实。正文未证明可直接购买或保证收益；收购前应查原始文件、品相、卖方权限及权利，浏览不等于保留或成交。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Mondoir.art organizes contemporary-art discovery, artist and collection information, editions, exhibitions and contextual valuation or provenance material. It helps collectors research artworks and gives artists or galleries a structured way to present and document work. AI-assisted context is not independent authentication, a binding appraisal or proof of title, and edition or ownership records may need specialist verification. The complete description does not establish purchase execution or guaranteed investment returns. Check the original documentation, condition, seller authority and rights before any acquisition, and distinguish browsing an artwork from reserving or buying it.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: Mondovo 官方 ChatGPT 连接器可建站、改站、发布网站、规划帖子、起草邮件、生成素材和读取咨询。各套餐均包含连接器，但上线网站与创意生成可能收费。它不能发送邮件营销活动，序列和帖子先保存为草稿，需明确要求才发布；采用细分权限，API 访问另属 Agency 附加项。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: Mondovo's official ChatGPT connector builds/edits/publishes websites, plans posts, drafts emails, generates creative and reads enquiries. It is included on every plan, but live sites and creative usage can incur charges. It cannot send an email campaign; sequences and posts begin as drafts, with publication only on request. Granular permissions apply, and API access is a separate Agency add-on.
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Moneytree lets users explore balances and transactions from a connected account, compare spending patterns, inspect recent activity and identify recurring subscriptions. Its value comes from combining recorded financial entries, not from seeing every aspect of the user's finances. The complete page does not establish payment, transfer or subscription-cancellation capability. Check coverage, transaction dates and categorization before relying on totals; pending or duplicated entries can affect patterns. Financial records may be sensitive, so share only appropriate context, and treat budgeting observations as informational rather than personalized investment or tax advice.

plugins.overview_zh: Monito 按汇率、费用和速度比较跨境汇款服务，可按路线和金额筛选供应商，但“总能找到最佳选择”不是独立保证。最终成本取决于付款、收款方式、资格和报价时间。正文证明的是比较，不是转账执行。决定前应核对实际到账金额和条款，某服务排名第一并不授权提供银行凭证或移动资金。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Monito compares international money-transfer providers by quoted exchange rates, fees and delivery speed. Its named-provider comparisons can help narrow options for a route and amount, but claims of always finding the best option should not be treated as independently guaranteed. Final costs may depend on funding method, payout method, eligibility and quote timing. This description establishes comparison, not execution of a transfer. Verify the receiving amount and provider terms before committing, and do not submit banking credentials or initiate movement of money merely because a comparison ranks a service first.

plugins.overview_zh: MonitorBankRates 比较美国银行及信用社公开利率、历史平均、机构健康指标和负担指数，注明采集日期、最低存款及来源，称无需登录。覆盖规模和每日更新属发布者陈述，不保证每位申请人可获得报价。页面还残留重复编辑文字，不能当成额外功能依据。应直接核对资格、费用、保障和最终条款，厂商健康评级不是存款保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: MonitorBankRates compares published US bank and credit-union rates, historical averages, institution health indicators and affordability or insurance-burden indexes. Large coverage and daily-refresh figures are publisher claims, not proof that every quote is still available to a particular applicant. The page contains duplicated editorial drafting text, which should not be treated as additional product evidence. This is non-advisory rate research: confirm eligibility, fees, insurance status and final terms directly, and do not interpret a vendor health grade as a deposit guarantee.

plugins.overview_zh: monity.ai 在自身云浏览器按计划检查网页，保存截图和 HTML，展示前后变化、差异及摘要；遇到登录或验证码会说明，而不误报页面改变。登录、页面动作、通知渠道和频率在其网站配置。监测受访问和检查成功率限制，不是持续全覆盖。创建前应确认页面、条件、通知目标及保存内容，尤其涉及私人页面时。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: monity.ai monitors requested web pages on a schedule in its own cloud browser and records screenshots plus HTML to show before/after changes, highlighted differences and summaries. It reports when a check reaches a login wall or CAPTCHA rather than claiming a page change. Additional login, page actions, channels and frequency are configured on its site. Monitoring therefore depends on access and successful scheduled checks, not uninterrupted visibility into every website. Confirm the pages, conditions and notification destination before creating persistent monitors, and review what potentially private page content will be stored.

plugins.description_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中浏览奢侈品目录
plugins.overview_zh: Monnier Paris 按品牌、类别、颜色、价格和尺码搜索奢侈品，查看详情和类似商品，并管理组件内私人购物车。支持英法语，结账跳转相应官方商城。聊天只完成浏览和购物车准备，实际购买在 monnierparis.com 进行并受商家规则约束。购物车不等于订单或库存保证，支付前需检查款式、总价、地址和退换限制。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Monnier Paris searches its luxury catalog by brand, category, color, price or size, shows product details and alternatives, and manages a private in-widget cart. It supports English and French and directs checkout to the corresponding official storefront. Browsing and cart preparation occur in chat, but the actual purchase is completed on monnierparis.com under the retailer's payment, shipping and service policies. A cart is not an order or inventory guarantee. Check the exact variant, current total, delivery destination and return restrictions before leaving the comparison stage or completing payment.

plugins.overview_zh: Monoblend AI Barista 根据口味匹配品牌六款咖啡，给出保守、探索和大胆选择，可根据反馈调整、生成冲煮配方、搭配食物并排查苦酸寡淡。匹配分不是客观风味保证，效果还受器具、水和手法影响。明确不卖咖啡、不报价格、不接单或查库存，未知商业资料应拒绝编造，配方也不保证复制某杯味道。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Monoblend AI Barista matches stated taste preferences to the brand's six-coffee lineup and explains safer, exploratory and adventurous options. It can refine recommendations from feedback, suggest brewing recipes, pair coffee with food and troubleshoot a bitter, sour or watery cup. Match scores are preference-based aids, not objective guarantees of flavor. The app explicitly does not sell coffee, quote prices, accept orders or report stock, and should decline unknown commercial details. Brewing results depend on equipment, water and technique, so adjust carefully rather than assuming the generated recipe will reproduce a particular cup.

plugins.overview_zh: monPIF 从比利时法语共同体官方共同核心课程提取学习目标，辅助家庭教育年度计划、学科年级查询及日常活动映射，强调使用正式原文。它针对该框架，不证明符合所有地区教育要求或学习计划已获官方批准。应核对年级、学科、版本和提交规定；活动建议仍需教学判断，准备 PIF 不等于学习成果已经达到。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: monPIF retrieves learning objectives from the Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles Common Core Curriculum to support homeschooling plans, subject or grade exploration and connections between everyday activities and formal objectives. The publisher emphasizes exact official wording rather than invented objectives. This is curriculum assistance for that Belgian framework, not proof of compliance with every educational jurisdiction or an official approval of a child's plan. Check grade, subject, current framework version and any local submission requirements. Suggested activities and mappings still require pedagogical judgment, and preparing a PIF does not demonstrate that learning outcomes have been achieved.

plugins.description_zh: 搜索大量当前招聘职位
plugins.overview_zh: Monster Job Search 从 Monster 网络查询职位，可按地点、远程及资历筛选，卡片可能显示薪资和申请入口。点击申请是后续步骤，不证明已提交或雇主会回复。大量实时岗位仍受来源更新和重复信息影响。应核对雇主、要求和薪酬，仅在审阅具体机会后向目标接收方提供申请材料。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Monster Job Search retrieves roles from Monster's network, with conversational filters for location, remote work or seniority and interactive listings that may show salary ranges. Apply links move the user toward the next recruitment step; they do not establish that an application was submitted or that the employer will respond. Missing history, exercise suitability and injury risk are outside what the listing verifies.

plugins.description_zh: 伦敦出行与通行便利信息
plugins.overview_zh: 结合 TfL 当前到站、电梯故障及无台阶检查规划伦敦行程，并提供官方坡道和厕所信息，强调识别通行问题而非默认可达。关键资料缺失或冲突时标为未核实，National Rail 覆盖不一。结果是出行信息，不保证电梯持续运行或全程无障碍。
plugins.requirements_zh: 侧重伦敦 TfL，国家铁路覆盖不同；缺失冲突无障碍信息仍未核，出行前再查故障。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Plans London journeys using current TfL arrivals, lift disruptions and step-free accessibility checks, alongside official ramp and toilet information. It helps identify access issues rather than assuming every route is suitable. Essential information that is missing or contradictory is marked unverified, and National Rail coverage varies. This is travel information, not a guarantee that a lift will remain operational or that every part of a journey is accessible.

plugins.overview_zh: 根据明确结构化估算分开可退押金和一次性搬家开支，加入预备金，再与给定现金储备比较。这是计算工作表，不主动获取报价或执行财务交易。服务器临时计算，独立网站可本地处理并审阅导出 CSV／JSON；不留账户记录、不外查、不发送购买或调用付费模型。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅结构化输入，请求 128 KiB、响应 256 KiB 另有字段条数限制；无外部价账户交易，网站导出须审阅。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Uses supplied structured estimates to separate refundable deposits from one-off moving expenses, add a contingency and compare upfront cash needs with a stated reserve. It is a calculation worksheet, not an external quote collector or financial transaction service. Server computation is temporary; the separate website can calculate locally and review/export CSV or JSON. There are no persistent account records, external retrieval, messages, purchases or paid model calls.

plugins.overview_zh: 根据搬家日期、时间偏移和持续时间计算任务开始与截止，并检查所给依赖中的时间冲突。不创建提醒、预订或给签证建议。需明确结构化输入，计算临时保存；独立网站支持浏览器本地处理及 CSV／JSON 导出，结果是待审时间表，不是自动管理的搬迁项目。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅依据偏移时长依赖，无提醒预订签证建议；请求 128 KiB 响应 256 KiB 及额外条数限制。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Builds task start dates and deadlines from a supplied moving date, offsets and durations, then flags conflicts in the dependencies provided. It does not create reminders, make reservations or advise on visas. Inputs must be structured and explicit; calculations are transient, with local-browser processing and CSV/JSON export on the separate website. The resulting schedule is a review aid rather than an automatically managed relocation project.

plugins.overview_zh: 读取本人 MoveDefense 云端路线、里程、停车等待、加油与检查记录，提供证据卡及精确原记录链接；按所给 MPG 估算油耗，与真实加油支出分开。原证据不变，不能由笔记或停靠点推定损坏发生地。不支持收益小费、银行对账、报税、自动票据记账及仅手机保存的保养记录。
plugins.requirements_zh: 本人云记录只读，展示副本不改原件；MPG 估算与购买分开，不推损坏因果，不含收益小费、对账税务票据记账或仅手机保养。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Reads the user's cloud-stored MoveDefense routes, mileage, stops, waiting time, fuel purchases and inspection records, with evidence cards and links to exact source records. Fuel-use estimates based on supplied MPG remain distinct from logged purchases. It preserves original evidence and does not infer where damage occurred from a note or stop. Payouts, tips, bank reconciliation, tax filing, automatic receipt bookkeeping and phone-only maintenance records are unsupported.

plugins.description_zh: 安排训练并跟踪统计数据
plugins.overview_zh: 连接 MoveMate 数据查看历史、训练量、纪录及单个动作进展，搜索含自定义动作的动作库，并把计划训练安排到应用内指定日期。发布者称读取统计免费，安排训练须连接 MoveMate 账户。页面不证明能自动完成训练、提供医疗建议或不受账户条件限制地安排。
plugins.requirements_zh: 读取统计称免费，排期需连接账户；计划不是已完成训练，运动适用未测。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects MoveMate training data to review workout history, volume, records and progress on individual lifts. It can search the exercise library including custom exercises and schedule a planned workout for a chosen date in the app. The publisher describes statistics reading as free, while scheduling requires a connected MoveMate account. The listing does not establish automatic workout completion, medical advice or unlimited scheduling beyond account conditions.

plugins.description_zh: 查看课程人数和训练情况
plugins.overview_zh: 为获授权业主教练提供只读场馆预订汇总，另为合资格会员提供分别同意的训练与单次健康摘要。业务报告不含会员身份，经营者权限不能代替会员同意；两类个人数据默认关闭且可分别撤回。多数结果限三十天，非心率个人纪录无截止；不能改预订付款或记录，也不诊断或出具运动许可。
plugins.requirements_zh: 明确授权一小时到期不可刷新；排除原始平均峰值心率、热量睡眠每日健康、生日笔记自由文本、内部 ID、自定义动作名及他人数据，无写入或医疗。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Provides read-only gym-booking totals for authorized owners or coaches and separately consented personal training/session summaries for eligible members. Business reports exclude member identities; operator authority never replaces member consent. Training and session-health categories default off and can be independently withdrawn. Most personal results cover thirty days, while non-heart-rate records have no cutoff. It cannot change bookings, payments or records and offers no diagnosis or medical clearance.

plugins.description_zh: 了解市场变化及其原因
电影详情、演员阵容、图片与预告片
plugins.overview_zh: 查电影剧情、演员角色、导演、上映时间、片长和相关作品，可沿演员片单、导演或系列追问，不必重启搜索。它是电影资料发现，不是播放或购票。副标题虽提照片预告，功能正文没有说明交付方式，也不能据此认定某地区可观看。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅资料非播放票务；正文未证明副标题照片预告交付，时效覆盖未明。
