plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Looks up films and supports follow-up exploration of plots, cast, characters, directors, release dates, running times and related works. Users can move between an actor's films, a director's work or a series without restarting their search. This is film-reference discovery rather than streaming or ticket purchase. Although the subtitle mentions photos and trailers, the main functional body does not specify their delivery or establish availability in a particular region.

plugins.overview_zh: 按偏好推荐电影、记录已看与评分、管理想看清单，并通过 Instagram、TikTok 或 YouTube 链接识别影片，结合观影整理和发现。页面未证实播放、私人或失效视频支持、识别准确率或账户条件；识别片名不等于能在应用中观看。
plugins.requirements_zh: 识别受链接与元数据限制，无播放权准确保证，账户隐私条件未详。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Offers movie recommendations based on taste, tracks watched films and ratings, maintains a wishlist and attempts to identify films from Instagram, TikTok or YouTube links. It combines personal viewing organization with discovery. The listing does not establish streaming access, support for private or unavailable videos, identification accuracy or account requirements, so a recognized title is not proof that the film can be watched through this app.

plugins.overview_zh: 官方搜索索引显示精确的 MovieFind ID 与名称，但只有图片/标题行，没有功能正文。原目录副标题仅称随机发现电影；筛选、推荐方法、播放链接及账户要求均未核实。
plugins.detail_source_type: 新增历史研究片段恢复
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 幸存历史双语记录恢复，未重新核验，原始证据可能不完整。 仅标题/图片行恢复，未取得功能正文。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: The official search index exposes the exact selected MovieFind ID and name, but only an image/title line, not a functional description. The original directory subtitle says it randomly finds movies; filters, recommendation logic, streaming links and account requirements remain unverified.

plugins.description_zh: 与朋友共享电影待看清单

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: moviegroupies 明确支持 ChatGPT 通过 MCP 搜电影、评分、管理片单和协调共享群组。工具文档采用 OAuth，支持类型/年份/语言筛选，并分别记录星级和想看程度。加入群组及分享片单可能改变可见范围；这是目录/片单工具，不是影片播放服务。未发现精确 ID。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: moviegroupies explicitly supports ChatGPT via MCP for movie search, ratings, watchlists and coordinating shared groups. Its tool reference describes OAuth, genre/year/language filters and separate personal star ratings/want-to-watch levels. Joining groups and sharing lists can change visibility; this is a catalog/watchlist workflow, not movie streaming. No exact selected-ID bridge was observed.
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。

plugins.description_zh: 查询 MSCI 投资数据
plugins.overview_zh: 让有权限的 MSCI 用户用自然语言查询指数、私募资本、组合和实物资产数据，涉及表现、基准、持仓、敞口、成分及方法。它是受授权控制的数据检索，并非开放全部 MSCI 数据；正文未证实交易、转账或个人投资建议，访问依赖已有许可。
plugins.requirements_zh: MSCI 许可控制数据，无交易转账证据；重大用途前核对方法许可日期。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lets entitled MSCI users query index, private-capital, portfolio and real-assets datasets in natural language. Covered topics include performance, benchmarks, holdings, exposures, constituents and methodology. It is access-controlled investment-data retrieval rather than unrestricted access to MSCI's entire catalog. The page does not establish trading, account transfers or individualized investment advice, and data access remains subject to the user's existing entitlements.

plugins.description_zh: 实验室工作的化学安全
plugins.overview_zh: 检索有来源的化学兼容、危害、防护、储存废弃、暴露运输及地区监管信息，可从上传 SDS PDF 提取结构化数据并生成签名审计报告。它是参考和记录工具，不保证实验安全或合规。真实实验仍需核对原安全说明、现行法规及合格 EHS 审查，签名也不代表政府批准。
plugins.requirements_zh: 上传 SDS 可能外部处理，核对原文件、司法区日期及专业 EHS；签名不认证安全合规。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Retrieves sourced chemical-safety information such as compatibility, hazards, protective equipment, storage, disposal, exposure and transport classifications, with regional regulatory coverage. It can extract structured data from uploaded SDS PDFs and generate signed audit reports. These are reference and documentation capabilities, not a guarantee that an experiment is safe or compliant. Original safety sheets, current regulations and qualified EHS review remain necessary for actual laboratory decisions.

plugins.overview_zh: 按主题、经文、日期或教区搜索以波兰语为主的天主教讲道，并用用户语言解释，可比较观点、准备讨论笔记及查看读经祈祷和公共教区资料。仅覆盖参与教会且隐私处理后的公开内容。转录可能出错或经 AI 编辑，翻译评论须与原文分开，没有录音控制。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅参与教会、主要波兰语脱敏公开资料，可有转录 AI 编辑错误，区分原文翻译评论，无录音控制。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Finds Catholic homilies by topic, scripture passage, date or parish in a mainly Polish archive and explains them in the user's language. It supports comparisons, discussion notes, available readings, prayers and public parish information with source links. Coverage is restricted to participating churches and privacy-redacted public content. Transcripts may be wrong or AI-edited, and translations/commentary are distinguished from original text; no recording controls are provided.

plugins.overview_zh: 用 MT Newswires 金融报道研究公司、行业和宏观，可查标的新闻、财报、并购、分析师变化及央行动态，讨论市场影响。发布者强调多资产实时覆盖，但新鲜度、订阅许可和偏见未独立实测。新闻检索不能证明价格因果，也不等于交易建议或券商下单。
plugins.requirements_zh: 可能有许可时间版权限制，实时中立声明未测，不保证价格因果或投资回报。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Brings MT Newswires financial reporting into company, sector and macroeconomic research. It can surface ticker news, earnings, M&A, analyst changes and central-bank developments and support discussion of their market effects. The publisher emphasizes real-time multi-asset coverage, but freshness, subscription entitlements and source bias were not independently tested. News access does not establish price causality, a trading recommendation or brokerage execution.

plugins.description_zh: 优化《万智牌》指挥官套牌清单
plugins.overview_zh: 使用对应工具审查万智牌指挥官套牌的法术力基础、预组升级、廉价替换、角色缺口和分档变化，结果含估价、取舍与警示，可附 TCGplayer 联盟链接，无需账户。建议不认证合法性或强度，购物链接不下单，仍需核对现行规则及零售价格。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需账户，价格估算且可附联盟链接，不认证强度合法性、不下单。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Reviews Magic: The Gathering Commander decks using named tools for mana bases, preconstructed-deck upgrades, cheaper substitutions, missing roles and bracket changes. Results include estimated prices, trade-offs and warnings, with optional TCGplayer affiliate links. No account is required. Suggestions are not a certification of legality or deck power, and the shopping links do not place orders; verify current card rules and actual retailer prices separately.

plugins.description_zh: 旅行 SIM、eSIM 和移动数据
plugins.overview_zh: 按目的地比较预付费旅行流量的价格、用量、有效期和覆盖国家，包括单国及跨国套餐。结账在 MTX Connect 网站而非聊天内完成；卡可在账户中追加套餐继续使用，实体卡邮寄，eSIM 需兼容手机。实际线路和设备仍须核对覆盖适用性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 外站结账，eSIM 需兼容手机、实体卡邮寄；追加套餐在账户，核对国家期限运输。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Compares live prepaid travel-data packages by destination, price, allowance, validity and covered countries, including local and multi-country plans. Users proceed to the MTX Connect website for checkout rather than paying in ChatGPT. SIMs can be reused for later packages in the account; physical SIMs are shipped and eSIMs need a compatible phone. Coverage and plan suitability must be checked for the actual itinerary and device.

plugins.overview_zh: 通过用户自己的桌面 Chrome 与 Muchita 扩展核查精确商品及款式报价，在 ChatGPT 卡片中显示已核实结果。运费独立显示，不影响商品价排序，未知运费不算免费；手机不能运行新核价。无需账户密钥，商品及检查数据临时处理并在一小时内删除，不下单付款。
plugins.requirements_zh: 须桌面 Chrome 扩展非手机，无账户密钥；运费另算未知非免费；声称一小时删数据不传完整对话，不订购付款。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Checks offers for an exact product and variant in the user's own desktop Chrome through the Muchita extension, then displays verified offers in a ChatGPT card. Shipping is separate from item-price ranking and unknown shipping is not free. Fresh checks cannot run on phones. No account or API key is required; selected-product/check data is temporarily processed and deleted within an hour. It does not order or take payment.

plugins.description_zh: 处理 Muesli 转录文本

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: Muesli 官方 ChatGPT/Codex 公告说明可查找本地会议转录、提取决定/行动项和起草实施计划。必须在保存录音的 Mac 上安装 Muesli，并让助手有权访问本地 CLI/数据；仅安装插件不会把数据库开放给远程或浏览器会话。可改用导出 Markdown；写回经审核笔记时保留原转录。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: Muesli's official ChatGPT/Codex announcement covers finding local meeting transcripts, extracting decisions/action items and drafting implementation plans. It requires Muesli installed on the Mac holding recordings and assistant access to its local CLI/data; installing a plugin alone does not expose that database to a remote/browser session. Markdown export is the fallback. Reviewed notes can be replaced while preserving the raw transcript.
official_product_supplement.limitations_zh: 仅从幸存历史记录恢复；未重新核验，完整原始响应未恢复。

plugins.description_zh: 查询经核验的 NFL 统计数据
plugins.overview_zh: 从预核验数据面板返回 NFL 数字、来源、核验日期和署名，支持球员球队查询、比较、排行榜、指标解释及按联盟 ID 查询 Sleeper 背景；临时计算另标未验证并附方法和样本量。不提供预测、阵容建议、推荐投注或赔率。引用只覆盖原始数字，不覆盖助手衍生评论；缺覆盖须说明，梦幻分采用注明的半 PPR。
plugins.requirements_zh: 免费只读无账户，来源只核数字；临时未验证计算和助手评论分开，无预测阵容推荐建议排名或赔率，注明半 PPR。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Retrieves NFL statistics from a prechecked panel with sources, verification dates and required attribution, supporting player/team lookups, comparisons, leaderboards, metric explanations and Sleeper-league context by league ID. On-demand calculations are separately labeled unverified computations with method and population size. The service supplies no predictions, lineup advice, picks or betting odds. Citations cover returned figures, not an assistant's derived commentary, and unavailable coverage is disclosed; fantasy figures use stated half-PPR scoring.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接参与的本地商家尤其餐厅，查看菜单服务、提问和获取建议；正文还包括通过商家系统下自取订单，因此不只是目录。地域、支付、取消及确认流程未详述，真实订购前须确认店家、商品价格和自取条件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅参与商家，自取下单可能形成承诺，先核总价商品店家及取消支付条款。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects users with participating local businesses, especially restaurants, to explore menus and offerings, ask questions and receive recommendations. Its functional description also includes placing pickup orders through connected business ordering systems, making it more than a directory. Geographic coverage, payment handling, cancellation and approval steps are not detailed on the page; confirm the business, items, price and pickup terms before any consequential order.

plugins.description_zh: 韩国包装食品营养信息
plugins.overview_zh: 按韩文品名及可选厂商查询韩国包装食品标签，展示营养、原料、已记录过敏原、HACCP 和参考日期，可按每百克比较二至五品及显示每包装数据。只读无需账户，不查价购物。过敏原资料约仅覆盖 4.6%，缺失绝不代表无过敏原或安全可食，必须看包装。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只读无需账户、政府标签日期；过敏原仅约 4.6%，缺失非安全；不做饮食健康判定或广告店铺购买链接。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Looks up Korean packaged-food label records by Korean name and optionally manufacturer, showing nutrients, ingredients, recorded allergens, HACCP status and reference dates. It can compare two to five products per 100 g and display per-package data. It is read-only with no account, prices or purchasing. Allergen records cover only about 4.6% of products, so missing data is never an allergen-free or safe-to-eat verdict; check the package.

plugins.overview_zh: 把明确提供的多行单元格拆成有序记录，保留来源 ID 和原行号，支持 LF、CRLF、CR，明确空白及修剪策略，每格最多一百行。临时处理，独立网站可本地计算、审阅导出 CSV／JSON；不外查、不保存账户记录、不发送交易或用付费模型。
plugins.requirements_zh: 每格一百行，明确修剪空白和换行；请求 128 KiB 响应 256 KiB 加字段条数限制，网站导出须审阅。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Splits explicitly supplied multiline cells into ordered records while preserving source IDs and original line numbers. LF, CRLF and CR are supported, with explicit trimming and blank-line policies and a maximum of 100 lines per cell. Processing is transient; the separate website offers local-browser calculation and CSV/JSON review or export. It does not retrieve external data, maintain account records, send messages, transact or use paid model calls.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 Multilocale 翻译工作区审阅本地化文案、检查缺失重复翻译、管理项目与语言，并在确认后新增、更新、分享或删除翻译键。操作会影响保存的本地化内容，不只是聊天草稿；未证实自动部署到生产、翻译质量保证或任意分享项目权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需工作区授权，改键共享删除均确认，生产部署和恢复方式未明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Brings Multilocale translation workspaces into ChatGPT to review localized wording, identify missing or duplicate translations and manage projects and locales. It can create, update, share or delete translation keys with confirmation. These changes affect stored localization work, not only a conversational draft. The listing does not establish automatic production deployment, translation-quality guarantees or a universal permission to share project content.

plugins.description_zh: 上市公司可比估值、并购和风投数据
plugins.description_en: Public comps, M&A and VC data
plugins.overview_zh: 返回带来源的上市可比公司、并购倍数和创投资料，可研究买方、行业倍数或融资轮次，辅助投行和私募市场研究。发布者所称投资级及已验证不等于独立准确保证；估值前须核对许可、覆盖、方法与时效，正文不证明交易或投资建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 核对来源日期估值法和许可，供应商核验非独立审计，未证实个人建议或执行。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Returns structured, sourced valuation-research information on listed-company comparables, M&A multiples and venture-capital activity. Queries can explore acquisition buyers, sector multiples or funding rounds, supporting banking and private-market research. The publisher's investment-grade and verified-data language is not an independent accuracy guarantee. Entitlements, coverage, methodology and freshness should be checked before use in a valuation, and the connector does not establish trading or investment advice.

plugins.overview_zh: 在私人或家庭厨房保存定稿食谱及不可变历史版本，连接本人 Mums! 账户后可查找、读取、保存和更新。它是存储与版本服务，不自行生成食谱。发布者说明不调用 OpenAI API、不售卖数据、没有付费功能，这些运营声明未在本轮独立审计。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需本人连接账户和厨房权限；保存定稿不可变版本，不生成食谱，无付费功能。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Stores finalized recipes and immutable historical versions in private or family kitchens. After connecting their own Mums! account, users can find, read, save and update recipes through ChatGPT. It is a recipe storage and versioning service, not the recipe generator itself. The publisher says it neither calls the OpenAI API nor sells data and has no paid features; those broader operating claims were not independently audited here.

plugins.description_zh: 选购婴幼儿和儿童必需品
plugins.overview_zh: 无需账户即可搜索 Mumzworld 母婴儿童目录、查看详情和尺寸颜色定制、建立访客购物车，查询配送估算、常见问题和优惠。可选关联账户会合并购物车并开放收藏、地址、余额及订单历史跟踪。查目录和购物车不等于已能最终付款，也不保证商品适合特定孩子。
plugins.requirements_zh: 访客可浏览建车，关联会合并并开放地址余额订单；核对授权结账，未证实年龄安全适用。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches Mumzworld's baby, children's and maternity catalog, reviews details and customization options, and builds a guest cart without an account. Delivery estimates, FAQs and promotions are available to guests. Optional account linking merges the guest cart and exposes the wishlist, saved addresses, credit, order history and tracking. Catalog and cart access do not themselves establish final payment or a guarantee of product suitability for a particular child.

plugins.overview_zh: 搜索 Municibid 政府剩余资产拍卖，查看已成交可比记录并作粗略市场估价，帮助研究设备或车辆。估值不是正式评估、保证转售价或当前中标价。正文未证实竞价、交押金、成交支付、运输安排或支出授权。
plugins.requirements_zh: 历史成交仅粗估，无竞价押金购买权，参与前查当前拍卖条款。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches active government-surplus auctions on Municibid and compares them with completed-auction sales. Historical results can be used for rough market-value estimates, helping users research equipment or vehicles before deciding whether to participate. The estimates are not formal appraisals, guaranteed resale values or live auction-winning prices. The description does not establish bidding, deposits, purchase execution, shipping arrangements or authority to commit funds.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 Muninx 支持历史，搜索记录、查看更新和创建工单、起草回复，并用自然语言理解处理情况。正文关于客户回复写的是草拟，不应当作已证实发送。账户角色、删除行为、外部发送审批和套餐限制没有详列。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需工单权限，写入持久，客户回复仅草稿非发送，套餐删除规则未明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects Muninx support history to search conversations, inspect and update tickets, create new tickets and draft replies. Teams can understand ticket activity through natural language instead of treating a shared inbox as the sole source of context. The documented reply action is drafting, not a demonstrated send. Account roles, deletion behavior, external messaging approval and plan restrictions are not specified on the public page.

plugins.description_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯家庭服务
读取和编辑 Mural 看板
plugins.description_en: Read and write in Mural boards
plugins.overview_zh: 创建、读取和编辑 Mural 看板，把获授权组织信息转为协作视觉材料，用于会议、研究归纳、战略规划及复杂概念说明。编辑会改变外部工作区，不仅生成静态图。页面未列全对象类型、共享范围、删除控制或其他数据源连接方式，需另核权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需看板权限，读写影响共享成果，对象共享删除范围未列全。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates, reads and edits Mural boards to turn authorized organizational information into collaborative visual material. Intended workflows include meeting facilitation, synthesizing research, strategic planning and explaining complex ideas. Board editing changes external workspace content rather than merely producing a static image. The listing does not enumerate supported object types, sharing scopes, deletion controls or how other source systems are connected, so those permissions must be checked separately.

plugins.description_zh: 筛选高确信度股票买入想法（原文表述）
plugins.overview_zh: 按 Murali Growth Fund v3.0 框架跨行业筛选，考虑基本面、估值、催化因素、财报、技术指标、组合风险及可访问论坛资料；达不到标准时可以没有合格候选。结果不是独立验证的投资意见、盈利保证或券商执行证据，来源时效及框架假设显著影响判断。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需当前证据和框架审阅，可无候选，不保证建议盈利或执行。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Applies the named Murali Growth Fund v3.0 screening framework across sectors using fundamentals, valuations, catalysts, earnings, technical measures, portfolio risk and accessible public-forum material. It may return no qualifying purchase candidate when its criteria are unmet. The framework's screening output is not independently validated investment advice, a profitability guarantee or proof of brokerage execution. Current source access and the framework's assumptions materially affect conclusions.

plugins.overview_zh: 用 Musafir.com 当前产品目录解释从阿联酋申请者可用的签证服务、费用材料、处理期及最近公布预约情况，并跳转匹配申请页。连接器只读，不能读账户订单、占位预约或付款。供应商能受理不等于政府法律要求，名额不是预留，更不预测获签。
plugins.requirements_zh: 目前仅阿联酋申请者，供应商目录非政府法律，公开名额非预留，申请链接可能携带所给资料；无账户订单支付预约或获签预测。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Uses Musafir.com's live product catalog to explain visa-service eligibility, fees, required documents, processing times and last-published appointment availability for travelers applying from the UAE. It hands users to the matching website application page. The connector is read-only: no account/order access, booking hold or payment. A provider's service scope is not the government's legal requirement, appointment data is not a reservation, and approval is never predicted.

plugins.overview_zh: 登录后可列设计、建空白画布、生成可编辑海报或素材图、去背景、分析自有图片及建二维码，在 Musamimuk 应用中完成编辑。生图消耗账户币，不表示无限生成、自动发布或所有素材都有商业权利，制作最终广告前需核对余额与条款。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需登录，生图耗账户币，到应用完成编辑，核对权利余额。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: After sign-in, Musamimuk can list designs, create a blank canvas, generate an editable poster, create a library image, remove backgrounds, analyze owned images or make a QR code. Users finish editing in the Musamimuk app. Image generation consumes account coins. The description does not establish unlimited generation, automatic publishing or commercial rights for every asset, so review credits and usage terms before producing final campaign material.

plugins.description_zh: 了解个人审美并选购商品
plugins.overview_zh: 从多张穿搭图、情绪板或文字概括整体审美和配色，并链接相符独立品牌商品；多参考合为品味，不是精确找同款。免费无需账户，部分购买可能带佣金；发布者称不影响结果，此点未独立核实。实际购买通过商家链接。
plugins.requirements_zh: 免费无账户，多图整体审美非找同款，部分链接有佣金，核对库存权利。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Infers an overall clothing aesthetic and color palette from multiple outfit images, a mood board or a written description, then links to matching independent-brand items. It treats several references as a combined taste rather than exact product identification. No account or fee is required. Muse may receive commissions on purchases; the publisher says this does not change results, but that claim was not independently tested. Purchases happen through linked merchants.

plugins.overview_zh: 把自然语言音乐构想转为可编辑的 Strudel、LilyPond 或 SuperCollider 源码，并提供链接与本地交接方式播放编辑。它是源码辅助，不保证输出最终母带或在任意聊天直接播放。相应运行、渲染工具及本地文件权限须另行具备。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需对应运行时及播放编辑交接，生成源码不等于已渲染或本地运行。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Converts natural-language musical ideas into editable source for Strudel, LilyPond or SuperCollider. It provides links and local handoff actions so the result can be played or edited in an appropriate environment. This is source-generation assistance rather than a guarantee of a finished audio master or playback in every chat. The relevant runtime, rendering tools and permission to use local files are separate requirements.

plugins.description_zh: 创建乐谱与吉他指法谱
plugins.overview_zh: 把简短原创音乐构想转成可播放排版乐谱，包括吉他贝斯尤克里里六线谱及键盘大谱表，支持多乐器、最多八声部、变速与分轨静音独奏；还涵盖替代调弦、扩展音域和常见演奏节奏技巧。适合创作练习教学，不承诺转录任意录音或复现受版权保护乐谱。
plugins.requirements_zh: 简短原创示例，合奏最多八部；不含无限导谱转录或受版权曲目权利。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Turns short original music ideas into engraved notation and playable examples, including guitar/bass/ukulele TAB and keyboard grand staff. It supports many instrument families, ensembles up to eight parts, tempo changes and part muting or soloing. Alternate tunings, extended-range instruments and common rhythmic or instrumental techniques are described. It is a composition, practice and teaching aid, not a promise to transcribe arbitrary recordings or reproduce copyrighted scores.

plugins.overview_zh: 围绕和弦、音程、音阶调式、调号、节奏和记谱进行交互练习，重练习而非讲课，严格检查拼写并调整难度、用学习者语言回复。它是对话教练，未证实听演奏评分、认证成绩、长期进度存储或接入某乐器课程。
plugins.requirements_zh: 练习教练严格拼写可调难度，未证实认证考核、乐器音频分析或持久课程记录。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Runs interactive music-theory drills on chords, intervals, scales, modes, key signatures, rhythm and notation. It emphasizes practice rather than lectures, checks spelling strictly, adjusts difficulty and responds in the learner's language. This is a conversational learning coach; the description does not establish audio performance assessment, certified grading, long-term progress storage or integration with a particular instrument or school curriculum.

plugins.overview_zh: 按听感发现相似歌曲艺人及符合情绪、风格、活动的歌单，解释声音特点、播放预览并跳转流媒体继续听。速度宣传不是测量保证，正文未证明完整播放权、各地区均可用或能修改用户歌单和听歌历史。

plugins.overview_zh: 搜索 My AskAI 的公开产品与帮助资料，包括安装、集成、API、功能、价格和故障排查，读取完整文档/OpenAPI 文件，并根据每月客服工单量估算价格。所有工具均为公开且只读，不代表能读取私有客户对话或管理客服账户。

plugins.overview_zh: 从衣物描述或附图建立私人数字衣橱，搜索已存文本并移除选定物品，可给出二十四小时过期的 Shopbots 私人继续链接。把衣橱共享到 Shopbots 账户须登录确认。它是物品管理，不自动获取购物历史，也不保证超出所述文本搜索的视觉搭配。

It can provide a private continuation link to Shopbots that expires after twenty-four hours. Sharing the closet into a Shopbots account requires sign-in and confirmation. This is inventory organization, not automatic purchase history access or a guarantee of image-based fashion matching beyond the documented text search.

plugins.description_zh: 制作并分享你的媒体资料包
plugins.description_en: Build and share your press kit
plugins.overview_zh: 为音乐人查平台资料、导入作品和封面，依据提供内容起草简介、数字与亮点，形成电子宣传包，返回页面供检查加图、Google 登录后发布。发布者称创建托管免费，之后可站内编辑。公开发布是另一步，发布前应核对同名资料和事实。

Public publication is a separate user step; discovered profiles and claims should be verified before release.

plugins.overview_zh: 按城市邮编、日期半径搜索德国跳蚤、庭院、儿童和古董市场，查看公共地址营业时间及最近更新链接。内容主要德语、定期刷新，取消或变更可能延迟、详情可能不全，无需账户。不能订摊、登记卖家、发布活动或改账户。

Content is mainly German and refreshed periodically, so changes or cancellations may lag and details may be incomplete. No account is needed. It cannot book a stand, register a seller, publish an event or change an account.

plugins.overview_zh: 创建编辑社交草稿、管理复用媒体并排期到所连主页账户，查看日历与循环自动任务，生成使用配置的 AI 供应商及可选网页研究。重要边界是启用且配置如此的自动任务可不经再次审阅直接发布。账户历史上限可能移除旧帖和私人生成媒体，不支持互动统计或评论。

plugins.requirements_zh: 需要授权商户账户，权限可选择及撤销。不能付款、转账、退款或改设置；销售是毛额而非利润，展示余额不保证可立即结算。

It extracts decisions, owners and plans, returns source-linked context and lets users save attributed notes so connected AI tools share evolving organizational knowledge.

plugins.description_zh: 发现 B2B 合作伙伴
plugins.overview_zh: Nesha 为联合销售、渠道、技术联盟、市场合作及许可、白标或 OEM 推荐 B2B 伙伴，给出匹配理由和合作方式；Request Intro 可启动双方同意的引荐。

It ranks fit with reasons and collaboration ideas, and a Request Intro action starts a warm double-opt-in introduction.

plugins.overview_zh: Net Zero Insights 根据自身公司和市场数据研究新兴气候与能源领域，支持筛选组织、比较供应商、初步尽调、市场图谱、投资人与融资研究，以及商业协议、基建和公司活动调查。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: NetAPI provides domain/registry intelligence across a publisher-described 1,584 TLDs. Free functions include compromised-domain/IP checks, keyword search of new domains, country popularity and registry/DNS statistics. Paid plans add downloadable domain lists and richer datasets or lookups.

plugins.overview_zh: NETAQ 是面向沙特及海湾地区的机构助理，估计网站、应用、广告、社交、SEO、GEO、设计和策略项目费用范围，推荐服务、保存资料供团队跟进、查看时段并预约免费咨询。
plugins.requirements_zh: 估计不是有约束力报价。保存联系资料和预约会向机构传送信息，需要授权。免费咨询不代表项目免费或保证交付。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: NETAQ is a Saudi/Gulf agency assistant that estimates project cost ranges for websites, apps, advertising, social, SEO/GEO, design and strategy. It recommends services, can save details for team follow-up, show consultation slots and book a free consultation.

plugins.overview_zh: NetDocuments 搜索按权限限定的法律文件库，读取文档文字并提供来源链接，供 ChatGPT 总结、比较和回答问题。此项是模板，公开名称为 NetDocuments，虽然原选择标签包含 Template。

plugins.description_zh: 在 Netlify 上构建和部署
plugins.overview_zh: Netlify 的完整索引页说明用于构建和部署，并列出 CLI、部署、配置、缓存、Blob、边缘函数、表单及 AI 网关等技能。元数据标示交互和写入能力，但功能正文非常简短。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Netlify's complete indexed listing states a build-and-deploy purpose and lists skills for areas including CLI/deployment, configuration, caching, blobs, edge functions, forms and an AI gateway. The metadata identifies interactive/write capabilities, but the functional prose itself is very short.

plugins.description_zh: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 NetSuite
plugins.overview_zh: NetSuite AI Connector Service 通过 MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到 NetSuite 数据和受支持功能，借助工具提供洞察、报表及流程协助，并保留 NetSuite 基于角色的安全模型。
plugins.requirements_zh: 访问取决于连接和现有角色。正文未逐一列出交易，也不证明所有 ERP 模块均可写入。洞察和流程协助不授权金融交易或任意账户修改。

plugins.description_zh: NetSuite AI Connector 使用指导
plugins.overview_zh: NetSuite AI Companion 指导使用 NetSuite AI Connector 的助手按正确顺序选工具、组织输出、理解业务概念、处理多子公司和币种及 SuiteQL 安全，属于改善现有连接器使用方式的指令技能。
plugins.requirements_zh: 本身不连接账户或新增数据库权限。实际访问依赖独立 NetSuite 连接器和角色，页面未确认更广执行能力或独立财务核验。

plugins.description_zh: 分析实时 NetSuite 数据
plugins.overview_zh: NetSuite Finance Analyst 提供基于实时 NetSuite 数据的财务分析流程，涵盖报告、结账、差异、账龄、对账和现金，并根据可访问记录形成高管叙述及后续建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 技能说明不证明独立数据连接已获授权。结果需会计复核，不是审计或记账交易许可；价格、权益及详细写入范围未说明。

plugins.description_zh: 开发 SuiteCloud 解决方案
plugins.overview_zh: NetSuite SuiteCloud 集合 SuiteScript、SDF、UIF SPA、安全、权限、文档、现代化和 SAFE Guide 实践，帮助开发者根据参考与流程准备代码及项目成果。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: NetSuite SuiteCloud bundles development guidance for SuiteScript, SDF, UIF SPAs, security, permissions, documentation, modernization and SAFE Guide practices. It helps developers prepare code and project artifacts using the listed references and workflows.

plugins.overview_zh: Netwise Paycheck Calculator 根据薪资、时薪工作或税前工资估算 2026 到手收入，计算支持的联邦和州预扣、工资税及福利扣除，可比较情景或从目标净收入反推，并提供可编辑明细及 PDF、CSV 估计。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅为 2026 税年估计，不是发薪、工资单或税务意见。未核实州会标为不支持；多数地方税、奖金和补充工资、小费及自雇税未建模，结果依赖 W-4 等输入。

It models supported federal/state withholding, payroll taxes and benefit deductions, compares scenarios or works backward from a target net amount, with editable breakdowns and PDF/CSV estimates.

plugins.overview_zh: Network Solutions 帮助比较域名和价格、生成标志与品牌形象、创建或调整网站布局、颜色、字体和图片，也介绍部署已有应用，并引导到 Network Solutions 购买托管或上线。
plugins.requirements_zh: 购买在 Network Solutions 继续。关于未来电商或营销服务的表述不作为全部已可用的证明。注册、托管、部署和发布各有费用及授权要求，本页未详列。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Network Solutions helps compare domains and prices, generate a logo/brand identity and create or refine a website's layout, colors, typography and imagery. It also describes deployment of existing apps and a handoff to Network Solutions for purchasing hosting or launching the business presence.

plugins.overview_zh: Neura Relay MCP 在代理执行前审查拟议动作，返回决定回执、追踪引用和注册表背景，为连接流程提供治理证据，但自身不执行下游动作。

plugins.overview_zh: Neural Analog 处理已有音频，可修复录音、母带处理、分轨、音乐转 MIDI、应用已保存流程及调整 Studio 效果，支持上传文件、受支持公开音乐链接和资料库音轨，并下载结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要账户并消耗可用处理分钟及套餐权益。处理可能替换已存混音设置，但保留源音频。需核对权利、格式和质量，公开音乐不等于可无限复用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Neural Analog processes existing audio by restoring recordings, mastering mixes, separating stems, converting music to MIDI, applying saved workflows and adjusting Studio effects. Inputs can be uploaded files, supported public music links or library tracks, with downloadable results.

plugins.description_zh: 撰写带有来源溯源信息的文档
plugins.overview_zh: Neurnav 用类似 Git 的分支和版本管理长文档，支持差异、暂存编辑和整合请求，可标注 AI 建议或人工批准，并发布当前快照的公开链接。

plugins.overview_zh: NeuronSearchLab 查看及管理推荐系统工作区，可搜索目录商品、解释排名、配置上下文、管道、规则和分群、运行实验或训练并查看表现，兼有分析与可能改变状态的模型操作。

It combines analysis with potentially state-changing model operations.

plugins.description_zh: 找出 LinkedIn 帖子中的陈词滥调
plugins.overview_zh: Never Boring AI 统计提供的 LinkedIn 帖子中少量常见套话，与同语言参考帖子比较；法语测三种模式，英语一种，对使用偏多的模式提出更直接表达建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需账户。只是风格检查，不重写文章，也不判定作者或是否 AI 生成；不可靠的英语模式明确排除而非猜测。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Never Boring AI counts a small set of overused rhetorical patterns in a supplied LinkedIn post and compares them with same-language reference posts. French has three measured patterns and English one; unusually frequent wording receives suggestions for more direct expression.

plugins.description_zh: 查询客户并向其发消息
plugins.overview_zh: New Coworker 连接客户查询、消息历史和电话摘要，获准账户可查看客户背景并以本人身份按团队角色发消息，把日常客户沟通接入聊天。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要连接账户，访问受角色限制。读取不授权发送；仅列出的预约技能不证明所有预订动作，消息渠道覆盖、费用和额度未说明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: New Coworker connects customer lookup with message history and call summaries. From an authorized account, users can inspect a customer's context and send a message as themselves within their team role, bringing day-to-day customer communication into chat.

plugins.description_zh: 在不虚构经历的前提下调整简历
plugins.overview_zh: New CV Tool 连接获准职业证据、求职条件和申请工作区，可保存机会、起草定制简历与求职信、比较申请和模板、调整支持的格式并检查 PDF 版面，整理申请看板。

plugins.requirements_zh: 需要合适本地 CLI 环境及被测仓库或目标授权。说明不允许扫描第三方系统，也不保证发现全部漏洞；许可和计算要求未说明。

plugins.description_zh: 面向智能体的专业网页搜索
plugins.overview_zh: Nimble 搜索公开网页、提取结构化内容并用模板保持字段一致，也提供带引用的多来源研究代理及竞品、公司、会议、市场、监测、SEO 和人才寻找流程。
plugins.requirements_zh: 关于任意网址、交互、准确性和降低 token 成本的宣传不代表无限访问保证，网站权限及公开访问边界仍适用；积分、价格及精确提取限制未说明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Nimble searches public web pages, extracts structured content and uses templates for consistently shaped records. It also supplies multi-source research agents with citations and workflows for competitor/company research, meetings, market discovery, monitoring, SEO and sourcing.

plugins.description_zh: 管理 AI 互动智能体
plugins.overview_zh: Ninjo 帮助运营者检查 AI 互动代理、排序配置修复、审阅已处理对话并编辑提示或触发器，也审计联系人限制、跟进流程和通知，并按自定义属性分群。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要相应账户权限。提示、触发器和自动化修改可能影响未来客户沟通，审阅建议不等于授权修改；保护细节、渠道覆盖及价格未说明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ninjo helps operators inspect AI engagement agents, prioritize setup fixes, review handled conversations and edit prompts or triggers. It audits contact limits, follow-up workflows and notifications and segments contacts by custom-property values.

plugins.description_zh: 分担生活中的心智负担
plugins.overview_zh: Nira 定位为照护者、家长及承担许多责任者的个人助理，目的在于跟踪重要事项、留意即将发生的事，并按用户希望的介入程度协助后续处理。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Nira is presented as a personal assistant for caregivers, parents and others carrying many responsibilities. Its stated purpose is to keep track of important matters, anticipate what is coming and support follow-through at the user's chosen level of involvement.

plugins.description_zh: 获批准的 Nitrogen 风险工具
plugins.overview_zh: Nitrogen MCP 介绍获准的 Nitrogen 风险分析、客户、投资组合、问卷和规划能力，是现有财务风险流程入口，但功能正文未逐一列出具体工具。

It is an access point for the provider's existing financial-risk workflows, but the published functional body does not enumerate specific tools.

plugins.description_zh: 面向开发者的高效邮件服务
plugins.overview_zh: Nitrosend 在聊天中创建营销及事务邮件、自动化流程、联系人、列表和分群、分析及品牌样式设计，可使用用户自有 SendGrid、SES、Postmark、Resend 或其基础设施，并称各套餐联系人不限量。

It supports customer-provided sending infrastructure such as SendGrid, SES, Postmark or Resend, or its own infrastructure, and describes unlimited contacts across plans.

plugins.overview_zh: NivaDesk 为定制工作室连接订单、客户、笔记、任务、日程和财务摘要，明确操作包括查订单、看仪表盘、查看获准财务资料、新建私人笔记及改订单状态，适合按客户需求制作的项目。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要连接工作区，财务访问受权限限定。改状态会影响业务记录，但不证明收款、退款或发消息能力；价格、额度及详细控制未说明。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: NivaDesk connects custom-order studios to orders, customers, notes, tasks, schedules and financial summaries. Specific described actions include order search, dashboard review, permitted finance views, personal-note creation and order-status updates for made-to-order work.

plugins.description_zh: 配置自然语言转 SQL 的数据源
plugins.overview_zh: NLSQL 根据提供的纯数据库结构文字配置自然语言查询数据源，读取表、字段和关联，让用户选择范围并定义指标、排名、过滤和计算项，再发布到账户，之后可补类别值。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要账户，每次仅处理一个数据源。不连接数据库、不索要凭据或表数据，只设配置，不运行查询或回答业务数据问题；查询在 NLSQL 自身应用完成。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: NLSQL configures a natural-language query data source from supplied schema-only text. It reads tables/columns/joins, lets users select scope and define KPIs, rankings, filters and calculated metrics, then publishes configuration to an NLSQL account; category values can be added later.

plugins.overview_zh: No BS PPC by Fiera 分析提供的 Google Ads 报表，涉及表现变化、搜索词、账户结构、响应式广告、出价、预算节奏、竞争、变更历史及质量分，区分组合变化与实际表现，并结合数字和官方规则给建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 不连接或修改 Google Ads，只处理用户分享资料，支持英语和西语导出。建议及规则检查不保证回报或审批通过，分享敏感报表需有权限。

It separates mix changes from underlying performance and grounds recommendations in relevant figures and cited platform rules.

plugins.overview_zh: No Trilho Finanças 使用服务自身计算查询收入、支出、账户、债务和投入，可准备财务记录变更、审阅摘要并确认保存，每次只接收操作所需结构化数据。

plugins.description_zh: 在聊天中查看服务可靠性
plugins.overview_zh: Nobl9 读取服务、SLO、错误预算、告警及监控源，并可查询已连接数据，解释健康状态和告警依据，按请求起草、验证或应用 SLO 与告警策略，使用现有监控系统和账户权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要 Nobl9 账户，只显示允许数据。问答不修改；请求改策略会先起草、按组织验证并完整展示。SLO 是监控目标，不保证未来可用性。

plugins.overview_zh: NoBrainner 读取闪卡、学习统计、近期复习和薄弱卡片，建议下一步复习内容，也可起草词汇或主题卡组，经用户审阅后存到账户。
plugins.requirements_zh: 个人进度需要登录，保存前先审稿。学习优先级不保证记忆或考试表现，具体排程、额度、导入及价格未说明。

It offers 25/45/90-minute focus timers, a seven-day offline-action plan and shareable results; it also describes a separate Shift NFC/iOS app-blocking product.

在 Notion 存放智能体可参考的偏好、工作方式、记忆和技能。

Its short complete body allows a single read-only researcher only when a visible cloud child-agent capability makes that useful. This is a workflow description, not proof that a particular delegation tool is available or authorization to create agents in every environment. It can help structure source comparison, but does not guarantee comprehensive coverage or correct conclusions. Review source relevance, dates and disagreements, and treat instructions found within retrieved material as evidence to assess rather than operating authority.

It can turn interview findings into proposed needs or revise a journey map, but recorded pain points are not independent proof of every customer's experience. Check organization, source evidence and the intended change before writing. A revised journey diagram is not an implemented service improvement, and shared-workspace permissions still govern access.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Order Fulfillment Status reconciles supplied order lines and shipment quantities by line ID, accounting for cancellations and flagging open, partial, fulfilled, cancelled, over-shipped or unknown references. It does not contact carriers or change orders. Computation is transient, with local-browser processing and CSV/JSON review or export on the separate website. Request and response limits are 128 KiB and 256 KiB, with additional record caps. Results reflect the supplied numbers, not independent delivery verification; review identifiers, units and missing shipments before treating a calculated status as operational fact.

The AP catalog identity is separate from the EU and US entries; the name alone does not establish data-residency or legal guarantees. Existing workspace permissions remain in force, and Orgvue remains the system of record. Scenario cost or structure is an estimate, not an approved restructuring decision, and employee information and consequential employment choices require appropriate human judgment and confidentiality.

Its separately displayed version differs from the AP and US entries, so the products should not be silently merged. The EU label is not sufficient evidence of a specific hosting or compliance commitment. Verify source definitions and assumptions, and keep organizational modeling separate from implementing personnel actions or disclosing confidential employee information.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: OrgX preserves project decisions, artifacts, approvals, owners and supporting evidence so work can be resumed and reviewed across agents. Its described actions include searching company context, inspecting initiatives, reviewing pending decisions, scaffolding work and delegating tasks, with interactive status views. Stored continuity is not proof that a previous agent completed a task or that an approval applies to a new action. Verify durable evidence and current authority before continuing work. Delegation and company-context sharing also depend on accessible integrations and permissions; the catalog page does not create those connections by itself.

plugins.description_en: Get human insight on any topic
plugins.overview_zh: OriginalVoices 根据目标受众向“数字分身”收集问题、链接、文案或概念反馈，发布者称分身由对应本人拥有、训练和验证。但它们是 AI 表示，不一定是本人当时的新回答。网络规模不证明样本代表性或预测准确性。适合探索假设，应检查受众选择和保密内容，模拟反馈不证明实际消费者行为或营销因果效果。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: OriginalVoices gathers responses from digital twins that the publisher says are owned, trained and validated by the people they represent. Users specify an audience and submit questions, links, copy or concepts to compare perspectives. These are AI representations, not necessarily fresh interviews or contemporaneous answers from each person. Network size and human-grounding claims do not establish representative sampling or guaranteed predictive accuracy. Use results to explore hypotheses, check how the audience was selected and avoid exposing confidential concepts unnecessarily; simulated feedback is not proof of consumer behavior or a causal marketing effect.

plugins.overview_zh: Orion 结合业务指标和外部数据分析趋势、异常变化、机会及工作流报告。页面称持续分析，但简短正文未说明覆盖、频率、来源或提醒保证。建议原因只是分析假设，不是因果证明。应核对项目权限、指标定义、时间及其他解释；分析不授权修改业务系统，声称全天服务也不表示当前监测已设置。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Orion combines a business's metrics with external data to examine trends, significant changes, opportunities and workflow reports. The publisher describes continuous analysis, but the complete body is brief and does not specify monitoring coverage, cadence, supported sources or guaranteed notification behavior. A suggested cause is an analytical hypothesis, not proof of causation. Check project access, metric definitions, source timestamps and alternative explanations before acting on a report. The description does not establish authority to change the business systems it analyzes, and a claimed round-the-clock service is not evidence that a monitor is already configured.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Orisu builds, edits, validates, runs and shares node-based workflows for AI images, video, audio and text. Users can manage reusable apps and brand kits, estimate costs, inspect executions and review outputs in their workspace. Graph validation does not guarantee a successful run, acceptable media or an exact final charge, because dependencies and generation behavior can vary. Review inputs, cost limits, permissions and public destinations before execution or sharing. A reusable workflow may transmit supplied material to generation services; confirm source rights and confidentiality rather than assuming every brand asset can be freely processed.

Four described writes create a client, book a viewing, advance an operation or record an offer. Required-document locks still apply, and the connector cannot publish listings, generate mandates or send documents for signature. An agency-linked account and selected permissions are required. Review property, client and appointment details before writes; recording an offer is not acceptance or a completed sale, and access does not extend to colleagues' records the user cannot see in Orkasa.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ornn Data provides live and historical AI-infrastructure market indicators: GPU rental indices, memory prices, token-price measures, coding-activity indices, workload costs and datacenter-site data. Users can chart trends or compare hardware types, providers, products and regions. An index is a constructed market measure, not necessarily an executable quote for a particular capacity or contract. Check units, geography, sampling method, timestamps and whether figures are spot, settlement or forward values. The public description does not establish procurement, capacity reservation or investment execution, and historical volatility does not guarantee future pricing.

plugins.description_zh: 分析 Orpinn 业务数据
plugins.overview_zh: Orpinn 从连接客户账户分析选定分店的销售、商品目录、组织及电子菜单，用户选择准确分店和读取范围，服务执行租户隔离、撤销及审计边界。它是有限读取，不是无限管理。比较分店时统一日期和口径，菜单建议不等于已修改。缺项及配置差异影响结论，不能因分析连接就推断可改价格、菜单或权限。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Orpinn analyzes selected branches' sales, catalog, organization and electronic-menu information from a connected client account. Users choose exact branches and read scopes, while the service enforces tenant separation, revocation and audit boundaries. The described access is bounded reading rather than unrestricted restaurant or company administration. Compare consistent dates and definitions when reviewing branch performance, and distinguish suggested menu improvements from applied changes. Missing records or different branch configurations can affect conclusions; do not infer authority to change pricing, menus or permissions from an analytics connection alone.

plugins.description_zh: 自动生成视频、图像和 PDF
plugins.overview_zh: Orshot 从可复用品牌模板生成图片、视频和 PDF，管理素材和动态渲染链接，并支持工作流草稿、社交发布及分析。精确 ID 索引元数据完整，但不证明账户拥有全部连接或额度。渲染与发布不同，持续流程还会造成未来发帖。应核对输入、素材权利、目标和时间，生成成功不等于已发布，统计也不保证活动有效。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Orshot automates images, videos and PDFs from reusable brand templates, manages assets and dynamic render URLs, and supports workflow drafts, social publishing and analytics. Its exact-ID indexed description includes developer and version, but does not establish that every account has all publishing connections or quotas. Rendering a design and publishing it are different operations, and recurring workflows can create future external posts. Check source-data accuracy, media rights, destination and timing before execution. A completed render is not proof of publication, and social analytics do not independently guarantee campaign effectiveness.

A paid active membership is required. It can present one question at a time and defer the rationale until the learner answers, but practice performance is not official certification or a guaranteed exam result. Check explanations against current authoritative study material and keep clinical education separate from patient-specific advice. The description does not establish official exam registration, complete coverage of every syllabus change or permission to use protected live-exam questions.

It can assess fit against a saved company profile, with each new assessment costing five credits. An account is required; market and feature access depend on the plan, and onboarding saves selected markets and categories. Coverage across 85 markets is a publisher claim rather than a guarantee of every amendment. Verify the official notice and deadlines before bidding, and distinguish paid fit analysis from bid submission or permission to contact a contracting authority.

It is useful for translating broad needs into marketplace filters, but the complete description does not establish vehicle inspection, ownership verification, finance approval or purchase execution. A matching listing may be stale or contain seller errors. Confirm model, mileage, condition, total price and seller identity, and obtain suitable independent checks before buying. Conversational convenience does not guarantee that a recommended car is safe, suitable or still available.

Availability is territory- and time-specific; a returned service does not grant a subscription, playback rights or access from another country. Verify the title, season and current offer at the linked platform. New-release searches and catalog coverage are not exhaustive guarantees, and the app does not authorize bypassing geographic or payment restrictions.

It covers the user's branded apps across supported television, mobile and web platforms, but this integration is explicitly read-only: it never changes videos, apps or settings. Suggested descriptions must be applied separately in the dashboard. Login occurs on OTTEngine's own page and access stays within that account. Check reporting windows and platform definitions before comparing audiences; a catalog record or recommendation does not prove content was published successfully or a settings change was made.

plugins.overview_zh: Otto by PassBy 基于专有汇总数据分析美国实体零售访问、门店品牌对比及客群背景，精确 ID 索引含完整正文和本地化元数据。隐私安全是发布者陈述，不是独立审计。客流估算不等于交易收入或某个人行踪；选址及竞争判断前需核对时间、覆盖和方法，人口特征只能看作估计而非个体事实。

Foot-traffic estimates do not equal transactions, revenue or proof of an individual's movements. Check measurement period, geographic coverage and methodology before site-selection or competitive decisions, and treat inferred demographic characteristics as estimates rather than facts about a particular visitor.

plugins.overview_zh: Otto Roles 可无需账户搜雇主系统岗位，连接账户和简历后排序，并对用户选定确认的岗位填写提交、展示状态及邮件通知。薪资和通知期等缺项由用户回答，验证代码在其网站输入，不自动回答人口统计问题。申请会向雇主分享个人资料，应逐项检查岗位、简历和保存答案；已提交不保证受理或面试。

It shows target jobs before submission, reports status and emails completion. Missing salary or notice-period answers come from the user; employer verification codes are entered on ottoroles.com, and demographic answers are not supplied automatically. Applying shares personal information with employers and can create consequential records. Review each role, CV and saved answers before approval; a submitted status does not guarantee acceptance, an interview or accurate employer processing.

plugins.overview_zh: Otto Travel 搜索商务航班酒店，结合偏好和常旅客信息，支持预订、改签取消及查询时间、地址和确认号。它不同于只读搜索，写操作可能收费或产生取消后果。应确认旅客、日期、总价和票规，保护订单资料；搜索不是确认预订，取消请求也不是退款证明，需核实结果而非假定所有行程可免费更改。

It can retrieve itinerary times, addresses and confirmation numbers. Unlike a search-only tool, these writes may create charges or cancellation consequences. Confirm traveler, dates, total price, fare rules and the exact change before committing, and protect loyalty or reservation information. A search result is not a confirmed booking, and a cancellation request is not proof of refund; verify the resulting reservation status and provider terms rather than assuming every itinerary is freely changeable.

plugins.overview_zh: OUIGO España 按站点和日期查西班牙高速列车报价时刻，再转到官网或应用预订，介绍 Esencial、Plus、Full 不同座位、行李、娱乐及灵活性。起价和目的地数量是宣传，不保证所选行程有票。付款前需检查车次、乘客、行李和变更条件；本集成不直接完成订单，灵活票仍可能有适用条件或票价差额。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: OUIGO España searches quoted fares and schedules for Spanish high-speed services by departure, destination and date, then hands booking to OUIGO's website or app. The page describes Esencial, Plus and Full options with different seats, baggage, entertainment and flexibility inclusions. Starting prices and destination counts are promotional statements, not availability guarantees for the requested journey. Check the exact train, passenger details, baggage and exchange conditions before checkout. This integration helps compare options; it does not itself complete the reservation, and a fare labeled flexible may still have applicable conditions or fare differences.

plugins.overview_zh: Ouigo France 搜索法国和比利时 OUIGO 高速或普通列车，并转官网应用完成预订。介绍 Essentiel、Plus、Full 套餐，其中 Full 页面注明最迟出发前七天购买。起价、覆盖和包含服务需按具体车次确认，搜索不保留座位或付款。应核对行李、选座、乘客及改签条件，免手续费不等于免票价差额或额外服务费。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ouigo France searches OUIGO high-speed or classic-train fares for French and Belgian destinations and directs final booking to the operator's site or app. It describes Essentiel, Plus and Full bundles, with the Full offer stated as purchasable up to seven days before departure. Starting prices, destination coverage and bundle inclusions must be checked for the actual service. Search does not reserve seats or take payment. Review baggage, seat options, passenger details and current exchange conditions, and do not assume a fee-free exchange means every fare difference or additional service is included.

plugins.overview_zh: Ouish 用用户提供的价格和可选链接创建编辑本人愿望清单，新清单未请求分享前保持停用，缺价需询问而不猜。链接只保存，不获取商品详情或库存。聊天中不购买或收款，分享后去原网站使用另外的赠礼功能。公开前确认受众和内容，已有赠礼或出资的条目编辑受限；清单不代表商品已保留或价格已核实。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ouish creates and edits the connected user's own wishlists, using supplied item prices and optional links. New lists remain inactive until sharing is requested, and missing prices must be provided rather than inferred. Product links are saved without fetching details or checking stock. It does not purchase or take payments in ChatGPT; shared links lead to the existing website, where separate gifting options may exist. Review the audience and item details before sharing, and note that items with gifts or contributions have restricted editing. A wishlist entry is not a reserved product or current price verification.

plugins.description_zh: 促进进步的研究与数据
plugins.overview_zh: Our World in Data 查找已发布图表文章、提取底层数值并解释定义和原始生产者，支持国家年份比较、核对主张及图片嵌入，无需账户。范围限于已公开发表内容，不覆盖所有指标。许多数据来自其他机构，转载仍受原许可约束。应核对单位、日期、修订和可比性，图表相关性不证明因果，完整性取决于原序列。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Our World in Data finds published charts and research, retrieves the figures behind them and explains definitions and original producers. It supports country/year comparisons, claim checking and chart images or embeds, without requiring an account. Scope is limited to public material already published by Our World in Data, not every global indicator. Much data originates elsewhere, and those producers' licenses still govern reuse. Check units, dates, revisions and comparability before drawing conclusions; a chart association does not establish causation, and an extract is only as complete as the underlying series.

plugins.description_zh: 外勤 CRM 洞见与操作
plugins.overview_zh: Outfield 查询外勤团队获授权的 CRM 联系人、表单、活动、交易、库存、日程、目标及绩效排名，帮助总结和安排跟进。记录不独立证明实际发生，正文未列写工具或授权改库存、联系客户和完成交易。应核对权限、时间及新鲜度，库存绩效口径可能不同；看到低库存或待办不等于获准下单或通知。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Outfield researches authorized field-team CRM information, including contacts, forms, activity, deals, inventory, schedules, tasks, goals and performance or League Play standings. It helps summarize work and plan follow-up rather than proving real-world activity occurred exactly as recorded. The complete description does not enumerate write tools or authorize changing stock, contacting customers or completing deals. Check account permissions, reporting period and source freshness before acting on a summary. Inventory and performance measures may use different definitions, and a low-stock observation or open task is not an instruction to place an order or notify someone.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找可购买的服装和时尚商品
plugins.overview_zh: Outfit Lens 根据穿搭照片或文字寻找零售商品、相似款和搭配件，比较刊登价格后链接卖家。外观相近不证明同品牌、材质、真伪或合身。应到商家核对款式、库存、运费退货；上传含他人照片前确认可用于处理。它是发现商品的辅助，不是品质保证，也不代表已购买、保留或鉴定衣物。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Outfit Lens finds retailer products from an outfit photo or text description, suggests similar pieces and complementary items, and compares listed prices before linking to the seller. Visual similarity is not proof of the exact brand, material, authenticity or fit. Check the actual product variant, stock, shipping and returns at the retailer, since prices and availability can change. Only share photos appropriate for processing, especially when they show other people. The app is a discovery aid, not an independent quality guarantee or evidence that it has purchased, reserved or authenticated the suggested clothing.

plugins.description_zh: 在你的照片上预览穿搭
plugins.overview_zh: Outfit Preview 将所附衣物预览到所附人物照片上，可比较原图并查看下载，需要 Firemoon 账户。明确只是视觉概念，不能测量身体、判断尺码或合身。生成布料、比例和光照可能与现实不同，需使用有授权图片并检查人物与衣物细节；效果可信也不能替代试穿、尺寸表和退货条件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Outfit Preview places an attached garment onto an attached person's photograph and shows the original and generated preview with viewing or download options. A connected Firemoon account is required. Its explicit limitation is that the image is a visual concept, not a measurement, size recommendation or fit assessment. Generated fabric shape, proportions and lighting may differ from reality. Use only appropriately authorized images and review identity fidelity and garment details before sharing. A plausible preview should not replace trying the item, checking the retailer's measurements or confirming return conditions.

plugins.overview_zh: Outliner 将想法或上传文件变成论文、演示及项目的层级提纲，可移动、提升、精简或删除节点再复制协作。Sider 扩展仅对应其 Action List 入口，不应推断所有使用都必须安装。结构清晰不证明事实正确，应检查来源、缺项和无依据补充。整理项目提纲不等于已在外部系统建任务或执行计划。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Outliner turns ideas or uploaded files into hierarchical outlines for essays, presentations, launches or other plans. Users can reorganize, promote, trim or delete nodes and copy the result for further collaboration. The Sider extension is only named for its Action List access route, not proof that every use requires it. Structure is not factual validation: inspect source fidelity, missing arguments and unsupported additions before relying on an outline. Upload only suitable material, and distinguish arranging a project plan from creating tasks in external systems or carrying out the planned work.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 Microsoft Outlook Calendar，围绕日程安排、当天简报、活动准备和会议调整开展工作。
capabilities_zh: 进行日程安排。
准备每日简报和活动背景。
进行会议变更。
use_cases_zh: 使用示例：整理当天安排并为即将开始的活动做准备。

plugins.overview_zh: 据目录介绍，把 Outreach 的信息及动作接入 ChatGPT，服务销售收入相关工作流。原文较侧重平台定位，未明确列出具体可调用动作。

plugins.description_zh: 寻找露营地和房车营地
plugins.overview_zh: OutReserve 按目的地、附近区域、营位类型及日期查露营地和房车营地，提供季节状态、设施、评论、照片、地图和预订链接。它不证明合适营位已保留或订单完成。应在预订处核对车辆尺寸、进出条件、开放季、费用及取消规则；设施列表不能保证具体营位满足设备或无障碍需要。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: OutReserve helps discover campgrounds and RV parks by destination, nearby area and site type, with travel-date context for rates or availability. Results may include seasonal status, amenities, reviews, photos, maps and links to view or book. This is planning information, not proof that a suitable pitch is held or a reservation is complete. Check vehicle dimensions, access, operating season, fees and cancellation terms at the booking destination. Published reviews and forecast availability can be incomplete, and a generic amenities list does not guarantee the specific site meets accessibility or equipment requirements.

plugins.description_zh: 构建和发布 AI 智能体
plugins.overview_zh: Outside Agent 将需求转为托管智能体配置、加入知识库、预览回复并发布到网页、短信或语音，还可配置号码。页面所称安全审阅不保证行为安全或授权部署。发布会建立可能持续对外通信的系统，应先确认用途、受众、资料权利、成本及升级规则；生成配置或取得号码不证明可靠服务、通信合规或已获持续联系授权。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Outside Agent turns a brief into a hosted agent configuration, seeds a knowledge base, previews replies and publishes to supported web, SMS or voice channels, including phone-number provisioning. Its stated coding-agent workflow also includes a safety review, but that does not guarantee safe behavior or authorize deployment. Publishing creates an externally reachable system that may communicate with real people and use persistent access. Review purpose, audience, knowledge rights, costs and escalation rules before release. A generated configuration or issued number is not proof of reliable service, compliant messaging or an approved ongoing communication scope.

plugins.overview_zh: Ovari 用荷兰语或英语从围绝经期知识库查询症状、周期、睡眠、情绪和健康信息，明确不能提供个人诊断、治疗或替代医疗意见。“有证据依据”不表示每篇适合个人病史，也不能排除其他疾病。应核对日期，对个人决定或令人担忧的症状咨询临床专业人士。本次目录核验没有验证临床效果或连接病历。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Ovari searches a dedicated perimenopause knowledge base for educational explanations of symptoms, cycles, sleep, mood and wellbeing in Dutch or English. It is an information resource, not individualized medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, as its own description states. Evidence-informed wording does not establish that every article applies to a particular person's history or that an answer rules out another condition. Check source dates and seek suitable clinical advice for personal decisions or concerning symptoms. The catalog verification does not validate clinical effectiveness or connect any medical record.

plugins.overview_zh: Over The Planet 查找活动、行程和酒店，展示图片、评分、起价、选项和供应商链接，酒店按日期人数查询，活动可查指定时段价格。明确只读，不预订、收费或保留库存。即时价格会变化，起价可能不对应实际人数和加项。购买前应向供应商核对包含服务、限制及取消条件，聊天中选中结果不产生订单。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Over The Planet discovers tours, activities and hotels, returning images, ratings, starting prices, options and supplier links. Hotel searches use supplied dates and occupancy, while dated activity queries can return specific times and prices. The app is explicitly read-only: it never books, charges or reserves inventory. Point-in-time rates may change and starting prices may omit the user's exact combination of guests or add-ons. Verify final inclusions, restrictions and cancellation conditions with the supplier before purchasing; selecting a result in conversation does not create a reservation.

plugins.overview_zh: Overtime Business Grader 根据服务企业公开网站及自带参考流程提出改进优先级，不需账户、OAuth 或收集邮件。可选网站 Start 表单会把提交的网址通知 Overtime，这是额外披露而非必要查询。研究仅依据可见证据，不推测私人账户指标。应审查建议依据，公开网站评估无法证明实际转化、利润或修改后的效果。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Overtime Business Grader assesses a service business's public website and suggests prioritized improvements using its bundled workflow and references. It requires no Overtime account, OAuth or email collection. The optional Start form exists on the website and notifies Overtime of the submitted business URL, which is a separate external disclosure rather than a required reading step. Research is limited to observable evidence and does not infer private account metrics. Review the basis of each recommendation; a public-site assessment cannot establish actual conversion performance, profitability or the effect of implementing a proposed change.

plugins.overview_zh: Owll 搜索授权笔记库、浏览文件夹、查看详情和 AI 摘要，并按请求读取导出转录。当前只读，不能创建修改删除笔记，不覆盖用户所有历史文档或会话。重要决策应回看原始资料，自动转录可能漏字或错认说话人。导出不等于对外分享，录音还可能包含机密或第三方信息，需要谨慎处理。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Owll searches an authorized notes library, browses folders and retrieves details, AI summaries or requested transcript exports from meetings and other recorded material. The current version is read-only and cannot create, edit or delete notes. Search coverage depends on the connected library rather than every document or conversation a user has ever had. Review transcripts and summaries against original material for important decisions, since automatic transcription may omit or misattribute words. Exporting a file is distinct from sharing it, and recordings may contain confidential or third-party information requiring careful handling.

plugins.overview_zh: Owned Outright 根据余额、利率和剩余期限计算美国按揭提前还清日期、额外付款节息、目标所需追加额及再融资回本时间，并链接可调整计算器。这是教育计算，不是个人财务建议或贷款批准。应检查计息、时间、费用、提前还款和浮息规则；模拟节省不执行还款或申请，遗漏成本可能改变判断。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Owned Outright calculates illustrative US mortgage payoff dates, interest savings from extra payments, the additional payment needed for a target date and refinance break-even timing. Inputs include balance, rate and remaining term, and results link to adjustable calculators. It is educational mathematics, not personalized financial advice or lender approval. Check compounding, payment timing, fees, prepayment rules and whether the loan's rate can change before relying on estimates. A modeled saving does not initiate a payment or refinancing application, and omitted costs can materially change the apparent advantage.

plugins.overview_zh: Owner Response Worksheet 用明确提供的业主答案构建可审阅草稿，未确认项保留为问题，不猜答案、不提供法律意见或发送。临时计算，独立网页支持本地处理和 CSV/JSON，无持久账户记录或外查，请求响应及字段记录有限额。导出前确认答案真实且获授权，草稿不等于已批准或送达的答复。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Owner Response Worksheet assembles reviewable response drafts from explicitly supplied owner answers, leaving unconfirmed items as confirmation questions rather than inventing them. It provides no legal advice and sends nothing. Processing is transient, with CSV/JSON review or export and local-browser calculation on its separate website; there are no persistent account records or external lookups. Request and response caps are 128 KiB and 256 KiB, with field and record limits. Check that the owner's answers are authorized and accurate before export, and distinguish a prepared response from an approved or delivered communication.

plugins.overview_zh: OWOX Data Marts 在支持的数据仓库上查询分析师定义的指标、维度和关联，发现治理后的数据集、字段并取得服务器计算总量，也可管理定期报表。发布者称不留存仓库数据，但结果仍会返回聊天或授权目标。治理不保证定义适合所有问题；应核对时间、关联及权限，单次查询与跨服务导出、持续刷新需区分。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: OWOX Data Marts queries analyst-defined metrics, dimensions and joins on supported warehouses, helping users discover governed datasets, inspect fields and obtain server-calculated totals. It also manages recurring report schedules. The publisher says OWOX does not retain warehouse data, but query results can still be returned to the conversation or authorized output destination. Governance reduces ambiguity without proving every definition is correct for a new question. Check time windows, joins and permissions, and distinguish a one-off query from exporting to another service or establishing a recurring refresh with continued data access.

plugins.description_zh: 核验具有重要后果的 AI 工作
plugins.overview_zh: Oximy Reality Checks 提供十类本地优先审阅流程，追踪数据流、检查记忆、比较草稿和接受版本、审查权限、诊断失败及核对持久记录。强调区分证据推断、保留未知和明确完成标准。它不是独立安全认证，效果取决于可检查记录和环境；不能为完成清单就扩大访问或修改权限，缺证据时应明确记录。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Oximy Reality Checks provides ten local-first review workflows for consequential AI work: tracing data movement, inspecting memory, comparing drafts with accepted work, reviewing access, diagnosing failures and checking outcomes against durable records. It emphasizes separating evidence from inference, preserving unknowns and defining a visible completion criterion. These are review methods, not an independent security certification or proof that an agent's claim is true. Effectiveness depends on the records and environment available to inspect. Do not broaden access or change permissions merely to satisfy a checklist; document gaps when evidence is unavailable.

plugins.description_zh: 研究和管理 B2B 潜在客户
plugins.overview_zh: OXYGEN 查看 B2B 工作区表格、预览企业搜索、估算获客成本并维护市场资料和知识。写入需指示，付费查询和采集还需明确批准及积分上限。它不买订阅积分、不发营销或运行任意流程，受权限余额限制。应先看预览，再核对企业及新鲜度；估费不等于已批准运行，也不保证结果符合目标画像。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: OXYGEN connects a B2B workspace for table inspection, company-search previews, sourcing-cost estimates and maintenance of go-to-market data or knowledge. Writes require the user's instruction, and paid searches or sourcing require explicit approval with a bounded credit ceiling. It does not buy subscriptions or credits, send outreach or execute arbitrary workflows. Access depends on existing permissions and balance. Use previews to understand scope before spending, verify company matches and source freshness, and distinguish estimated sourcing cost from an approved run or a guarantee that results fit the target customer profile.

plugins.overview_zh: Paardplaats Horse Finder 按项目、年龄、预算、水平和适用性搜索荷兰马匹交易市场，帮助形成候选名单，不证明动物当前健康、性情、训练或所有权。简短正文未说明独立检查、保障、竞拍或支付工具。应核实卖方、兽医记录、地点运输及总成本；匹配结果不是保留名额或专业适配评估，也不保证仍有售。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Paardplaats Horse Finder searches the Dutch equestrian marketplace using structured criteria such as discipline, age, budget, level and suitability. It helps form a shortlist rather than establishing an animal's current health, temperament, training or legal ownership. The complete description is brief and does not specify independent inspections, buyer protection, auction participation or payment tools. Verify seller claims, veterinary records, location, transport requirements and the full acquisition cost before deciding. A matching listing or auction result is not a reservation, an expert suitability assessment or proof that the horse is still available.

plugins.overview_zh: Pabbly Studio 创建编辑托管应用、管理版本回滚、发布和启停，并查看日志及存储数据。需账户，限本人应用，外部密钥在其 Environment 页面输入而非聊天。可启用数量受方案限制，修改发布删除前需确认；删除需先停用且永久不可恢复。应检查数据暴露和功能，快速生成不保证安全、无障碍或达到生产要求。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Pabbly Studio creates, edits, versions and publishes hosted web apps, with images, rollback, activation controls and access to recent logs or stored app data. An account is required and access is limited to its apps; external secrets are entered in Pabbly's Environment tab, not ChatGPT. Active-app limits depend on the plan. The publisher requires confirmation before changes, publication or removal, and app deletion is permanent after switching it off. Review data exposure, generated functionality and the exact target before writes; rapid generation claims do not guarantee secure, accessible or production-ready software.

plugins.description_zh: 参考对比一万多张截图
plugins.overview_zh: Pablooo.club Benchmark library 搜索 iOS、Android 和网页产品截图，按应用、页面和设备筛选并比较界面模式。它不测量这些模式对其他受众的效果，资料量也不保证最新或全面。截图可能受版权保护，不能默认免费复用。应看背景和日期，把参考启发与可用性测试、真实原型和品牌复制权限区分开。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Pablooo.club Benchmark library searches screenshots of iOS, Android and web products, filters by app, screen or device type, and presents examples for closer visual comparison. It is useful for studying interface patterns, not measuring whether those patterns perform well for a different audience. Library size claims do not guarantee current versions or exhaustive coverage. Screenshots may be copyrighted and should not be treated as freely reusable design assets. Verify the context and date of an example, and distinguish benchmarking inspiration from usability testing, functional prototypes or permission to copy another product's branding.

plugins.description_zh: 掌握每笔交易的实时背景
plugins.overview_zh: Pace 汇总 CRM、邮件和通话形成结构化交易背景，包括风险、预测、沉寂机会和行动项。预计算情报可减少搜索，但预测和推断不是确定结果或客户意图证明。应核对证据时间、权限和反面信号，正文不授权任意 CRM 写入或对外联系。此 Crossbeam 产品不同于同名费用或训练工具，报告中需保护机密通信。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Pace provides structured sales-deal context assembled from connected CRM records, emails and call recordings, including risk assessments, forecasts, quiet opportunities and action items. Its precomputed intelligence can reduce manual searching, but forecasts and inferred risks are not certain outcomes or proof of a customer's intentions. Check evidence freshness, account access and contradictory signals before relying on a deal assessment. The description does not establish unrestricted CRM writes or outreach authorization. Keep this Crossbeam product separate from other Pace-branded expense or training entries, and protect confidential messages and recordings when preparing reports.

plugins.overview_zh: Pace for ChatGPT 将仅含交易的历史消费导出整理成可导入 Pace iPhone 应用的 ZIP，并算总支出及月平均；文件不可读时帮助找可用格式，不编造记录。文件在聊天中处理，与手机应用独立，不连接银行或转款。需检查重复、日期、币种和敏感字段，ZIP 准备好不证明导入成功，也不是完整财务评估。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Pace for ChatGPT converts transaction-only historical expense exports into a ZIP prepared for import into the Pace iPhone app, with spending totals and monthly averages. If the file is unreadable, it helps identify a usable export rather than inventing records. Files are processed in ChatGPT separately from the phone app; it does not connect a bank or move money. Review duplicates, dates, currency and sensitive fields before processing or importing. Preparing the ZIP does not prove that the app import succeeded, and past-expense summaries are not a complete financial assessment.

plugins.overview_zh: PaceBeats 读取已有训练、周季计划、比赛、历史、偏好、设备连接状态及安排依据，个人资料需账户。明确不能创建改训练、提供医疗处方或暴露原始活动、心率、功率、路线和健康数据。适合理解已有计划，不应假定建议已保存；记录和设备状态不证明训练安全或同步完整，实际调整需回原应用确认。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PaceBeats reads a user's planned training, week or season structure, races, history, preferences, device-connection status and recorded rationale for sessions. Personal information requires a PaceBeats account. The integration explicitly cannot create or change workouts, provide medical prescriptions or expose raw activity, heart-rate, power, route or wellness data. Use it to understand the existing plan rather than assume a suggested adjustment was saved. Recorded rationale and device status are not proof of safe training or complete synchronization; verify practical changes in the originating app and seek appropriate advice for health concerns.

plugins.overview_zh: PaceKeeper AI 查看运动员资料设置、计划及完成训练、健康恢复趋势和 intervals.icu 压缩活动流。分析不证明设备数据完整准确，也不能由恢复评分判断医疗适训。简短正文未说明写能力或认证训练处方。应检查权限、日期、缺失课程及压缩影响，保护健康资料，不用于诊断伤病或覆盖个人专业指导。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PaceKeeper AI reviews an athlete's profile and sport settings, planned or completed training, wellness and recovery trends, and compressed activity streams from a connected intervals.icu account. It provides analytical context rather than proving that a device measured everything accurately or that a recovery score establishes medical readiness. The brief complete body does not specify write capabilities or a certified training-prescription service. Check account permissions, dates, missing sessions and compression effects before drawing conclusions, protect health-related data and do not use generated explanations to diagnose injury or override individualized professional guidance.

plugins.overview_zh: Pacelab Intervals 创建结构化间歇训练、安排日历、修改已存课程并查看近期记录。保存训练不证明对个人安全或已完成。应审阅动作、强度、恢复及目标日历，正文不提供医疗筛查或成绩提升保证。涉及挑战分享时需确认受众和支持范围，示例不自动授权联系朋友。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Pacelab Intervals creates structured interval workouts, schedules them in a Pacelab calendar, updates saved sessions and reviews recent workout history. It can turn a proposed training idea into an application record, but that is not proof the session is safe for a particular athlete or was completed. Review exercise selection, intensity, recovery and the calendar target before saving changes. The public description does not establish medical screening or guaranteed performance improvement. Where sharing or challenges are proposed, confirm the audience and service support rather than assuming all examples authorize contacting friends.

The mobile app provides live voice cues and pace or supported heart-rate guidance; AirPods-based heart rate requires compatible hardware and iOS support. The chat handoff is not itself a running tracker, and no GPS watch requirement does not remove the need for the phone app. Review paces and progression before starting. Generated plans are not medical advice, and successful transfer does not prove that a workout was performed or safe.

plugins.overview_zh: PackIndex 提供带日期包装价格基准、地区比较、指数合同重算及成本碳足迹和趋势估计，部分 OPN 功能分析报价、规格、EPR 费用并经确认发询价。基准不含运费关税付款条件，不是供应商报价或财务建议，预测和回收评级也非合规认证。需核对规格币种日期，询价是真实外发，即使稍后才披露身份也需授权。

Some OPN-account features analyze quotes, develop specifications, estimate EPR fees and send confirmed supplier quotation requests. Benchmarks exclude freight, duties and payment terms and are not supplier offers or financial advice. A forecast or recyclability grade is not independently verified compliance or performance. Check material specification, currency and date before negotiation; requesting a quote is a real external communication, and the described later identity disclosure does not remove the need to authorize the inquiry.

plugins.description_zh: 规划旅行并优化行李准备
plugins.overview_zh: PackRat 结合户外行程、装备搜索、打包和重量分析，提供轻量替代、天气及指南，保存至账户并同步手机。价格重量和预报可能缺失或变化，自动查漏不能证明装备适合路线和安全条件。出发前核实必备物、许可、风险及预报时间；保存行程或推荐商品不等于预订购买，总重量也取决于数量分类正确。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PackRat combines outdoor-trip planning, gear search and packing lists with weight breakdowns, lighter alternatives, destination weather and guides. Saved trips and packs synchronize with a PackRat account and mobile app. Catalog weights, prices and weather forecasts can be incomplete or change, and an automatic gap check does not certify a pack is safe for a route or conditions. Verify essential equipment, permits, local hazards and forecast timing before travel. A saved itinerary or recommended product is not a booking or purchase, and total carried weight depends on correct quantities and classifications.

plugins.description_en: Submit tasks to the PACO team
plugins.overview_zh: PACO Concierge 向里斯本真人礼宾团队提交会员请求、查进度、补充笔记或取消，团队可处理预约、供应商联系、跑腿和文件。因此创建请求是真正给人下任务，不是私人草稿，需要有效会员账户。提交前明确动作、个人资料、费用上限和对象；已提交或处理中不证明餐厅、服务或底层任务已经完成。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PACO Concierge submits member requests directly to a human concierge team in Lisbon, retrieves progress, adds notes and cancels requests that are no longer needed. The team can pursue bookings, supplier contact, errands and paperwork, so creating a request is a real instruction to people rather than a private draft. An active PACO membership and account connection are required. Confirm the requested action, relevant personal details, spending bounds and recipient before submission. A submitted or in-progress status does not establish that the restaurant, service or other underlying task has been completed.

plugins.description_zh: 适合你们一群人玩的派对游戏
plugins.overview_zh: PadConsole 按人数和氛围推荐浏览器聚会游戏，说明通过二维码将手机当控制器，由电脑、兼容电视浏览器或平板承载，并提供异地游玩指引。列出英、土、德语。推荐不启动会话或授权摄像头设备权限，应按游戏检查网络、设备和年龄适用性，不假定所有游戏人数或远程玩法相同。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PadConsole recommends browser-based group games by player count and desired mood and explains how to use phones as controllers by scanning a QR code. A computer, compatible television browser or tablet hosts the console, with game-page links and support information for remote groups. English, Turkish and German are listed. A recommendation does not launch a shared session or grant camera or device permissions. Check game-specific equipment, connectivity and age suitability, especially for camera games, and do not assume every listed game supports the same number of players or remote-play setup.

plugins.description_zh: 查询职业板式网球数据
plugins.overview_zh: Padel Analyst 从 Padel API 查询职业板式网球球员、排名、战绩、交锋、赛事和详细统计，覆盖 Premier Padel、FIP 及历史巡回赛，也可据表现模拟对阵。需核对具体赛事赛季和更新，模拟不是保证预测或博彩建议。缺统计不代表表现为零，合并记录前应正确匹配球员和搭档。

It describes Premier Padel and FIP coverage plus historical tours and can simulate matchups from performance data. Coverage and freshness should be checked for the exact event or season. Simulations are model outputs, not predictions guaranteed to occur or betting advice. Missing statistics are not zero performance, and player names or pairings must be matched correctly before combining records or drawing conclusions about current form.

plugins.overview_zh: PadelTrue 按来源原文、日期和明确筛选条件比较球拍规格，力量控制等评分来自五项参数公式，不是试打、实验或个人适配，缺项和厂商矛盾会注明。只覆盖自身目录，只读免登录、不售卖收款，不能确认库存和配送。需核对准确型号年份及价格；舒适度分不是医疗建议或防伤保证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PadelTrue Racket Finder compares published racket specifications with source wording, dates and explicit filters. Its calculated power, control, handling, forgiveness and comfort scores use five specifications, not play tests, laboratory measurements or personal fitting; missing inputs and contradictory manufacturer statements are disclosed. Scope is its own catalog, not the entire market. It is read-only, needs no login, does not sell or take payments and cannot confirm stock or delivery geography. Verify the exact model year and source price, and distinguish a formula-based comfort score from medical advice or a guarantee against injury.

plugins.description_zh: 创建并管理 Padlet 看板
plugins.overview_zh: Padlet 可创建整理看板、编辑帖子、分析附件、评论分享、定时冻结及支持的 LMS 评分；管理员还可管理成员、SSO 和域名，但普通用户不获得这些权限。Sandbox 白板尚未全面支持。帖子章节可软删除恢复，其他若干删除属破坏性。应审查受众、学生资料和评分，权限改动、邀请、持续自动化分别确认，所有操作仍受账户角色限制。

Administrator functions can include membership, SSO and domain controls, but ordinary users do not acquire those privileges. Sandbox whiteboards are not yet fully supported. Posts and sections are recoverable soft-deletes, while several other removals are destructive and require confirmation. Review audiences, student information and grading outputs carefully, and treat access changes, invitations and persistent automations as separate consequential actions. Account permissions still limit every operation despite the broad published feature list.

plugins.overview_zh: Page Pulse 结合站点 Search Console、GA4 和页面变更分析流量、查询及内容标题链接变化，可新增跟踪页面并配置邮件或 Slack 提醒。变化与流量下降相关不证明因果，数据也可能延迟或缺失。需确认所有权、报告期和范围；创建提醒意味着持续检查通信，应明确条件目标，配置完成不保证检测所有重要变化。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Page Pulse combines a site's Search Console, GA4 and page-change records to investigate traffic differences, query performance and changes in text, titles, metadata or links. It can add tracked sites or page lists and configure email or Slack alerts. Correlation between a page change and a traffic drop does not establish causation, and connected metrics may have delays or missing coverage. Confirm ownership, reporting period and tracking scope before interpretation. Creating alerts establishes ongoing checks and communications, so specify conditions and destinations; a configured monitor is not a guarantee that every meaningful change will be detected.

plugins.description_zh: 将公开网页转换为 Markdown
plugins.overview_zh: Page2AI 仅把明确提供的一个公开网址转为 Markdown，保留标题代码表格链接并去除杂项；按需只读，不爬站、无需账户，页面称不存储。不绕登录付费访问控制，拒绝私网和云元数据地址，响应限 10 MB 且有限时限流。提取可能遗漏动态布局，引用前应对照原文；可选本地开源服务不代表已安装。
