plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Product Listing Validator checks whether submitted listing data contains the fields required for a review or publication workflow. It returns a structured account of fields present, fields missing and validation errors, helping sellers identify incomplete titles, descriptions, prices or image references before moving forward.

plugins.overview_zh: Production Engine 读取商业视频制作工作区的已保存运营记录，可汇总正在拍摄的项目及期限、比较预算与已记实际支出、找出未结发票，并查看团队回复、交付物和待处理投标，适合形成制作状态简报。
plugins.requirements_zh: 访问明确只读，限于由所有者或管理员连接的工作区。不更新排期、支付发票或验证未入账费用，报告准确性取决于保存的数据。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Production Engine reads the saved operational records of a commercial-video workspace. It can summarize active shoots and deadlines, compare budgets with recorded actuals, identify outstanding invoices and review crew replies, deliverables and open bids. It is useful for preparing a current production briefing from the team’s existing records.

plugins.description_zh: 了解谁在何处拍摄什么
plugins.overview_zh: Production List 按片名、城市、公司或参与人员检索影视制作目录，可回答哪里正在拍摄、是否开机及由谁负责选角等问题。回答附公开制作页面和最近更新时间，便于判断记录时效。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只返回公开目录事实，插件明确不提供会员可见的个人联系方式。目录记录不代表存在招聘机会，也不等于获准联系参与者。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Production List searches film and television production listings by title, city, companies or attached people. It can answer what is shooting, whether production has begun and who is casting a project. Answers include the public production-page link and last-update time to help users assess the currency of the directory record.

plugins.description_en: Run your work in one place
plugins.overview_zh: Productive 将专业服务组织的运营数据接入 ChatGPT，可查询项目、工时、人员可用性、预算使用、逾期任务及销售管道，正文也提到可对这些数据采取操作。目标用户是已使用 Productive 的代理商、咨询和软件服务团队。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要连接组织的访问权。页面未枚举写入工具、审批规则、删除或财务交易，不应把笼统的操作描述扩展为未经证明的具体动作。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Productive connects a professional-services organization’s operations data to ChatGPT. It supports questions about project status, time, resource availability, budget usage, overdue work and sales pipeline, and describes acting on that operational data. The target users are agencies, consultancies and software-services teams already working in Productive.

plugins.overview_zh: Productivity Hub 汇集任务、项目、会议、笔记、目标、习惯、学习、旅行及沟通的规划与回顾技能，可依据可用精力和约束组织计划，辅助决策、委派及周期复盘，并明确区分建议步骤与已确认动作。
plugins.requirements_zh: 技能包本身不证明已连接日历、邮件或任务管理系统。外部动作仍需实际宿主工具和权限，书面计划或委派建议不能被当作已执行。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Productivity Hub bundles planning and reflection skills for tasks, projects, meetings, notes, goals, habits, study, travel and communication. It turns available capacity and constraints into realistic plans and can help with decisions, delegation and periodic reviews, explicitly distinguishing suggested next steps from actions already confirmed.

plugins.overview_zh: ProductNow 连接组织上下文系统，可搜索和读取有权访问的文档、文件夹及版本，也支持新建、编辑、评论、移动、归档和审核流程，便于把对话中的知识维护进组织资料。发布者明确提及 ChatGPT 和 Codex。
plugins.requirements_zh: 所有操作受连接账户与工作区权限限制。编辑和归档会改变共享记录，不能推定跨客户端完全同功能、无限组织访问或自动审核通过。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProductNow connects an organization’s context engine for searching and reading accessible documents, folders and versions. It also supports document creation and editing, comments, moves, archiving and review workflows, helping turn conversation context into maintained organizational knowledge. The publisher explicitly names both ChatGPT and Codex.

plugins.overview_zh: ProductOS 提供无需本地克隆的远程云开发工作区，可管理项目、启动带预览链接的隔离沙箱、编辑文件、执行 shell、配置 Postgres 与 S3 资源，并触发生产部署。发布者称文件变更会自动同步到 GitHub。
plugins.requirements_zh: shell 执行、资源创建、GitHub 同步及部署都有真实副作用。应限于获准项目并核对成本与公开范围；页面未详细说明额度、计费及部署权限控制。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProductOS provides a remote cloud development workspace rather than requiring a local clone. It can manage projects, start isolated sandboxes with preview links, edit files, run shell commands, provision Postgres and S3 resources, and trigger production deployments. The publisher states that file changes synchronize automatically to GitHub.

plugins.overview_zh: ProdVerity 检查公开 HTTPS 应用是否可达及常见安全响应头，发现可选验证清单并运行确定性的公开健康检查，还可比较公开构建标记与预期提交或版本标识，帮助判断线上是否在提供预期构建。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅执行公开只读检查，不登录、不修改目标、不访问私有网络，也不做视觉验证。构建标记或响应头通过不等于全面安全审计或全部用户流程正常。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProdVerity checks public HTTPS applications for reachability and common security headers, discovers an optional verification manifest and runs deterministic public health checks. It can compare an exposed build marker with an expected commit or release identifier, helping operators investigate whether the intended build is being served.

plugins.overview_zh: ProEigentum Immobilien 面向慕尼黑及周边地区，以位置为中心发现房产。互动地图可帮助比较住宅、公寓和投资房源与社区、基础设施的关系，并提供联系当地房产专家的途径。
plugins.requirements_zh: 范围为精选区域房源，而非全国完整数据库。浏览房源不等于购房、保证估值或完成经纪委托，合同和实时可用性需另行确认。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProEigentum Immobilien offers location-led property discovery in Munich and surrounding areas. Its interactive map helps compare houses, apartments and investment-property listings in relation to neighborhoods and infrastructure, with a route to regional real-estate experts for further discussion.

plugins.overview_zh: ProfileID 使用整合学历、能力、经历、认证、项目及证明材料的职业档案，帮助分析优势与技能差距、准备简历或作品集、评估求职准备度，并根据档案探索职业方向及机会匹配。
plugins.requirements_zh: 访问取决于用户 ProfileID 资料与权限。发布者所称验证不代表本次已独立审计资质；建议不是招聘决定、就业保证，也不等于获准代投申请。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProfileID uses a connected digital career profile combining education, competencies, work history, certifications, projects and supporting evidence. It helps interpret strengths and skill gaps, prepare resumes or portfolios, assess job readiness and explore career directions or opportunity matches grounded in that profile.

plugins.description_zh: 追踪目标与关键成果及进度
plugins.overview_zh: Profit.co 是涵盖目标与关键结果、项目任务、工时、会议和员工绩效流程的战略执行平台。条目示例包括列出目标和待办动作、创建公司目标，可作为现有组织目标管理的对话入口。
plugins.requirements_zh: 正文较多介绍整体平台，不能假定所有宣传集成、人事流程或平台功能都通过此连接器开放；实际工具、账户访问与写入权限需另核对。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Profit.co is a strategy-execution platform spanning objectives and key results, project and task management, time tracking, meetings and employee-performance processes. The entry’s examples include listing objectives and pending actions and creating a corporate objective, giving a conversational route into an existing organization’s goal-tracking work.

plugins.overview_zh: ProfitHero 把暖通、管道、电工等服务企业的目标、当前关键指标和每周洞察带入对话，利用 ServiceTitan、HouseCall Pro 与 QuickBooks 的业务资料讨论差距、趋势及目标对比实际表现。
plugins.requirements_zh: 回答依赖已连接来源资料的可用性和准确性。条目描述获取上下文，未证明能修改这些外部系统、付款或保证经营改善。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProfitHero brings trade-business goals, current KPIs and weekly findings into a conversation. It uses business context from ServiceTitan, HouseCall Pro and QuickBooks to discuss performance gaps, trends and goal-versus-actual comparisons for HVAC, plumbing, electrical and related service companies.

plugins.description_zh: 面向卖家的 Etsy 分析
plugins.overview_zh: ProfitTree 把公开 Etsy 商品、店铺和关键词研究与卖家已连接店铺分析结合，可查看销售、利润、订单、广告、商品成本和跟踪项目，便于复盘近期表现并研究公开商品或关键词机会。
plugins.requirements_zh: 私有店铺信息需要连接店铺。利润计算取决于成本资料是否齐全；页面未证明刊登编辑、广告预算修改、订单履约或保证需求预测。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProfitTree combines public Etsy product, shop and keyword research with analytics from a seller’s connected shop. It can inspect sales, profitability, orders, ads, product costs and tracked items, helping compare recent performance and investigate public listing or keyword opportunities.

plugins.overview_zh: Prognyx 使用实时 ClinicalTrials.gov 记录，在同一适应症下围绕药物资产或靶点比较最多三项肿瘤介入研究，展示申报设计、申办方、阶段、状态、结局及更新和来源链接，也可搜索注册研究格局与附来源的竞争情报简报。
plugins.requirements_zh: 免费只读，无需账户或 API 密钥。注册记录描述申报研究设计，不证明疗效、患者资格或项目间直接竞争；属于研究情报而非个体治疗建议。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prognyx compares up to three oncology interventional studies around an asset or target in one indication using live ClinicalTrials.gov records. It shows declared design, sponsor, phase, status, outcomes and update/source links, while separate searches provide registry landscapes and source-linked competitive-intelligence briefings.

plugins.overview_zh: Programming Hub 汇集编码、解释、排障、评审、重构、架构、测试、安全、性能、部署和文档技能，覆盖前后端、数据库、API、Cloudflare、Git 与迁移，也可准备编码代理交接，并明确记录证据与验证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 这些是工作流技能，不代表已连接仓库、云账户或保证执行环境。实际构建、部署及迁移需要工具、权限和批准，建议应在具体项目中验证。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Programming Hub groups engineering skills for coding, explanation, debugging, review, refactoring, architecture, testing, security, performance, deployment and documentation. It spans frontend, backend, databases, APIs, Cloudflare, Git and migrations, and can prepare coding-agent handoffs while making evidence and verification explicit.

plugins.description_zh: 按百分比追踪计划进展
自然地确定方向和探索
plugins.overview_zh: Progressive Clarity 是组织回答的技能，优先直接结论和重要限定，简单追问保持精炼；在不同读者需要速览、背景与深入细节时采用分层表达，适合技术选择或项目更新，而非把所有回答强制变成长模板。
plugins.requirements_zh: 主题理解与语义质量仅属辅助，不能保证正确。公开正文未证明外部数据连接、事实核验服务或独立执行能力。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Progressive Clarity is an answer-organization skill that prioritizes a direct response and important qualifications. It keeps simple follow-ups compact and uses layered views when different readers need quick orientation, background and deeper detail, helping explain technical choices or project updates without forcing every answer into a long template.

plugins.overview_zh: Proje Merkezi 按位置、预算、房型及周边条件发现土耳其新住宅项目，展示发布者称已核验的项目详情，并支持比较符合条件或靠近指定地点的开发项目。
plugins.requirements_zh: 范围为土耳其新住宅项目。房源核验未在本次独立测试；条目未说明预订、购买、贷款、产权核查或最终可售确认功能。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Proje Merkezi helps discover new residential developments in Türkiye by location, budget, room type and nearby surroundings. It presents project details described by the publisher as verified and supports comparing suitable developments, including projects near a chosen location.

plugins.overview_zh: Project Kickoff Pack 将提供的项目资料整理为启动文件，涵盖目标、角色职责、里程碑、风险和启动条件。它区分已确认内容与建议，使团队能审核已达成的起点，避免把拟议工作误当作承诺。
plugins.requirements_zh: 当前交付仅纳入提供的资料与已确认事项，拟议内容单列且不纳入。页面未证明项目系统同步、邀请、任务分派或自动批准。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Project Kickoff Pack organizes supplied project material into a kickoff document covering objectives, roles, responsibilities, milestones, risks and start conditions. It distinguishes confirmed inputs from suggestions so a team can review an agreed starting point without accidentally treating proposed work as a commitment.

plugins.overview_zh: Project Milestone Schedule 根据开始日期、里程碑时长及依赖 ID 计算排期。时长包含首日，后继任务在所有前置任务结束后的次日开始，未知依赖和循环会被拒绝。它生成可审核的确定性排期，而非资源优化计划。
plugins.requirements_zh: 按自然日计算，不处理人员、假日或产能优化。服务器计算临时进行，独立浏览器工具提供 CSV/JSON 导出；无持久记录、检索、发送、交易或付费模型调用，请求和响应分别限 128/256 KiB，另有字段和记录限制。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Project Milestone Schedule calculates dates from a start date, supplied milestone durations and dependency IDs. Durations include the first day, and successors begin the day after all predecessors finish; unknown dependencies and cycles are rejected. It provides a reviewable deterministic schedule rather than resource-aware project optimization.

plugins.description_zh: 管理 Microsoft Project MPP 文件

plugins.overview_zh: ProjectManager 把项目和任务信息接入对话规划，可识别近期工作、优先事项和瓶颈，并将讨论中的计划整理为带任务层级、日期及负责人的排期，也能在适当授权下修改任务状态和优先级。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要相关 ProjectManager 工作区访问权。创建排期或调整分派会影响共享工作；条目未说明全部操作、通知、资源优化或计费细节。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProjectManager connects project and task information to conversational planning. It helps identify upcoming work, priorities and bottlenecks, then can turn a discussed plan into a schedule with task hierarchy, dates and assignees. Task status and priority can be changed from the conversation when appropriate.

plugins.overview_zh: Promocodes.com 提供对话式优惠码查询，发布者称结果为可用优惠码，旨在让用户留在 ChatGPT 中寻找折扣，而不必逐页搜索优惠网站。正文很简短，未描述其他购物操作。
plugins.requirements_zh: 优惠码能否使用仍取决于商家、购物车、地区、日期及排除条件。条目未证明自动结账、保证折扣、完整商家覆盖或当前验证频率。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Promocodes.com provides a conversational lookup for promotional codes, with the publisher describing the results as working codes. It is intended to help shoppers find a discount while staying in ChatGPT rather than manually searching coupon pages. The functional description is brief and does not describe additional shopping operations.

plugins.description_zh: 检查代码变更、联调证据与 CR 准备度
plugins.description_en: 检查代码变更、联调证据与 CR 准备度
plugins.overview_zh: Promotion Check 在编码后依据真实变更、仓库知识和工程规范生成联调清单，可结合请求响应、日志、截图或人工结果定位单个联调问题，并在 Code Review 前分别给出准备度判断与动作建议。
plugins.requirements_zh: 默认只读，不修改代码、不调用改变业务数据的接口。需要相关仓库和证据，不能替代团队正式评审门禁。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Promotion Check prepares integration-test checklists after coding using actual changes, repository knowledge and engineering conventions. It can investigate an individual integration issue from request/response evidence, logs, screenshots or human results, then report Code Review readiness separately from suggested actions.

plugins.description_zh: 使用 Promova 学习语言
plugins.overview_zh: Promova English Check 在 ChatGPT 中提供免费的五题自适应语法测验，返回 A1 至 C2 的 CEFR 水平估计、相关语言评分及匹配示例课程，再可转到 Promova 获取个性化学习计划。
plugins.requirements_zh: 五题评估不等于受认可的语言证书或完整口语、听力考试。这里明确免费的范围是测评，后续学习计划收费及报名条件未说明。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Promova English Check runs a free adaptive five-question grammar quiz in ChatGPT and returns an indicative CEFR level from A1 to C2, with associated language scores and a sample lesson. Users can then continue on Promova for a personalized learning plan.

plugins.description_zh: 提示词撰写和模型建议
plugins.overview_zh: Prompt & Model Optimizer 将草稿或目标改为结构化提示，并建议模型、工具及推理投入级别。它集中询问缺失背景、保留用户事实，也能把跨工具工作拆成相衔接的提示。模型状态建议来自开发者维护的列表，并标记不确定性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 它只写提示，不直接完成图片、代码等任务。模型状态需与服务商核对，模型名称和检索词会发送给开发者服务器；不要提交秘密或敏感个人资料。它独立于 AI 服务商，未获其背书。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prompt & Model Optimizer turns a draft or goal into a structured prompt and suggests a model, tool and effort level. It gathers missing context in one grouped question, preserves the user’s facts and can split a multi-tool workflow into linked prompts. Model-status advice comes from a developer-maintained list and marks uncertainty.

plugins.description_zh: 设计和测试 AI 提示
plugins.overview_zh: Prompt Engineer 根据目标和约束设计提示，在不改变原意的前提下改进已有提示，并准备评估样例和评分标准，帮助比较可靠性、质量与安全，同时区分提示可影响的行为和真正需要工具或应用代码的能力。
plugins.requirements_zh: 效果需要实证且依赖模型，不保证成功。设计评估不等于已运行评估，提示也不能赋予缺少的工具、权限或可靠事实知识。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prompt Engineer designs prompts from goals and constraints, improves existing prompts without changing intent and prepares evaluation examples with scoring rubrics. It helps compare reliability, quality and safety while separating behavior a prompt can influence from capabilities that actually need tools or application code.

plugins.overview_zh: Prompt Injection Security 审阅提示、应用设计、检索内容和工具流程中的注入风险，给出关联证据的攻击路径、校准后的严重度与置信度、分层缓解措施及安全回归测试思路，帮助定位不可信内容可能影响系统的位置。
plugins.requirements_zh: 分析仅作辅助，明确不能保证防护。它不代表已部署持续过滤器或自动保护当前对话；测试应限于获准系统，并验证缓解效果。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prompt Injection Security reviews prompts, application designs, retrieved content and tool workflows for injection risks. It produces evidence-linked attack paths, calibrated severity and confidence, layered mitigations and safe regression-test ideas, helping teams inspect where untrusted content might influence an AI system.

plugins.description_zh: GPT 6 提示（原文自称完美）
plugins.overview_zh: Prompt Machine 6 是法语提示编写技能，极简正文称可为面向发布者所称 ChatGPT 6 的请求撰写优化提示。已核验范围仅为提示准备，未描述详细方法、评估步骤或外部集成。
plugins.requirements_zh: 宣传中的完美提示并非质量保证，也不是任何模型功能或可用性的官方确认。条目未说明实际任务执行、可量化提升、价格或前提条件。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prompt Machine 6 is a French-language skill whose very short description offers to write an optimized prompt for a request directed at what the publisher calls ChatGPT 6. The verified scope is prompt preparation, with no detailed methodology, evaluation procedure or external integration described.

plugins.description_zh: 将零散想法整理成提示
plugins.overview_zh: Prompt Optimizer 把冗长或杂乱请求整理为清晰执行说明，区分目标、必须保留项、参数、假设及待决问题，强调保留任务范围和批准边界而不是暗中扩展，并在提示用于后续流程前指出偏离。
plugins.requirements_zh: 所列能力针对四句或以上相关内容触发，本地运行且不需凭据。它只准备提示，不执行任务、不发布内容或花费资金。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prompt Optimizer restructures long or messy requests into an executable brief that separates the goal, required details, parameters, assumptions and unresolved choices. It is designed to preserve scope and approval limits rather than silently expand the user’s task, and flags drift before the prompt is used elsewhere.

plugins.overview_zh: Prompt Perfect 为 ChatGPT 工作流加入提示库管理及质量反馈，可把简单请求改为上下文更充分的提示、评分并提出反馈，也可浏览、定制和保存常用提示，适合反复使用相似提示模式的个人或团队。
plugins.requirements_zh: 评分是服务自身反馈，不是独立基准或模型表现保证。页面未说明账户要求、存储可见性、提示库共享及导出格式。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prompt Perfect adds prompt-library management and quality feedback to a ChatGPT workflow. It restructures simple requests into richer prompts, scores prompting with feedback, and allows browsing, customizing and saving reusable favorites. It is useful when a team or individual repeatedly applies similar prompting patterns.

plugins.overview_zh: Promptbanken 是面向组织与个人的开放精选提示目录，可按任务检索、获取完整模板，并在 ChatGPT 中逐步使用提示包。它用于读取现有模板，而非修改私有提示仓库。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需账户且连接器只读。发布者称请求仅含规定的检索、角色、筛选和条目 ID/slug 参数，不存储查询文本，只匿名统计查询长度；这些是发布者说明，非独立隐私审计结论。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Promptbanken is an open curated catalog of reusable prompts for organizations and individuals. Users can search by task, fetch a full template and work through a multi-step prompt package within ChatGPT. It is designed for retrieving existing templates rather than modifying a private prompt repository.

plugins.description_zh: 制定 AI 测试和计划
plugins.overview_zh: PromptBrake Free Tools 准备注入测试输入，把 OWASP 大模型风险映射为检查项和预警信号，并起草包含待决事项与基础门禁策略的 AI 发布计划，还可生成含一至二十个响应检查的 tests.json 供 PromptBrake CI 使用。
plugins.requirements_zh: 免费且无需账户或密钥，但只准备测试，不扫描应用。检查采用不区分大小写的文本比较，规划完整度分数不是安全保证；测试输入仅限自有或明确获准系统。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PromptBrake Free Tools prepares prompt-injection test inputs, maps OWASP LLM risks to checks and warning signals, and drafts AI release plans with open decisions and a starter gate policy. It can create a tests.json file containing one to twenty response checks for use in PromptBrake CI.

plugins.description_zh: 复用团队 AI 工作流程
plugins.overview_zh: PromptCrew 读取团队保存的 AI 能力及配套知识，推荐相关可复用流程，并展示指令和变量。在用户明确选择保存后，还可新建或更新能力，支持复用而不暗中改写团队知识。
plugins.requirements_zh: 检索限于可访问的团队资料。新建或修改能力需要明确保存选择；在对话中使用流程不意味着已修改存储版本或执行外部任务。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PromptCrew retrieves a team’s saved AI capabilities and supporting knowledge, recommends relevant reusable workflows and exposes their instructions and variables. It can also create or update a saved capability after the user explicitly chooses to save, supporting reuse without silently rewriting the team’s knowledge.

plugins.overview_zh: Promptfoo 汇集配置评估服务商及目标、编写评估集、设置或运行大模型应用红队流程的技能，帮助开发者从预期行为或 HTTP 接口建立可重复的评估配置。
plugins.requirements_zh: 测试需要适当执行环境、获准目标以及流程所需的服务商访问。条目未说明附带算力、凭据或免费额度；配置或完成测试都不保证应用安全。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Promptfoo bundles skills for connecting evaluation providers and targets, writing evaluation suites, and setting up or running red-team workflows against language-model applications. It supports developers moving from a desired behavior or HTTP endpoint to a repeatable assessment configuration.

plugins.overview_zh: PromptKosh 获取公开图片风格或网站中的风格 ID，再把风格提示和所需输入交给 ChatGPT。实际出图依赖用户 ChatGPT 账户可用的图像功能，因此插件是风格发现与提示衔接工具，而不是额外的出图额度。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需 PromptKosh 账户，但仍受 ChatGPT 图像能力可用性、额度及适用政策限制。选择风格不保证能生成，也不赋予上传参考素材的权利。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: PromptKosh retrieves a public image style or a style identified on its website, then passes the style prompt and required inputs to ChatGPT. Image creation uses the image features available in the user’s ChatGPT account, making the plugin a style-discovery and prompt bridge rather than a separate image-rendering entitlement.

plugins.description_zh: 追踪 AI 搜索可见度
plugins.overview_zh: Promptwatch 帮助团队观察品牌在 AI 搜索中的出现情况，包括引用和竞品，也管理相关提示、监测器、内容和项目，为持续 AI 可见性研究提供工作区，而非一次普通网页搜索。
plugins.requirements_zh: 简短正文未定义服务商覆盖、采样频率、历史深度或具体写入动作。可见性观察不能视为全体消费者曝光、销售因果效应或排名提升保证。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Promptwatch helps teams observe how their brand appears in AI search, including citations and competing brands. It also manages the associated prompts, monitors, content and projects, providing a workspace for organizing an AI-visibility research program rather than a one-off general web search.

plugins.overview_zh: Prontuno 将事务性邮件运营接入 ChatGPT，可发送邮件、检查投递结果、管理发件域名及抑制记录，并配置投递事件 webhook。示例用途包括核对域名准备情况、近期失败或退信，以及地址被抑制的原因。
plugins.requirements_zh: 发信、移除抑制或配置 webhook 可能传输资料或改变投递行为，须限于获准范围。域名认证、额度、价格与保留期未详述，投递状态也不证明收件人已阅读。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Prontuno connects transactional-email operations to ChatGPT. It can send messages, inspect delivery outcomes, manage sending domains and suppression records, and configure delivery-event webhooks. Suggested investigations include checking domain readiness, recent failures or bounces and why an address is suppressed.

plugins.overview_zh: Proofline 围绕精确证据组织工程决策，保留引用片段，在证据变化时追踪明确关联的下游影响，并验证可携带证据包或签名证明。发布者称验证不依赖 AI 服务商，重点是可审计关系而非只有自由摘要。
plugins.requirements_zh: 检查证据包完整性或签名，不证明底层主张真实或签署者可信。页面未说明支持密钥格式、信任根、存储或执行前提。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Proofline organizes engineering decisions around exact supporting evidence. It preserves cited spans, traces explicitly linked downstream impacts when evidence changes, and verifies portable evidence packages or signed attestations. The publisher describes verification without requiring an AI provider, emphasizing auditable relationships rather than free-form summaries alone.

plugins.description_zh: 在保留原意的前提下编辑
plugins.overview_zh: Proofread 改善语法、拼写、清晰度与文风，也处理翻译文本，同时力求保留作者事实、声音、引文、代码、引用和精确数值。示例流程包括先检查文件差异再应用修改，以及将译文与原文对照。
plugins.requirements_zh: 这是保留原意的编辑，不是独立事实核查或认证翻译。文件修改取决于宿主工具和用户批准，技术数值与关键主张仍需人工检查。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Proofread improves grammar, spelling, clarity and style, including translated prose, while aiming to preserve the author’s facts, voice, quotations, code, citations and exact values. Example workflows include reviewing a file diff before applying edits and comparing a translation with its source.

plugins.overview_zh: ProofX 使用密码学证据登记文本类数字内容并返回验证链接，可生成内容指纹、按内容 ID 或哈希查询登记，以及查看创作者档案和保护历史。示例材料包括文章、诗歌、脚本及代码。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要 ProofX 账户；免费注册不代表无限免费内容登记。密码学记录可说明完整性或登记，但不能单独确立著作权、原创性或法律效力；提交前应审查公开可验证信息。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: ProofX registers text-based digital content with cryptographic evidence and returns a verification link. It can compute a content fingerprint, look up registration by content ID or hash, and inspect creator profiles or protection history. Intended material includes articles, poems, scripts and code.

plugins.description_zh: 提供附来源的自营交易公司规则
plugins.overview_zh: Prop Trading Intelligence 检索人工核对的外汇和差价合约自营交易考核项目数据，以原文、链接和核对日期比较规则与费用，解释术语，并依据输入计算头寸规模或回撤恢复；可按新闻交易、持仓和分成等条件筛选。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Describes a real-estate working environment intended to bring market participants, structured information, analytics, communication and AI assistance into one system. Its potential use is coordinating information that would otherwise be scattered across separate broker, developer, investor and buyer tools. The complete page is largely platform-level positioning and does not enumerate specific ChatGPT actions or datasets. Do not infer that this integration can execute a purchase, verify title, access every market or deliver independent valuations. Coverage, transaction permissions, account requirements, freshness and pricing remain unspecified despite the complete developer/version metadata.

plugins.overview_zh: Quartlympus 的受限学术书籍写作流程，可按指定模板及来源规范完成教材、参考书或专著大约一半的结构，并制作该范围所需视觉内容。关键限制是并非整本书服务，页面将完整版引向另一个升级产品及管理员。生成部分仍需专业审阅、核实引文及作者责任检查。不能把它理解为出版录用、原创性认证、同行评议或第三方插图转载许可。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: A limited academic-book writing workflow from Quartlympus, designed to produce approximately half the structure of a textbook, reference work or monograph using its prescribed templates and sourcing standards. It also covers visuals within that limited scope. The key boundary is explicit: this is not a complete-book service, and the page points to a separate upgrade through its administrator. Treat generated sections as drafts requiring subject expertise, source verification and authorship review. The description does not establish publication acceptance, originality certification, peer review or permission to reproduce third-party illustrations.

plugins.overview_zh: 供已有 RaamTrade 账户查看获授权策略、交易账户、市场及运行中策略数据，编写和编译 RaamCode，执行历史回测、优化与滚动前推测试，并把拟议修改放入 Save & Trade 待人工审阅。边界非常明确：不能发单、批准篮子、启动策略或连接券商。回测只是基于假设的模拟，不保证收益；应检查费用、市场条件和过拟合，再决定是否在其他界面采取行动。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lets existing RaamTrade members inspect accessible strategy libraries, account information, market data and running-strategy information. Users can author and compile RaamCode, run historical or walk-forward testing and optimization, then stage proposed changes in Save & Trade for human review. The staging boundary is important: it cannot place orders, approve the basket, activate strategies or connect a broker. Results are simulations and account-dependent information, not guaranteed returns. Review assumptions, fees, market conditions and overfitting before using a backtest to make decisions outside this app.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 RaceCharts 后，可从数据、现有项目或示例制作动态条形、折线和饼图，调整色彩、布局、图片、音乐和时间线事件，预览修改、保存项目并导出视频。需要账户，视频导出消耗套餐权益或积分。开启直接保存意味着真实修改项目，不只是展示建议；应限定可访问项目和操作，检查数据及配乐图片使用权，再对外分享动画。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Builds and edits animated bar, line and pie charts from your dataset, an existing project or a supplied example. You can adjust presentation elements such as colors, layout, images, music and timeline annotations, preview a change, save a project and request a video download. A RaceCharts account is required, and video exports use that account's plan or credits. Direct saving, when enabled, changes the project rather than just showing a draft. Scope the permitted projects/actions carefully and check the underlying data and media rights before sharing an exported animation.

plugins.description_zh: 通过 Red Sift 检查域名安全
plugins.overview_zh: 检查域名的邮件认证、DNS 和网页安全配置，以雷达图、问题摘要及优先修复建议展示结果，也可比较多个域名或解释 DMARC 等术语。适合配置排查，但不等于完整渗透测试或“该域名绝对安全”的证明。结果取决于实际执行的测试和当时记录；页面没有证明会自动修复、访问私有基础设施、持续监测或出具安全认证。重要配置变更仍应单独审查。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Examines a domain's email-authentication, DNS and web-security configuration, summarizes test findings and visualizes relative scores on a radar chart. It can compare domains or explain the meaning of issues such as DMARC configuration and prioritize remediation topics. This is a configuration-assessment workflow, not evidence of a complete penetration test or proof that a domain is safe. Findings describe the checks performed and can change as records change. The page does not establish automatic remediation, access to private infrastructure, a security certification or continuous monitoring; verify consequential configuration changes separately.

plugins.description_zh: 管理你的 Amazon 业务
plugins.overview_zh: 面向 Amazon 巴西站卖家，分析销售到净利润的组成、预计结算、库存风险、调价原因及广告效果，也能修改出价预算、启停广告、处理关键词和广告组合。直接编辑可先预览，但批准自动化建议会真正执行，拒绝也会改变建议状态。需连接 Radar Scout 与卖家账户，每次卖家数据查询仅针对一个账户。估计值受可用数据影响，具体操作有校验和运行限制；批准前尤其要核对预算及实际投放后果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Analyzes an Amazon Brazil seller's revenue-to-profit breakdown, estimated settlements, inventory pressure, repricing history and advertising performance. It also supports real ad changes, including bids, budgets, campaign status, keywords and portfolios. Direct edits can be previewed, but approving an automation proposal executes it; rejection changes proposal status. Connect both Radar Scout and the seller account, and note that each seller-data request covers one account. Estimates and performance ratios depend on the available records, and action-specific validation and operating limits apply. Review spending consequences before approving changes.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接已有 RadarJobs 账户，搜索美国技术岗位，包括一般雇佣与合同工作，查看个性化推荐或单个职位详情。结果提供标准化雇佣信息、时效、来源依据、原始招聘链接和 RadarJobs 详情链接，便于比较并追溯出处。页面没有说明会自动投递、联系雇主、验证工作资格或保证职位仍开放。薪资、用工类型、地点及申请条件应再以雇主原始公告为准。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches current US technology roles through an existing RadarJobs account, including standard employee and contract positions. It can show personalized recommendations and inspect one selected job, with normalized employment details, freshness information, source evidence and separate links to the original posting and RadarJobs record. This helps compare roles without losing their provenance. The description does not state that it submits applications, contacts employers, verifies work authorization or guarantees that a vacancy remains open. Confirm salary, employment classification, location and application requirements against the employer's actual posting.

plugins.description_zh: 提升你的 AI 搜索可见度
plugins.overview_zh: 查看 Radarkit 定期采集的 AI 回答，分析品牌提及、排名、情绪、竞争者和引用网站，可读完整回答、管理监测提示词、重新提问和导出记录。需要订阅及相应权限；读取消耗 API 积分，导出消耗行数额度，每次调用及成本可查。指标只代表所设问题和实际观察到的回答，不能保证品牌在所有搜索中的表现。授权时应区分只读、添加提示词、导出和创作内容的权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Analyzes tracked AI-search answers for brand mentions, position, sentiment, competitors and cited websites across the models covered by Radarkit. Users can inspect full saved answers, manage tracked prompts, request a fresh run and export selected records. A subscription and appropriate account permissions are required. Reading uses API credits, while exports consume an export-row allowance; calls and costs are logged. This is measurement of the configured prompts and observed answers, not a guarantee of universal search visibility. Distinguish read access from permissions to add prompts, export information or create content.

plugins.overview_zh: 结合 Radi8 账户中的品牌背景、策略和月度计划起草社交内容，可与该渠道已发内容对照，附上素材库图片并排入多个社交平台日历。日历不是纯计划表，排程到点会实际发布，只是在发布前可以修改。因此应把排程视为未来对外发布，核对账户、渠道、文案、素材权利和时区。需 Radi8 账户，具体额度、套餐和各平台限制未公开说明。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Uses a Radi8 account's brand context, strategy and monthly plan to prepare channel-specific posts. It can compare a draft with previously published material, attach an image from the media library and schedule content for supported social networks. That calendar is operational: posts are published when their scheduled time arrives, although they can be changed beforehand. Treat scheduling as a future external publication rather than a harmless draft. Verify the account, media rights, destination, wording and time zone; exact quotas, plan pricing and network-specific restrictions are not specified on the page.

plugins.overview_zh: 公开页面介绍全球网络电台及播客的查找与收听，可按国家、节目分类搜索、收藏并查看最近播放，也列出睡眠定时、闹钟和若干 Android 设备支持。后者属于 Radio FM 产品功能，不能自动当作 ChatGPT 能控制所有设备的证明。内容可用性取决于电台和流地址，缺失电台可在原应用建议添加。页面不保证覆盖全部广播源、连续播放、离线下载或所有设备，应在实际收听界面确认。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: The page describes an internet-radio and podcast product for finding stations by country, searching programs, saving favorites and revisiting recent listening. It also lists sleep timers, alarms and several Android-related playback environments. Those device features belong to the described Radio FM product and should not automatically be assumed to be executable ChatGPT controls. Availability depends on stations and podcast streams, and missing stations can be suggested through the app. The page does not promise every broadcaster, uninterrupted playback, offline downloads or universal device support; check the actual listening surface for a needed feature.

plugins.overview_zh: 按目的地、日期、预算、设施及周边位置查找和比较 Radisson 酒店，以地图、价格及实用信息辅助筛选。选定后提供预订链接，ChatGPT 内不处理付款。范围是该集团酒店，不是全市场酒店比价。正式下单前须在预订页核对房型、入住人数、税费、餐食及取消条款，价格和余房可能变化。本次只核验公开说明，未付款、订房或实测预订。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches and compares Radisson properties using destination, dates, budget, amenities and nearby places, with rates, practical hotel information and an interactive map. The conversation can narrow options as preferences change. Once you choose, it supplies a booking link rather than charging you inside ChatGPT. This is a Radisson-focused planning surface, not a comparison of every hotel brand. Check the final room, occupancy, taxes, meal inclusions and cancellation terms on the booking page, because availability and prices may change before purchase. No payment was made or reservation tested during this verification.

plugins.description_zh: 构建和调试生产环境 RAG
plugins.overview_zh: 辅助设计、排查和评估 RAG 系统，覆盖采集、切块、检索、重排、上下文构建、生成、引用及授权，也关注提示注入、数据泄漏、可观测性、延迟和成本。其方法强调可测证据、可逆修改，而非只改提示词。它是工程辅助，不代表系统已经安全或可上线；应提供不含密钥的必要材料，复现问题、检查源级权限并实际运行评测。页面没有承诺自动访问基础设施或发布生产版本。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Helps design, diagnose and evaluate retrieval-augmented generation systems across ingestion, chunking, search, reranking, context assembly and answer generation. It also addresses citations, authorization boundaries, prompt-injection risk, data leakage, observability, latency and cost. The described approach favors measurable tests and reversible changes over prompt-only patches. This is engineering assistance rather than an automatic proof of security or production readiness. Provide relevant artifacts without secrets, reproduce failures, validate source-level access controls and run the proposed evaluations before deployment; the page does not promise access to your infrastructure or automatic releases.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Compares recorded candidate behavior with an accepted baseline to identify regressions by policy and test case, then assembles reviewable release evidence. It is suited to investigating why a RAG release is blocked and preparing a release-gate report without requiring a particular model provider. The quality of the conclusion depends on the recorded runs, baseline and policies supplied; it does not establish that untested scenarios are safe. The short but complete description does not specify hosting, execution integrations or an ability to deploy software. Keep the report distinct from a human release decision.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接主播自己的 RaidRunner 账户，查看 Twitch 接力直播活动、已认领时段和完整阵容，也能寻找公开活动、认领或释放时段、加入候补及处理换班请求。因此不仅是查询，还会改变参与安排。权限限于所连接账户；操作前应核对活动、时区及组织规则，候补或交换请求不等于已确认席位。页面没有说明可控制直播、保证观众量、处理付款或管理其他账户。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知账户、地区、运行环境和重要限制均在介绍内说明；未公开的价格、额度、许可和权限细节仍未核验。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects a streamer's RaidRunner account to inspect raid-train events, upcoming claimed time slots and complete lineups, or find public events to join. It can claim or release slots, enter waitlists and handle slot-trade requests, so it includes schedule-changing actions rather than only discovery. Access is restricted to the connected user's account. Check the event, time zone and organizer rules before changing a commitment, and distinguish a waitlist or trade request from a confirmed slot. The page does not describe broadcasting control, audience guarantees, payment handling or cross-account administration.

plugins.description_zh: 管理 Whatnot 直播接力
plugins.overview_zh: 在用户时区中展示 Whatnot 接力活动、挑战、个人时段和待办，并按组织者或参与者身份显示不同信息及原活动链接。帮助答案来自实际帮助文档。创建新活动时逐项收集信息、与联系人核对邀请名单，并在创建前展示完整方案；默认只读，除非明确要求更改，权限不超出已连接账户。上线前应仔细确认时间、名单和安排，不能把组织者权限默认赋给参与者。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Shows Whatnot raid-train schedules, challenges, personal slots and outstanding tasks in the user's time zone, with role-specific detail and links back to events. Help answers draw from the service's documentation. For a new train or challenge, it gathers the plan step by step, checks invitees against contacts and presents the complete proposal before creation. plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects to a TikTok Shop affiliate program through Reacher to analyze GMV, creators, videos, samples, campaigns and outreach automation across one or more shops. It can help discover creators and assemble evidence for performance reporting. Writing actions, such as starting an automation or replying to a creator, are separately labeled and confirmed before execution. Moving money is unavailable through ChatGPT. Check shop scope and recipient details, since an outreach action is an external communication, not just analysis. Sales metrics depend on the stored/live Reacher data and should be interpreted with their attribution context.

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Retrieves meeting history, summaries, transcripts, questions and action items from Read AI, covering its meeting assistant for Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. It also describes dispatching a meeting agent into a live call and emailing reports to teammates. These are distinct actions: searching existing notes does not itself authorize recording a new meeting or sharing its contents. Verify meeting access, participant expectations and recipients before those steps. Notes may contain transcription or summarization errors. This entry was verified from a complete official indexed page containing the exact selected ID, developer and version.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 Read Frog 学习空间，搜索单词及阅读笔记、查看笔记库结构、模板、复习历史和统计；获得相应权限后可新增修改笔记、记录复习并调整学习设置。需要已有 Ultra 权益的账户，授权细分到账户、笔记库、笔记、模板及学习操作。删除字段、模板、笔记或整库可能连带移除学习内容，不只是隐藏界面。破坏性操作前应核对对象和影响，页面未保证自动恢复。

With selected permissions, it can create or update notes, record reviews and alter study settings. An account with existing Ultra access is required. Authorization is granular, covering account, notebases, notes, templates and study actions. Deleting a note, field, template or entire notebase can remove related learning material, not merely hide a view. Review the selected object and downstream effect before destructive changes; this description does not establish automatic recovery.

It can inspect projects, monitor generation progress and handle non-sensitive clarification questions. Complex work is deliberately divided into a page or another independently checkable task at a time, which makes intermediate review important. The description establishes creation and refinement, not automatic verification of every link, accessibility feature, backend or published deployment. Check the generated content, responsive behavior and intended project before accepting changes; domain, hosting, commercial plan and publishing details are not specified here.

plugins.overview_zh: 根据两人的出生日期、城市及可选出生时间，用产品自定义的“温度”和“湿度”隐喻展示关系预览，完整解读需跳转原站，并携带已填资料。这属于解释性娱乐体验，不是科学验证的好感、同意或匹配度测量，不能据此判断他人真实情感。出生资料随跳转交给服务属于额外披露；预览也没有证明后续解读的价格或完整范围。

The detailed reading is opened on its own site with the supplied details prefilled. This is an interpretive entertainment experience, not a scientifically established measure of another person's affection, consent or compatibility. Avoid treating a generated gauge as evidence about someone's private feelings. Sharing birth details in the linked experience is a separate disclosure to that service; the preview does not establish the price or scope of any further reading.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: Readplace 官方指南介绍保存网址、查看阅读队列、读取文章清洁正文与摘要、发现相关收藏、整理清单并标记已读/未读。需要 OAuth 登录；助手不能删除文章，删除须在 Readplace 应用完成。官网确认 ChatGPT 条目，但没有显示本条精确目录 ID。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: Readplace’s official MCP guide describes saving URLs, listing reading queues, reading clean article text and summaries, finding related saves, organizing readlists and marking items read/unread. OAuth sign-in is required. The assistant cannot delete articles; deletion remains in the Readplace app. The vendor confirms a ChatGPT listing, but the selected catalog ID is not visible.

It can help explain why one itinerary fits better rather than simply listing flights. The page describes a Book action but does not detail payment handling, ticketing guarantees or carrier-specific change and refund rules. Review the complete itinerary, baggage allowance, passenger requirements and final total at the actual booking step. Search recommendations are not a confirmed reservation, and availability can change before ticket issuance.

The publisher uses a true-random positioning, but the page does not explain the entropy source, auditability, cryptographic certification or fairness controls for a formal draw. Ensure the input list is complete and handles duplicates as intended. Do not infer suitability for security keys, regulated gambling or legally consequential allocation merely from the word random in the product description.

plugins.overview_zh: 按预算、卧室、浴室和其他条件搜索澳大利亚待售房产，提供排序、地图、照片及说明，也可收藏或协助联系经纪人。这是发现与联系功能，不是估价、产权调查或完成购房。价格及可售状态仍须向挂牌方确认，联系经纪人可能披露个人资料。页面明确列出平台条款、隐私政策及 Google Maps 的独立条款；公开范围是买房，不应扩展成所有租赁或交易流程。

It can help save a favorite or connect a prospective buyer with the agent. This is discovery and contact support, not an appraisal, title investigation or completed purchase. Listing prices and availability need checking with the advertiser, and contacting an agent may share personal information. The page expressly refers to realestate.com.au's terms/privacy policy and separate Google Maps terms. Coverage described here is buying property, not every possible rental or transaction workflow.

plugins.description_zh: 现金流与投资回报率分析
plugins.overview_zh: 根据输入数字计算出租或投资物业的净营运收益、资本化率、现金回报率、内部收益率及二十年收益情景，适合出价前检查经济性和假设影响。长期投影是模型情景，不保证实际发生。租金、空置、融资、维修、税费、交易成本和增长率都应独立验证。页面没有证明具备市场数据校验、个人投资建议、估价资质或执行地产交易的能力。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Calculates rental-property investment measures from numbers you enter, including operating income, capitalization rate, cash-on-cash return, internal rate of return and a twenty-year projection. It is useful for exploring how a prospective property's economics respond to assumptions before making an offer. A long-range projection is a modeled scenario, not a forecast guaranteed to occur. Verify rent, vacancy, financing, maintenance, taxes, transaction costs and growth assumptions independently. The page does not establish market-data validation, individualized investment advice, appraisal credentials or any ability to execute a property transaction.

plugins.overview_zh: 集中展示 Chemnitz 及周边地区的精选住宅、公寓、土地和投资物业，以交互地图帮助比较位置、基础设施及邻里，并结合本地经纪经验。范围是区域性业务，不代表德国全国或全部市场覆盖。完整页面没有列出成交执行、法律尽调或自动估价功能。选中房源后仍需专业核对可售状态、价格、产权、规划限制和合同条款，不能把地图比较当作完整尽调。

Location and surrounding infrastructure are central to its comparison workflow, supported by the agency's described local expertise. This is a regional offering, not nationwide or exhaustive market coverage. The complete page does not enumerate transaction execution, legal due diligence or automatic valuation tools. Verify current availability, asking price, ownership, planning constraints and contractual terms with the relevant professionals before relying on an attractive listing or location-based comparison.

plugins.overview_zh: 按主题、标题或文号搜索阿联酋已发布法律，可按辖区、机关、文种及法律领域筛选，获取全文、元数据、来源链接及新闻摘要。法律工具需要已连接且持有效 Professional 或 Team 订阅的账户，可查询当前访问状态。检索结果不是个人法律意见，也不保证翻译摘要充分反映现行效力。实际依赖前须核对权威原文、修订、生效日和适用辖区。

It can retrieve document text, metadata and source links, and explore legislative news or digests in a conversational workflow. Legislation tools require a connected realLaw AI account with an active Professional or Team subscription; access status can be checked. Retrieval is not personalized legal advice or a guarantee that a translated summary captures current enforceability. Verify the authoritative document, amendments, effective dates and jurisdiction before relying on an interpretation.

plugins.description_zh: 评估拉丁美洲扩张适配度
plugins.overview_zh: 把拉美扩张评估整理为首选国家、买家、渠道、方案、试验及继续/迭代/停止标准，并用输入数据比较准备度、单笔贡献、盈亏平衡销量和已观察获客成本。关键区别是 MCP 服务器只处理状态和数字，不抓网站或核实证据；公开研究依赖会话中的浏览工具，没有时只用用户材料并说明局限。无需账户或 CRM，不执行活动、不外联，也不保证需求、收入或合规。结果是待检验商业试验，不是已经验证成功。

It supports readiness comparisons and supplied-number calculations such as contribution margin, break-even volume and observed acquisition cost. The MCP server does not browse or verify evidence; research depends on tools available in the conversation, otherwise it uses your inputs and states that limitation. No account or CRM connection is needed. It does not launch campaigns, contact prospects or promise demand, revenue or regulatory compliance. Treat the result as a bounded business experiment, not validation already obtained.

It can begin the RealOpen purchase workflow, but actual conversion of crypto and transfer of fiat to the seller or escrow take place outside ChatGPT through RealOpen. A letter is not a completed purchase or a guarantee of transaction acceptance. Review identity requirements, valuation timing, fees, settlement arrangements and legal terms in the actual service. This public description does not authorize handling wallet secrets, signing transactions or moving assets.

The description does not establish that the avatar represents a real person, can call third parties, or provides a particular professional qualification. Voice/video permissions, recording practices, available avatars, session length and pricing are not specified on the page. Confirm the actual privacy and media settings before sharing sensitive information in a session.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 RealtyAds 地产营销，公开举例包括创建编辑保存广告、查看效果、获取报告及咨询产品支持。发布者笼统称门户功能可在聊天中使用，但具体只列这些例子，不能推断所有投放权限或预算操作均开放。编辑会影响真实广告资产，应区分分析、草稿和发布/预算变更。核对物业、账户、归因日期及审批要求，访客报告也不等于可任意读取个人身份。

Editing an advertisement may affect real marketing assets, so separate analysis and draft preparation from publication or budget changes. Verify the property, account scope, attribution dates and approval requirements; visitor-related reporting should not be treated as unrestricted access to individuals' identities.

The complete description is brief and does not specify editions, amendment coverage, jurisdictional adoption, licensing or the extent of quoted text. A code answer is not a permit, certified design review or assurance of compliance. Check the governing edition, local amendments and authoritative language with the responsible qualified professional before applying a construction requirement.

This is a learning-content workflow, not the separate meeting-data product Recall.ai or the recall-alert tool Recall Scout. Card quality depends on the source material and generated answers; review factual accuracy and avoid treating a scheduled review as proof of mastery. The page does not specify import limits, account tiers, deletion recovery or guarantees about audio generation despite illustrative prompts mentioning audio.

plugins.overview_zh: 查询 NHTSA 与 CPSC 的车辆、轮胎、儿童安全座椅、设备及消费品召回信息，发布者称每日更新、免费，并附危险、补救措施和官方链接。明确不覆盖 FDA 管辖的食品、药品和医疗器械。查不到结果不代表安全或未受影响，必须按型号、年份、序列号或 VIN 核对官方公告，并遵循机构或厂商的原始补救说明。

Food, drugs and medical devices under FDA coverage are explicitly excluded. A missing search match is not proof that an item is safe or unaffected; confirm the exact model, year, serial number or VIN against the official notice. Follow the manufacturer's or agency's remedy instructions rather than substituting a summary for the original warning.

Respect workspace access and meeting confidentiality, verify timestamps and delivery logs, and do not assume a diagnostic explanation means a bot was restarted or missing recording data was recovered.

The description does not establish calendar synchronization, automated reminders, diagnostic testing validity or access to learning materials beyond what the user supplies.

It can turn saved recipes into meal plans or grocery checklists, update trip notes and add reminders or sharing actions. Cook Mode features such as step tracking and timers belong to the Recalo app. Shared lists and reminders are distinct actions, not implicit consequences of search. Verify recipients and the items being changed; the page does not prove universal import support, offline access or unlimited storage across every advertised surface.

plugins.overview_zh: 读取本人 Receivo 的发票、逾期金额、客户及收款记录；连接时另行授权后，可新增客户和发票，但发票一律保存为草稿，由用户回到 Receivo 复核发送。不能发票外发、邮件联系、收取或移动款项、改套餐、编辑已有资料或删除内容。它是有明确边界的开票准备工具，不是自动催收。权限与用户一致，保存前仍要核对客户和金额，记录中的收款也不等于独立银行核验。

If separately permitted during connection, it can add clients and create invoices, but every invoice is saved as a draft for the user to review and send within Receivo. It cannot send invoices or email, collect or move payments, change the subscription, edit existing items or delete anything. This makes it a bounded invoicing-preparation tool, not autonomous debt collection. Account permissions match the connected user; check client and invoice details before saving a draft, and distinguish recorded payments from bank verification.

plugins.overview_zh: 把对话中的完整食谱整理成含材料用量、份数、时间和全部步骤的卡片，在 ChatGPT 内阅读复制无需账户。若要存入 iPhone/iPad 的 Receptly，需打开导入链接并在应用确认，不会悄悄写入手机。可附实际提供的图片文件，临时传输链接有效 24 小时；工具只传图片，不负责生成。它也不能通过 ChatGPT 读取或修改已有私人食谱库。

No account is needed to use that card in ChatGPT. Saving into an iPhone/iPad Receptly collection requires opening the import link and confirming in the app; the chat does not silently write to the phone. Optional images must be actual supplied files, with temporary transfer links lasting 24 hours. The plugin transfers images rather than generating them, and cannot browse or modify an existing private recipe collection through ChatGPT.

plugins.overview_zh: 把 Meta 和 Google 广告的钩子、主题、形式、主张及行动号召等创意标签与已保存效果分析关联，并比较指定竞争者的公开广告、提出测试方向；不混加无法统一的币种。范围限于选定 Reckon 工作区，广告账户须由管理员连接。不能暂停广告、改预算或发布，少量写入只发生在 Reckon 内且先确认。相关性不是因果，也不表示拿到竞争者私密收益，投放决策需进一步测试。

It also studies named competitors' public ads and proposes test candidates; incompatible currencies are not silently combined. Access is limited to the selected Reckon workspace, with ad accounts connected by an administrator. It cannot pause ads, change budgets or publish. Its limited writes stay within Reckon and require confirmation. Observed correlations are not causal proof or competitors' private financial results; recommendations need controlled testing before spending decisions.

Its broader database covers companies, people, documents and ownership links, but the visible integration material does not establish all those datasets as plugin tools, current completeness or licensing. No exact-ID bridge was recovered.

plugins.description_zh: 审查 PRIIPs 关键信息文件数据
plugins.overview_zh: 用获授权 PRIIPs 引擎按产品数据算风险情景成本，比较已刊 KID 与新值以标记数值型第十五条复核触发，返回结构化结果覆盖轨迹。支持审阅非监管批准；输入引擎权限及适用要求须专业复核，非投资意见或合规保证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需授权引擎及准确产品输入，数值复核触发非监管批准投资意见完整合规认证。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Calculates risk, performance-scenario and cost figures from supplied financial-product data using an authorized PRIIPs engine. It compares published KID values with newly calculated ones to flag numeric Article 15 review triggers, returning structured outputs, coverage and calculation traces. It supports document-review analysis rather than issuing regulatory clearance. Input quality, engine authorization and jurisdiction-specific requirements need professional review; the result is not investment advice or a guarantee of KID compliance.

plugins.overview_zh: 对获授权目标做有限静态检查、评估所供同意流程证据并取确定性跟踪修复指南，区分已观察与待核，非完整实时审计。只查有权测试站点，明确不认证合法合规，建议不证明已改站或验证成功。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅获授权目标及所供同意证据，静态检查修复指南不认证合规或证明已执行。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Performs a bounded static inspection of an authorized target, evaluates supplied consent-flow evidence and retrieves deterministic remediation playbooks for tracking issues. It helps organize what is observed and what still needs verification, rather than claiming a complete live audit. Only sites the user is permitted to test should be inspected. The description explicitly does not certify legal compliance, and recommended remediation does not itself establish that a site was changed or validated.

plugins.overview_zh: 按长短租、BRRRR、翻修转售、多户、新建六策略建模，输入数字得评分指标压力情景、公开假设分享报告，可比较用途反算达收益目标最高价。均软件估算非财务建议，投资前须核假设本地成本原始数值。
plugins.requirements_zh: 审输入补充假设压力场景本地成本，评分最高价是估算非财务意见回报保证。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 仅核验发布者公开描述，不代表已实测功能、质量或宣传保证。具体限制见自写介绍及使用条件。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Models a property under six strategies, including long- and short-term rentals, BRRRR, flipping, multifamily and new construction. Supplied figures produce a score, strategy metrics, stress tests, disclosed assumptions and a shareable report; it can compare uses or solve for a maximum price meeting a return target. All results are software estimates, not financial advice. Assumptions, local costs and source figures must be checked before any investment decision.

plugins.description_zh: 查找和更新 CRM 记录
plugins.overview_zh: 连接单个 Relaticle Cloud 工作区搜公司人员机会任务笔记、总结销售管线并回查链接，可建关联笔记改交易阶段金额含自定义字段。OAuth 可撤且限单工作区，发布者称不用于广告训练；写入需授权，隐私声明未独立审计。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需 Cloud 账户 OAuth、单工作区可撤；核记录写入，不广告不训练声明未独立审计。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects one Relaticle Cloud workspace to search companies, people, opportunities, tasks and notes, summarize pipelines and follow record links. It creates linked notes and updates deal stages or amounts, including existing custom fields. OAuth access is revocable and restricted to a single workspace; the publisher states CRM data is not used for advertising or model training. Actual writes need appropriate authority, and the privacy statement was not independently audited.

plugins.overview_zh: 帮助理解私人对话、选回复目标并为亲密家人朋友约会冲突起草不同语气，保留本人声音界限，鼓励诚实尊重而非施压欺骗监视。草稿不代表发送、访问他人账户或准确读心，也不保证关系结果。
plugins.requirements_zh: 诚实尊重保留界限；非欺骗监视自动发送读心或保证关系结果。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Helps interpret a personal conversation, choose the purpose of a reply and draft tone alternatives for relationships, family, friendship, dating or ordinary conflict. It preserves the user's voice and boundaries while encouraging honest, respectful communication rather than pressure, deception or surveillance. Drafting does not establish message sending, access to another person's account or reliable knowledge of their intentions. It offers communication support, not guaranteed relationship outcomes.

plugins.overview_zh: 通过 MCP 为系统管理员提供 Relativity aiR 事项管理、工作区配置、授权及用量审阅，不只是普通文档搜索。需管理员权限及系统允许；授权配置可能暴露敏感法律资料或影响同事，介绍本身不授权变更也不证明已连接。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需系统管理员及现有权限，授权配置变更另审批保护案件敏感资料。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Provides system administrators an MCP-based route to Relativity aiR administration, including managing matters, configuring workspaces, granting access and reviewing system usage. These are organizational administration capabilities rather than general document search alone. Existing administrator authority and the connected system's permissions are prerequisites. Access grants and configuration changes can expose sensitive legal material or affect colleagues; describing the connector does not authorize any such change or prove a deployed connection.

plugins.overview_zh: 让体能教练用私人 Relay 数据找运动员动作、看日历结果、建分配计划、改训练并推进周期处方，含真实记录写入。正文不证明临床评估或任意运动员访问；教练需审适用性和资料权限。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需授权教练访问，计划分配训练是真变更；先审运动员适用隐私。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Lets strength-and-conditioning coaches use their private Relay records to find athletes and exercises, review calendars and workout results, build or assign programs, edit workouts and progress prescriptions across a training block. It supports coaching administration and planning, with real writes to training records. The description does not establish clinical assessment or permission to access every athlete; coaches must review suitability and ensure account access and athlete-data handling are authorized.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: RelayPlay 官方 FAQ 说明可选的 ChatGPT 插件用于发现播客并准备经确认的导入，也可识别提供的截图。Flow 和 Moments 分别自愿授权共享，片段音频不会上传。插件不能播放、暂停或拖动进度，文字识别和提取结果可能错误；未对应精确目录 ID。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: RelayPlay’s official FAQ says the optional ChatGPT plugin discovers podcasts and prepares confirmed imports, including recognition of supplied screenshots. Flow and Moments context have separate opt-in sharing; moment audio is not uploaded. It cannot play, pause or seek in the player, and transcript/findings may be wrong. Exact catalog-ID mapping is not established.

plugins.overview_zh: 用 RelayShield 情报筛网址、加密钱包、可疑邮件邮箱的钓鱼恶意软件制裁诈骗和泄露迹象，四工具只读免注册密钥。结果只有标记或未知，绝不称安全；无证据非无风险，语料数量非完整性，私信邮箱提交仍需授权。
plugins.requirements_zh: 免费只读免注册密钥，仅标记或未知绝不安全，覆盖不完整；私信内容未经授权不外传。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Screens URLs, crypto wallets, suspicious emails and email addresses against RelayShield threat intelligence for phishing, malware, sanctions/scam indicators and known breaches. Four tools are read-only and need no signup or API key. Results are explicitly flagged or unknown, never safe: missing evidence is not proof of safety. Published corpus counts describe coverage rather than completeness, and submitting private email contents or addresses still requires appropriate authorization.

plugins.description_zh: 检查发布说明覆盖情况
plugins.overview_zh: 只从本次所供变更清单交付报告提交摘要测试结果提结构化发布项，再对所供发布说明，带证据标已覆盖缺失矛盾。不访问仓库跑测试验证实现、改说明或发布；完整性限所给文字非全项目历史。
plugins.requirements_zh: 只分析本次文字，无仓库测试实现核验改写发布；未提供变更难可靠检测。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Extracts structured release items from the change lists, delivery reports, commit summaries and test results supplied in the current request, then compares them with supplied release notes. It flags covered, missing or inconsistent descriptions with source evidence for review. The tool does not access repositories, run tests, verify implementation, rewrite notes or publish a release. Completeness is bounded by the text provided, not the real project's entire change history.

plugins.overview_zh: 用 C#、TS/JS、PHP、Java 的 API SDK 指导构建审查排错 Relewise 搜索推荐行为跟踪数据集成。是开发辅助，不证明已装部署；实施需项目工具权限，跟踪须守同意数据政策，生成改动和版本指导需核。
plugins.requirements_zh: 支持四语言体系，实现需项目宿主权限，跟踪需同意且指导应匹配部署版本。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Helps build, review and troubleshoot Relewise Search, Recommendations, behavioral tracking and data integrations using API and SDK guidance for C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP and Java. It is a developer-assistance workflow rather than proof that an integration is installed or deployed. Appropriate project access and supported tooling are required for implementation, while tracking must respect consent and data policies. Generated changes and purportedly current guidance should be checked against the target version.

plugins.overview_zh: 搜私人 Relic 的书、高亮笔记词汇阅读活动，并把新词释义存词典。写入仅词典，不能删书高亮笔记词；需有效订阅或试用。用于回顾已有材料，不等于无限电子书获取、任改库或购书。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需有效订阅试用；读私人库仅写词典，不能删书高亮笔记词或改其他内容。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches a private Relic reading library for books, highlights, notes, saved words and reading activity, and saves new vocabulary with meanings to the dictionary. Write access is limited to that dictionary; the connector cannot delete books, highlights, notes or words. An active Relic subscription or trial is required. It supports reflecting on existing reading material, not unlimited ebook retrieval, editing all library content or purchasing books.

plugins.overview_zh: 把明确提供的经常家庭成本归一为月额，与净收入储备比较作搬迁预算，不抓生活成本；服务器计算暂存，独立网站本地算且审阅后导出 CSV/JSON。无持久账户、外取发送交易付费模型，MCP 请求响应限 128/256 KiB 并有字段记录限，依所给假设。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅明确结构化输入，不抓生活费、不持久账户外发交易付费模型；审网站导出，MCP 128/256 KiB 及字段记录限。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Normalizes explicitly supplied recurring household costs to monthly amounts and compares them with supplied net income and a reserve for relocation planning. It fetches no cost-of-living data and keeps server computation transient; the standalone website calculates locally and offers reviewed CSV/JSON export. There are no persistent accounts, external retrieval, sends, transactions or paid model calls. MCP request/response limits are 128/256 KiB, with additional field and record caps; output depends entirely on supplied assumptions.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 Relvato 配置运行网站监控、看健康性能结果，并应用 WordPress 建议修复或漏洞插件更新及回滚，可认可预期视觉变化并撤销。须证所有权且限账户，改前询问；文件完整性脚本 DNS 审批、改通知人、秘密删除计费均不开放。监控回滚不保证生产结账不受影响。
plugins.requirements_zh: 不能跳所有权证明，改前询问；不批完整性脚本 DNS、不改收件人、不取秘密删数据计费；仍限账户及生产风险。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects Relvato to configure and run website monitors, review health, performance and findings, and apply a proposed WordPress fix or vulnerable-plugin update with rollback. It can accept intended visual changes with undo. Site ownership must be proved and account limits apply. Change tools ask first; file-integrity, script and DNS approvals, alert-recipient changes, secrets, deletion and billing remain outside the connector. Monitor or rollback claims are not a guarantee against disruption, especially on checkout or production sites.

plugins.description_zh: 寻找各地骑行和跑步路线

plugins.overview_zh: 按位置价格类型房间面积设施视觉特征搜奥德瑞 REMAX 住宅，统计匹配并可按三个国家站的房源 URL 取详情，含币种图片经纪联系。是房源研究非约看或交易，限三市场，资料有效性需与经纪核对。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅奥德瑞公开房源，核币种经纪有效性，未证明约看交易。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches residential REMAX listings in Austria, Germany and Switzerland by location, price, type, rooms, size, amenities and visual attributes. It counts matching properties and retrieves a specific listing from an observed remax.at, remax.de or remax.ch URL, returning public facts, currency, images and broker contacts. This is listing research, not booking a viewing or transacting. Coverage is those three markets, and listing accuracy and availability need confirmation with the broker.

plugins.overview_zh: 查二十五欧洲国家 REMAX 买卖租赁、住宅商业房源，自然语言筛选最多一百结果，可按价面积排序，三十二语言显示。详情含照片轮播译文经纪联系方式来源链接；不是预订，需核覆盖翻译有效性最终条款。
plugins.requirements_zh: 描述二十五国、最多一百结果、三十二语言，核来源翻译经纪条款，看详情非订房产。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches live REMAX listings across 25 European countries, including sale or rental and residential or commercial property. Natural-language filters produce up to 100 results with photos, prices and facts, sortable by price or size and viewable in 32 languages. Detail views add a photo carousel, description translation, agent contact and a source link. Search results are not reservations; coverage, translation quality, availability and final terms require independent checking.

plugins.description_en: Find homes for sale or rent
plugins.overview_zh: 按地点预算房间等偏好查土耳其 RE/MAX 住宅商业土地，结果摘要价格面积房间位置，照片完整详情及负责门店联系方式在原站打开。描述是找公开挂牌，非约看出价购房，须与门店核有效性条件。
plugins.requirements_zh: 仅土耳其库，到原站看全详情联系并核条款，未证明出价预约购买。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Searches the RE/MAX Türkiye portfolio for homes, commercial spaces and land using stated location, budget, room count and other preferences. Results summarize price, size, rooms and location, while full photos, details and the responsible office's contact information are opened on remax.com.tr. The described workflow is finding published listings, not scheduling viewings, submitting offers or buying property. Local availability, terms and accuracy should be confirmed with the listing office.

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: RemDo 官网确认 ChatGPT 可经 MCP 读取链接指向的文档，并在授权后追加笔记。产品是早期开发中的关联大纲笔记工具；邮件、日历及文件连接仍是未来计划，不是已具备能力。单独分享链接不会赋予文档权限；未桥接精确 ID。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: RemDo’s official site confirms that ChatGPT can read linked RemDo documents and append notes after approval through MCP. It is an early-development outliner with linked notes; email, calendar and file integrations are explicitly future work, not current capabilities. Sharing a link alone does not grant document access. Exact selected-ID linkage is missing.

plugins.description_zh: 让 AI 草稿读起来更自然

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: Rephrasy 官方 ChatGPT 指南介绍草稿改写、Studio 并排编辑、修改对比和 AI 概率评分。使用已连接账户余额，每次最多 12,000 字符，可保留原语言或指定语言。评分只是统计估计，不能证明作者身份，也不应伪装学业作品来源；未桥接精确 ID。

It uses the connected Rephrasy account’s balance, accepts up to 12,000 characters per request and supports the original or requested language. Scores are statistical estimates, not proof of authorship; dishonest academic use is discouraged. Exact-ID linkage is missing.
official_product_supplement.requirements_zh: 已知条件见介绍。未列明的价格、额度、权限、地区、许可及账户要求仍未核验；没有尝试连接。

Records can be grouped by property, category, participant or date and sync to the mobile/web apps. An active Premium subscription must be purchased separately outside ChatGPT. It is documentation support, not confirmation that recorded hours qualify for tax status; privacy remains account-scoped and hours should reflect actual work.

plugins.overview_zh: 取五十多平台标准化评论、情感翻译摘要评分历史并比监控竞品，可加资料标签及管理新评评分事件签名 webhook。沿本人 API 账户额度价格，宣传十天免卡试用。AI 情感摘要须核，webhook 配置是持久集成非只读。
plugins.requirements_zh: 本人 API 账户密钥额度价格，宣传十天免卡；审 AI 解释，持久 webhook 目的权限另授权。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Retrieves normalized reviews from more than fifty platforms, with sentiment labels, translation, profile summaries, rating history and comparisons to monitored competitors. It adds profiles, tags reviews and manages signed webhooks for new-review or rating events. Calls use the user's Repuso Monitoring API account, quotas and pricing; a ten-day no-card trial is advertised. AI sentiment and summaries need review, while webhook configuration is a persistent integration rather than a harmless read.

plugins.description_zh: 记录时间并管理专注状态

official_product_supplement.overview_zh: RescueTime MCP 分析个人活动和项目用时，额外 OAuth 权限可控制专注/计时及活动分类。它不是团队分析模式，不能修改设置或项目记录。普通用时报告最多 45 天、项目历史最多 366 天；API 密钥连接保持只读。未确立精确目录 ID。
official_product_supplement.overview_en: RescueTime’s MCP analyzes personal activity and project-time history, with optional OAuth permissions for focus/timer control and activity categorization. It is not a team-analysis mode and cannot edit settings or project records. Reports have bounded ranges: other tracked-time reports 45 days, project history 366 days. API-key connections remain read-only. Exact catalog ID was not established.

plugins.overview_zh: 把技术产品问题交给证据优先研究流程并返回有依据结果，不擅改成实施。是研究技能非已部署服务或改仓库代理，效果依可用来源宿主工具，此处未测。来源时效不确定应保留，研究不授权构建安装发布。
plugins.requirements_zh: 证据研究非实施，限宿主工具来源；保留日期不确定链接，不推定部署授权。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Routes technical or product questions into an evidence-first research workflow and returns grounded findings without turning the request into implementation. It is a research-oriented skill rather than a deployed research service or repository-changing agent. Useful output depends on accessible sources and suitable host research tools, which were not tested here. Source quality, currency and unresolved uncertainty should remain visible, and research alone does not authorize building, installing or publishing anything.

plugins.overview_zh: 规划研究核源建立主张来源轨迹，写技术文章文档报告及平台改编稿，可比产品查过时事实并分事实分析不确定日期，技术优先一手来源。不编引用是目标非准确保证；可发表稿仍是草稿，外发工具权限素材权利另核。
plugins.requirements_zh: 核来源日期主张，可发表草稿非发布许可；工具引用有效及复用权仍须核。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Plans research, verifies sources, builds claim-to-source trails and turns evidence into technical articles, documentation, reports or platform-adapted drafts. It compares products, checks stale claims and distinguishes facts, analysis, uncertainty and source dates, favoring primary sources for current technical details. The publisher's no-invented-citations aim is not an accuracy guarantee. Publication-ready content is still a draft: external posting, tool access and rights to reuse source material require separate checks.

plugins.overview_zh: Research Assistant 组合学术、网页、产品及竞品研究和证据综合，可细化问题、评估来源、比较观点、识别分歧与研究缺口，并给出带来源的结论。不编造引文是其流程目标，不是正确性保证；仍应检查原文与来源可访问性。
plugins.requirements_zh: 已知条件见介绍。未列明的价格、额度、权限、地区、许可及账户要求仍未核验；没有尝试连接。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Research Assistant combines academic, web, product and competitor research with evidence synthesis. It refines questions, evaluates sources, compares claims, identifies disagreements and gaps, and produces source-linked conclusions. Avoiding invented citations is its stated workflow goal, not a guarantee of correctness; source access and fact checking remain necessary.

plugins.overview_zh: 查比研究、核主张质量解释统计提数据以写综述系统综述计划，支持检索策略缺口和主要引用格式。来源验证广泛覆盖主张仍须核，重大决策尤其如此。回答可能含披露的推广链接，应与证据选择分清，不保证全面无偏。
plugins.requirements_zh: 核研究质量真源范围，可能有披露推广链接；不保证穷尽无偏或准确。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Finds and compares research, checks claims, evaluates study quality, explains statistics and extracts information for literature reviews, systematic-review plans and evidence-based writing. It also helps with search strategies, gaps and major citation styles. Verified-source and broad-coverage claims need independent checking, especially for consequential decisions. Responses may contain a disclosed affiliate link, which should be distinguished from evidence selection; the tool is not a guarantee of exhaustive or bias-free scholarship.

plugins.description_zh: 将研究转化为可核查结果
plugins.overview_zh: 提供产品科学设备故障市场技术的可移植研究流程，强调来源核对因果纪律和实施行动计划交接，随请求语言回应并带工作原则。交接不证明已实施市场操作；未确立专用数据库保证结论独立实验，仍限证据宿主工具。
plugins.requirements_zh: 按请求语言可移植研究、限证据；交接非已执行实施实验金融操作。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Provides a portable research process for products, science, device failures, markets and technology, emphasizing source checks, causal discipline and implementation or action-plan handoffs. It responds in the request's language and includes working-principle guidance. A handoff is not proof that implementation or market action has occurred. The page does not establish dedicated database access, guaranteed conclusions or independent experiments; actual research remains bounded by available evidence and host tools.

plugins.overview_zh: 检查技术问题机制证据对齐，并以有证据边界、一致术语、精简 Elsevier/COMPAG 风格改科学稿。是论证审阅编辑，非实验验证期刊背书；保留真实数据定义不确定并对研究核稿，不证明提交录用或创造新证据。
plugins.requirements_zh: 论证审改非实验证明期刊背书，保留数据范围；未证明录用代交新证据。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Checks alignment among a technical problem, proposed mechanism and supporting evidence, then helps revise scientific manuscripts with bounded claims, consistent terms and concise Elsevier/COMPAG-style prose. It is an argument-auditing and editing workflow rather than experimental validation or journal endorsement. Authors should preserve real data, definitions and uncertainty and check every revision against the underlying study. The description does not establish submission, acceptance or creation of new evidence.

plugins.description_zh: 面向开发者的邮件服务
plugins.overview_zh: Resend 使用用户自己的 Resend 凭据，支持事务邮件发送、投递及请求日志检查，以及受众、域名、模板、群发、自动化、Webhook、API 密钥和 OAuth 授权管理。这包含真实写入及安全相关操作，不只是起草；权限、发送额度和费用取决于账户。

These include consequential write and security operations, not just drafting. Actual authorization, sending quotas and costs depend on the connected account.

plugins.overview_zh: 连接 ChatGPT/Codex 查警报调查、开根因分析追问、用本地上下文指导过程，变更前取生产概况并把发现转本地改码 PR。需系统仓库权限；生产资料和根因建议不自动授权部署，代码 PR 外部影响须批准验证。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需授权 Resolve 仓库工具，生产上下文调查改码 PR 范围不同，不推定自动部署运营批准。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Connects ChatGPT or Codex to Resolve AI for alert review, investigation summaries, new root-cause analyses, follow-up questions and steering active investigations with local context. It can retrieve production profiles before a change and translate findings into local code changes and a pull request. These engineering actions need connected-system and repository permissions. Production context and proposed root causes are not blanket authority to deploy fixes; code, PR creation and external operational effects require appropriate approval and validation.

plugins.overview_zh: 用证据优先写作、ATS 取向格式及可重复评分卡创建审核定制简历职业材料，改进真实经历表达而非编资历。短文未证明独立核履历、特定筛选结果、代申请或就业安置。逐项核主张职位要求，ATS 格式不保证通过。
plugins.requirements_zh: 用真实经历职位要求，ATS 格式评分卡不认证雇主通过核履历代交录用。

plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Creates, audits and tailors resumes and other career documents using evidence-first wording, ATS-oriented formatting choices and a repeatable quality report card. It supports improving how genuine experience is presented rather than inventing credentials. The short description does not establish independent verification of employment history, a particular employer's screening result, application submission or job placement. Review every claim and use the target role's actual requirements; ATS-safe choices are not guaranteed acceptance.

plugins.overview_zh: Respond.io 将客户对话工作带入 ChatGPT，支持查找和管理联系人、查看消息历史、审阅及发送客户消息、调整对话负责人或状态、整理工作区资料，以及配置 AI 代理。适合先了解客户互动背景，再在同一流程中执行获准的客服操作。
plugins.requirements_zh: 公开正文未列出全部渠道、额度或细分权限。发送消息、分配对话和修改代理配置都会影响正式服务，应核对目标收件人及改动；目录说明本身不授予访问权，也不代表消息已经送达。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Respond.io brings customer-conversation work into ChatGPT. Teams can find and manage contacts, inspect message history, review and send customer messages, change conversation ownership or status, organize workspace information and configure AI agents. This makes it useful for understanding a customer interaction and carrying out the next authorized support action in the same workflow.

plugins.overview_zh: Responsive 将已认证用户连接到获准使用的企业知识及答复管理流程。支持搜索内容、列出或创建 Content Library 问答、查看组织标签和集合、创建或检查分配的项目、起草答案、运行 Answer Agent、管理评论和需求受理记录，以及更新答复工作流，适合利用已有企业资料准备 RFP 等答复。
plugins.requirements_zh: 需要认证并具备相应 Responsive 内容和项目权限。生成答案应按最新获批资料复核，不自动成为已批准的合同承诺；创建问答、项目、评论或修改工作流会改变账户记录，不能推断未说明的导出或外部投递能力。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: Responsive connects authenticated users to approved company knowledge and response-management work. It can search content, list or create Content Library Q&A, inspect organizational tags and collections, create or inspect assigned projects, draft answers, run Answer Agent, manage comments and intakes, and update answer workflows. It is designed to help prepare responses such as RFP answers using the organization's existing information.

plugins.overview_zh: RESTL 按地点、菜系和日期搜索奥地利参与餐厅，显示实际可订时段，并可在对话中创建预约。订单进入餐厅系统后，确认邮件提供取消链接；已有预约可凭预订代码及当时使用的邮箱查询或取消。
plugins.requirements_zh: 无需账户；应用说明不会读取住客档案或其他客人的资料。若餐厅要求信用卡担保，该步骤只能在浏览器中的 restl.at 完成，不在聊天内进行。应核实餐厅预约与取消条件，并以实际确认结果为订位依据。
plugins.detail_verification_scope: 已核对公开说明与条目ID，不代表功能实测、当前可用性或效果。 本次核验发布者公开描述，并非连接后的功能实测、质量保证、账户可用性确认或对宣传数据的独立验证。
plugins.detail_source_paraphrase_en: RESTL searches participating Austrian restaurants by place, cuisine and date, displays actual available time slots and can create a reservation in the conversation. The booking enters the venue's system and a confirmation email includes a cancellation link. Existing reservations can be looked up or cancelled using the booking code together with the email address used for the booking.

plugins.overview_zh: restplass.no 为代理提供访问挪威包机度假与套餐旅行市场的入口。发布者简短正文确认了这一旅行市场连接，条目还包含旅行搜索技能，适合探索度假套餐选择，但不能据此认定所有购买环节都可在聊天内完成。
plugins.requirements_zh: “挪威最大市场”是发布者宣传，本次未独立核实其规模。已观察正文未明确搜索参数、实时价格保证、预订付款步骤、账户要求或费用。
